verses.sanskrit: अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये । नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि
verses.transliteration: agna A yAhi vItaye gR^iNAno havyadAtaye | ni hotA satsi barhiShi
verses.translation: O Agni, come for the enjoyment of the oblation, praised and ready to carry the offering; sit as the priest on the sacred grass.
verses.hindi: हे अग्नि! यज्ञ के आनंद के लिए आओ, स्तुति करते हुए हव्य देने के लिए; पवित्र कुश पर पुरोहित के रूप में बैठो।
verses.wordMeaning: The Sama Veda opens with an invocation of Agni — not merely the fire element but the divine intelligence that illuminates, purifies, and transforms. Agni is the fire of consciousness, the sacred principle that carries human offerings (thoughts, intentions, actions) to the divine. To "invite Agni" is to consciously invite illumination into one's life. The Sama Veda adds music to this invocation — because sound is the most direct path to the divine.
verses.explanation: The Sama Veda opens with an invocation of Agni — not merely the fire element but the divine intelligence that illuminates, purifies, and transforms. Agni is the fire of consciousness, the sacred principle that carries human offerings (thoughts, intentions, actions) to the divine. To "invite Agni" is to consciously invite illumination into one's life. The Sama Veda adds music to this invocation — because sound is the most direct path to the divine.
verses.commentary: The Sama Veda opens with an invocation of Agni — not merely the fire element but the divine intelligence that illuminates, purifies, and transforms. Agni is the fire of consciousness, the sacred principle that carries human offerings (thoughts, intentions, actions) to the divine. To "invite Agni" is to consciously invite illumination into one's life. The Sama Veda adds music to this invocation — because sound is the most direct path to the divine.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने यज्ञानाँ होता विश्वेषाँ हितः । देवेभिर्मानुषे जने
verses.transliteration: tvamagne yaj~nAnA.N hotA vishveShA.N hitaH | devebhirmAnuShe jane
verses.translation: You, O Agni, are the priest of all sacrifices, placed among the gods for the people of men.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: agniM dUtaM vR^iNImahe hotAraM vishvavedasam | asya yaj~nasya sukratum
verses.translation: We choose Agni as messenger, the priest who knows all things, the one skilled in this sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्वृत्राणि जङ्घनद्द्रविणस्युर्विपन्यया । समिद्धः शुक्र आहुतः
verses.transliteration: agnirvR^itrANi ja~NghanaddraviNasyurvipanyayA | samiddhaH shukra AhutaH
verses.translation: Agni, kindled, bright and well-fed with offerings, strikes down obstacles; seeking wealth, he is praised with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिँ स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियम् । अग्ने रथं न वेद्यम्
verses.transliteration: preShThaM vo atithi.N stuShe mitramiva priyam | agne rathaM na vedyam
verses.translation: I praise your dearest guest, beloved like a friend — Agni, who is to be known like a chariot.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने महोभिः पाहि विश्वस्या अरातेः । उत द्विषो मर्त्यस्य
verses.transliteration: tvaM no agne mahobhiH pAhi vishvasyA arAteH | uta dviSho martyasya
verses.translation: O Agni, protect us with your mighty powers from every enemy, and from the mortal who hates us.

verses.sanskrit: एह्यू षु ब्रवाणि तेऽग्न इत्थेतरा गिरः । एभिर्वर्धास इन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration: ehyU Shu bravANi te.agna itthetarA giraH | ebhirvardhAsa indubhiH
verses.translation: Come, let me speak to you, Agni, other words as well; grow strong through these soma-drops.

verses.sanskrit: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् । अग्ने त्वां कामये गिरा
verses.transliteration: A te vatso mano yamatparamAchchitsadhasthAt | agne tvAM kAmaye girA
verses.translation: Your calf has turned its mind to you from the farthest dwelling; O Agni, I long for you with my song.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने पुष्करादध्यथर्वा निरमन्थत । मूर्ध्नो विश्वस्य वाघतः
verses.transliteration: tvAmagne puShkarAdadhyatharvA niramanthata | mUrdhno vishvasya vAghataH
verses.translation: O Agni, Atharvan churned you forth from the lotus leaf, from the head of the whole bearer of offerings.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने विवस्वदा भरास्मभ्यमूतये महे । देवो ह्यसि नो दृशे
verses.transliteration: agne vivasvadA bharAsmabhyamUtaye mahe | devo hyasi no dR^ishe
verses.translation: O Agni, bring to us radiant gifts for our great protection; for you are a god, to be seen by us.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः । अमैरमित्रमर्दय
verses.transliteration: namaste agna ojase gR^iNanti deva kR^iShTayaH | amairamitramardaya
verses.translation: Homage to your might, O Agni; the peoples sing to you, O god. Crush our enemies with your strength.

verses.sanskrit: दूतं वो विश्ववेदसँ हव्यवाहममर्त्यम् । यजिष्ठमृञ्जसे गिरा
verses.transliteration: dUtaM vo vishvavedasa.N havyavAhamamartyam | yajiShThamR^i~njase girA
verses.translation: With song I adorn your messenger, the knower of all, the immortal bearer of offerings, the best of sacrificers.

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः । वायोरनीके अस्थिरन्
verses.transliteration: upa tvA jAmayo giro dedishatIrhaviShkR^itaH | vAyoranIke asthiran
verses.translation: The hymns of the offering-makers approach you like sisters, pointing the way; they have stood before the wind.

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयम् । नमो भरन्त एमसि
verses.transliteration: upa tvAgne divedive doShAvastardhiyA vayam | namo bharanta emasi
verses.translation: O Agni, day by day, morning and evening, with devout thought we come to you bearing homage.

verses.sanskrit: जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय । स्तोमँ रुद्राय दृशीकम्
verses.transliteration: jarAbodha tadviviDDhi vishevishe yaj~niyAya | stoma.N rudrAya dR^ishIkam
verses.translation: Awake the worshipful one; enter each clan for the sake of him who deserves worship — a pleasing hymn to Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: प्रति त्यं चारुमध्वरं गोपीथाय प्र हूयसे । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि
verses.transliteration: prati tyaM chArumadhvaraM gopIthAya pra hUyase | marudbhiragna A gahi
verses.translation: You are invoked to this lovely sacrifice to drink the soma; come, Agni, with the Maruts.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः । सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम्
verses.transliteration: ashvaM na tvA vAravantaM vandadhyA agniM namobhiH | samrAjantamadhvarANAm
verses.translation: I praise you, Agni, like a horse with its mane, with homage — the sovereign of sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: और्वभृगुवच्छुचिमप्नवानवदा हुवे । अग्निँ समुद्रवाससम्
verses.transliteration: aurvabhR^iguvachChuchimapnavAnavadA huve | agni.N samudravAsasam
verses.translation: I call the pure Agni, clothed in the sea, as the Aurva and the Bhrigus did.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमिन्धानो मनसा धियँ सचेत मर्त्यः । अग्निमिन्धे विवस्वभिः
verses.transliteration: agnimindhAno manasA dhiya.N sacheta martyaH | agnimindhe vivasvabhiH
verses.translation: Kindling Agni with the mind, let the mortal gain insight; I kindle Agni together with the Vivasvans.

verses.sanskrit: आदित्प्रत्नस्य रेतसो ज्योतिः पश्यन्ति वासरम् । परो यदिध्यते दिवि
verses.transliteration: Aditpratnasya retaso jyotiH pashyanti vAsaram | paro yadidhyate divi
verses.translation: They behold the light of the ancient seed, the day, when it is kindled high in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमम् । अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते
verses.transliteration: agniM vo vR^idhantamadhvarANAM purUtamam | achChA naptre sahasvate
verses.translation: We invoke Agni, who increases the sacrifices and is most abundant, for the strong grandson.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा यँसद्विश्वं न्या३त्रिणम् । अग्निर्नो वँसते रयिम्
verses.transliteration: agnistigmena shochiShA ya.NsadvishvaM nyA3triNam | agnirno va.Nsate rayim
verses.translation: Agni, with his sharp flame, subdues every devourer; may Agni bring wealth to us.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने मृड महाँ अस्यय आ देवयुं जनम् । इयेथ बर्हिरासदम्
verses.transliteration: agne mR^iDa mahA.N asyaya A devayuM janam | iyetha barhirAsadam
verses.translation: O Agni, be gracious; you are great. You have come to the people devoted to the gods, to sit on the sacred grass.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने रक्षा णो अँहसः प्रति स्म देव रीषतः । तपिष्ठैरजरो दह
verses.transliteration: agne rakShA No a.NhasaH prati sma deva rIShataH | tapiShThairajaro daha
verses.translation: O Agni, protect us from distress; burn the harmful, O god, with your hottest flames, unaging one.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने युङ्क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः । अरं वहन्त्याशवः
verses.transliteration: agne yu~NkShvA hi ye tavAshvAso deva sAdhavaH | araM vahantyAshavaH
verses.translation: O Agni, yoke your horses, god — the good, swift ones that carry you well.

verses.sanskrit: नि त्वा नक्ष्य विश्पते द्युमन्तं धीमहे वयम् । सुवीरमग्न आहुत
verses.transliteration: ni tvA nakShya vishpate dyumantaM dhImahe vayam | suvIramagna Ahuta
verses.translation: O lord of the people, we meditate upon you, the radiant, rich in heroes; O Agni who receives the oblation.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम् । अपाँ रेताँसि जिन्वति
verses.transliteration: agnirmUrdhA divaH kakutpatiH pR^ithivyA ayam | apA.N retA.Nsi jinvati
verses.translation: Agni is the head and summit of heaven, the lord of the earth; he quickens the seeds of the waters.

verses.sanskrit: इममू षु त्वमस्माकँ सनिं गायत्रं नव्याँसम् । अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः
verses.transliteration: imamU Shu tvamasmAka.N saniM gAyatraM navyA.Nsam | agne deveShu pra vochaH
verses.translation: O Agni, speak among the gods for this our new Gayatri hymn, our offering of praise.

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा गोपवनो गिरा जनिष्ठदग्ने अङ्गरः । स पावक श्रुधी हवम्
verses.transliteration: taM tvA gopavano girA janiShThadagne a~NgaraH | sa pAvaka shrudhI havam
verses.translation: Gopavana praised you with song, O Agni Angiras; O purifier, hear our call.

verses.sanskrit: परि वाजपतिः कविरग्निर्हव्यान्यक्रमीत् । दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे
verses.transliteration: pari vAjapatiH kaviragnirhavyAnyakramIt | dadhadratnAni dAshuShe
verses.translation: Agni, lord of strength and seer, has gone around the offerings, bestowing treasures on the giver.

verses.sanskrit: उदु त्यं जातवेदसं देवं वहन्ति केतवः । दृशे विश्वाय सूर्यम्
verses.transliteration: udu tyaM jAtavedasaM devaM vahanti ketavaH | dR^ishe vishvAya sUryam
verses.translation: His rays carry aloft the god Jatavedas, that all may see the Sun.

verses.sanskrit: कविमग्निमुप स्तुहि सत्यधर्माणमध्वरे । देवममीवचातनम्
verses.transliteration: kavimagnimupa stuhi satyadharmANamadhvare | devamamIvachAtanam
verses.translation: Praise Agni the seer at the sacrifice — the god who keeps truth and drives away disease.

verses.sanskrit: शं नो देवीरभिष्टये शं नो भवन्तु पीतये । शं योरभि स्रवन्तु नः
verses.transliteration: shaM no devIrabhiShTaye shaM no bhavantu pItaye | shaM yorabhi sravantu naH
verses.translation: May the divine waters be good for us, for our desire; may they be good for drinking; may they flow around us with health and blessing.

verses.sanskrit: कस्य नूनं परीणसि धियो जिन्वसि सत्पते । जोषाता यस्य ते गिरः
verses.transliteration: kasya nUnaM parINasi dhiyo jinvasi satpate | joShAtA yasya te giraH
verses.translation: Whom do you now surround, lord of the good; whose thoughts do you quicken? Whose songs do you accept?

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरागिरा च दक्षसे । प्रप्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शँसिषम्
verses.transliteration: yaj~nAyaj~nA vo agnaye girAgirA cha dakShase | prapra vayamamR^itaM jAtavedasaM priyaM mitraM na sha.NsiSham
verses.translation: At every sacrifice and with every song we honor Agni for his skill; let me praise the immortal Jatavedas, dear like a friend.

verses.sanskrit: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्यू३त द्वितीयया । पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो
verses.transliteration: pAhi no agna ekayA pAhyU3ta dvitIyayA | pAhi gIrbhistisR^ibhirUrjAM pate pAhi chatasR^ibhirvaso
verses.translation: Protect us, Agni, with one verse, protect us with a second; protect us with three songs, lord of strength, protect us with four, O Vasu.

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्भिरग्ने अर्चिभिः शुक्रेण देव शोचिषा । भरद्वाजे समिधानो यविष्ठ्य रेवत्पावक दीदिहि
verses.transliteration: bR^ihadbhiragne archibhiH shukreNa deva shochiShA | bharadvAje samidhAno yaviShThya revatpAvaka dIdihi
verses.translation: O Agni, with your great flames and bright radiance, O god, kindled among the Bharadvajas, shine richly, O youngest, O purifier.

verses.sanskrit: त्वे अग्ने स्वाहुत प्रियासः सन्तु सूरयः । यन्तारो ये मघवानो जनानामूर्वं दयन्त गोनाम्
verses.transliteration: tve agne svAhuta priyAsaH santu sUrayaH | yantAro ye maghavAno janAnAmUrvaM dayanta gonAm
verses.translation: O Agni of the good offering, may your patrons be dear to you, the liberal lords who give wide pastures of cattle to the people.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने जरितर्विश्पतिस्तपानो देव रक्षसः । अप्रोषिवान्गृहपते महाँ असि दिवस्पायुर्दुरोणयुः
verses.transliteration: agne jaritarvishpatistapAno deva rakShasaH | aproShivAngR^ihapate mahA.N asi divaspAyurduroNayuH
verses.translation: O Agni, praised by your worshipper, lord of the clans, burning the demons, O god, never absent, lord of the house, you are great, protector of heaven, dwelling in our homes.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने विवस्वदुषसश्चित्रँ राधो अमर्त्य । आ दाशुषे जातवेदो वहा त्वमद्या देवाँ उषर्बुधः
verses.transliteration: agne vivasvaduShasashchitra.N rAdho amartya | A dAshuShe jAtavedo vahA tvamadyA devA.N uSharbudhaH
verses.translation: O Agni, immortal, bring bright wondrous wealth with the dawn; carry the gods who wake with the dawn to the giver today.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नश्चित्र ऊत्या वसो राधाँसि चोदय । अस्य रायस्त्वमग्ने रथीरसि विदा गाधं तुचे तु नः
verses.transliteration: tvaM nashchitra UtyA vaso rAdhA.Nsi chodaya | asya rAyastvamagne rathIrasi vidA gAdhaM tuche tu naH
verses.translation: O wondrous one, O Vasu, urge on riches with your help; you, Agni, are the charioteer of this wealth; find for us a shallow ford for our offspring.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमित्सप्रथा अस्यग्ने त्रातरृतः कविः । त्वां विप्रासः समिधान दीदिव आ विवासन्ति वेधसः
verses.transliteration: tvamitsaprathA asyagne trAtarR^itaH kaviH | tvAM viprAsaH samidhAna dIdiva A vivAsanti vedhasaH
verses.translation: Agni, protector, you alone are wide and true, a seer; the wise, kindling you, bright one, serve you, the ordainers.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो अग्ने वयोवृधँ रयिं पावक शँस्यम् । रास्वा च न उपमाते पुरुस्पृहँ सुनीती सुयशस्तरम्
verses.transliteration: A no agne vayovR^idha.N rayiM pAvaka sha.Nsyam | rAsvA cha na upamAte puruspR^iha.N sunItI suyashastaram
verses.translation: O purifying Agni, bring us wealth that increases vigor and is worthy of praise; grant us, O nearest friend, wealth much desired, with good guidance and great fame.

verses.sanskrit: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानाम् । मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्वग्नये
verses.transliteration: yo vishvA dayate vasu hotA mandro janAnAm | madhorna pAtrA prathamAnyasmai pra stomA yantvagnaye
verses.translation: Whoever grants all treasures, the joyful priest of the peoples — to him first let our hymns go forth like cups of honey, to Agni.

verses.sanskrit: एना वो अग्निं नमसोर्जो नपातमा हुवे । प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिँ स्वाध्वरं विश्वस्य दूतममृतम्
verses.transliteration: enA vo agniM namasorjo napAtamA huve | priyaM chetiShThamarati.N svAdhvaraM vishvasya dUtamamR^itam
verses.translation: I invoke Agni with this homage, the grandson of strength, beloved, most attentive, ever near, with a fair sacrifice, the immortal messenger of all.

verses.sanskrit: शेषे वनेषु मातृषु सं त्वा मर्तास इन्धते । अतन्द्रो हव्यं वहसि हविष्कृत आदिद्देवेषु राजसि
verses.transliteration: sheShe vaneShu mAtR^iShu saM tvA martAsa indhate | atandro havyaM vahasi haviShkR^ita AdiddeveShu rAjasi
verses.translation: You lie in the forests and in your mothers; mortals kindle you. Untiring, you carry the offering for the giver, and then you reign among the gods.

verses.sanskrit: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः । उपो षु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्तु नो गिरः
verses.transliteration: adarshi gAtuvittamo yasminvratAnyAdadhuH | upo Shu jAtamAryasya vardhanamagniM nakShantu no giraH
verses.translation: He has been seen, the best knower of the way, in whom the sacred rites are placed; may our songs reach Agni, the newborn increaser of the Aryan.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरुक्थे पुरोहितो ग्रावाणो बर्हिरध्वरे । ऋचा यामि मरुतो ब्रह्मणस्पते देवा अवो वरेण्यम्
verses.transliteration: agnirukthe purohito grAvANo barhiradhvare | R^ichA yAmi maruto brahmaNaspate devA avo vareNyam
verses.translation: Agni is set forward in the hymn; the pressing-stones are at the sacrifice, the grass is spread; with the verse I come to the Maruts and Brahmanaspati — the gods' protection is to be chosen.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमीडिष्वावसे गाथाभिः शीरशोचिषम् । अग्निँ राये पुरुमीढ श्रुतं नरोऽग्निः सुदीतये छर्दिः
verses.transliteration: agnimIDiShvAvase gAthAbhiH shIrashochiSham | agni.N rAye purumIDha shrutaM naro.agniH sudItaye ChardiH
verses.translation: Praise Agni for your protection with songs, him of the burning flame; O Agni, bountiful, famed among men, grant us wealth; Agni gives shelter for brilliant light.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुधि श्रुत्कर्ण वह्निभिर्देवैरग्ने सयावभिः । आ सीदतु बर्हिषि मित्रो अर्यमा प्रातर्यावभिरध्वरे
verses.transliteration: shrudhi shrutkarNa vahnibhirdevairagne sayAvabhiH | A sIdatu barhiShi mitro aryamA prAtaryAvabhiradhvare
verses.translation: Hear us, O Agni with listening ear, with the gods who come in company; may Mitra and Aryaman sit on the grass at the early-morning sacrifice with those who come at dawn.

verses.sanskrit: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देव इन्द्रो न मज्मना । अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य शर्मणि
verses.transliteration: pra daivodAso agnirdeva indro na majmanA | anu mAtaraM pR^ithivIM vi vAvR^ite tasthau nAkasya sharmaNi
verses.translation: Agni, the god, son of Divodasa, like Indra in might, has gone forth; he moves after his mother Earth and stands in the shelter of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अध ज्मो अध वा दिवो बृहतो रोचनादधि । अया वर्धस्व तन्वा गिरा ममा जाता सुक्रतो पृण
verses.transliteration: adha jmo adha vA divo bR^ihato rochanAdadhi | ayA vardhasva tanvA girA mamA jAtA sukrato pR^iNa
verses.translation: Now from the earth, or from the great shining heaven, grow with this body and this song of mine; O skilful one, fulfill my offspring.

verses.sanskrit: कायमानो वना त्वं यन्मातॄरजगन्नपः । न तत्ते अग्ने प्रमृषे निवर्तनं यद्दूरे सन्निहाभुवः
verses.transliteration: kAyamAno vanA tvaM yanmAtR^IrajagannapaH | na tatte agne pramR^iShe nivartanaM yaddUre sannihAbhuvaH
verses.translation: When, desiring the woods, you went to the waters, your mothers, O Agni, that return of yours is not forgotten, even though you were far away.

verses.sanskrit: नि त्वामग्ने मनुर्दधे ज्योतिर्जनाय शश्वते । दीदेथ कण्व ऋतजात उक्षितो यं नमस्यन्ति कृष्टयः
verses.transliteration: ni tvAmagne manurdadhe jyotirjanAya shashvate | dIdetha kaNva R^itajAta ukShito yaM namasyanti kR^iShTayaH
verses.translation: Manu set you, Agni, as light for the eternal people; you shine, born of truth and sprinkled, whom the peoples worship — Kanva.

verses.sanskrit: देवो वो द्रविणोदाः पूर्णां विवष्ट्वासिचम् । उद्वा सिञ्जध्वमुप वा पृणध्वमादिद्वो देव ओहते
verses.transliteration: devo vo draviNodAH pUrNAM vivaShTvAsicham | udvA si~njadhvamupa vA pR^iNadhvamAdidvo deva ohate
verses.translation: May the god, giver of wealth, bring you the full pouring-vessel; pour it out or fill it up — then the god carries it on to you.

verses.sanskrit: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस्पतिः प्र देव्येतु सूनृता । अच्छा वीरं नर्यं पङ्क्तिराधसं देवा यज्ञं नयन्तु नः
verses.transliteration: praitu brahmaNaspatiH pra devyetu sUnR^itA | achChA vIraM naryaM pa~NktirAdhasaM devA yaj~naM nayantu naH
verses.translation: May Brahmanaspati go forth; may divine Truth go forth; may the gods lead our sacrifice to a hero, a leader, who gives abundant wealth.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्व ऊ षु ण ऊतये तिष्ठा देवो न सविता । ऊर्ध्वो वाजस्य सनिता यदञ्जिभिर्वाघद्भिर्विह्वयामहे
verses.transliteration: Urdhva U Shu Na Utaye tiShThA devo na savitA | Urdhvo vAjasya sanitA yada~njibhirvAghadbhirvihvayAmahe
verses.translation: Stand up for our help like the god Savitar; standing high, the winner of strength, whom we invoke with hymns and with the offering priests.

verses.sanskrit: प्र यो राये निनीषति मर्तो यस्ते वसो दाशत् । स वीरं धत्ते अग्न उक्थशँसिनं त्मना सहस्रपोषिणम्
verses.transliteration: pra yo rAye ninIShati marto yaste vaso dAshat | sa vIraM dhatte agna ukthasha.NsinaM tmanA sahasrapoShiNam
verses.translation: The mortal who, O Vasu, wishes to bring wealth and gives to you, gains a hero by himself, one who praises, who nourishes thousands.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो यह्वं पुरूणां विशां देवयतीनाम् । अग्निँ सूक्तेभिर्वचोभिर्वृणीमहे यँसमिदन्य इन्धते
verses.transliteration: pra vo yahvaM purUNAM vishAM devayatInAm | agni.N sUktebhirvachobhirvR^iNImahe ya.Nsamidanya indhate
verses.translation: We choose Agni, great among many peoples who seek the gods, with well-spoken words; whom others also kindle together.

verses.sanskrit: अयमग्निः सुवीर्यस्येशे हि सौभगस्य । राय ईशे स्वपत्यस्य गोमत ईशे वृत्रहथानाम्
verses.transliteration: ayamagniH suvIryasyeshe hi saubhagasya | rAya Ishe svapatyasya gomata Ishe vR^itrahathAnAm
verses.translation: This Agni rules over heroic strength and good fortune; he rules over wealth and good offspring; he rules over cattle and the slayings of Vritra.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने गृहपतिस्त्वँ होता नो अध्वरे । त्वं पोता विश्ववार प्रचेता ताक्षि यासि च वार्यम्
verses.transliteration: tvamagne gR^ihapatistva.N hotA no adhvare | tvaM potA vishvavAra prachetA tAkShi yAsi cha vAryam
verses.translation: You, Agni, are the lord of the house; you are our priest at the sacrifice; you are the Potri, O all-choosing, wise one; you give desirable things and go to them.

verses.sanskrit: सखायस्त्वा ववृमहे देवं मर्तास ऊतये । अपां नपातँ सुभगँ सुदँससँ सुप्रतूर्तिमनेहसम्
verses.transliteration: sakhAyastvA vavR^imahe devaM martAsa Utaye | apAM napAta.N subhaga.N suda.Nsasa.N supratUrtimanehasam
verses.translation: We, your friends, have chosen you, god, for help — the son of the waters, fortunate, skilful, swift to act, unfailing.

verses.sanskrit: आ जुहोता हविषा मर्जयध्वं नि होतारं गृहपतिं दधिध्वम् । इडस्पदे नमसा रातहव्यँ सपर्यता यजतं पस्त्यानाम्
verses.transliteration: A juhotA haviShA marjayadhvaM ni hotAraM gR^ihapatiM dadhidhvam | iDaspade namasA rAtahavya.N saparyatA yajataM pastyAnAm
verses.translation: Pour the oblation and cleanse him; set the priest, the lord of the house, in his place; with homage worship at the altar the worshipful one of the peoples, to whom the offering is given.

verses.sanskrit: चित्र इच्छिशोस्तरुणस्य वक्षथो न यो मातरावन्वेति धातवे । अनूधा यदजीजनदधा चिदा ववक्षत्सद्यो महि दूत्या३ं चरन्
verses.transliteration: chitra ichChishostaruNasya vakShatho na yo mAtarAvanveti dhAtave | anUdhA yadajIjanadadhA chidA vavakShatsadyo mahi dUtyA3M charan
verses.translation: Wondrous is the youth who, like a young child, does not follow his two mothers to be suckled; when he, though not milk-fed, was born, he immediately carries on, performing a great messenger's task.

verses.sanskrit: इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सं विशस्व । संवेशनस्तन्वे३ चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे जनित्रे
verses.transliteration: idaM ta ekaM para U ta ekaM tR^itIyena jyotiShA saM vishasva | saMveshanastanve3 chAruredhi priyo devAnAM parame janitre
verses.translation: This is one form of yours; another is beyond; enter into a third light. May your entry be a delight for your body; be dear to the gods in the highest birthplace.

verses.sanskrit: इमँ स्तोममर्हते जातवेदसे रथमिव सं महेमा मनीषया । भद्रा हि नः प्रमतिरस्य सँसद्यग्ने सख्ये मा रिषामा वयं तव
verses.transliteration: ima.N stomamarhate jAtavedase rathamiva saM mahemA manIShayA | bhadrA hi naH pramatirasya sa.Nsadyagne sakhye mA riShAmA vayaM tava
verses.translation: We fashion this hymn for the worthy Jatavedas with our mind, as we fashion a chariot; his favor is good for us; in your friendship, Agni, may we not come to harm.

verses.sanskrit: मूर्धानं दिवो अरतिं पृथिव्या वैश्वानरमृत आ जातमग्निम् । कविँ सम्राजमतिथिं जनानामासन्नाः पात्रं जनयन्त देवाः
verses.transliteration: mUrdhAnaM divo aratiM pR^ithivyA vaishvAnaramR^ita A jAtamagnim | kavi.N samrAjamatithiM janAnAmAsannAH pAtraM janayanta devAH
verses.translation: The head of heaven, the lord of earth, Vaishvanara, Agni born in the order of truth; the seer, sovereign, guest of men — the gods who sat near made him their cup.

verses.sanskrit: वि त्वदापो न पर्वतस्य पृष्ठादुक्थेभिरग्ने जनयन्त देवाः । तं त्वा गिरः सुष्टुतयो वाजयन्त्याजिं न गिर्ववाहो जिग्युरश्वाः
verses.transliteration: vi tvadApo na parvatasya pR^iShThAdukthebhiragne janayanta devAH | taM tvA giraH suShTutayo vAjayantyAjiM na girvavAho jigyurashvAH
verses.translation: Like waters from the mountain's back, O Agni, the gods bring you forth with hymns; the well-praised songs urge you on like horses winning in a race, O you who are borne by songs.

verses.sanskrit: आ वो राजानमध्वरस्य रुद्रँ होतारँ सत्ययजँ रोदस्योः । अग्निं पुरा तनयित्नोरचित्ताद्धिरण्यरूपमवसे कृणुध्वम्
verses.transliteration: A vo rAjAnamadhvarasya rudra.N hotAra.N satyayaja.N rodasyoH | agniM purA tanayitnorachittAddhiraNyarUpamavase kR^iNudhvam
verses.translation: Make for your protection Agni, king of the sacrifice, Rudra, the priest true in sacrifice for heaven and earth, golden-formed, before the thunder's unexpected stroke.

verses.sanskrit: इन्धे राजा समर्यो नमोभिर्यस्य प्रतीकमाहुतं घृतेन । नरो हव्येभिरीडते सबाध आग्निरग्रमुषसामशोचि
verses.transliteration: indhe rAjA samaryo namobhiryasya pratIkamAhutaM ghR^itena | naro havyebhirIDate sabAdha AgniragramuShasAmashochi
verses.translation: The king is kindled with homage, whose face is anointed with ghee; men with offerings praise him, together in need; Agni has shone first among the dawns.

verses.sanskrit: प्र केतुना बृहता यात्यग्निरा रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति । दिवश्चिदन्तादुपमामुदानडपामुपस्थे महिषो ववर्ध
verses.transliteration: pra ketunA bR^ihatA yAtyagnirA rodasI vR^iShabho roravIti | divashchidantAdupamAmudAnaDapAmupasthe mahiSho vavardha
verses.translation: Agni goes forth with a great banner; the bull roars to heaven and earth; he has reached the nearest end of heaven; the mighty one has grown in the lap of the waters.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिरण्योर्हस्तच्युतं जनयत प्रशस्तम् । दूरेदृशं गृहपतिमथव्युम्
verses.transliteration: agniM naro dIdhitibhiraNyorhastachyutaM janayata prashastam | dUredR^ishaM gR^ihapatimathavyum
verses.translation: Men, with their fingers, bring forth Agni from the two fire-sticks, the praised one released from the hand, the far-seeing lord of the house.

verses.sanskrit: अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासम् । यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सस्रते नाकमच्छ
verses.transliteration: abodhyagniH samidhA janAnAM prati dhenumivAyatImuShAsam | yahvA iva pra vayAmujjihAnAH pra bhAnavaH sasrate nAkamachCha
verses.translation: Agni has awakened with the kindling of the people, like Dawn approaching like a cow; like branches shooting up, his rays spread toward heaven.

verses.sanskrit: प्र भूर्जयन्तं महां विपोधां मूरैरमूरं पुरां दर्माणम् । नयन्तं गीर्भिर्वना धियं धा हरिश्मश्रुं न वार्मणा धनर्चिम्
verses.transliteration: pra bhUrjayantaM mahAM vipodhAM mUrairamUraM purAM darmANam | nayantaM gIrbhirvanA dhiyaM dhA harishmashruM na vArmaNA dhanarchim
verses.translation: He is conquering, great, the winner of many; the unforgetful, destroyer of fortresses, with the wise; leading the songs through the forests, he inspires thought, bright-bearded like a warrior with armor.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रं ते अन्यद्यजतं ते अन्यद्विषुरूपे अहनी द्यौरिवासि । विश्वा हि माया अवसि स्वधावन्भद्रा ते पूषन्निह रातिरस्तु
verses.transliteration: shukraM te anyadyajataM te anyadviShurUpe ahanI dyaurivAsi | vishvA hi mAyA avasi svadhAvanbhadrA te pUShanniha rAtirastu
verses.translation: One of your forms is bright, another worshipful; you are like heaven, with two differently formed days. You protect all wonders, O self-sustaining one; may your fair gift be here, O Pushan.

verses.sanskrit: इडामग्ने पुरुदँसँ सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमँ हवमानाय साध । स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे
verses.transliteration: iDAmagne puruda.Nsa.N saniM goH shashvattama.N havamAnAya sAdha | syAnnaH sUnustanayo vijAvAgne sA te sumatirbhUtvasme
verses.translation: O Agni, bring to the one who calls on you the much-working Ida, the gift of cattle, forever; may we have a son, offspring and descendants; may your favor be with us.

verses.sanskrit: प्र होता जातो महान्नभोविन्नृषद्मा सीददपां विवर्ते । दधद्यो धायी सुते वयाँसि यन्ता वसूनि विधते तनूपाः
verses.transliteration: pra hotA jAto mahAnnabhovinnR^iShadmA sIdadapAM vivarte | dadhadyo dhAyI sute vayA.Nsi yantA vasUni vidhate tanUpAH
verses.translation: The priest, born great and knowing the sky, sits in the abode of men in the turning of the waters; sustaining the strengths in the pressed soma, he gives treasures to the worshipper and guards the body.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सम्राजमसुरस्य प्रश्स्तं पुँसः कृष्टीनामनुमाद्यस्य । इन्द्रस्येव प्र तवसस्कृतानि वन्दद्वारा वन्दमाना विवष्टु
verses.transliteration: pra samrAjamasurasya prashstaM pu.NsaH kR^iShTInAmanumAdyasya | indrasyeva pra tavasaskR^itAni vandadvArA vandamAnA vivaShTu
verses.translation: Let the worshipper praise the praised sovereign, lord of the powerful, the one to be rejoiced in by the peoples; with the deeds of the strong Indra, let the praiser, praising, make known the door.

verses.sanskrit: अरण्योर्निहितो जातवेदा गर्भ इवेत्सुभृतो गर्भिणीभिः । दिवेदिव ईड्यो जागृवद्भिर्हविष्मद्भिर्मनुष्येभिरग्निः
verses.transliteration: araNyornihito jAtavedA garbha ivetsubhR^ito garbhiNIbhiH | divediva IDyo jAgR^ivadbhirhaviShmadbhirmanuShyebhiragniH
verses.translation: Jatavedas lies hidden in the two fire-sticks like a well-borne child in pregnant women; he is to be praised day by day by the wakeful, offering-bringing men — Agni.

verses.sanskrit: सनादग्ने मृणसि यातुधानान्न त्वा रक्षाँसि पृतनासु जिग्युः । अनु दह सहमूरान्कयादो मा ते हेत्या मुक्षत दैव्यायाः
verses.transliteration: sanAdagne mR^iNasi yAtudhAnAnna tvA rakShA.Nsi pR^itanAsu jigyuH | anu daha sahamUrAnkayAdo mA te hetyA mukShata daivyAyAH
verses.translation: From of old, O Agni, you crush the sorcerers; the demons do not conquer you in battles. Burn the flesh-eaters, the foolish ones; let the weapon of the divine not let them go.

verses.sanskrit: अग्न ओजिष्ठमा भर द्युम्नमस्मभ्यमध्रिगो । प्र नो राये पनीयसे रत्सि वाजाय पन्थाम्
verses.transliteration: agna ojiShThamA bhara dyumnamasmabhyamadhrigo | pra no rAye panIyase ratsi vAjAya panthAm
verses.translation: O unconquerable Agni, bring us the most mighty splendor; give us the path to abundant wealth and strength.

verses.sanskrit: यदि वीरो अनु ष्यादग्निमिन्धीत मर्त्यः । आजुह्वद्धव्यमानुषक्षर्म भक्षीत दैव्यम्
verses.transliteration: yadi vIro anu ShyAdagnimindhIta martyaH | AjuhvaddhavyamAnuShakSharma bhakShIta daivyam
verses.translation: If the mortal hero were to follow, let him kindle Agni; having poured the offering continuously, let him enjoy the divine protection.

verses.sanskrit: त्वेषस्ते धूम ऋण्वति दिवि सं च्छुक्र आततः । सूरो न हि द्युता त्वं कृपा पावक रोचसे
verses.transliteration: tveShaste dhUma R^iNvati divi saM chChukra AtataH | sUro na hi dyutA tvaM kR^ipA pAvaka rochase
verses.translation: Your smoke rises brilliant; in heaven you are spread out, bright; for like the sun you shine by your radiance, O purifier, by your grace.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ हि क्षैतवद्यशोऽग्ने मित्रो न पत्यसे । त्वं विचर्षणे श्रवो वसो पुष्टिं न पुष्यसि
verses.transliteration: tva.N hi kShaitavadyasho.agne mitro na patyase | tvaM vicharShaNe shravo vaso puShTiM na puShyasi
verses.translation: For you, Agni, bestow dwelling-given glory; like Mitra you are the lord. O all-seeing Vasu, you nourish us as with abundance.

verses.sanskrit: प्रातरग्निः पुरुप्रियो विष स्तवेतातिथिः । विश्वे यस्मिन्नमर्त्ये हव्यं मर्तास इन्धते
verses.transliteration: prAtaragniH purupriyo viSha stavetAtithiH | vishve yasminnamartye havyaM martAsa indhate
verses.translation: Morning Agni, beloved of many, is praised like a guest — in whom, the immortal, all mortals kindle the offering.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वाहिष्ठं तदग्नये बृहदर्च विभावसो । महिषीव त्वद्रयिस्त्वद्वाजा उदीरते
verses.transliteration: yadvAhiShThaM tadagnaye bR^ihadarcha vibhAvaso | mahiShIva tvadrayistvadvAjA udIrate
verses.translation: Sing aloud to Agni what is best to carry; O shining one, wealth rises from you like a queen; strengths arise from you.

verses.sanskrit: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम् । अग्निं वो दुर्यं वचः स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः
verses.transliteration: vishovisho vo atithiM vAjayantaH purupriyam | agniM vo duryaM vachaH stuShe shUShasya manmabhiH
verses.translation: Desiring strength, I praise Agni, the beloved guest of every clan, your door-guard, with the thoughts of the strong.

verses.sanskrit: बृहद्वयो हि भानवेऽर्चा देवायाग्नये । यं मित्रं न प्रशस्तये मर्तासो दधिरे पुरः
verses.transliteration: bR^ihadvayo hi bhAnave.archA devAyAgnaye | yaM mitraM na prashastaye martAso dadhire puraH
verses.translation: Sing a vast strength to the shining god Agni, whom mortals have set in front like a friend for praise.

verses.sanskrit: अगन्म वृत्रहन्तमं ज्येष्ठमग्निमानवम् । य स्म श्रुतर्वन्नार्क्षे बृहदनीक इध्यते
verses.transliteration: aganma vR^itrahantamaM jyeShThamagnimAnavam | ya sma shrutarvannArkShe bR^ihadanIka idhyate
verses.translation: We have approached Agni Manava, the best slayer of Vritra, eldest, who is kindled with his high flame, O Shrutarvan, in the Arkshya.

verses.sanskrit: जातः परेण धर्मणा यत्सवृद्भिः सहाभुवः । पिता यत्कश्यपस्याग्निः श्रद्धा माता मनुः कविः
verses.transliteration: jAtaH pareNa dharmaNA yatsavR^idbhiH sahAbhuvaH | pitA yatkashyapasyAgniH shraddhA mAtA manuH kaviH
verses.translation: Born by the highest law, when you were with the fellow-growers; when Agni was the father of Kashyapa, Faith the mother, Manu the seer.

verses.sanskrit: सोमँ राजानं वरुणमग्निमन्वारभामहे । आदित्यं विष्णुँ सूर्यं ब्रह्मानं च बृहस्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: soma.N rAjAnaM varuNamagnimanvArabhAmahe | AdityaM viShNu.N sUryaM brahmAnaM cha bR^ihaspatim
verses.translation: We take hold of Soma the king, Varuna, Agni, Aditya, Vishnu, Surya, and Brahma with Brihaspati.

verses.sanskrit: इत एत उदारुहन्दिवः पृष्ठान्या रुहन् । प्र भूर्जयो यथा पथोद्यामङ्गिरसो ययुः
verses.transliteration: ita eta udAruhandivaH pR^iShThAnyA ruhan | pra bhUrjayo yathA pathodyAma~Ngiraso yayuH
verses.translation: From here these have risen up; they ascended the back of heaven; like victors, they went by the path to heaven — the Angirases.

verses.sanskrit: राये अग्ने महे त्वा दानाय समिधीमहि । ईडिष्वा हि महे वृषं द्यावा होत्राय पृथिवी
verses.transliteration: rAye agne mahe tvA dAnAya samidhImahi | IDiShvA hi mahe vR^iShaM dyAvA hotrAya pR^ithivI
verses.translation: O Agni, for wealth and for the great gift we kindle you; praise the bull, great — heaven and earth for the offering.

verses.sanskrit: दधन्वे वा यदीमनु वोचद्ब्रह्मेति वेरु तत् । परि विश्वानि काव्या नेमिश्चक्रमिवाभुवत्
verses.transliteration: dadhanve vA yadImanu vochadbrahmeti veru tat | pari vishvAni kAvyA nemishchakramivAbhuvat
verses.translation: When the priest declared that the prayer is Brahman, it was held; it encompassed all poetic wisdom, like a rim around a wheel.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यग्ने हरसा हरः शृणाहि विश्वतस्परि । यातुधानस्य रक्षसो बलं न्युब्जवीर्यम्
verses.transliteration: pratyagne harasA haraH shR^iNAhi vishvataspari | yAtudhAnasya rakShaso balaM nyubjavIryam
verses.translation: O Agni, with fury answer fury; crush on all sides the strength of the sorcerer-demon, and cast down his power.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने वसूँरिह रुद्राँ आदित्याँ उत । यजा स्वध्वरं जनं मनुजातं घृतप्रुषम्
verses.transliteration: tvamagne vasU.Nriha rudrA.N AdityA.N uta | yajA svadhvaraM janaM manujAtaM ghR^itapruSham
verses.translation: You, Agni, here worship the Vasus, Rudras and Adityas — the people who perform good sacrifice, born of Manu, dripping ghee.

verses.sanskrit: पुरु त्वा दाशिवाँ वोचेऽरिरग्ने तव स्विदा । तोदस्येव शरण आ महस्य
verses.transliteration: puru tvA dAshivA.N voche.ariragne tava svidA | todasyeva sharaNa A mahasya
verses.translation: I, the giver, speak much of you, O Agni; I am yours indeed; as in the refuge of a driver, in the great one.

verses.sanskrit: प्र होत्रे पूर्व्यं वचोऽग्नये भरता बृहत् । विपां ज्योतीँषि बिभ्रते न वेधसे
verses.transliteration: pra hotre pUrvyaM vacho.agnaye bharatA bR^ihat | vipAM jyotI.NShi bibhrate na vedhase
verses.translation: Bring to the priest, to Agni, an ancient, mighty word, to him who bears the lights of the wise, like an ordainer.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो । अस्मे धेहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः
verses.transliteration: agne vAjasya gomata IshAnaH sahaso yaho | asme dhehi jAtavedo mahi shravaH
verses.translation: O Agni, lord of strength with cattle, son of might, give us, O Jatavedas, great fame.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने यजिष्ठो अध्वरे देवां देवयते यज । होता मन्द्रो वि राजस्यति स्रिधः
verses.transliteration: agne yajiShTho adhvare devAM devayate yaja | hotA mandro vi rAjasyati sridhaH
verses.translation: O Agni, best of sacrificers, at the sacrifice worship the gods for the one who seeks the gods; the joyful priest shines forth, thrusting away enemies.

verses.sanskrit: जज्ञानः सप्त मातृभिर्मेधामाशासत श्रिये । अयं ध्रुवो रयीणां चिकेतदा
verses.transliteration: jaj~nAnaH sapta mAtR^ibhirmedhAmAshAsata shriye | ayaM dhruvo rayINAM chiketadA
verses.translation: Born from the seven mothers, they sought wisdom for glory; this firm one has been known among the riches.

verses.sanskrit: उत स्या नो दिवा मतिरदितिरूत्यागमत् । सा शन्ताता मयस्करदप स्रिधः
verses.transliteration: uta syA no divA matiraditirUtyAgamat | sA shantAtA mayaskaradapa sridhaH
verses.translation: And may that thought of ours, Aditi, come by day with help; may she bring happiness and comfort and drive away enemies.

verses.sanskrit: ईडिष्वा हि प्रतीव्या३ं यजस्व जातवेदसम् । चरिष्णुधूममगृभीतशोचिषम्
verses.transliteration: IDiShvA hi pratIvyA3M yajasva jAtavedasam | chariShNudhUmamagR^ibhItashochiSham
verses.translation: Praise the one who is to be met, and worship Jatavedas, the wandering smoke, with unseized flame.

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य मायया च न रिपुरीशीत मर्त्यः । यो अग्नये ददाश हव्यदातये
verses.transliteration: na tasya mAyayA cha na ripurIshIta martyaH | yo agnaye dadAsha havyadAtaye
verses.translation: No mortal enemy rules over him by deceit — he who has given to Agni, the receiver of offerings.

verses.sanskrit: अप त्यं वृजिनँ रिपुँ स्तेनमग्ने दुराध्यम् । दविष्ठमस्य सत्पते कृधी सुगम्
verses.transliteration: apa tyaM vR^ijina.N ripu.N stenamagne durAdhyam | daviShThamasya satpate kR^idhI sugam
verses.translation: O Agni, lord of the good, drive far away this crooked foe and thief, hard to restrain; make the way easy for us.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुष्ट्यग्ने नवस्य मे स्तोमस्य वीर विश्पते । नि मायिनस्तपसा रक्षसो दह
verses.transliteration: shruShTyagne navasya me stomasya vIra vishpate | ni mAyinastapasA rakShaso daha
verses.translation: Hear, O Agni, my new hymn, O hero, lord of the people; burn down with heat the deceitful demons.

verses.sanskrit: प्र मँहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे । उपस्तुतासो अग्नये
verses.transliteration: pra ma.NhiShThAya gAyata R^itAvne bR^ihate shukrashochiShe | upastutAso agnaye
verses.translation: Sing to the greatest, to Agni, keeper of truth, mighty, with bright flame, praised from near.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तरति वाजकर्मभिः । यस्य त्वँ सख्यमाविथ
verses.transliteration: pra so agne tavotibhiH suvIrAbhistarati vAjakarmabhiH | yasya tva.N sakhyamAvitha
verses.translation: That man crosses over, O Agni, with your helps and heroic deeds of strength — he whose friendship you have favored.

verses.sanskrit: तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे । देवत्रा हव्यमूहिषे
verses.transliteration: taM gUrdhayA svarNaraM devAso devamaratiM dadhanvire | devatrA havyamUhiShe
verses.translation: Praise him, the sun-leader, the god; the gods have set him as the unfailing god; you carry the offering among the gods.

verses.sanskrit: मा नो हृणीथा अतिथिं वसुरग्निः पुरुप्रशस्त एशः । यः सुहोता स्वध्वरः
verses.transliteration: mA no hR^iNIthA atithiM vasuragniH puruprashasta eshaH | yaH suhotA svadhvaraH
verses.translation: Do not be angry at us, the guest — this Agni, the Vasu, much praised, who is a good priest of the good sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः । भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः
verses.transliteration: bhadro no agnirAhuto bhadrA rAtiH subhaga bhadro adhvaraH | bhadrA uta prashastayaH
verses.translation: Auspicious for us is Agni to whom the offering is poured; auspicious is the gift, O fortunate one; auspicious the sacrifice, and auspicious the praises.

verses.sanskrit: यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: yajiShThaM tvA vavR^imahe devaM devatrA hotAramamartyam | asya yaj~nasya sukratum
verses.translation: We choose you, best of sacrificers, god, among the gods, the immortal priest, skilful in this sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: तदग्ने द्युम्नमा भर यत्सासाहा सदने कं चिदत्रिणम् । मन्युं जनस्य दूढ्यम्
verses.transliteration: tadagne dyumnamA bhara yatsAsAhA sadane kaM chidatriNam | manyuM janasya dUDhyam
verses.translation: O Agni, bring that splendor which overcomes whatever devourer there is in the house, the anger of men hard to resist.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा उ विश्पतिः शितः सुप्रीतो मनुषो विशे । विश्वेदग्निः प्रति रक्षाँसि सेधति
verses.transliteration: yadvA u vishpatiH shitaH suprIto manuSho vishe | vishvedagniH prati rakShA.Nsi sedhati
verses.translation: When the lord of the people, sharpened and well pleased, comes for the clan of Manu, Agni drives off all demons.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वो गाय सुते सचा पुरुहूताय सत्वने । शं यद्गवे न शाकिने
verses.transliteration: tadvo gAya sute sachA puruhUtAya satvane | shaM yadgave na shAkine
verses.translation: Sing to him together at the pressing, to the much-invoked, the mighty, for the blessing, like a cow for the powerful.

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते नूनँ शतक्रतविन्द्र द्युम्नितमो मदः । तेन नूनं मदे मदेः
verses.transliteration: yaste nUna.N shatakratavindra dyumnitamo madaH | tena nUnaM made madeH
verses.translation: O Indra of a hundred powers, may the most splendid exhilaration of yours now, by that, exhilarate us now in the joy.

verses.sanskrit: गाव उप वदावटे महि यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा । उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया
verses.transliteration: gAva upa vadAvaTe mahi yaj~nasya rapsudA | ubhA karNA hiraNyayA
verses.translation: Speak to the cows in the pit, to the giver of the great sacrifice's song; both ears are golden.

verses.sanskrit: अरमश्वाय गायत श्रुतकक्षारं गवे । अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने
verses.transliteration: aramashvAya gAyata shrutakakShAraM gave | aramindrasya dhAmne
verses.translation: Sing enough for the horse, sufficient for the cow, to Shrutakaksha; sufficient for the abode of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे । स वृषा वृषभो भुवत्
verses.transliteration: tamindraM vAjayAmasi mahe vR^itrAya hantave | sa vR^iShA vR^iShabho bhuvat
verses.translation: We strengthen that Indra for the slaying of the great Vritra; may he be the bull, the bull.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र बलादधि सहसो जात ओजसः । त्वँ सन्वृषन्वृषेदसि
verses.transliteration: tvamindra balAdadhi sahaso jAta ojasaH | tva.N sanvR^iShanvR^iShedasi
verses.translation: You, Indra, are born of strength, of might and power; being a bull, you are indeed the bull.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् । चक्राण ओपशं दिवि
verses.transliteration: yaj~na indramavardhayadyadbhUmiM vyavartayat | chakrANa opashaM divi
verses.translation: The sacrifice made Indra grow when he turned the earth round, making a cover in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्राहं तथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् । स्तोता मे गोसखा स्यात्
verses.transliteration: yadindrAhaM tathA tvamIshIya vasva eka it | stotA me gosakhA syAt
verses.translation: If I were as you are, Indra, alone ruling over wealth, my praiser would be a friend with cattle.

verses.sanskrit: पन्यंपन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय । सोमं वीराय शूराय
verses.transliteration: panyaMpanyamitsotAra A dhAvata madyAya | somaM vIrAya shUrAya
verses.translation: Run, pressers, to each praiseworthy one for exhilaration; press Soma for the hero, the brave.

verses.sanskrit: इदं वसो सुतमन्धः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरम् । अनाभयिन्ररिमा ते
verses.transliteration: idaM vaso sutamandhaH pibA supUrNamudaram | anAbhayinrarimA te
verses.translation: Drink this pressed juice, O Vasu, with a full belly; fearless one, may we be yours.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसम् । अस्तारमेषि सूर्य
verses.transliteration: uddhedabhi shrutAmaghaM vR^iShabhaM naryApasam | astArameShi sUrya
verses.translation: You rise up, O Sun, toward the famed bounteous bull, the man of good works, the archer.

verses.sanskrit: यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य । सर्वं तदिन्द्र ते वशे
verses.transliteration: yadadya kachcha vR^itrahannudagA abhi sUrya | sarvaM tadindra te vashe
verses.translation: Whatever today, O Vritra-slayer, you have risen upon, O Sun — all that, O Indra, is in your power.

verses.sanskrit: य आनयत्परावतः सुनीती तुर्वशं यदुम् । इन्द्रः स नो युवा सखा
verses.transliteration: ya AnayatparAvataH sunItI turvashaM yadum | indraH sa no yuvA sakhA
verses.translation: Who led Turvasha and Yadu from afar with good guidance — that Indra is our youthful friend.

verses.sanskrit: मा न इन्द्राभ्याऽऽ३ दिशः सूरो अक्तुष्वा यमत । त्वा युजा वनेम तत्
verses.transliteration: mA na indrAbhyA.a.a3 dishaH sUro aktuShvA yamata | tvA yujA vanema tat
verses.translation: O Indra, let no quarters of the sky constrain us at night; with you as ally we would win that.

verses.sanskrit: एन्द्र सानसिँ रयिँ सजित्वानँ सदासहम् । वर्षिष्ठमूतये भर
verses.transliteration: endra sAnasi.N rayi.N sajitvAna.N sadAsaham | varShiShThamUtaye bhara
verses.translation: Come, Indra, bring for our protection the greatest wealth — victorious, ever-conquering.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वयं महाधन इन्द्रमर्भे हवामहे । युजं वृत्रेषु वज्रिणम्
verses.transliteration: indraM vayaM mahAdhana indramarbhe havAmahe | yujaM vR^itreShu vajriNam
verses.translation: We call on Indra in the great contest, on Indra in the small; the ally in battles against Vritras, the wielder of the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: अपिबत्कद्रुवः सुतमिन्द्रः सहस्रबाह्वे । तत्राददिष्ट पौँस्यम्
verses.transliteration: apibatkadruvaH sutamindraH sahasrabAhve | tatrAdadiShTa pau.Nsyam
verses.translation: Indra drank the pressed soma of Kadru for the thousand-armed; there he took manly strength.

verses.sanskrit: वयमिन्द्र त्वायवोऽभि प्र नोनुमो वृषन् । विद्धी त्वा३स्य नो वसो
verses.transliteration: vayamindra tvAyavo.abhi pra nonumo vR^iShan | viddhI tvA3sya no vaso
verses.translation: We, longing for you, Indra, cry loudly to you, O bull; know us, O Vasu, in this matter.

verses.sanskrit: आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा
verses.transliteration: A ghA ye agnimindhate stR^iNanti barhirAnuShak | yeShAmindro yuvA sakhA
verses.translation: Those who kindle Agni and constantly spread the grass — to them Indra is the youthful friend.

verses.sanskrit: भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर
verses.transliteration: bhindhi vishvA apa dviShaH pari bAdho jahI mR^idhaH | vasu spArhaM tadA bhara
verses.translation: Break all enemies; drive away the oppressors, crush the foes; then bring the desired wealth.

verses.sanskrit: इहेव शृण्व एषां कशा हस्तेषु यद्वदान् । नि यामं चित्रमृञ्जते
verses.transliteration: iheva shR^iNva eShAM kashA hasteShu yadvadAn | ni yAmaM chitramR^i~njate
verses.translation: Here, as it were, I hear the whip in their hands when they speak; they adorn the wondrous journey.

verses.sanskrit: इम उ त्वा वि चक्षते सखाय इन्द्र सोमिनः । पुष्टावन्तो यथा पशुम्
verses.transliteration: ima u tvA vi chakShate sakhAya indra sominaH | puShTAvanto yathA pashum
verses.translation: These soma-offering friends behold you, Indra, like well-fed cattle.

verses.sanskrit: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः । समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः
verses.transliteration: samasya manyave visho vishvA namanta kR^iShTayaH | samudrAyeva sindhavaH
verses.translation: At his wrath the peoples bow, all the tribes, as rivers bow to the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: देवानामिदवो महत्तदा वृणीमहे वयम् । वृष्णामस्मभ्यमूतये
verses.transliteration: devAnAmidavo mahattadA vR^iNImahe vayam | vR^iShNAmasmabhyamUtaye
verses.translation: We choose the great protection of the gods alone; for our help, that of the bountiful ones.

verses.sanskrit: सोमानाँ स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते । कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः
verses.transliteration: somAnA.N svaraNaM kR^iNuhi brahmaNaspate | kakShIvantaM ya aushijaH
verses.translation: O Brahmanaspati, make the soma-sounds ring for Kakshivan, the son of Ushij.

verses.sanskrit: बोधन्मना इदस्तु नो वृत्रहा भूर्यासुतिः । शृणोतु शक्र आशिषम्
verses.transliteration: bodhanmanA idastu no vR^itrahA bhUryAsutiH | shR^iNotu shakra AshiSham
verses.translation: May he of attentive mind be ours, the Vritra-slayer, receiver of many libations; may the mighty one hear our prayer.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य नो देव सवितः प्रजावत्सावीः सौभगम् । परा दुःष्वप्न्यँ सुव
verses.transliteration: adya no deva savitaH prajAvatsAvIH saubhagam | parA duHShvapnya.N suva
verses.translation: Today, O god Savitar, bring us good fortune with offspring; drive away the bad dream.

verses.sanskrit: क्वा३स्य वृषभो युवा तुविग्रीवो अनानतः । ब्रह्मा कस्तँ सपर्यति
verses.transliteration: kvA3sya vR^iShabho yuvA tuvigrIvo anAnataH | brahmA kasta.N saparyati
verses.translation: Where is his young bull with a strong neck, unbowed? Which priest worships him?

verses.sanskrit: उपह्वरे गिरीणाँ सङ्गमे च नदीनाम् । धिया विप्रो अजायत
verses.transliteration: upahvare girINA.N sa~Ngame cha nadInAm | dhiyA vipro ajAyata
verses.translation: In the folds of the mountains and at the confluence of rivers, the sage was born through thought.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिन्द्रँ स्तोता नव्यं गीर्भिः । नरं नृषाहं मँहिष्ठम्
verses.transliteration: pra samrAjaM charShaNInAmindra.N stotA navyaM gIrbhiH | naraM nR^iShAhaM ma.NhiShTham
verses.translation: The singer, with songs, praises Indra, new sovereign of the peoples, the hero, conqueror of men, the greatest.

verses.sanskrit: अपादु शिप्रयन्धसः सुदक्षस्य प्रहोषिणः । इन्द्रोरिन्द्रो यवाशिरः
verses.transliteration: apAdu shiprayandhasaH sudakShasya prahoShiNaH | indrorindro yavAshiraH
verses.translation: From the one with the fine jaw, the skilled, the generous one — Indra of the moon-drops, mixed with barley.

verses.sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पुरुवसोऽभि प्र नोनवुर्गिरः । गावो वत्सं न धेनवः
verses.transliteration: imA u tvA puruvaso.abhi pra nonavurgiraH | gAvo vatsaM na dhenavaH
verses.translation: These songs of ours, O rich in wealth, have cried out to you, like cows to their calf.

verses.sanskrit: अत्राह गोरमन्वत नाम त्वष्टुरपीच्यम् । इत्था चन्द्रमसो गृहे
verses.transliteration: atrAha goramanvata nAma tvaShTurapIchyam | itthA chandramaso gR^ihe
verses.translation: Here they perceived the secret name of the cow, of Tvashtar, thus in the house of the moon.

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्रो अनयद्रितो महीरपो वृषन्तमः । तत्र पूषाभुवत्सचा
verses.transliteration: yadindro anayadrito mahIrapo vR^iShantamaH | tatra pUShAbhuvatsachA
verses.translation: When Indra led the great waters, the most manly, there Pushan was our companion.

verses.sanskrit: गौर्धयति मरुताँ श्रवस्युर्माता मघोनाम् युक्ता वह्नी रथानाम्
verses.transliteration: gaurdhayati marutA.N shravasyurmAtA maghonAm yuktA vahnI rathAnAm
verses.translation: The cow nurses, eager for fame, the mother of the Maruts and of the bounteous, the yoked bearer of chariots.

verses.sanskrit: उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम्
verses.transliteration: upa no haribhiH sutaM yAhi madAnAM pate | upa no haribhiH sutam
verses.translation: Come to us with your bay horses to the pressed soma, lord of exhilarations; come to us with your bay horses to the pressed soma.

verses.sanskrit: इष्टा होत्रा असृक्षतेन्द्रं वृधन्तो अध्वरे । अच्छावभृथमोजसा
verses.transliteration: iShTA hotrA asR^ikShatendraM vR^idhanto adhvare | achChAvabhR^ithamojasA
verses.translation: The offerings, desired, have been poured to Indra as they increase him at the sacrifice, toward the final bath with might.

verses.sanskrit: अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रह । अहँ सूर्य इवाजनि
verses.transliteration: ahamiddhi pituShpari medhAmR^itasya jagraha | aha.N sUrya ivAjani
verses.translation: I have taken hold of the wisdom of truth from my father; I have been born like the sun.

verses.sanskrit: रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः । क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम
verses.transliteration: revatIrnaH sadhamAda indre santu tuvivAjAH | kShumanto yAbhirmadema
verses.translation: May our rich cattle, strong in vigor, be with Indra in the shared feast, by which we may rejoice with plenty.

verses.sanskrit: सोमः पूषा च चेततुर्विश्वासाँ सुक्षितीनाम् । देवत्रा रथ्योर्हिता
verses.transliteration: somaH pUShA cha chetaturvishvAsA.N sukShitInAm | devatrA rathyorhitA
verses.translation: Soma and Pushan awaken to all the good dwellings; among the gods they are placed for the charioteers.

verses.sanskrit: पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । विश्वासाहँ शतक्रतुं मँहिष्ठं चर्षणीनाम्
verses.transliteration: pAntamA vo andhasa indramabhi pra gAyata | vishvAsAha.N shatakratuM ma.NhiShThaM charShaNInAm
verses.translation: Sing to Indra, the best protector of your drink — the all-conquering, hundred-powered, greatest of the peoples.

verses.sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय मादनँ हर्यश्वाय गायत । सखायः सोमपाव्ने
verses.transliteration: pra va indrAya mAdana.N haryashvAya gAyata | sakhAyaH somapAvne
verses.translation: Sing the exhilarating song for Indra of the bay horses, friends — for the drinker of soma.

verses.sanskrit: वयमु त्वा तदिदर्था इन्द्र त्वायन्तः सखायः । कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते
verses.transliteration: vayamu tvA tadidarthA indra tvAyantaH sakhAyaH | kaNvA ukthebhirjarante
verses.translation: We, O Indra, longing for you, friends with this very aim, the Kanvas, praise you with hymns.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः । अर्कमर्चन्तु कारवः
verses.transliteration: indrAya madvane sutaM pari ShTobhantu no giraH | arkamarchantu kAravaH
verses.translation: Let our songs resound around Indra for the pressed exhilarating soma; let the singers sing the hymn.

verses.sanskrit: अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि । एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब
verses.transliteration: ayaM ta indra somo nipUto adhi barhiShi | ehImasya dravA piba
verses.translation: This soma of yours, O Indra, is purified on the grass; come, hasten and drink it.

verses.sanskrit: सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे । जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि
verses.transliteration: surUpakR^itnumUtaye sudughAmiva goduhe | juhUmasi dyavidyavi
verses.translation: For help we invoke day by day him who makes fair forms, like a good milker for the one who milks.

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतँ सृजामि पीतये । तृम्पा व्यश्नुही मदम्
verses.transliteration: abhi tvA vR^iShabhA sute suta.N sR^ijAmi pItaye | tR^impA vyashnuhI madam
verses.translation: O bull, I pour out the pressed soma for you to drink; be satisfied and attain exhilaration.

verses.sanskrit: य इन्द्र चमसेष्वा सोमश्चमूषु ते सुतः । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे
verses.transliteration: ya indra chamaseShvA somashchamUShu te sutaH | pibedasya tvamIshiShe
verses.translation: O Indra, the soma pressed for you in the cups and vessels — you are lord of it; drink it.

verses.sanskrit: योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये
verses.transliteration: yogeyoge tavastaraM vAjevAje havAmahe | sakhAya indramUtaye
verses.translation: At every yoking, at every battle, we, friends, invoke Indra, the mightiest, for help.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । सखायः स्तोमवाहसः
verses.transliteration: A tvetA ni ShIdatendramabhi pra gAyata | sakhAyaH stomavAhasaH
verses.translation: Come and sit down; sing to Indra, friends who bear the hymn.

verses.sanskrit: इदँ ह्यन्वोजसा सुतँ राधानां पते । पिबा त्वा३स्य गिर्वणः
verses.transliteration: ida.N hyanvojasA suta.N rAdhAnAM pate | pibA tvA3sya girvaNaH
verses.translation: This has been pressed with strength, O lord of bounties; drink of it, you who love songs.

verses.sanskrit: महाँ इन्द्रः पुरश्च नो महित्वमस्तु वज्रिणे । द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः
verses.transliteration: mahA.N indraH purashcha no mahitvamastu vajriNe | dyaurna prathinA shavaH
verses.translation: Great is Indra, and may greatness be before us for the thunderbolt-bearer; his strength spreads wide like heaven.

verses.sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभँ सं गृभाय । महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन
verses.transliteration: A tU na indra kShumantaM chitraM grAbha.N saM gR^ibhAya | mahAhastI dakShiNena
verses.translation: Now, Indra, take hold of the abundant, wondrous grasp for us, great-handed, with your right hand.

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । सूनुँ सत्यस्य सत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: abhi pra gopatiM girendramarcha yathA vide | sUnu.N satyasya satpatim
verses.translation: Praise with song Indra, lord of cattle, as one who knows — son of truth, lord of the good.

verses.sanskrit: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा । कया शचिष्ठया वृता
verses.transliteration: kayA nashchitra A bhuvadUtI sadAvR^idhaH sakhA | kayA shachiShThayA vR^itA
verses.translation: By what wondrous help shall he come to us, an ever-growing friend? By what mighty company?

verses.sanskrit: त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतम् । आ च्यावयस्यूतये
verses.transliteration: tyamu vaH satrAsAhaM vishvAsu gIrShvAyatam | A chyAvayasyUtaye
verses.translation: We praise him, who is conqueror in all battles, stretched out in all songs; may you bring him to help us.

verses.sanskrit: सदसस्पतिमद्भुतं प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम् । सनिं मेधामयासिषम्
verses.transliteration: sadasaspatimadbhutaM priyamindrasya kAmyam | saniM medhAmayAsiSham
verses.translation: I have sought the wise, the lord of the assembly, wondrous, dear to Indra, desirable — a gift of insight.

verses.sanskrit: ये ते पन्था अधो दिवो येभिर्व्यश्वमैरयः । उत श्रोषन्तु नो भुवः
verses.transliteration: ye te panthA adho divo yebhirvyashvamairayaH | uta shroShantu no bhuvaH
verses.translation: The paths of yours which lie below heaven, by which you drove the horseless — may the lands also hear us.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रम्भद्रं न आ भरेषमूर्जँ शतक्रतो । यदिन्द्र मृडयासि नः
verses.transliteration: bhadrambhadraM na A bhareShamUrja.N shatakrato | yadindra mR^iDayAsi naH
verses.translation: Bring us every good thing, strength and food, O hundred-powered; since, Indra, you make us happy.

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति सोमो अयँ सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः । उत स्वराजो अश्विना
verses.transliteration: asti somo aya.N sutaH pibantyasya marutaH | uta svarAjo ashvinA
verses.translation: This soma has been pressed; the Maruts drink of it, and also the self-ruling Ashvins.

verses.sanskrit: ईङ्खयन्तीरपस्युव इन्द्रं जातमुपासते । वन्वानासः सुवीर्यम्
verses.transliteration: I~NkhayantIrapasyuva indraM jAtamupAsate | vanvAnAsaH suvIryam
verses.translation: The waters, busy and moving, wait on the newborn Indra, desiring heroic strength.

verses.sanskrit: न कि देवा इनीमसि न क्या योपयामसि । मन्त्रश्रुत्यं चरामसि
verses.transliteration: na ki devA inImasi na kyA yopayAmasi | mantrashrutyaM charAmasi
verses.translation: We do not harm the gods, nor do we bring them to harm; we walk by the hearing of the mantra.

verses.sanskrit: दोषो आगाद्बृहद्गाय द्युमद्गामन्नाथर्वण । स्तुहि देवँ सवितारम्
verses.transliteration: doSho AgAdbR^ihadgAya dyumadgAmannAtharvaNa | stuhi deva.N savitAram
verses.translation: Evening has come; sing the great, the radiant song, O Atharvan descendant; praise the god Savitar.

verses.sanskrit: एषो उषा अपूर्व्या व्युच्छति प्रिया दिवः । स्तुषे वामश्विना बृहत्
verses.transliteration: eSho uShA apUrvyA vyuchChati priyA divaH | stuShe vAmashvinA bR^ihat
verses.translation: This incomparable Dawn dawns, the beloved of heaven; I praise you, Ashvins, loudly.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर्वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः । जघान नवतीर्नव
verses.transliteration: indro dadhIcho asthabhirvR^itrANyapratiShkutaH | jaghAna navatIrnava
verses.translation: Indra, with the bones of Dadhyanch, unresisted, slew the Vritras, ninety-nine times.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रेहि मत्स्यन्धसो विश्वेभिः सोमपर्वभिः । महाँ अभिष्टिरोजसा
verses.transliteration: indrehi matsyandhaso vishvebhiH somaparvabhiH | mahA.N abhiShTirojasA
verses.translation: Come, Indra, rejoice in the drink, with all the soma-joints; great is your aim, great your strength.

verses.sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र वृत्रहन्नस्माकमर्धमा गहि । महान्महीभिरूतिभिः
verses.transliteration: A tU na indra vR^itrahannasmAkamardhamA gahi | mahAnmahIbhirUtibhiH
verses.translation: Come to us now, Indra, Vritra-slayer, to our sacrifice, great one, with great helps.

verses.sanskrit: ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्तयत् । इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी
verses.transliteration: ojastadasya titviSha ubhe yatsamavartayat | indrashcharmeva rodasI
verses.translation: His strength shone forth when he turned both worlds like a skin, Indra, heaven and earth.

verses.sanskrit: अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिम् । वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे
verses.transliteration: ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbhadhim | vachastachchinna ohase
verses.translation: Here for you, in the contest, like a dove to its nest — you carry that word of ours as well.

verses.sanskrit: वात आ वातु बेषजँ शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे । प्र न अयूँषि तारिषत्
verses.transliteration: vAta A vAtu beShaja.N shambhu mayobhu no hR^ide | pra na ayU.NShi tAriShat
verses.translation: O wind, blow healing; bring comfort and joy to our hearts, and extend our lives.

verses.sanskrit: यँ रक्षन्ति प्रचेतसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । न किः स दभ्यते जनः
verses.transliteration: ya.N rakShanti prachetaso varuNo mitro aryamA | na kiH sa dabhyate janaH
verses.translation: The man whom the wise Varuna, Mitra and Aryaman protect — no one harms him.

verses.sanskrit: गव्यो षु णो यथा पुराश्वयोत रथया । वरिवस्या महोनाम्
verses.transliteration: gavyo Shu No yathA purAshvayota rathayA | varivasyA mahonAm
verses.translation: Desiring cattle, and horses and chariots, as before, do homage to the great ones.

verses.sanskrit: इमास्त इन्द्र पृश्नयो घृतं दुहत आशिरम् । एनामृतस्य पिप्युषीः
verses.transliteration: imAsta indra pR^ishnayo ghR^itaM duhata Ashiram | enAmR^itasya pipyuShIH
verses.translation: These dappled cows of yours, Indra, yield the ghee-mixed drink, swelling with this of truth.

verses.sanskrit: अया धिया च गव्यया पुरुणामन्पुरुष्टुत । यत्सोमेसोम आभुवः
verses.transliteration: ayA dhiyA cha gavyayA puruNAmanpuruShTuta | yatsomesoma AbhuvaH
verses.translation: By this thought, desiring cattle, O much-named, much-praised, whenever you are present at every soma.

verses.sanskrit: पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती । यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः
verses.transliteration: pAvakA naH sarasvatI vAjebhirvAjinIvatI | yaj~naM vaShTu dhiyAvasuH
verses.translation: May the purifying Sarasvati, rich in strength, with strengths, desire our sacrifice, she who gives wealth through thought.

verses.sanskrit: क इमं नाहुषीष्वा इन्द्रँ सोमस्य तर्पयात् । स नो वसून्या भरात्
verses.transliteration: ka imaM nAhuShIShvA indra.N somasya tarpayAt | sa no vasUnyA bharAt
verses.translation: Who will satisfy this Indra among the human clans with soma? May he bring us treasures.

verses.sanskrit: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम् । एदं बर्हिः सदो मम
verses.transliteration: A yAhi suShumA hi ta indra somaM pibA imam | edaM barhiH sado mama
verses.translation: Come, for we have pressed for you, Indra; drink this soma; come to this grass, my seat.

verses.sanskrit: महि त्रीणामवरस्तु द्युक्षं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः । दुराधर्षं वरुणस्य
verses.transliteration: mahi trINAmavarastu dyukShaM mitrasyAryamNaH | durAdharShaM varuNasya
verses.translation: May the great, heaven-dwelling, indomitable protection of the three — Mitra, Aryaman, Varuna — be below us.

verses.sanskrit: त्वावतः पुरूवसो वयमिन्द्र प्रणेतः । स्मसि स्थातर्हरीणाम्
verses.transliteration: tvAvataH purUvaso vayamindra praNetaH | smasi sthAtarharINAm
verses.translation: We are of those like you, O rich in wealth, O leader, Indra; stand, lord of the bay horses.

verses.sanskrit: उत्त्वा मन्दन्तु सोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः । अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि
verses.transliteration: uttvA mandantu somAH kR^iNuShva rAdho adrivaH | ava brahmadviSho jahi
verses.translation: May the soma-drops delight you; make us rich, O stone-bearer; strike down the haters of prayer.

verses.sanskrit: गिर्वणः पाहि नः सुतं मधोर्धाराभिरज्यसे । इन्द्र त्वादातमिद्यशः
verses.transliteration: girvaNaH pAhi naH sutaM madhordhArAbhirajyase | indra tvAdAtamidyashaH
verses.translation: O you who love songs, protect our pressed soma; you are anointed with streams of honey; Indra, fame is what you have given.

verses.sanskrit: सदा व इन्द्रश्चर्कृषदा उपो नु स सपर्यन् । न देवो वृतः शूर इन्द्रः
verses.transliteration: sadA va indrashcharkR^iShadA upo nu sa saparyan | na devo vR^itaH shUra indraH
verses.translation: Indra ever does good for you; he will worship near; the hero Indra is not a god who is resisted.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते
verses.transliteration: A tvA vishantvindavaH samudramiva sindhavaH | na tvAmindrAti richyate
verses.translation: May the drops enter you as rivers the sea; none excels you, Indra.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत
verses.transliteration: indramidgAthino bR^ihadindramarkebhirarkiNaH | indraM vANIranUShata
verses.translation: The singers sing to Indra great songs; those with hymns, with hymns; the voices praised Indra.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र इषे ददातु न ऋभुक्षणमृभुँ रयिम् । वाजी ददातु वाजिनम्
verses.transliteration: indra iShe dadAtu na R^ibhukShaNamR^ibhu.N rayim | vAjI dadAtu vAjinam
verses.translation: May Indra give us food, wealth, skilled and bright; may the strong one give the strong.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो अङ्ग महद्भयमभी षदप चुच्यवत् । स हि स्थिरो विचर्षणिः
verses.transliteration: indro a~Nga mahadbhayamabhI Shadapa chuchyavat | sa hi sthiro vicharShaNiH
verses.translation: Indra, indeed, has driven away great fear; he is steady and all-seeing.

verses.sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा सुतेसुते नक्षन्ते गिर्वणो गिरः । गावो वत्सं न धेनवः
verses.transliteration: imA u tvA sutesute nakShante girvaNo giraH | gAvo vatsaM na dhenavaH
verses.translation: These songs of ours, O lover of songs, reach you at every pressing, like cows reaching their calf.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रा नु पूषणा वयँ सख्याय स्वस्तये । हुवेम वाजसातये
verses.transliteration: indrA nu pUShaNA vaya.N sakhyAya svastaye | huvema vAjasAtaye
verses.translation: Now Indra and Pushan, we call on you for friendship, for welfare, for the winning of strength.

verses.sanskrit: न कि इन्द्र त्वदुत्तरं न ज्यायो अस्ति वृत्रहन् । न क्येवं यथा त्वम्
verses.transliteration: na ki indra tvaduttaraM na jyAyo asti vR^itrahan | na kyevaM yathA tvam
verses.translation: Nothing, Indra, is higher than you, nothing greater, Vritra-slayer; none is such as you.

verses.sanskrit: तरणिं वो जनानां त्रदं वाजस्य गोमतः । समानमु प्र शँसिषम्
verses.transliteration: taraNiM vo janAnAM tradaM vAjasya gomataH | samAnamu pra sha.NsiSham
verses.translation: I praise the same one for you: the deliverer of the peoples, the giver of strength with cattle.

verses.sanskrit: असृग्रमिन्द्र ते गिरः प्रति त्वामुदहासत । सजोषा वृषभं पतिम्
verses.transliteration: asR^igramindra te giraH prati tvAmudahAsata | sajoShA vR^iShabhaM patim
verses.translation: Our songs have gone out to you, Indra; they rise to you, the bull, the lord, in harmony.

verses.sanskrit: सुनीथो घा स मर्त्यो यं मरुतो यमर्यमा । मित्रास्पान्त्यद्रुहः
verses.transliteration: sunItho ghA sa martyo yaM maruto yamaryamA | mitrAspAntyadruhaH
verses.translation: He is indeed the well-led mortal whom the Maruts and Aryaman, the friends, guard without deceit.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वीडाविन्द्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतम् । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर
verses.transliteration: yadvIDAvindra yatsthire yatparshAne parAbhR^itam | vasu spArhaM tadA bhara
verses.translation: Whatever wealth is hidden in strength, in steadiness, or in the far distance — bring that desirable wealth.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतं वो वृत्रहन्तमं प्र शर्धं चर्षणीनाम् । आशिषे राधसे महे
verses.transliteration: shrutaM vo vR^itrahantamaM pra shardhaM charShaNInAm | AshiShe rAdhase mahe
verses.translation: The famed best Vritra-slayer, the force of the peoples, is for blessing and great bounty.

verses.sanskrit: अरं त इन्द्र श्रवसे गमेम शूर त्वावतः । अरँ शक्र परेमणि
verses.transliteration: araM ta indra shravase gamema shUra tvAvataH | ara.N shakra paremaNi
verses.translation: May we reach enough fame for you, O hero Indra; enough, powerful one, in the far attack.

verses.sanskrit: धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम् । इन्द्र प्रातर्जुषस्व नः
verses.transliteration: dhAnAvantaM karambhiNamapUpavantamukthinam | indra prAtarjuShasva naH
verses.translation: Indra, enjoy this morning our offering of roasted grain, porridge, cakes and hymns.

verses.sanskrit: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः । विश्वा यदजय स्पृधः
verses.transliteration: apAM phenena namucheH shira indrodavartayaH | vishvA yadajaya spR^idhaH
verses.translation: With the foam of the waters, Indra, you cut off the head of Namuchi, when you conquered all rivals.

verses.sanskrit: इमे त इन्द्र सोमाः सुतासो ये च सोत्वाः । तेषां मत्स्व प्रभूवसो
verses.transliteration: ime ta indra somAH sutAso ye cha sotvAH | teShAM matsva prabhUvaso
verses.translation: These soma-drops are yours, Indra, those pressed and those yet to be pressed; rejoice in them, O lord of wealth.

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यँ सुतासः सोमाः स्तीर्णं बर्हिर्विभावसो । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र मृडय
verses.transliteration: tubhya.N sutAsaH somAH stIrNaM barhirvibhAvaso | stotR^ibhya indra mR^iDaya
verses.translation: The pressed somas are for you, the grass is spread, O shining one; be gracious to the singers, Indra.

verses.sanskrit: आ व इन्द्र कृविं यथा वाजयन्तः शतक्रतुम् । मँहिष्ठँ सिञ्च इन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration: A va indra kR^iviM yathA vAjayantaH shatakratum | ma.NhiShTha.N si~ncha indubhiH
verses.translation: O Indra, hundred-powered like a skilled worker, desiring strength, I pour the greatest soma-drops for you.

verses.sanskrit: अतश्चिदिन्द्र न उपा याहि शतवाजया । इषा सहस्रवाजया
verses.transliteration: atashchidindra na upA yAhi shatavAjayA | iShA sahasravAjayA
verses.translation: From here, Indra, come to us with a hundred strengths, with food that brings a thousand strengths.

verses.sanskrit: आ बुन्दं वृत्रहा ददे जातः पृच्छद्वि मातरम् । क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे
verses.transliteration: A bundaM vR^itrahA dade jAtaH pR^ichChadvi mAtaram | ka ugrAH ke ha shR^iNvire
verses.translation: The Vritra-slayer took the arrow; born, he asked his mother: who are the mighty, who are heard of?

verses.sanskrit: बृबदुक्थँ हवामहे सृप्रकरस्नमूतये । साधः कृण्वन्तमवसे
verses.transliteration: bR^ibaduktha.N havAmahe sR^iprakarasnamUtaye | sAdhaH kR^iNvantamavase
verses.translation: We call on the one of great hymns, the shining-handed, for help — one who accomplishes for protection.

verses.sanskrit: ऋजुनीती नो वरुणो मित्रो नयति विद्वान् । अर्यमा देवैः सजोषाः
verses.transliteration: R^ijunItI no varuNo mitro nayati vidvAn | aryamA devaiH sajoShAH
verses.translation: May Varuna, Mitra, knowing, lead us by the straight path, and Aryaman in harmony with the gods.

verses.sanskrit: दूरादिहेव यत्सतोऽरुणप्सुरशिश्वितत् । वि भानुं विश्वथातनत्
verses.transliteration: dUrAdiheva yatsato.aruNapsurashishvitat | vi bhAnuM vishvathAtanat
verses.translation: When from afar, as if here, the ruddy-limbed one blazed, he spread his light everywhere.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो मित्रावरुणा घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम् । मध्वा रजाँसि सुक्रतू
verses.transliteration: A no mitrAvaruNA ghR^itairgavyUtimukShatam | madhvA rajA.Nsi sukratU
verses.translation: O Mitra and Varuna, skilled ones, sprinkle our pasture with ghee and our realms with honey.

verses.sanskrit: उदु त्ये सूनवो गिरः काष्ठा यज्ञेष्वत्नत । वाश्रा अभिज्ञु यातवे
verses.transliteration: udu tye sUnavo giraH kAShThA yaj~neShvatnata | vAshrA abhij~nu yAtave
verses.translation: These sons of ours have stretched the songs to the goal at the sacrifices, to go forth with eager spirits.

verses.sanskrit: इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदम् । समूढमस्य पाँसुले
verses.transliteration: idaM viShNurvi chakrame tredhA ni dadhe padam | samUDhamasya pA.Nsule
verses.translation: Vishnu strode across this; he set his foot in three ways; the whole was gathered in his dusty step.

verses.sanskrit: अतीहि मन्युषाविणँ सुषुवाँसमुपेरय । अस्य रातौ सुतं पिब
verses.transliteration: atIhi manyuShAviNa.N suShuvA.Nsamuperaya | asya rAtau sutaM piba
verses.translation: Pass by the one who is full of wrath; urge on the one who has pressed; drink the pressed soma in his gift.

verses.sanskrit: कदु प्रचेतसे महे वचो देवाय शस्यते । तदिध्यस्य वर्धनम्
verses.transliteration: kadu prachetase mahe vacho devAya shasyate | tadidhyasya vardhanam
verses.translation: What word is spoken to the great wise god? That alone increases him.

verses.sanskrit: उक्थं च न शस्यमानं नागो रयिरा चिकेत । न गायत्रं गीयमानम्
verses.transliteration: ukthaM cha na shasyamAnaM nAgo rayirA chiketa | na gAyatraM gIyamAnam
verses.translation: Neither the recited hymn nor the wealth is known to be praised; nor is the Gayatri sung.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र उक्थेभिर्मन्दिष्ठो वाजानां च वाजपतिः । हरिवान्त्सुतानाँ सखा
verses.transliteration: indra ukthebhirmandiShTho vAjAnAM cha vAjapatiH | harivAntsutAnA.N sakhA
verses.translation: Indra is the most exhilarating with hymns and lord of strengths; he has bay horses and is friend of the pressed soma.

verses.sanskrit: आ याह्युप नः सुतं वाजेभिर्मा हृणीयथाः । महाँ इव युवजानिः
verses.transliteration: A yAhyupa naH sutaM vAjebhirmA hR^iNIyathAH | mahA.N iva yuvajAniH
verses.translation: Come to our pressed soma with your strengths; do not be angry at us, like a great young husband.

verses.sanskrit: कदा वसो स्तोत्रँ हर्यत आ अव श्मशा रुधद्वाः । दीर्घँ सुतम् वाताप्याय
verses.transliteration: kadA vaso stotra.N haryata A ava shmashA rudhadvAH | dIrgha.N sutam vAtApyAya
verses.translation: When, O Vasu, will the praise reach him, the beloved, and hold back the strongly spread hostility? The long pressing for the wind to swell.

verses.sanskrit: ब्राह्मणादिन्द्र राधसः पिबा सोममृतूँ रनु । तवेदँ सख्यमस्तृतम्
verses.transliteration: brAhmaNAdindra rAdhasaH pibA somamR^itU.N ranu | taveda.N sakhyamastR^itam
verses.translation: O Indra, drink soma from the Brahmin's offering, following the seasons; this friendship of yours is unconquered.

verses.sanskrit: वयं घा ते अपि स्मसि स्तोतार इन्द्र गिर्वणः । त्वं नो जिन्व सोमपाः
verses.transliteration: vayaM ghA te api smasi stotAra indra girvaNaH | tvaM no jinva somapAH
verses.translation: We too are yours, Indra, your praisers, lover of songs; you, soma-drinker, quicken us.

verses.sanskrit: एन्द्र पृक्षु कासु चिन्नृम्णं तनूषु धेहि नः । सत्राजिदुग्र पौँस्यम्
verses.transliteration: endra pR^ikShu kAsu chinnR^imNaM tanUShu dhehi naH | satrAjidugra pau.Nsyam
verses.translation: Come, Indra, place manly vigor in our bodies in all the battles; O ever-victorious, mighty one, give us strength.

verses.sanskrit: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः । एवा ते राध्यं मनः
verses.transliteration: evA hyasi vIrayurevA shUra uta sthiraH | evA te rAdhyaM manaH
verses.translation: So indeed you are hero-loving, so indeed brave and steady; so your mind is to be won.

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमोऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः । ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिन्द्र तस्थुषः
verses.transliteration: abhi tvA shUra nonumo.adugdhA iva dhenavaH | IshAnamasya jagataH svardR^ishamIshAnamindra tasthuShaH
verses.translation: We cry to you, O hero, like unmilked cows — you who rule this world, who see the sun, who rule what stands, Indra.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामिद्धि हवामहे सातौ वाजस्य कार्वः । त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस्त्वां काष्ठास्वर्वतः
verses.transliteration: tvAmiddhi havAmahe sAtau vAjasya kArvaH | tvAM vR^itreShvindra satpatiM narastvAM kAShThAsvarvataH
verses.translation: We call on you alone for the winning of strength, the poets; you, lord of the good in battles, Indra — men call on you, as do racers at the goals.

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति
verses.transliteration: abhi pra vaH surAdhasamindramarcha yathA vide | yo jaritR^ibhyo maghavA purUvasuH sahasreNeva shikShati
verses.translation: Praise Indra, bounteous, as one who knows, who gives to singers, rich in wealth, giving as if by thousands.

verses.sanskrit: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः । अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे
verses.transliteration: taM vo dasmamR^itIShahaM vasormandAnamandhasaH | abhi vatsaM na svasareShu dhenava indraM gIrbhirnavAmahe
verses.translation: Him, your wondrous victor over foes, rejoicing in the soma-drink of the Vasu — with songs we praise Indra anew, as cows their calf in their stalls.

verses.sanskrit: तरोभिर्वो विदद्वसुमिन्द्रँ सबाध ऊतये । बृहद्गायन्तः सुतसोमे अध्वरे हुवे भरं न कारिणम्
verses.transliteration: tarobhirvo vidadvasumindra.N sabAdha Utaye | bR^ihadgAyantaH sutasome adhvare huve bharaM na kAriNam
verses.translation: With strengths I invoke Indra, finder of wealth, together with our fellows for help, at the soma-pressing sacrifice, singing loudly, as one calls a worker for his burden.

verses.sanskrit: तरणिरित्सिषासति वाजं पुरन्ध्या युजा । आ व इन्द्रं पुरुहूतं नमे गिरा नेमिं तष्टेव सुद्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: taraNiritsiShAsati vAjaM purandhyA yujA | A va indraM puruhUtaM name girA nemiM taShTeva sudruvam
verses.translation: The swift one desires strength with his yoked fullness; with song I bow to Indra, invoked by many, as a carpenter to a well-running wheel-rim.

verses.sanskrit: पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः । आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्ये वृधे३ऽस्माँ अवन्तु ते धियः
verses.transliteration: pibA sutasya rasino matsvA na indra gomataH | Apirno bodhi sadhamAdye vR^idhe3.asmA.N avantu te dhiyaH
verses.translation: Drink the flavored pressed soma, Indra, and rejoice for us, rich in cattle; be our kinsman in the shared feast; may your thoughts protect us.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये । उद्वावृषस्व मघवन्गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये
verses.transliteration: tva.N hyehi cherave vidA bhagaM vasuttaye | udvAvR^iShasva maghavangaviShTaya udindrAshvamiShTaye
verses.translation: You come, for the wanderer; find fortune for the winning of wealth; rise up, bounteous one, for the seeking of cattle, Indra, for the seeking of horses.

verses.sanskrit: न हि वश्चरमं च न वसिष्ठः परिमँस्ते । अस्माकमद्य मरुतः सुते सचा विश्वे पिबन्तु कामिनः
verses.transliteration: na hi vashcharamaM cha na vasiShThaH parima.Nste | asmAkamadya marutaH sute sachA vishve pibantu kAminaH
verses.translation: For neither the last nor Vasishtha will be shut out from you; today, O Maruts, may all the wishful ones drink together at our pressing.

verses.sanskrit: मा चिदन्यद्वि शँसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत । इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वृषणँ सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शँसत
verses.transliteration: mA chidanyadvi sha.Nsata sakhAyo mA riShaNyata | indramitstotA vR^iShaNa.N sachA sute muhurukthA cha sha.Nsata
verses.translation: Friends, praise no other; do not wish harm. Praise Indra the bull together at the pressing, and recite the hymns again and again.
