verses.sanskrit: न किष्टं कर्मणा नशद्यश्चकार सदावृधम् । इन्द्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्णुमोजसा
verses.transliteration: na kiShTaM karmaNA nashadyashchakAra sadAvR^idham | indraM na yaj~nairvishvagUrtamR^ibhvasamadhR^iShTaM dhR^iShNumojasA
verses.translation: No work of him who has made the ever-growing one perishes; by sacrifices praise Indra, the all-praised, skilful, unassailable, bold in strength.

verses.sanskrit: य ऋते चिदभिश्रिषः पुरा जत्रुभ्य आतृदः । सन्धाता सन्धिं मघवा पुरूवसुर्निष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः
verses.transliteration: ya R^ite chidabhishriShaH purA jatrubhya AtR^idaH | sandhAtA sandhiM maghavA purUvasurniShkartA vihrutaM punaH
verses.translation: He who, without any support, breaks things before the collar-bones, the bounteous, rich in wealth, joins what is joined and restores again what is broken.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये । ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये
verses.transliteration: A tvA sahasramA shataM yuktA rathe hiraNyaye | brahmayujo haraya indra keshino vahantu somapItaye
verses.translation: May a thousand, a hundred, yoked to your golden chariot, your prayer-yoked, long-maned bay horses carry you, Indra, to drink the soma.

verses.sanskrit: आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः । मा त्वा के चिन्नि येमुरिन्न पाशिनोऽति धन्वेव ताँ इहि
verses.transliteration: A mandrairindra haribhiryAhi mayUraromabhiH | mA tvA ke chinni yemurinna pAshino.ati dhanveva tA.N ihi
verses.translation: Come, Indra, with your joyful bay horses, with peacock-feathered coats; let none, though they bind you, hold you back; pass beyond them like an archer.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमङ्ग प्र शँसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यम् । न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः
verses.transliteration: tvama~Nga pra sha.NsiSho devaH shaviShTha martyam | na tvadanyo maghavannasti marDitendra bravImi te vachaH
verses.translation: You indeed, O mightiest god, are praised for the mortal; there is no other than you, bounteous one, to be gracious; Indra, I speak this word to you.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पतिः । त्वं वृत्राणि हँस्यप्रतीन्येक इत्पुर्वनुत्तश्चर्षणीधृतिः
verses.transliteration: tvamindra yashA asyR^ijIShI shavasaspatiH | tvaM vR^itrANi ha.NsyapratInyeka itpurvanuttashcharShaNIdhR^itiH
verses.translation: You, Indra, are glorious, the receiver of the pressed soma, lord of strength; you alone slay the unopposed Vritras, the supporter of peoples, urged on by many.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे । इन्द्रँ समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये
verses.transliteration: indramiddevatAtaya indraM prayatyadhvare | indra.N samIke vanino havAmaha indraM dhanasya sAtaye
verses.translation: We call on Indra for worship; Indra at the progressing sacrifice; Indra in battle, we the singers call, and Indra for the winning of wealth.

verses.sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम । पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत
verses.transliteration: imA u tvA purUvaso giro vardhantu yA mama | pAvakavarNAH shuchayo vipashchito.abhi stomairanUShata
verses.translation: May these songs of mine strengthen you, O rich in wealth; the pure, fire-colored sages have sung to you with hymns.

verses.sanskrit: उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिर स्तोमास ईरते । सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव
verses.transliteration: udu tye madhumattamA gira stomAsa Irate | satrAjito dhanasA akShitotayo vAjayanto rathA iva
verses.translation: These sweetest songs and hymns of praise rise up — they are victory-winning, wealth-giving, unfailing helpers, striving like chariots.

verses.sanskrit: यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणम् । आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब
verses.transliteration: yathA gauro apA kR^itaM tR^iShyannetyaveriNam | Apitve naH prapitve tUyamA gahi kaNveShu su sachA piba
verses.translation: As a thirsty wild buffalo goes to the prepared water, so come swiftly in our kinship and our approach; drink well among the Kanvas.

verses.sanskrit: शग्ध्यू३षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि
verses.transliteration: shagdhyU3Shu shachIpata indra vishvAbhirUtibhiH | bhagaM na hi tvA yashasaM vasuvidamanu shUra charAmasi
verses.translation: Be able, lord of power, Indra, with all your helps; for we follow you, O hero, as fortune, glorious, finder of wealth.

verses.sanskrit: या इन्द्र भुज आभरः स्वर्वाँ असुरेभ्यः । स्तोतारमिन्मघवन्नस्य वर्धय ये च त्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः
verses.transliteration: yA indra bhuja AbharaH svarvA.N asurebhyaH | stotAraminmaghavannasya vardhaya ye cha tve vR^iktabarhiShaH
verses.translation: The arms, Indra, that you brought from the Asuras, winning the light — increase, bounteous one, this singer and those who have spread the grass for you.

verses.sanskrit: प्र मित्राय प्रार्यम्णे सचथ्यमृतावसो । वरूथ्ये३ वरुणे छन्द्यं वचः स्तोत्रँ राजसु गायत
verses.transliteration: pra mitrAya prAryamNe sachathyamR^itAvaso | varUthye3 varuNe ChandyaM vachaH stotra.N rAjasu gAyata
verses.translation: Sing forth a praise-song, fitting, to Mitra and Aryaman, O keepers of truth; sing the hymn to Varuna, the protector, among the kings.

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः । समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यम्
verses.transliteration: abhi tvA pUrvapItaya indra stomebhirAyavaH | samIchInAsa R^ibhavaH samasvaranrudrA gR^iNanta pUrvyam
verses.translation: The Ayus, with hymns, for your first drinking, O Indra; the Ribhus joined in one voice; the Rudras praised the ancient one.

verses.sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत । वृत्रँ हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा
verses.transliteration: pra va indrAya bR^ihate maruto brahmArchata | vR^itra.N hanati vR^itrahA shatakraturvajreNa shataparvaNA
verses.translation: O Maruts, offer the prayer for your great Indra; the Vritra-slayer, hundred-powered, slays Vritra with the hundred-jointed thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: बृहदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहन्तमम् । येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि
verses.transliteration: bR^ihadindrAya gAyata maruto vR^itrahantamam | yena jyotirajanayannR^itAvR^idho devaM devAya jAgR^ivi
verses.translation: Sing the great song to Indra, O Maruts, the best slayer of Vritra, by which the truth-strengtheners brought forth light — a wakeful god for the god.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा । शिक्षा णो अस्मिन्पुरुहूत यामनि जीवा ज्योतिरशीमहि
verses.transliteration: indra kratuM na A bhara pitA putrebhyo yathA | shikShA No asminpuruhUta yAmani jIvA jyotirashImahi
verses.translation: O Indra, bring us wisdom, as a father to his sons; teach us in this course, O much-invoked, that living we may attain the light.

verses.sanskrit: मा न इन्द्र परा वृणग्भवा नः सधमाद्ये । त्वं न ऊती त्वमिन्न आप्यम् मा न इन्द्र परा वृणक्
verses.transliteration: mA na indra parA vR^iNagbhavA naH sadhamAdye | tvaM na UtI tvaminna Apyam mA na indra parA vR^iNak
verses.translation: Indra, do not abandon us; be with us in the shared feast; you are our help, you our kinship; Indra, do not forsake us.

verses.sanskrit: वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः । पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते
verses.transliteration: vayaM gha tvA sutAvanta Apo na vR^iktabarhiShaH | pavitrasya prasravaNeShu vR^itrahanpari stotAra Asate
verses.translation: We who have pressed the soma for you, Vritra-slayer, and spread the grass, sit around the streams of the filter, as the waters.

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वा ओजो नृम्णं च कृष्टिषु । यद्वा पञ्च क्षितीनां द्युम्नमा भर सत्रा विश्वानि पौँस्या
verses.transliteration: yadindra nAhuShIShvA ojo nR^imNaM cha kR^iShTiShu | yadvA pa~ncha kShitInAM dyumnamA bhara satrA vishvAni pau.NsyA
verses.translation: Indra, the strength and manly power that you have among the Nahusha peoples, or among the five tribes — bring that splendor, and all manly powers together.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यमित्था वृषेदसि वृषजूतिर्नोऽविता । वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे परावति वृषो अर्वावति श्रुतः
verses.transliteration: satyamitthA vR^iShedasi vR^iShajUtirno.avitA | vR^iShA hyugra shR^iNviShe parAvati vR^iSho arvAvati shrutaH
verses.translation: Truly, thus you are a bull; our helper is urged on by bulls; you, fierce one, are heard far away; the bull is renowned near and far.

verses.sanskrit: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् । अतस्त्वा गीर्भिर्द्युगदिन्द्र केशिभिः सुतावाँ आ विवासति
verses.transliteration: yachChakrAsi parAvati yadarvAvati vR^itrahan | atastvA gIrbhirdyugadindra keshibhiH sutAvA.N A vivAsati
verses.translation: Whether, mighty one, you are far away, or nearby, Vritra-slayer, from there the pressed-soma giver, with his bay horses, honors you with songs.

verses.sanskrit: अभि वो वीरमन्धसो मदेषु गाय गिरा महा विचेतसम् । इन्द्रं नाम श्रुत्यँ शाकिनं वचो यथा
verses.transliteration: abhi vo vIramandhaso madeShu gAya girA mahA vichetasam | indraM nAma shrutya.N shAkinaM vacho yathA
verses.translation: In the delights of the drink, sing with song for yourselves the great, wise hero Indra, the powerful, of famed name, in words.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र त्रिधातु शरणं त्रिवरूथँ स्वस्तये । छर्दिर्यच्छ मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च यावया दिद्युमेभ्यः
verses.transliteration: indra tridhAtu sharaNaM trivarUtha.N svastaye | ChardiryachCha maghavadbhyashcha mahyaM cha yAvayA didyumebhyaH
verses.translation: Indra, grant a threefold refuge, threefold shelter, for welfare; give protection to the bountiful and to me; drive away from these the shining enemies.

verses.sanskrit: श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत । वसूनि जातो जनिमान्योजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिमः
verses.transliteration: shrAyanta iva sUryaM vishvedindrasya bhakShata | vasUni jAto janimAnyojasA prati bhAgaM na dIdhimaH
verses.translation: They seek the sun as if resting; enjoy all that belongs to Indra; born, the born wins wealth by might; we shine to claim our share.

verses.sanskrit: न सीमदेव आप तदिषं दीर्घायो मर्त्यः । एतग्वा चिद्या एतशो युयोजत इन्द्रो हरी युयोजते
verses.transliteration: na sImadeva Apa tadiShaM dIrghAyo martyaH | etagvA chidyA etasho yuyojata indro harI yuyojate
verses.translation: No mortal of long life, not divine, attains that food; even Etasha yoked, Indra yokes his bay horses.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो विश्वासु हव्यमिन्द्रँ समत्सु भूषत । उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहन्परमज्या ऋचीषम
verses.transliteration: A no vishvAsu havyamindra.N samatsu bhUShata | upa brahmANi savanAni vR^itrahanparamajyA R^ichIShama
verses.translation: Honor Indra, to be called in all battles; come to our prayers and soothing offerings, Vritra-slayer, with highest verses.

verses.sanskrit: तवेदिन्द्रावमं वसु त्वं पुष्यसि मध्यमम् । सत्रा विश्वस्य परमस्य राजसि न किष्ट्वा गोषु वृण्वते
verses.transliteration: tavedindrAvamaM vasu tvaM puShyasi madhyamam | satrA vishvasya paramasya rAjasi na kiShTvA goShu vR^iNvate
verses.translation: Yours alone, Indra, is the lowest wealth; you nourish the middle; you rule completely over all, the highest too; none hinders you among the cattle.

verses.sanskrit: क्वेयथ क्वेदसि पुरुत्रा चिद्धि ते मनः । अलर्षि युध्म खजकृत्पुरन्दर प्र गायत्रा अगासिषुः
verses.transliteration: kveyatha kvedasi purutrA chiddhi te manaH | alarShi yudhma khajakR^itpurandara pra gAyatrA agAsiShuH
verses.translation: Where do you go, where are you? Your mind is in many places. O warrior, fort-destroyer, the Gayatri songs have been sung.

verses.sanskrit: वयमेनमिदा ह्योपीपेमेह वज्रिणम् । तस्मा उ अद्य सवने सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते
verses.transliteration: vayamenamidA hyopIpemeha vajriNam | tasmA u adya savane sutaM bharA nUnaM bhUShata shrute
verses.translation: We have indeed fed this thunderbolt-bearer here; today at the pressing bring the soma for him; honor now the famed one.

verses.sanskrit: यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः । विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठं यो वृत्रहा गृणे
verses.transliteration: yo rAjA charShaNInAM yAtA rathebhiradhriguH | vishvAsAM tarutA pR^itanAnAM jyeShThaM yo vR^itrahA gR^iNe
verses.translation: The king of the peoples, who goes in chariots, irresistible, conqueror of all armies, the foremost Vritra-slayer — I praise him.

verses.sanskrit: यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि । मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतये वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि
verses.transliteration: yata indra bhayAmahe tato no abhayaM kR^idhi | maghava~nChagdhi tava tanna Utaye vi dviSho vi mR^idho jahi
verses.translation: From whatever we fear, Indra, make us safe from that; bounteous one, help us for our protection; drive away foes and enemies.

verses.sanskrit: वास्तोष्पते ध्रुवा स्थूणाँ सत्रँ सोम्यानाम् । द्रप्सः पुरां भेत्ता शश्वतीनामिन्द्रो मुनीनाँ सखा
verses.transliteration: vAstoShpate dhruvA sthUNA.N satra.N somyAnAm | drapsaH purAM bhettA shashvatInAmindro munInA.N sakhA
verses.translation: O lord of the dwelling, firm pillar, assembly of the soma-drinkers; the drop, breaker of the eternal forts, Indra, friend of sages.

verses.sanskrit: बण्महाँ असि सूर्य बडादित्य महाँ असि । महस्ते सतो महिमा पनिष्टम मह्ना देव महाँ असि
verses.transliteration: baNmahA.N asi sUrya baDAditya mahA.N asi | mahaste sato mahimA paniShTama mahnA deva mahA.N asi
verses.translation: Indeed you are great, O Sun; indeed, O Aditya, you are great; the greatness of you who exist is most to be praised; by might, O god, you are great.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वी रथी सुरूप इद्गोमाँ यदिन्द्र ते सखा । श्वात्रभाजा वयसा सचते सदा चन्द्रैर्याति सभामुप
verses.transliteration: ashvI rathI surUpa idgomA.N yadindra te sakhA | shvAtrabhAjA vayasA sachate sadA chandrairyAti sabhAmupa
verses.translation: The friend of yours, Indra, who has a horse, a chariot, a fair form and cattle, is always accompanied with vigor and wealth and goes to the assembly with shining gifts.

verses.sanskrit: यद्द्याव इन्द्र ते शतँ शतं भूमीरुत स्युः । न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रँ सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी
verses.transliteration: yaddyAva indra te shata.N shataM bhUmIruta syuH | na tvA vajrintsahasra.N sUryA anu na jAtamaShTa rodasI
verses.translation: Though a hundred heavens and a hundred earths were yours, Indra, a thousand suns would not equal you, O thunderbolt-bearer; the two worlds do not encompass you at birth.

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदग्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः । सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे
verses.transliteration: yadindra prAgapAgudagnyagvA hUyase nR^ibhiH | simA purU nR^iShUto asyAnave.asi prashardha turvashe
verses.translation: Indra, when you are called by men from east, west, north and west, from many places — you are the mighty protector of Anu, Turvasha, praised for strength.

verses.sanskrit: कस्तमिन्द्र त्वा वसवा मर्त्यो दधर्षति । श्रद्धा हि ते मघवन्पार्ये दिवि वाजी वाजँ सिषासति
verses.transliteration: kastamindra tvA vasavA martyo dadharShati | shraddhA hi te maghavanpArye divi vAjI vAja.N siShAsati
verses.translation: What mortal, O Indra, dares to withstand you, Vasu? For faith in you, bounteous one, in the farther heaven, the strong man wins strength.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी अपादियं पूर्वागात्पद्वतीभ्यः । हित्वा शिरो जिह्वया रारपच्चरत्त्रिँशत्पदा न्यक्रमीत्
verses.transliteration: indrAgnI apAdiyaM pUrvAgAtpadvatIbhyaH | hitvA shiro jihvayA rArapachcharattri.NshatpadA nyakramIt
verses.translation: Indra and Agni: this footless one came first of the footed; leaving her head, she chattered with her tongue, and the thirty-footed one stepped on.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र नेदीय एदिहि मितमेधाभिरूतिभिः । आ शं तम शं तमाभिरभिष्टिभिरा स्वापे स्वापिभिः
verses.transliteration: indra nedIya edihi mitamedhAbhirUtibhiH | A shaM tama shaM tamAbhirabhiShTibhirA svApe svApibhiH
verses.translation: Indra, come very near with your helps of measured wisdom; come with the most auspicious, with blessings, with good friends.

verses.sanskrit: इत ऊती वो अजरं प्रहेतारमप्रहितम् । आशुं जेतारँ हेतारँ रथीतममतूर्तं तुग्रियावृधम्
verses.transliteration: ita UtI vo ajaraM prahetAramaprahitam | AshuM jetAra.N hetAra.N rathItamamatUrtaM tugriyAvR^idham
verses.translation: From here your help, unaging, the sender, the unsent; swift, victorious, the chariot-warrior, unconquered, who strengthens Tugrya.

verses.sanskrit: मो षु त्वा वाघतश्च नारे अस्मन्नि रीरमन् । आरात्ताद्वा सधमादं न आ गहीह वा सन्नुप श्रुधि
verses.transliteration: mo Shu tvA vAghatashcha nAre asmanni rIraman | ArAttAdvA sadhamAdaM na A gahIha vA sannupa shrudhi
verses.translation: Let not the ritual priests keep you from us far away; come to our shared feast from near or far, and listen here.

verses.sanskrit: सुनोत सोमपाव्ने सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । पचता पक्तीरवसे कृणुध्वमित्पृणन्नित्पृणते मयः
verses.transliteration: sunota somapAvne somamindrAya vajriNe | pachatA paktIravase kR^iNudhvamitpR^iNannitpR^iNate mayaH
verses.translation: Press soma for the soma-drinker, Indra the thunderbolt-bearer; cook the cakes for his help; the giver gives joy to the giver.

verses.sanskrit: यः सत्राहा विचर्षणिरिन्द्रं तँ हूमहे वयम् । सहस्रमन्यो तुविनृम्ण सत्पते भवा समत्सु नो वृधे
verses.transliteration: yaH satrAhA vicharShaNirindraM ta.N hUmahe vayam | sahasramanyo tuvinR^imNa satpate bhavA samatsu no vR^idhe
verses.translation: We call on Indra, who is a conqueror in battle and all-seeing, of a thousand moods, of much strength, lord of the good; be present in battles to help us grow.

verses.sanskrit: शचीभिर्नः शचीवसू दिवानक्तं दिशस्यतम् । मा वाँ रातिरुप दसत्कदा च नास्मद्रातिः कदा च न
verses.transliteration: shachIbhirnaH shachIvasU divAnaktaM dishasyatam | mA vA.N rAtirupa dasatkadA cha nAsmadrAtiH kadA cha na
verses.translation: O you of power and wealth, with your powers show us the way by day and night; may your gift never fail, nor ours to you.

verses.sanskrit: यदा कदा च मीढुषे स्तोता जरेत मर्त्यः । आदिद्वन्देत वरुणं विपा गिरा धर्त्तारं विव्रतानाम्
verses.transliteration: yadA kadA cha mIDhuShe stotA jareta martyaH | Adidvandeta varuNaM vipA girA dharttAraM vivratAnAm
verses.translation: Whenever the mortal praiser grows old before the generous one, let him then worship Varuna, upholder of the sacred laws, with a wise song.

verses.sanskrit: पाहि गा अन्धसो मद इन्द्राय मेध्यातिथे । यः सम्मिश्लो हर्योर्यो हिरण्यय इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः
verses.transliteration: pAhi gA andhaso mada indrAya medhyAtithe | yaH sammishlo haryoryo hiraNyaya indro vajrI hiraNyayaH
verses.translation: Protect our cattle in the exhilaration of the drink, for Indra, O Medhyatithi — who is mingled with the two bay horses, who is golden, Indra the thunderbolt-bearer, golden.

verses.sanskrit: उभयँ शृणवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः । सत्राच्या मघवान्त्सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत्
verses.transliteration: ubhaya.N shR^iNavachcha na indro arvAgidaM vachaH | satrAchyA maghavAntsomapItaye dhiyA shaviShTha A gamat
verses.translation: Let Indra hear both of ours, this word of ours here; the strongest, bounteous one comes with thought, together, to drink the soma.

verses.sanskrit: महे च न त्वाद्रिवः परा शुल्काय दीयसे । न सहस्राय नायुताये वज्रिवो न शताय शतामघ
verses.transliteration: mahe cha na tvAdrivaH parA shulkAya dIyase | na sahasrAya nAyutAye vajrivo na shatAya shatAmagha
verses.translation: O stone-bearer, you are not given away for a great price; not for a thousand, nor ten thousand, nor a hundred, O lord of a hundred.

verses.sanskrit: वस्याँ इन्द्रासि मे पितुरुत भ्रातुरभुञ्जतः । माता च मे छदयथः समा वसो वसुत्वनाय राधसे
verses.transliteration: vasyA.N indrAsi me pituruta bhrAturabhu~njataH | mAtA cha me ChadayathaH samA vaso vasutvanAya rAdhase
verses.translation: Indra, you are better to me than a father and a brother who does not share; you and my mother both shelter me, O Vasu, for wealth and bounty.

verses.sanskrit: इम इन्द्राय सुन्विरे सोमासो दध्याशिरः । ताँ आ मदाय वज्रहस्त पीतये हरिभ्यां याह्योक आ
verses.transliteration: ima indrAya sunvire somAso dadhyAshiraH | tA.N A madAya vajrahasta pItaye haribhyAM yAhyoka A
verses.translation: These soma-drinks are pressed for Indra, mixed with curds; come to them, thunderbolt-handed, with your bay horses, to drink and be glad.

verses.sanskrit: इम इन्द्र मदाय ते सोमाश्चिकित्र उकिथनः । मधोः पपान उप नो गिरः शृणु रास्व स्तोत्राय गिर्वणः
verses.transliteration: ima indra madAya te somAshchikitra ukithanaH | madhoH papAna upa no giraH shR^iNu rAsva stotrAya girvaNaH
verses.translation: These soma-drinks, Indra, are for your delight, to be praised; having drunk the honey, hear our songs; give to the praiser, O lover of songs.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा३द्य सबर्दुघाँ हुवे गायत्रवेपसम् । इन्द्रं धेनुँ सुदुघामन्यामिषमुरुधारामरङ्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: A tvA3dya sabardughA.N huve gAyatravepasam | indraM dhenu.N sudughAmanyAmiShamurudhArAmara~NkR^itam
verses.translation: Today I invoke you, Indra, the milch cow with Gayatri-shaped body, the good milker, and other nourishment, wide-streaming and well adorned.

verses.sanskrit: न त्वा बृहन्तो अद्रयो वरन्त इन्द्र वीडवः । यच्छिक्षसि स्तुवते मावते वसु न किष्टदा मिनाति ते
verses.transliteration: na tvA bR^ihanto adrayo varanta indra vIDavaH | yachChikShasi stuvate mAvate vasu na kiShTadA minAti te
verses.translation: Neither the great stones nor the obstacles can hold you back, Indra, when you give wealth to the praiser like me; no one ever diminishes you.

verses.sanskrit: क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद्वयो दधे । अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्र्यन्धसः
verses.transliteration: ka IM veda sute sachA pibantaM kadvayo dadhe | ayaM yaH puro vibhinatyojasA mandAnaH shipryandhasaH
verses.translation: Who knows him, drinking with us at the pressing? What strength has he won? He who, delighted by the soma-drink of the fair-jawed, breaks the forts with might.

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र शासो अव्रतं च्यावया सदसस्परि । अस्माकमँशुं मघवन्पुरुस्पृहं वसव्ये अधि बर्हय
verses.transliteration: yadindra shAso avrataM chyAvayA sadasaspari | asmAkama.NshuM maghavanpuruspR^ihaM vasavye adhi barhaya
verses.translation: Indra, when you drive out the lawless from the assembly, uplift our desirable soma-stalk and exalt it in wealth.

verses.sanskrit: त्वष्टा नो दैव्यं वचः पर्जन्यो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः । पुत्रैर्भ्रातृभिरदितिर्नु पातु नो दुष्टरं त्रामणं वचः
verses.transliteration: tvaShTA no daivyaM vachaH parjanyo brahmaNaspatiH | putrairbhrAtR^ibhiraditirnu pAtu no duShTaraM trAmaNaM vachaH
verses.translation: May Tvashtar, Parjanya, Brahmanaspati and Aditi with sons and brothers protect us by a divine, hard-to-resist saving word.

verses.sanskrit: कदा च न स्तरीरसि नेन्द्र सश्चसि दाशुषे । उपोपेन्नु मघवन्भूय इन्नु ते दानं देवस्य पृच्यते
verses.transliteration: kadA cha na starIrasi nendra sashchasi dAshuShe | upopennu maghavanbhUya innu te dAnaM devasya pR^ichyate
verses.translation: You never overthrow, Indra; you do not cling to the giver; come ever nearer, bounteous one; the gift of the god is increasing in abundance.

verses.sanskrit: युङ्क्ष्वा हि वृत्रहन्तम हरी इन्द्र परावतः । अर्वाचीनो मघवन्त्सोमपीतय उग्र ऋष्वेभिरा गहि
verses.transliteration: yu~NkShvA hi vR^itrahantama harI indra parAvataH | arvAchIno maghavantsomapItaya ugra R^iShvebhirA gahi
verses.translation: Yoke your two bay horses, O best Vritra-slayer, from far away; come near, bounteous one, fierce, with the bright ones, to drink the soma.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः । स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहस इह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि
verses.transliteration: tvAmidA hyo naro.apIpyanvajrinbhUrNayaH | sa indra stomavAhasa iha shrudhyupa svasaramA gahi
verses.translation: Men, the nourishing, swelled you yesterday, thunderbolt-bearer; you, O Indra, bearer of hymns, hear here and come to the dwelling.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यु अदर्श्यायत्यू३च्छन्ती दुहिता दिवः । अपो मही वृणुते चक्षुषा तमो ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरि
verses.transliteration: pratyu adarshyAyatyU3chChantI duhitA divaH | apo mahI vR^iNute chakShuShA tamo jyotiShkR^iNoti sUnari
verses.translation: The daughter of heaven, coming forth, has been seen, shining; the great one uncovers the waters; with her eye she makes the darkness into light, O fair one.

verses.sanskrit: इमा उ वां दिविष्टय उस्रा हवन्ते अश्विना । अयं वामह्वेऽवसे शचीवसू विशंविशँ हि गच्छथः
verses.transliteration: imA u vAM diviShTaya usrA havante ashvinA | ayaM vAmahve.avase shachIvasU vishaMvisha.N hi gachChathaH
verses.translation: These cows of the dawn call you, O Ashvins, to heaven's sacrifice; I call you here for help, O you of power and wealth, for you go to every clan.

verses.sanskrit: कु ष्ठः को वामश्विना तपानो देवा मर्त्यः । घ्नता वामश्मया क्षपमाणोँशुनेत्थमु आदुन्यथा
verses.transliteration: ku ShThaH ko vAmashvinA tapAno devA martyaH | ghnatA vAmashmayA kShapamANo.Nshunetthamu AdunyathA
verses.translation: Where, O Ashvins, is the mortal who does you honor? Strike with the stone; the pressed soma-juice, the stalk, as in a mortar.

verses.sanskrit: अयं वां मधुमत्तमः सुतः सोमो दिविष्टिषु । तमश्विना पिबतं तिरो अह्न्यं धत्तँ रत्नानि दाशुषे
verses.transliteration: ayaM vAM madhumattamaH sutaH somo diviShTiShu | tamashvinA pibataM tiro ahnyaM dhatta.N ratnAni dAshuShe
verses.translation: Here is your sweetest pressed soma, Ashvins, at the heavenly sacrifices; drink it across the day; bestow jewels on the giver.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा सोमस्य गल्दया सदा याचन्नहं ज्या । भूर्णिं मृगं न सवनेषु चुक्रुधं क ईशानं न याचिषत्
verses.transliteration: A tvA somasya galdayA sadA yAchannahaM jyA | bhUrNiM mR^igaM na savaneShu chukrudhaM ka IshAnaM na yAchiShat
verses.translation: Always begging, I approach you with a cup of soma; who has not begged the ruler who is enraged at the pressings like a wild beast?

verses.sanskrit: अध्वर्यो द्रावया त्वँ सोममिन्द्रः पिपासति । उपो नूनं युयुजे वृष्णा हरी आ च जगाम वृत्रहा
verses.transliteration: adhvaryo drAvayA tva.N somamindraH pipAsati | upo nUnaM yuyuje vR^iShNA harI A cha jagAma vR^itrahA
verses.translation: O Adhvaryu, hasten the soma; Indra is thirsty; he has just yoked his two bay stallions and the Vritra-slayer has come.

verses.sanskrit: अभी षतस्तदा भरेन्द्र ज्यायः कनीयसः । पुरूवसुर्हि मघवन्बभूविथ भरेभरे च हव्यः
verses.transliteration: abhI ShatastadA bharendra jyAyaH kanIyasaH | purUvasurhi maghavanbabhUvitha bharebhare cha havyaH
verses.translation: Then bring, Indra, the greater than the lesser; for you, bounteous, have become the wealthy and are to be invoked in every battle.

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र यावतस्त्वमेतावदहमीशीय । स्तोतारमिद्दधिषे रदावसो न पापत्वाय रँसिषम्
verses.transliteration: yadindra yAvatastvametAvadahamIshIya | stotAramiddadhiShe radAvaso na pApatvAya ra.NsiSham
verses.translation: Indra, as much as you are, I would be master of so much; I would nourish your praiser, O giver of wealth, and I would not exult in evil.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः । अशस्तिहा जनिता वृत्रतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः
verses.transliteration: tvamindra pratUrtiShvabhi vishvA asi spR^idhaH | ashastihA janitA vR^itratUrasi tvaM tUrya taruShyataH
verses.translation: You, Indra, overcome all rivals in conflicts; you are the destroyer of slander, a begetter, the Vritra-smiter; you hasten the straining.

verses.sanskrit: प्र यो रिरिक्ष ओजसा दिवः सदोभ्यस्परि । न त्वा विव्याच रज इन्द्र पार्थिवमति विश्वं ववक्षिथ
verses.transliteration: pra yo ririkSha ojasA divaH sadobhyaspari | na tvA vivyAcha raja indra pArthivamati vishvaM vavakShitha
verses.translation: You who by might surpass the seat of heaven; no earthly space contains you, Indra; you have borne beyond all.

verses.sanskrit: असावि देवं गोऋजीकमन्धो न्यस्मिन्निन्द्रो जनुषेमुवोच । बोधामसि त्वा हर्यश्व यज्ञैर्बोधा न स्तोममन्धसो मदेषु
verses.transliteration: asAvi devaM goR^ijIkamandho nyasminnindro januShemuvocha | bodhAmasi tvA haryashva yaj~nairbodhA na stomamandhaso madeShu
verses.translation: The god-pleasing juice, mixed with milk, has been pressed; Indra has spoken among the born; we wake you, O bay-horsed one, with sacrifices; wake our song in the joy of the drink.

verses.sanskrit: योनिष्ट इन्द्र सदने अकारि तमा नृभिः पुरूहूत प्र याहि । असो यथा नोऽविता वृधश्चिद्ददो वसूनि ममदश्च सोमैः
verses.transliteration: yoniShTa indra sadane akAri tamA nR^ibhiH purUhUta pra yAhi | aso yathA no.avitA vR^idhashchiddado vasUni mamadashcha somaiH
verses.translation: Your seat, Indra, has been made in the house; come with the men, O much-invoked; be our helper, a strengthener, give treasures, and rejoice in the soma.

verses.sanskrit: अदर्दरुत्समसृजो वि खानि त्वमर्णवान्बद्बधानाँ अरम्णाः । महान्तमिन्द्र पर्वतं वि यद्वः सृजद्धारा अव यद्दानवान्हन्
verses.transliteration: adardarutsamasR^ijo vi khAni tvamarNavAnbadbadhAnA.N aramNAH | mahAntamindra parvataM vi yadvaH sR^ijaddhArA ava yaddAnavAnhan
verses.translation: You split the cavities, you released the streams; you gave rest to the confined seas; great Indra, when you released the mountain and struck down the Danavas, the streams flowed.

verses.sanskrit: सुष्वाणास इन्द्र स्तुमसि त्वा सनिष्यन्तश्चित्तुविनृम्ण वाजम् । आ नो भर सुवितं यस्य कोना तना त्मना सह्यामा त्वोताः
verses.transliteration: suShvANAsa indra stumasi tvA saniShyantashchittuvinR^imNa vAjam | A no bhara suvitaM yasya konA tanA tmanA sahyAmA tvotAH
verses.translation: We, pressing, praise you, Indra, of great strength, seeking strength; bring us good fortune whose end we may reach, protected by you.

verses.sanskrit: जगृह्मा ते दक्षिणमिन्द्र हस्तं वसूयवो वसुपते वसूनाम् । विद्मा हि त्वा गोपतिँ शूर गोनामस्मभ्यं चित्रं वृषणँ रयिन्दाः
verses.transliteration: jagR^ihmA te dakShiNamindra hastaM vasUyavo vasupate vasUnAm | vidmA hi tvA gopati.N shUra gonAmasmabhyaM chitraM vR^iShaNa.N rayindAH
verses.translation: We have grasped your right hand, Indra, desiring wealth, O lord of wealth; we know you, O hero, lord of cattle; give us shining, bounteous wealth.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं नरो नेमधिता हवन्ति यत्पार्या युनजते धियस्ताः । शूरो नृषाता श्रवसश्च काम आ गोमति व्रजे भजा त्वं नः
verses.transliteration: indraM naro nemadhitA havanti yatpAryA yunajate dhiyastAH | shUro nR^iShAtA shravasashcha kAma A gomati vraje bhajA tvaM naH
verses.translation: Men call on Indra, the near friend, when the thoughts yoke to cross; the hero, winner of men, the desire of fame — share with us a cattle-stocked pen.

verses.sanskrit: वयः सुपर्णा उप सेदुरिन्द्रं प्रियमेधा ऋषयो नाधमानाः । अप ध्वान्तमूर्णुहि पूर्धि चक्षुर्मुमुग्ध्या३स्मान्निधयेव बद्धान्
verses.transliteration: vayaH suparNA upa sedurindraM priyamedhA R^iShayo nAdhamAnAH | apa dhvAntamUrNuhi pUrdhi chakShurmumugdhyA3smAnnidhayeva baddhAn
verses.translation: The birds, the fair-winged, the sages of dear wisdom, sat near Indra, begging; drive away the darkness, fill the eye, free us who are bound as with a snare.

verses.sanskrit: नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तँ हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा । हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरण्युम्
verses.transliteration: nAke suparNamupa yatpatanta.N hR^idA venanto abhyachakShata tvA | hiraNyapakShaM varuNasya dUtaM yamasya yonau shakunaM bhuraNyum
verses.translation: When they saw you flying in the sky as a fair-winged bird, longing, with the heart; golden-winged, Varuna's messenger, a bird nourishing in Yama's seat.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म जज्ञानं प्रथमं पुरस्ताद्वि सीमतः सुरुचो वेन आवः । स बुध्न्या उपमा अस्य विष्ठाः सतश्च योनिमसतश्च विवः
verses.transliteration: brahma jaj~nAnaM prathamaM purastAdvi sImataH surucho vena AvaH | sa budhnyA upamA asya viShThAH satashcha yonimasatashcha vivaH
verses.translation: The first Brahman born, in the beginning, the shining Vena uncovered the borders; he opened the depths, the nearest places, the womb of being and non-being.

verses.sanskrit: अपूर्व्या पुरुतमान्यस्मै महे वीराय तवसे तुराय । विरप्शिने वज्रिणे शन्तमानि वचाँस्यास्मै स्थविराय तक्षुः
verses.transliteration: apUrvyA purutamAnyasmai mahe vIrAya tavase turAya | virapshine vajriNe shantamAni vachA.NsyAsmai sthavirAya takShuH
verses.translation: Unprecedented, the best have been made for this great, brave, strong, swift one; they fashioned most gracious words for this loud thunderbolt-bearer, the ancient.

verses.sanskrit: अव द्रप्सो अँशुमतीमतिष्ठदीयानः कृष्णो दशभिः सहस्रैः । आवत्तमिन्द्रः शच्या धमन्तमप स्नीहितिं नृमणा अधद्राः
verses.transliteration: ava drapso a.NshumatImatiShThadIyAnaH kR^iShNo dashabhiH sahasraiH | AvattamindraH shachyA dhamantamapa snIhitiM nR^imaNA adhadrAH
verses.translation: The dark drop descended into the stream of the Amshumati with ten thousand; Indra with his power found it blowing; the man-minded drove off the enemy.

verses.sanskrit: वृत्रस्य त्वा श्वसथादीषमाणा विश्वे देवा अजहुर्ये सखायः । मरुद्भिरिन्द्र सख्यं ते अस्त्वथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयासि
verses.transliteration: vR^itrasya tvA shvasathAdIShamANA vishve devA ajahurye sakhAyaH | marudbhirindra sakhyaM te astvathemA vishvAH pR^itanA jayAsi
verses.translation: Driven by the breath of Vritra, all the gods who were friends abandoned you; Indra, may friendship with the Maruts be yours; then you shall conquer all these armies.

verses.sanskrit: विधुं दद्राणँ समने बहूनाँ युवानँ सन्तं पलितो जगार । देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाद्या ममार स ह्यः समान
verses.transliteration: vidhuM dadrANa.N samane bahUnA.N yuvAna.N santaM palito jagAra | devasya pashya kAvyaM mahitvAdyA mamAra sa hyaH samAna
verses.translation: The gray one swallowed the shaker, the youth, in the gathering of many; see the poem of the god in its greatness — today he is dead, yesterday he lived.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ ह त्यत्सप्तभ्यो जायमानोऽशत्रुभ्यो अभवः शत्रुरिन्द्र । गूढे द्यावापृथिवी अन्वविन्दो विभुमद्भ्यो भुवनेभ्यो रणं धाः
verses.transliteration: tva.N ha tyatsaptabhyo jAyamAno.ashatrubhyo abhavaH shatrurindra | gUDhe dyAvApR^ithivI anvavindo vibhumadbhyo bhuvanebhyo raNaM dhAH
verses.translation: You, O Indra, born, were a foe to the seven without foes; you found heaven and earth hidden, you set joy in the pervading worlds.

verses.sanskrit: मेडिं न त्वा वज्रिणं भृष्टिमन्तं पुरुधस्मानं वृषभँ स्थिरप्स्नुम् । करोष्यर्यस्तरुषीर्दुवस्युरिन्द्र द्युक्षं वृत्रहणं गृणीषे
verses.transliteration: meDiM na tvA vajriNaM bhR^iShTimantaM purudhasmAnaM vR^iShabha.N sthirapsnum | karoShyaryastaruShIrduvasyurindra dyukShaM vR^itrahaNaM gR^iNIShe
verses.translation: We praise you, thunderbolt-bearer, like a ram-leader, strong-toothed, full of power, bull, firm; you make the foes of the strong flow, desiring their service; I praise Indra the sky-dweller, the Vritra-slayer.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो महे महेवृधे भरध्वं प्रचेतसे प्र सुमतिं कृणुध्वम् । विशः पूर्वीः प्र चर चर्षणिप्राः
verses.transliteration: pra vo mahe mahevR^idhe bharadhvaM prachetase pra sumatiM kR^iNudhvam | vishaH pUrvIH pra chara charShaNiprAH
verses.translation: Bring your offering to the great, who grows by greatness; make favor to the wise one; roam through the ancient clans, fulfilling the peoples.

verses.sanskrit: शुनँ हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ । शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु ध्नन्तं वृत्राणि सञ्जितं धनानि
verses.transliteration: shuna.N huvema maghavAnamindramasminbhare nR^itamaM vAjasAtau | shR^iNvantamugramUtaye samatsu dhnantaM vR^itrANi sa~njitaM dhanAni
verses.translation: We invoke Indra, the bounteous, the best of men in this contest for the winning of strength; he hears, the fierce one, for help, slaying Vritras in battles, winning wealth.

verses.sanskrit: उदु ब्रह्माण्यैरत श्रवस्येन्द्रँ समर्ये महया वसिष्ठ । आ यो विश्वानि श्रवसा ततानोपश्रोता म ईवतो वचाँसि
verses.transliteration: udu brahmANyairata shravasyendra.N samarye mahayA vasiShTha | A yo vishvAni shravasA tatAnopashrotA ma Ivato vachA.Nsi
verses.translation: Raise up the prayers, O Vasishtha, for fame; honor Indra in the battle; he who extended all by his glory, who hears my words in distress.

verses.sanskrit: चक्रं यदस्याप्स्वा निषत्तमुतो तदस्मै मध्विच्चच्छद्यात् । पृथिव्यामतिषितं यदूधः पयो गोष्वदधा ओषधीषु
verses.transliteration: chakraM yadasyApsvA niShattamuto tadasmai madhvichchachChadyAt | pR^ithivyAmatiShitaM yadUdhaH payo goShvadadhA oShadhIShu
verses.translation: The wheel of his that sat in the waters — then that sweetness covered it for him; the udder that is spread over the earth — you placed milk in the cows and in the plants.

verses.sanskrit: त्यमू षु वाजिनं देवजूतँ सहोवानं तरुतारँ रथानाम् । अरिष्टनेमिं पृतनाजमाशुँ स्वस्तये तार्क्ष्यमिहा हुवेम
verses.transliteration: tyamU Shu vAjinaM devajUta.N sahovAnaM tarutAra.N rathAnAm | ariShTanemiM pR^itanAjamAshu.N svastaye tArkShyamihA huvema
verses.translation: We call here for welfare on that strong Tarkshya, urged by the gods, the vigorous, the overcomer of chariots — of unharmed felly, swift, the winner of armies.

verses.sanskrit: त्रातारमिन्द्रमवितारमिन्द्रँ हवेहवे सुहवँ शूरमिन्द्रम् । हुवे नु शक्रं पुरुहूतमिन्द्रमिदँ हविर्मघवा वेत्विन्द्रः
verses.transliteration: trAtAramindramavitAramindra.N havehave suhava.N shUramindram | huve nu shakraM puruhUtamindramida.N havirmaghavA vetvindraH
verses.translation: Savior Indra, helper Indra, at every call easy to call, Indra the hero; I call Shakra, the much-invoked Indra; may the bounteous Indra enjoy this offering.

verses.sanskrit: यजामह इन्द्रं वज्रदक्षिणँ हरीणाँ रथ्य३ं विव्रतानाम् । प्र श्मश्रुभिर्दोधुवदूर्ध्वधा भुवद्वि सेनाभिर्भयमानो वि राधसा
verses.transliteration: yajAmaha indraM vajradakShiNa.N harINA.N rathya3M vivratAnAm | pra shmashrubhirdodhuvadUrdhvadhA bhuvadvi senAbhirbhayamAno vi rAdhasA
verses.translation: We worship Indra, thunderbolt in his right hand, charioteer of the bay horses of the different courses; with his beard shaking, standing high, he overcomes fear with armies and wealth.

verses.sanskrit: सत्राहणं दाधृषिं तुम्रमिन्द्रं महामपारं वृशभँ सुवज्रम् । हन्ता यो वृत्रँ सनितोत वाजं दाता मघानि मघवा सुराधाः
verses.transliteration: satrAhaNaM dAdhR^iShiM tumramindraM mahAmapAraM vR^ishabha.N suvajram | hantA yo vR^itra.N sanitota vAjaM dAtA maghAni maghavA surAdhAH
verses.translation: We praise Indra, the conqueror, the bold, the driver, great, boundless, bull, with the good thunderbolt; the slayer of Vritra, winner of strength, giver of gifts, the bounteous, the generous.

verses.sanskrit: यो नो वनुष्यन्नभिदाति मर्त उगणा वा मन्यमानस्तुरो वा । क्षिधी युधा शवसा वा तमिन्द्राभी ष्याम वृषमणस्त्वोताः
verses.transliteration: yo no vanuShyannabhidAti marta ugaNA vA manyamAnasturo vA | kShidhI yudhA shavasA vA tamindrAbhI ShyAma vR^iShamaNastvotAH
verses.translation: The mortal who would harm us, or considers himself strong, or swift, destroy him in battle or by strength; may we, urged by you, Indra, overcome him with manly spirit.

verses.sanskrit: यं वृत्रेषु क्षितय स्पर्धमाना यं युक्तेषु तुरयन्तो हवन्ते । यँ शूरसातौ यमपामुपज्मन्यं विप्रासो वाजयन्ते स इन्द्रः
verses.transliteration: yaM vR^itreShu kShitaya spardhamAnA yaM yukteShu turayanto havante | ya.N shUrasAtau yamapAmupajmanyaM viprAso vAjayante sa indraH
verses.translation: He whom the peoples, contending in the Vritra-fights, call on, whom the speeding call when yoked, in the winning of heroes, in the lap of the waters, whom the sages invigorate — he is Indra.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रापर्वता बृहता रथेन वामीरिष आ वहतँ सुवीराः । वीतँ हव्यान्यध्वरेषु देवा वर्धेथां गीर्भीरिडया मदन्ता
verses.transliteration: indrAparvatA bR^ihatA rathena vAmIriSha A vahata.N suvIrAH | vIta.N havyAnyadhvareShu devA vardhethAM gIrbhIriDayA madantA
verses.translation: O Indra and Parvata, bring with your great chariot the desirable nourishments with fair heroes; enjoy the offerings at the sacrifices, O gods; grow strong with songs and Ida, rejoicing.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय गिरो अनिशितसर्गा अपः प्रैरयत्सगरस्य बुध्नात् । यो अक्षेणेव चक्रियौ शचीभिर्विष्वक्तस्तम्भ पृथिवीमुत द्याम्
verses.transliteration: indrAya giro anishitasargA apaH prairayatsagarasya budhnAt | yo akSheNeva chakriyau shachIbhirviShvaktastambha pR^ithivImuta dyAm
verses.translation: For Indra the unsharpened songs were sent forth; he drove the waters from the depth of the sea; he who, as with an axle, supported on all sides the earth and heaven with his powers.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा सखायः सख्या ववृत्युस्तिरः पुरू चिदर्णवां जगम्याः । पितुर्नपातमा दधित वेधा अस्मिन्क्षये प्रतरां दीद्यानः
verses.transliteration: A tvA sakhAyaH sakhyA vavR^ityustiraH purU chidarNavAM jagamyAH | piturnapAtamA dadhita vedhA asminkShaye pratarAM dIdyAnaH
verses.translation: Friends have turned you toward friendship, having crossed many seas; the ordainer has set the grandson of the father in this dwelling, shining the more.

verses.sanskrit: को अद्य युङ्क्ते धुरि गा ऋतस्य शिमीवतो भामिनो दुर्हृणायून् । आसन्नेषामप्सुवाहो मयोभून्य एषां भृत्यामृणधत्स जीवात्
verses.transliteration: ko adya yu~Nkte dhuri gA R^itasya shimIvato bhAmino durhR^iNAyUn | AsanneShAmapsuvAho mayobhUnya eShAM bhR^ityAmR^iNadhatsa jIvAt
verses.translation: Who today yokes to the pole the cows of truth, the shining, the hard-to-subdue, the active? Near them are the water-carriers, joyful ones — whoever pays their wage may live.

verses.sanskrit: गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणोऽर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः । ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद्वँशमिव येमिरे
verses.transliteration: gAyanti tvA gAyatriNo.archantyarkamarkiNaH | brahmANastvA shatakrata udva.Nshamiva yemire
verses.translation: The Gayatri-singers sing to you, the hymn-makers hymn the hymn; the Brahmins, O hundred-powered, have raised you up like a bamboo pole.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः । रथीतमँ रथीनां वाजानाँ सत्पतिं पतिम्
verses.transliteration: indraM vishvA avIvR^idhantsamudravyachasaM giraH | rathItama.N rathInAM vAjAnA.N satpatiM patim
verses.translation: The songs have strengthened Indra, who is wide as the ocean, the best of charioteers, lord of strengths, lord of the good.

verses.sanskrit: इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ज्येष्ठममर्त्यं मदम् । शुक्रस्य त्वाभ्यक्षरन्धारा ऋतस्य सादने
verses.transliteration: imamindra sutaM piba jyeShThamamartyaM madam | shukrasya tvAbhyakSharandhArA R^itasya sAdane
verses.translation: Drink this pressed soma, Indra, this eldest immortal exhilaration; the streams of the bright one have flowed to you in the seat of truth.

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र चित्र म इह नास्ति त्वादातमद्रिवः । राधस्तन्नो विदद्वस उभयाहस्त्या भर
verses.transliteration: yadindra chitra ma iha nAsti tvAdAtamadrivaH | rAdhastanno vidadvasa ubhayAhastyA bhara
verses.translation: Whatever wondrous wealth, Indra, is not here with me, which is given by you, O stone-bearer — bring that wealth, Vasu, with both hands.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुदी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति । सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महाँ असि
verses.transliteration: shrudI havaM tirashchyA indra yastvA saparyati | suvIryasya gomato rAyaspUrdhi mahA.N asi
verses.translation: Hear the call of him, Indra, who worships you with crooked ways; fill us with heroic wealth and cattle; you are great.

verses.sanskrit: असावि सोम इन्द्र ते शविष्ठ धृष्णवा गहि । आ त्वा पृणक्त्विन्द्रियँ रजः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः
verses.transliteration: asAvi soma indra te shaviShTha dhR^iShNavA gahi | A tvA pR^iNaktvindriya.N rajaH sUryo na rashmibhiH
verses.translation: The soma has been pressed for you, Indra; come, O strongest, bold one; may the vital power fill you, as the sun fills the space with rays.

verses.sanskrit: एन्द्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिम् । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो
verses.transliteration: endra yAhi haribhirupa kaNvasya suShTutim | divo amuShya shAsato divaM yaya divAvaso
verses.translation: Come, Indra, with your bay horses to the fair praise of Kanva; go to heaven, to that heaven that rules, O Vasu of the day.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा गिरो रथीरिवास्थुः सुतेषु गिर्वणः । अभि त्वा समनूषत गावो वत्सं न धेनवः
verses.transliteration: A tvA giro rathIrivAsthuH suteShu girvaNaH | abhi tvA samanUShata gAvo vatsaM na dhenavaH
verses.translation: The songs have mounted you at the pressings like charioteers, O lover of songs; they have praised you together, as cows their calf.

verses.sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रँ स्तवाम शुद्धँ शुद्धेन साम्ना । शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वाँसँ शुद्धैराशीर्वान्ममत्तु
verses.transliteration: eto nvindra.N stavAma shuddha.N shuddhena sAmnA | shuddhairukthairvAvR^idhvA.Nsa.N shuddhairAshIrvAnmamattu
verses.translation: Come, let us praise Indra, the pure, with a pure song; with pure hymns he grows; may he rejoice with pure blessings.

verses.sanskrit: यो रयिं वो रयिन्तमो यो द्युम्नैर्द्युम्नवत्तमः । सोमः सुतः स इन्द्र तेऽस्ति स्वधापते मदः
verses.transliteration: yo rayiM vo rayintamo yo dyumnairdyumnavattamaH | somaH sutaH sa indra te.asti svadhApate madaH
verses.translation: Whatever soma is most rich in wealth, whatever is most splendid in splendor — that soma, pressed for you, Indra, is an exhilaration, O lord of the offering.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यस्मै पिपीषते विश्वानि विदुषे भर । अरङ्गमाय जग्मयेऽपश्चादध्वने नरः
verses.transliteration: pratyasmai pipIShate vishvAni viduShe bhara | ara~NgamAya jagmaye.apashchAdadhvane naraH
verses.translation: Bring everything in turn to him, the knower, who wishes to drink; to the ready, the active, the one who goes forward and not back, O men.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो वयोवयःशयं महान्तं गह्वरेष्ठां महान्तं पूर्विनेष्ठाम् । उग्रं वचो अपावधीः
verses.transliteration: A no vayovayaHshayaM mahAntaM gahvareShThAM mahAntaM pUrvineShThAm | ugraM vacho apAvadhIH
verses.translation: You have driven away the fierce word that lies in the hollows, the great, in the early abodes, the great one that lies in life.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा रथं यथोतये सुम्नाय वर्तयामसि । तुविकूर्मिमृतीषहमिन्द्रँ शविष्ठ सत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: A tvA rathaM yathotaye sumnAya vartayAmasi | tuvikUrmimR^itIShahamindra.N shaviShTha satpatim
verses.translation: We turn you toward help and favor like a chariot — the strong-acting, helper, bountiful, mightiest Indra, lord of the good.

verses.sanskrit: स पूर्व्यो महोनां वेनः क्रतुभिरानजे । यस्य द्वारा मनुः पिता देवेषु धिय आनजे
verses.transliteration: sa pUrvyo mahonAM venaH kratubhirAnaje | yasya dvArA manuH pitA deveShu dhiya Anaje
verses.translation: He, the ancient, great, loving, has been glorified by rites; at whose door Manu, the father, among the gods has glorified his prayers.

verses.sanskrit: यदी वहन्त्याशवो भ्राजमाना रथेष्वा । पिबन्तो मदिरं मधु तत्र श्रवाँसि कृण्वते
verses.transliteration: yadI vahantyAshavo bhrAjamAnA ratheShvA | pibanto madiraM madhu tatra shravA.Nsi kR^iNvate
verses.translation: When the swift ones carry him shining in the chariots, drinking the joyful honey, there they make fame.

verses.sanskrit: त्यमु वो अप्रहणं गृणीषे शवसस्पतिम् । इन्द्रं विश्वासाहं नरँ शचिष्ठं विश्ववेदसम्
verses.transliteration: tyamu vo aprahaNaM gR^iNIShe shavasaspatim | indraM vishvAsAhaM nara.N shachiShThaM vishvavedasam
verses.translation: I praise him of yours, the unyielding lord of strength, Indra, the all-conquering man, the most able, the all-knowing.

verses.sanskrit: दधिक्राव्णो अकारिषं जिष्णोरश्वस्य वाजिनः । सुरभि नो मुखा करत्प्र न आयूँषि तारिषत्
verses.transliteration: dadhikrAvNo akAriShaM jiShNorashvasya vAjinaH | surabhi no mukhA karatpra na AyU.NShi tAriShat
verses.translation: I have sung of Dadhikravan, the victorious, swift horse; may he make our faces fragrant and prolong our lives.

verses.sanskrit: पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत । इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्त्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः
verses.transliteration: purAM bhinduryuvA kaviramitaujA ajAyata | indro vishvasya karmaNo dharttA vajrI puruShTutaH
verses.translation: The breaker of forts, young, wise, of measureless strength was born — Indra, the upholder of all work, wielder of the thunderbolt, much praised.

verses.sanskrit: प्रप्र वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं वन्दद्वीरायेन्दवे । धिया वो मेधसातये पुरन्ध्या विवासति
verses.transliteration: prapra vastriShTubhamiShaM vandadvIrAyendave | dhiyA vo medhasAtaye purandhyA vivAsati
verses.translation: Offer to the delightful hero, to the soma, the food and the Trishtubh song; he honors it with devout thought, with abundance, for the gaining of wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: कश्यपस्य स्वर्विदो यावाहुः सयुजाविति । ययोर्विश्वमपि व्रतं यज्ञं धीरा निचाय्य
verses.transliteration: kashyapasya svarvido yAvAhuH sayujAviti | yayorvishvamapi vrataM yaj~naM dhIrA nichAyya
verses.translation: Of Kashyapa, finder of heaven, they say the two are well yoked, whose every rite and sacrifice the wise have observed.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चत प्रार्चता नरः प्रियमेधासो अर्चत । अर्चन्तु पुत्रका उत पुरमिद्धृष्ण्वर्चत
verses.transliteration: archata prArchatA naraH priyamedhAso archata | archantu putrakA uta puramiddhR^iShNvarchata
verses.translation: Sing, sing forth, men; the Priyamedhas sing; let the little sons sing; sing to the bold fort.

verses.sanskrit: उक्थमिन्द्राय शँस्यं वर्धनं पुरुनिःषिधे । शक्रो यथा सुतेषु नो रारणत्सख्येषु च
verses.transliteration: ukthamindrAya sha.NsyaM vardhanaM puruniHShidhe | shakro yathA suteShu no rAraNatsakhyeShu cha
verses.translation: A hymn, worthy of praise, strengthening, for Indra of many wins; so that the mighty one may delight in our pressings and friendships.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वानरस्य वस्पतिमनानतस्य शवसः । एवैश्च चर्षणीनामूती हुवे रथानाम्
verses.transliteration: vishvAnarasya vaspatimanAnatasya shavasaH | evaishcha charShaNInAmUtI huve rathAnAm
verses.translation: I call for help the lord of wealth of Vishvanara, of unbending strength, and the chariots of the peoples.

verses.sanskrit: स घा यस्ते दिवो नरो धिया मर्तस्य शमतः । ऊती स बृहतो दिवो द्विषो अँहो न तरति
verses.transliteration: sa ghA yaste divo naro dhiyA martasya shamataH | UtI sa bR^ihato divo dviSho a.Nho na tarati
verses.translation: He indeed, O heavenly one, the mortal who by devout thought and effort pleases you — by your help he crosses over hatred and sin from great heaven.

verses.sanskrit: विभोष्ट इन्द्र राधसो विभ्वी रातिः शतक्रतो । अथा नो विश्वचर्षणे द्युम्नँ सुदत्र मँहय
verses.transliteration: vibhoShTa indra rAdhaso vibhvI rAtiH shatakrato | athA no vishvacharShaNe dyumna.N sudatra ma.Nhaya
verses.translation: Pervading is your bounty, Indra, pervading your gift, O hundred-powered; so, all-seeing one, O good giver, exalt our splendor.

verses.sanskrit: वयश्चित्ते पतत्रिणो द्विपाच्चतुष्पादर्जुनि । उषः प्रारन्नृतूँरनु दिवो अन्तेभ्यस्परि
verses.transliteration: vayashchitte patatriNo dvipAchchatuShpAdarjuni | uShaH prArannR^itU.Nranu divo antebhyaspari
verses.translation: Even the birds, the two-footed, four-footed, flew up, O bright Dawn, following the seasons, from the ends of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अमी ये देवा स्थन मध्य आ रोचने दिवः । कद्व ऋतं कदमृतं का प्रत्ना व आहुतिः
verses.transliteration: amI ye devA sthana madhya A rochane divaH | kadva R^itaM kadamR^itaM kA pratnA va AhutiH
verses.translation: You gods who are there in the middle of heaven's light — what is your truth, what your immortality, what is your ancient offering?

verses.sanskrit: ऋचँ साम यजामहे याभ्यां कर्माणि कृण्वते । वि ते सदसि राजतो यज्ञं देवेषु वक्षतः
verses.transliteration: R^icha.N sAma yajAmahe yAbhyAM karmANi kR^iNvate | vi te sadasi rAjato yaj~naM deveShu vakShataH
verses.translation: We worship the Rik and the Saman, by which they perform rites; in your assembly they shine and carry the sacrifice among the gods.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरः सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे । क्रत्वे वरे स्थेमन्यामुरीमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तरसं तरस्विनम्
verses.transliteration: vishvAH pR^itanA abhibhUtaraM naraH sajUstatakShurindraM jajanushcha rAjase | kratve vare sthemanyAmurImutogramojiShThaM tarasaM tarasvinam
verses.translation: The men together fashioned Indra, overcomer of all armies, and begot him to reign; for the best deed, in a firm position — wide, fierce, mightiest, swift, speedy.

verses.sanskrit: श्रत्ते दधामि प्रथमाय मन्यवेऽहन्यद्दस्युं नर्यं विवेरपः । उभे यत्वा रोदसी धावतामनु भ्यसात्ते शुष्मात्पृथिवी चिदद्रिवः
verses.transliteration: shratte dadhAmi prathamAya manyave.ahanyaddasyuM naryaM viverapaH | ubhe yatvA rodasI dhAvatAmanu bhyasAtte shuShmAtpR^ithivI chidadrivaH
verses.translation: I place trust in you, in your first wrath, when you slew the Dasyu and uncovered the manly waters; when both worlds ran after you, even the earth, O stone-bearer, from fear of your might.

verses.sanskrit: समेत विश्वा ओजसा पतिं दिवो य एक इद्भूरतिथिर्जनानाम् स पूर्व्यो नूतनमाजिगीषं तं वर्त्तनीरनु वावृत एक इत्
verses.transliteration: sameta vishvA ojasA patiM divo ya eka idbhUratithirjanAnAm sa pUrvyo nUtanamAjigIShaM taM varttanIranu vAvR^ita eka it
verses.translation: All assemble by strength around the lord of heaven who alone is guest of the peoples; the ancient, the new victor — to him alone the paths have turned.

verses.sanskrit: इमे त इन्द्र ते वयं पुरुष्टुत ये त्वारभ्य चरामसि प्रभूवसो । न हि त्वदन्यो गिर्वणो गिरः सघत्क्षोणीरिव प्रति तद्धर्य नो वचः
verses.transliteration: ime ta indra te vayaM puruShTuta ye tvArabhya charAmasi prabhUvaso | na hi tvadanyo girvaNo giraH saghatkShoNIriva prati taddharya no vachaH
verses.translation: We, Indra, are yours, O much-praised, we who move having begun with you, O lord of wealth; for no other than you, O lover of songs, sustains songs as the lands do; welcome our word.

verses.sanskrit: चर्षणीधृतं मघवानमुक्थ्या३मिन्द्रं गिरो बृहतीरभ्यनूषत । वावृधानं पुरुहूतँ सुवृक्तिभिरमर्त्यं जरमाणं दिवेदिवे
verses.transliteration: charShaNIdhR^itaM maghavAnamukthyA3mindraM giro bR^ihatIrabhyanUShata | vAvR^idhAnaM puruhUta.N suvR^iktibhiramartyaM jaramANaM divedive
verses.translation: The songs, great and worthy of hymn, have praised Indra, upholder of peoples, the bounteous; the one growing, invoked by many, with good praises, immortal, praised day by day.

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा व इन्द्रं मतयः स्वर्युवः सध्रीचीर्विश्वा उशतीरनूषत । परि ष्वजन्त जनयो यथा पतिं मर्यं न शुन्ध्युं मघवानमूतये
verses.transliteration: achChA va indraM matayaH svaryuvaH sadhrIchIrvishvA ushatIranUShata | pari Shvajanta janayo yathA patiM maryaM na shundhyuM maghavAnamUtaye
verses.translation: The prayers desirous of heaven, together, all longing, have sung to Indra; they embrace him as wives their husband, the bounteous one, for help, as a bridegroom the pure.

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्यं मेषं पुरुहूतमृग्मियमिन्द्रं गीर्भिर्मदता वस्वो अर्णवम् । यस्य द्यावो न विचरन्ति मानुषं भुजे मँहिष्ठमभि विप्रमर्चत
verses.transliteration: abhi tyaM meShaM puruhUtamR^igmiyamindraM gIrbhirmadatA vasvo arNavam | yasya dyAvo na vicharanti mAnuShaM bhuje ma.NhiShThamabhi vipramarchata
verses.translation: Honor with songs that ram, much invoked, worthy of the Rik, Indra, the ocean of wealth, whose mighty ones do not move apart from men; praise the greatest sage for food.

verses.sanskrit: त्यँ सु मेषं महया स्वर्विदँ शतं यस्य सुभुवः साकमीरते । अत्यं न वाजँ हवनस्यदँ रथमेन्द्रं ववृत्यामवसे सुवृक्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: tya.N su meShaM mahayA svarvida.N shataM yasya subhuvaH sAkamIrate | atyaM na vAja.N havanasyada.N rathamendraM vavR^ityAmavase suvR^iktibhiH
verses.translation: Honor well that ram, finder of heaven, whose hundred good beings stir together; I turn Indra for help with fair praises, like a racing horse, a chariot flowing to the call.

verses.sanskrit: घृतवती भुवनानामभिश्रियोर्वी पृथ्वी मधुदुघे सुपेशसा । द्यावापृथिवी वरुणस्य धर्मणा विष्कभिते अजरे भूरिरेतसा
verses.transliteration: ghR^itavatI bhuvanAnAmabhishriyorvI pR^ithvI madhudughe supeshasA | dyAvApR^ithivI varuNasya dharmaNA viShkabhite ajare bhUriretasA
verses.translation: Rich in ghee, adorning the worlds, wide, broad, milking honey, fair-formed — heaven and earth, held apart by the law of Varuna, unaging, of abundant seed.

verses.sanskrit: उभे यदिन्द्र रोदसी आपप्राथोषा इव । महान्तं त्वा महीनाँ सम्राजं चर्षणीनाम् । देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्
verses.transliteration: ubhe yadindra rodasI ApaprAthoShA iva | mahAntaM tvA mahInA.N samrAjaM charShaNInAm | devI janitryajIjanadbhadrA janitryajIjanat
verses.translation: When, Indra, you filled both worlds like the dawn — great, sovereign of the great ones, of the peoples; the divine mother bore you; the auspicious mother bore you.

verses.sanskrit: प्र मन्दिने पितुमदर्चता वचो यः कृष्णगर्भा निरहन्नृजिश्वना । अवस्यवो वृषणं वज्रदक्षिणं मरुत्वन्तँ सख्याय हुवेमहि
verses.transliteration: pra mandine pitumadarchatA vacho yaH kR^iShNagarbhA nirahannR^ijishvanA | avasyavo vR^iShaNaM vajradakShiNaM marutvanta.N sakhyAya huvemahi
verses.translation: Offer a food-laden word to the delighted one, who with Rijishvan slew the black-wombed; we, desiring help, call the bull, thunderbolt in his right hand, with the Maruts, for friendship.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीष उक्थ्यम् । विदे वृधस्य दक्षस्य महाँ हि षः
verses.transliteration: indra suteShu someShu kratuM punISha ukthyam | vide vR^idhasya dakShasya mahA.N hi ShaH
verses.translation: Indra, among the pressed somas you purify the wisdom worthy of praise; he is great, for he knows the strengthening skill.

verses.sanskrit: तमु अभि प्र गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत
verses.transliteration: tamu abhi pra gAyata puruhUtaM puruShTutam | indraM gIrbhistaviShamA vivAsata
verses.translation: Sing to him, the much-invoked, the much-praised; honor Indra with songs, mighty one.

verses.sanskrit: तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृक्षु सासहिम् । उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम्
verses.transliteration: taM te madaM gR^iNImasi vR^iShaNaM pR^ikShu sAsahim | u lokakR^itnumadrivo harishriyam
verses.translation: We praise that exhilaration of yours, the bull, victorious in battle, O stone-bearer, the world-maker, the beauty of the bay horses.

verses.sanskrit: यत्सोममिन्द्र विष्णवि यद्वा घ त्रित आप्त्ये । यद्वा मरुत्सु मन्दसे समिन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration: yatsomamindra viShNavi yadvA gha trita Aptye | yadvA marutsu mandase samindubhiH
verses.translation: When, Indra, you rejoice in the soma in Vishnu, or in Trita Aptya, or among the Maruts, together with the drops.

verses.sanskrit: एदु मधोर्मदिन्तरँ सिञ्चाध्वर्यो अन्धसः । एवा हि वीरस्तवते सदावृधः
verses.transliteration: edu madhormadintara.N si~nchAdhvaryo andhasaH | evA hi vIrastavate sadAvR^idhaH
verses.translation: Pour out, O Adhvaryu, the most exhilarating of the honeyed drink; so is the hero praised, ever growing.

verses.sanskrit: एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु । प्र राधाँसि चोदयते महित्वना
verses.transliteration: endumindrAya si~nchata pibAti somyaM madhu | pra rAdhA.Nsi chodayate mahitvanA
verses.translation: Pour the drop for Indra; he drinks the soma honey; by his greatness he urges on gifts.

verses.sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रँ स्तवाम सखायः स्तोम्यं नरम् । कृष्टीर्यो विश्वा अभ्यस्त्येक इत्
verses.transliteration: eto nvindra.N stavAma sakhAyaH stomyaM naram | kR^iShTIryo vishvA abhyastyeka it
verses.translation: Come, friends, let us praise Indra, the praiseworthy man, who alone overcomes all peoples.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् । ब्रह्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे
verses.transliteration: indrAya sAma gAyata viprAya bR^ihate bR^ihat | brahmakR^ite vipashchite panasyave
verses.translation: Sing the great Saman to Indra, the wise, the great, the prayer-maker, the sage, the wonder-worker.

verses.sanskrit: य एक इद्विदयते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे । ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रो अङ्ग
verses.transliteration: ya eka idvidayate vasu martAya dAshuShe | IshAno apratiShkuta indro a~Nga
verses.translation: He who alone distributes wealth to the giving mortal, the ruler, not to be gainsaid — indeed Indra.

verses.sanskrit: सखाय आ शिषामहे ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे । स्तुष ऊ षु वो नृतमाय धृष्णवे
verses.transliteration: sakhAya A shiShAmahe brahmendrAya vajriNe | stuSha U Shu vo nR^itamAya dhR^iShNave
verses.translation: Friends, we bring prayer to Indra, the thunderbolt-bearer; I praise him well, your best of men, the bold.

verses.sanskrit: गृणे तदिन्द्र ते शव उपमां देवतातये । यद्धँसि वृत्रमोजसा शचीपते
verses.transliteration: gR^iNe tadindra te shava upamAM devatAtaye | yaddha.Nsi vR^itramojasA shachIpate
verses.translation: I praise that strength of yours, Indra, the highest, for the worship of the gods, by which you slay Vritra with might, O lord of power.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य त्यच्छम्बरं मदे दिवोदासाय रन्धयन् । अयँ स सोम इन्द्र ते सुतः पिब
verses.transliteration: yasya tyachChambaraM made divodAsAya randhayan | aya.N sa soma indra te sutaH piba
verses.translation: Who in joy cooked Shambara for Divodasa — this soma, Indra, is pressed for you; drink.

verses.sanskrit: एन्द्र नो गधि प्रिय सत्राजिदगोह्य । गिरिर्न विश्वतः पृथुः पतिर्दिवः
verses.transliteration: endra no gadhi priya satrAjidagohya | girirna vishvataH pR^ithuH patirdivaH
verses.translation: Come to us, dear Indra, the ever-victorious, unhidden, broad like a mountain on all sides, lord of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: य इन्द्र सोमपातमो मदः शविष्ठ चेतति । येना हँसि न्या३त्रिणं तमीमहे
verses.transliteration: ya indra somapAtamo madaH shaviShTha chetati | yenA ha.Nsi nyA3triNaM tamImahe
verses.translation: The most soma-drinking exhilaration, strongest Indra, which is perceived, by which you slay the devourer — we seek that.

verses.sanskrit: तुचे तुनाय तत्सु नो द्राधीय आयुर्जीवसे । आदित्यासः समहसः कृणोतन
verses.transliteration: tuche tunAya tatsu no drAdhIya AyurjIvase | AdityAsaH samahasaH kR^iNotana
verses.translation: For our children and grandchildren, and for living, grant us a long life, O Adityas, equal in splendor.

verses.sanskrit: वेत्था हि निरृतीनां वज्रहस्त परिवृजम् । अहरहः शुन्ध्युः परिपदामिव
verses.transliteration: vetthA hi nirR^itInAM vajrahasta parivR^ijam | aharahaH shundhyuH paripadAmiva
verses.translation: You know, thunderbolt-handed, the encircling of the Nirritis; day by day pure as a cleansing of the paths.

verses.sanskrit: अपामीवामप स्त्रिधमप सेधत दुर्मतिम् । आदित्यासो युयोतना नो अँहसः
verses.transliteration: apAmIvAmapa stridhamapa sedhata durmatim | AdityAso yuyotanA no a.NhasaH
verses.translation: Drive away disease, drive away the oppressor, drive away evil thought; O Adityas, free us from distress.

verses.sanskrit: पिबा सोममिन्द्र मन्दतु त्वा यं ते सुषाव हर्यश्वाद्रिः । सोतुर्बाहुभ्याँ सुयतो नार्वा
verses.transliteration: pibA somamindra mandatu tvA yaM te suShAva haryashvAdriH | soturbAhubhyA.N suyato nArvA
verses.translation: Drink the soma, Indra; may it delight you, which the stone pressed for you, O bay-horsed one, held by the arms of the presser like a horse.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि । युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे
verses.transliteration: abhrAtR^ivyo anA tvamanApirindra januShA sanAdasi | yudhedApitvamichChase
verses.translation: Without a rival, without kin, you, Indra, have been forever by nature; for battle you wish for kinship.

verses.sanskrit: यो न इदमिदं पुरा प्र वस्य आनिनाय तमु व स्तुषे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये
verses.transliteration: yo na idamidaM purA pra vasya AninAya tamu va stuShe | sakhAya indramUtaye
verses.translation: Of him who in the past brought us this and that gift, I praise him; friends, for help, Indra.

verses.sanskrit: आ गन्ता मा रिषण्यत प्रस्थावानो माप स्थात समन्यवः । दृढा चिद्यमयिष्णवः
verses.transliteration: A gantA mA riShaNyata prasthAvAno mApa sthAta samanyavaH | dR^iDhA chidyamayiShNavaH
verses.translation: Come, do not do harm; do not stand aloof, you who share one spirit, firm, restraining.

verses.sanskrit: आ याह्ययमिन्दवेऽश्वपते गोपत उर्वरापते । सोमँ सोमपते पिब
verses.transliteration: A yAhyayamindave.ashvapate gopata urvarApate | soma.N somapate piba
verses.translation: Come, for the drop, O lord of horses, lord of cattle, lord of fields; drink the soma, lord of soma.

verses.sanskrit: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं प्रति श्वसन्तं वृषभ ब्रुवीमहि । सँस्थे जनस्य गोमतः
verses.transliteration: tvayA ha svidyujA vayaM prati shvasantaM vR^iShabha bruvImahi | sa.Nsthe janasya gomataH
verses.translation: With you as our ally, O bull, we would speak to the snorting foe in the assembly of the people with cattle.

verses.sanskrit: गावश्चिद्धा समन्यवः सजात्येन मरुतः सबन्धवः । रिहते ककुभो मिथः
verses.transliteration: gAvashchiddhA samanyavaH sajAtyena marutaH sabandhavaH | rihate kakubho mithaH
verses.translation: Even the cows with one mind, the Maruts with kinsmen, lick the peaks one another.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्रा भर ओजो नृम्णँ शतक्रतो विचर्षणे । आ वीरं पृतनासहम्
verses.transliteration: tvaM na indrA bhara ojo nR^imNa.N shatakrato vicharShaNe | A vIraM pR^itanAsaham
verses.translation: Bring us, Indra, strength and manly power, O hundred-powered, all-seeing, a hero who overcomes armies.

verses.sanskrit: अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा काम ईमहे ससृग्महे । उदेव ग्मन्त उदभिः
verses.transliteration: adhA hIndra girvaNa upa tvA kAma Imahe sasR^igmahe | udeva gmanta udabhiH
verses.translation: So now, O lover of songs, Indra, we approach you with desire; we come together like waters flowing to waters.

verses.sanskrit: सीदन्तस्ते वयो यथा गोश्रीते मधौ मदिरे विवक्षणे । अभि त्वामिन्द्र नोनुमः
verses.transliteration: sIdantaste vayo yathA goshrIte madhau madire vivakShaNe | abhi tvAmindra nonumaH
verses.translation: We sit like birds around you in the cow-sweetened, intoxicating honey, to carry you; to you, Indra, we cry aloud.

verses.sanskrit: वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरन्तोऽवस्यवः । वज्रिञ्चित्रँ हवामहे
verses.transliteration: vayamu tvAmapUrvya sthUraM na kachchidbharanto.avasyavaH | vajri~nchitra.N havAmahe
verses.translation: We, O unprecedented, bring to you like a pillar nothing, longing for help; O thunderbolt-bearer, we call on the wonderful.

verses.sanskrit: स्वादोरित्था विषूवतो मधोः पिबन्ति गौर्यः । या इन्द्रेण सयावरीर्वृष्णा मदन्ति शोभथा वस्वीरनु स्वराज्यम्
verses.transliteration: svAdoritthA viShUvato madhoH pibanti gauryaH | yA indreNa sayAvarIrvR^iShNA madanti shobhathA vasvIranu svarAjyam
verses.translation: The fair-skinned ones drink of the sweet, all-spread honey, who with Indra, the bull, are joyful, beautiful, wealthy, according to self-rule.

verses.sanskrit: इत्था हि सोम इन्मदो ब्रह्म चकार वर्धनम् । शविष्ठ वज्रिन्नोजसा पृथिव्या निः शशा अहिमर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्
verses.transliteration: itthA hi soma inmado brahma chakAra vardhanam | shaviShTha vajrinnojasA pR^ithivyA niH shashA ahimarchannanu svarAjyam
verses.translation: So indeed soma is the exhilaration; it made prayer the increase; O strongest thunderbolt-bearer, with might you slew the serpent from the earth, praising according to self-rule.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो मदाय वावृधे शवसे वृत्रहा नृभिः । तमिन्महत्स्वाजिषूतिमर्भे हवामहे स वाजेषु प्र नोऽविषत्
verses.transliteration: indro madAya vAvR^idhe shavase vR^itrahA nR^ibhiH | taminmahatsvAjiShUtimarbhe havAmahe sa vAjeShu pra no.aviShat
verses.translation: Indra grew for exhilaration and strength, the Vritra-slayer with men; him, great in battles, we call in the small as well; may he protect us in the contests.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र तुभ्यमिदद्रिवोऽनुत्तं वज्रिन्वीर्यम् । यद्ध त्यं मायिनं मृगं तव त्यन्माययावधीरर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्
verses.transliteration: indra tubhyamidadrivo.anuttaM vajrinvIryam | yaddha tyaM mAyinaM mR^igaM tava tyanmAyayAvadhIrarchannanu svarAjyam
verses.translation: To you, Indra, O stone-bearer, thunderbolt-wielder, belongs the unrestrained heroism; when you slew that deceitful beast by your magic, praising according to self-rule.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेह्यभीहि धृष्णुहि न ते वज्रो नि यँसते । इन्द्र नृम्णँ हि ते शवो हनो वृत्रं जया अपोऽर्चन्ननु स्वराज्यम्
verses.transliteration: prehyabhIhi dhR^iShNuhi na te vajro ni ya.Nsate | indra nR^imNa.N hi te shavo hano vR^itraM jayA apo.archannanu svarAjyam
verses.translation: Go forth, attack, be bold; your thunderbolt does not fail; your strength, Indra, is manliness; you slew Vritra and won the waters, praising according to self-rule.

verses.sanskrit: यदुदीरत आजयो धृष्णवे धीयते धनम् । युङ्क्ष्वा मदच्युता हरी कँ हनः कं वसौ दधोऽस्माँ इन्द्र वसौ दधः
verses.transliteration: yadudIrata Ajayo dhR^iShNave dhIyate dhanam | yu~NkShvA madachyutA harI ka.N hanaH kaM vasau dadho.asmA.N indra vasau dadhaH
verses.translation: When contests arise, wealth is set for the bold; yoke your two bay horses that drop exhilaration; whom do you slay, in whose wealth do you place us, Indra?

verses.sanskrit: अक्षन्नमीमदन्त ह्यव प्रिया अधूषत । अस्तोषत स्वभानवो विप्रा नविष्ठया मती योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी
verses.transliteration: akShannamImadanta hyava priyA adhUShata | astoShata svabhAnavo viprA naviShThayA matI yojA nvindra te harI
verses.translation: They have eaten and rejoiced, and shaken off their dear ones; the sages of self-radiance have praised with new thought; Indra, your bay horses are yoked.

verses.sanskrit: उपो षु शृणुही गिरो मघवन्मातथा इव । कदा नः सूनृतावतः कर इदर्थयास इद्योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी
verses.transliteration: upo Shu shR^iNuhI giro maghavanmAtathA iva | kadA naH sUnR^itAvataH kara idarthayAsa idyojA nvindra te harI
verses.translation: Listen well to our songs, bounteous one, like a mother; when will you make us rich in truth and kindness? Your bay horses are yoked, Indra.

verses.sanskrit: चन्द्रमा अप्स्वा३न्तरा सुपर्णो धावते दिवि । न वो हिरण्यनेमयः पदं विन्दन्ति विद्युतो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी
verses.transliteration: chandramA apsvA3ntarA suparNo dhAvate divi | na vo hiraNyanemayaH padaM vindanti vidyuto vittaM me asya rodasI
verses.translation: The moon flies among the waters, the fair-winged bird in the sky; the golden-rimmed lightnings do not find your resting-place; know this, O heaven and earth.

verses.sanskrit: प्रति प्रियतमँ रथं वृषणं वसुवाहनम् । स्तोता वामश्विनावृशि स्तोमेभिर्भूषति प्रति माध्वी मम श्रुतँ हवम्
verses.transliteration: prati priyatama.N rathaM vR^iShaNaM vasuvAhanam | stotA vAmashvinAvR^ishi stomebhirbhUShati prati mAdhvI mama shruta.N havam
verses.translation: Your best-loved chariot, the bull, carrier of wealth, O Ashvins — the singer adorns it with hymns; O honeyed ones, hear my call.

verses.sanskrit: आ ते अग्न इधीमहि द्युमन्तं देवाजरम् । युद्ध स्या ते पनीयसी समिद्दीदयति द्यवीषँ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
verses.transliteration: A te agna idhImahi dyumantaM devAjaram | yuddha syA te panIyasI samiddIdayati dyavISha.N stotR^ibhya A bhara
verses.translation: O Agni, we kindle your shining, ageless splendor, O god; may your most worthy kindling blaze; bring to the singers the heavenly gift.

verses.sanskrit: आग्निं न स्ववृक्तिभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे । शीरं पावकशोचिषं वि वो मदे यज्ञेषु स्तीर्णबर्हिषं विवक्षसे
verses.transliteration: AgniM na svavR^iktibhirhotAraM tvA vR^iNImahe | shIraM pAvakashochiShaM vi vo made yaj~neShu stIrNabarhiShaM vivakShase
verses.translation: We choose you, the priest, like Agni, with good praises — the hero of pure flame, in your joy at the sacrifices, who spread the grass, you carry.

verses.sanskrit: महे नो अद्य बोधयोषो राये दिवित्मती । यथा चिन्नो अबोधयः सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते
verses.transliteration: mahe no adya bodhayoSho rAye divitmatI | yathA chinno abodhayaH satyashravasi vAyye sujAte ashvasUnR^ite
verses.translation: Awaken us today to great wealth, O Dawn of heaven, as you have awakened us, true-famed, O Vayya, well-born, bringer of horses and good speech.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रं नो अपि वातय मनो दक्षमुत क्रतुम् । अथा ते सख्ये अन्धसो वि वो मदे रणा गावो न यवसे विवक्षसे
verses.transliteration: bhadraM no api vAtaya mano dakShamuta kratum | athA te sakhye andhaso vi vo made raNA gAvo na yavase vivakShase
verses.translation: Bring auspicious things to us; stir our mind, skill and wisdom; then in your friendship, in the joy of the drink, we shall delight, like cows in pasture, you carry.

verses.sanskrit: क्रत्वा महाँ अनुष्वधं भीम आ वावृते शवः । श्रिय ऋष्व उपाकयोर्नि शिप्री हरिवां दधे हस्तयोर्वज्रमायसम्
verses.transliteration: kratvA mahA.N anuShvadhaM bhIma A vAvR^ite shavaH | shriya R^iShva upAkayorni shiprI harivAM dadhe hastayorvajramAyasam
verses.translation: By skill the great one, in accordance with his own power, the terrible strength has returned; the splendid, fair-lipped, bay-horsed one holds in his hands the iron thunderbolt for glory.

verses.sanskrit: स घा तं वृषणँ रथमधि तिष्ठाति गोविदम् । यः पात्रँ हारियोजनं पूर्णमिन्द्रा चिकेतति योजा न्विन्द्र ते हरी
verses.transliteration: sa ghA taM vR^iShaNa.N rathamadhi tiShThAti govidam | yaH pAtra.N hAriyojanaM pUrNamindrA chiketati yojA nvindra te harI
verses.translation: He indeed mounts that bull-chariot which finds cattle, who, O Indra, is aware of the bay-yoked vessel full; your two bay horses are yoked.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं तं मन्ये यो वसुरस्तं यं यन्ति धेनवः । अस्तमर्वन्त आशवोऽस्तं नित्यासो वाजिन इषँ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
verses.transliteration: agniM taM manye yo vasurastaM yaM yanti dhenavaH | astamarvanta Ashavo.astaM nityAso vAjina iSha.N stotR^ibhya A bhara
verses.translation: I consider Agni the one who is wealth, to whom the cows come home; home the swift horses, home the steadfast strong ones; bring food to the singers.

verses.sanskrit: न तमँहो न दुरितं देवासो अष्ट मर्त्यम् । सजोषसो यमर्यमा मित्रो नयति वरुणो अति द्विषः
verses.transliteration: na tama.Nho na duritaM devAso aShTa martyam | sajoShaso yamaryamA mitro nayati varuNo ati dviShaH
verses.translation: Neither sin nor evil, O gods, reaches the mortal whom Aryaman, Mitra and Varuna, in agreement, lead past hatred.

verses.sanskrit: परि प्र धन्वेन्द्राय सोम स्वादुर्मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय
verses.transliteration: pari pra dhanvendrAya soma svAdurmitrAya pUShNe bhagAya
verses.translation: Flow around, O Soma, for Indra, sweet, for Mitra, Pushan and Bhaga.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यू षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः । द्विषस्तरध्या ऋणया न ईरसे
verses.transliteration: paryU Shu pra dhanva vAjasAtaye pari vR^itrANi sakShaNiH | dviShastaradhyA R^iNayA na Irase
verses.translation: Flow well around for the winning of strength; overcoming Vritras all around; you pass over the enemies, you drive us to pay debts.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम महान्त्समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम
verses.transliteration: pavasva soma mahAntsamudraH pitA devAnAM vishvAbhi dhAma
verses.translation: Flow, Soma, great ocean, father of the gods, to all realms.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम महे दक्षायाश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय
verses.transliteration: pavasva soma mahe dakShAyAshvo na nikto vAjI dhanAya
verses.translation: Flow, Soma, for great skill, like a decked horse, strong, for wealth.

verses.sanskrit: इन्दुः पविष्ट चारुर्मदायापामुपस्थे कविर्भगाय
verses.transliteration: induH paviShTa chArurmadAyApAmupasthe kavirbhagAya
verses.translation: The drop has been purified, fair, for delight, the seer in the lap of the waters, for good fortune.

verses.sanskrit: अनु हि त्वा सुतँ सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये । वाजाँ अभि पवमान प्र गाहसे
verses.transliteration: anu hi tvA suta.N soma madAmasi mahe samaryarAjye | vAjA.N abhi pavamAna pra gAhase
verses.translation: We have rejoiced in you, pressed Soma, for great sovereignty in the battle; as you flow, you plunge into strengths.

verses.sanskrit: क ईं व्यक्ता नरः सनीडा रुद्रस्य मर्या अथ स्वश्वाः
verses.transliteration: ka IM vyaktA naraH sanIDA rudrasya maryA atha svashvAH
verses.translation: Who are these manifest men of one nest, the heroes of Rudra, the well-horsed?

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने तमद्याश्वं न स्तोमैः क्रतुं न भद्रँ हृदिस्पृशम् । ऋध्यामा त ओहैः
verses.transliteration: agne tamadyAshvaM na stomaiH kratuM na bhadra.N hR^idispR^isham | R^idhyAmA ta ohaiH
verses.translation: O Agni, today we make you succeed with praises as a horse, like auspicious wisdom touching the heart, with our offerings.

verses.sanskrit: आविर्मर्या आ वाजं वाजिनो अग्मं देवस्य सवितुः सवम् । स्वर्गाँ अर्वन्तो जयत
verses.transliteration: AvirmaryA A vAjaM vAjino agmaM devasya savituH savam | svargA.N arvanto jayata
verses.translation: The mortal-heroes, the strong, have come to the strength, to the impulse of the god Savitar; win heavens, O horses.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम द्युम्नी सुधारो महाँ अवीनामनुपूर्व्यः
verses.transliteration: pavasva soma dyumnI sudhAro mahA.N avInAmanupUrvyaH
verses.translation: Flow, Soma, splendid, with fair streams, great, first among the sheep.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वतोदावन्विश्वतो न आ भर यं त्वा शविष्ठमीमहे
verses.transliteration: vishvatodAvanvishvato na A bhara yaM tvA shaviShThamImahe
verses.translation: O giver on all sides, bring to us on all sides what we ask of you, the strongest.

verses.sanskrit: एष ब्रह्मा य ऋत्विय इन्द्रो नाम श्रुतो गृणे
verses.transliteration: eSha brahmA ya R^itviya indro nAma shruto gR^iNe
verses.translation: This is the prayer, the seasonal; I praise Indra, the famed by name.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माण इन्द्रं महयन्तो अर्कैरवर्धयन्नहये हन्तवा उ
verses.transliteration: brahmANa indraM mahayanto arkairavardhayannahaye hantavA u
verses.translation: The Brahmins, exalting Indra with hymns, strengthened him to slay the serpent.

verses.sanskrit: अनवस्ते रथमश्वाय तक्षुस्त्वष्टा वज्रं पुरुहूत द्युमन्तम्
verses.transliteration: anavaste rathamashvAya takShustvaShTA vajraM puruhUta dyumantam
verses.translation: They fashioned a chariot for your horse, and Tvashtar the shining thunderbolt, O much-invoked.

verses.sanskrit: शं पदं मघँ रयीषिणो न काममव्रतो हिनोति न स्पृशद्रयिम्
verses.transliteration: shaM padaM magha.N rayIShiNo na kAmamavrato hinoti na spR^ishadrayim
verses.translation: The one who desires wealth sends forth his wish for the auspicious place and bounty; the lawless one does not approach wealth.

verses.sanskrit: सदा गावः शुचयो विश्वधायसः सदा देवा अरेपसः
verses.transliteration: sadA gAvaH shuchayo vishvadhAyasaH sadA devA arepasaH
verses.translation: Ever pure are the cows that nourish all; ever sinless are the gods.

verses.sanskrit: आ याहि वनसा सह गावः सचन्त वर्त्तनिं यदूधभिः
verses.transliteration: A yAhi vanasA saha gAvaH sachanta varttaniM yadUdhabhiH
verses.translation: Come with the forest; the cows follow the path with their udders.

verses.sanskrit: उप प्रक्षे मधुमति क्षियन्तः पुष्येम रयिं धीमहे त इन्द्र
verses.transliteration: upa prakShe madhumati kShiyantaH puShyema rayiM dhImahe ta indra
verses.translation: Dwelling near the honeyed feast, may we thrive; we meditate on wealth, O Indra, for you.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चन्त्यर्कं मरुतः स्वर्क्का आ स्तोभति श्रुतो युवा स इन्द्रः
verses.transliteration: archantyarkaM marutaH svarkkA A stobhati shruto yuvA sa indraH
verses.translation: The Maruts of fair hymns sing the hymn; the famed youth, Indra, makes the response.

verses.sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय वृत्रहन्तमाय विप्राय गाथं गायत यं जुजोषते
verses.transliteration: pra va indrAya vR^itrahantamAya viprAya gAthaM gAyata yaM jujoShate
verses.translation: Sing a song to your Indra, the best Vritra-slayer, the sage, whom he delights in.

verses.sanskrit: अचेत्यग्निश्चिकितिर्हव्यवाड्न सुमद्रथः
verses.transliteration: achetyagnishchikitirhavyavADna sumadrathaH
verses.translation: Agni has been noticed, the wise bearer of oblations, like one with a splendid chariot.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भुवो वरूथ्यः
verses.transliteration: agne tvaM no antama uta trAtA shivo bhuvo varUthyaH
verses.translation: O Agni, be our nearest, our savior, kind and our protector.

verses.sanskrit: भगो न चित्रो अग्निर्महोनां दधाति रत्नम्
verses.transliteration: bhago na chitro agnirmahonAM dadhAti ratnam
verses.translation: Like Bhaga, wondrous Agni bestows treasure on the mighty.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्य प्र स्तोभ पुरो वा सन्यदि वेह नूनम्
verses.transliteration: vishvasya pra stobha puro vA sanyadi veha nUnam
verses.translation: Let the chant be before all, whether in the front, or here and now.

verses.sanskrit: उषा अप स्वसुष्टमः सं वर्त्तयति वर्त्तनिँ सुजातता
verses.transliteration: uShA apa svasuShTamaH saM varttayati varttani.N sujAtatA
verses.translation: Dawn, best sister, turns her path round in her good birth.

verses.sanskrit: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधेमेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः
verses.transliteration: imA nu kaM bhuvanA sIShadhemendrashcha vishve cha devAH
verses.translation: May we complete these worlds happily, Indra and all the gods.

verses.sanskrit: वि स्रुतयो यथा पथ इन्द्र त्वद्यन्तु रातयः
verses.transliteration: vi srutayo yathA patha indra tvadyantu rAtayaH
verses.translation: Like paths spreading out, may your gifts, Indra, go forth in all directions.

verses.sanskrit: अया वाजं देवहितँ सनेम मदेम शतहिमाः सुवीराः
verses.transliteration: ayA vAjaM devahita.N sanema madema shatahimAH suvIrAH
verses.translation: By this may we win the strength set by the gods, and rejoice with good heroes for a hundred winters.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जा मित्रो वरुणः पिन्वतेडाः पीवरीमिषं कृणुही न इन्द्र
verses.transliteration: UrjA mitro varuNaH pinvateDAH pIvarImiShaM kR^iNuhI na indra
