verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माणस्त्वा युजा वयँ सोमपामिन्द्र सोमिनः । सुतावन्तो हवामहे
verses.transliteration: brahmANastvA yujA vaya.N somapAmindra sominaH | sutAvanto havAmahe
verses.translation: We, the Brahmins, soma-offerers, with the yoked bay horses, call you, the soma-drinker Indra, having pressed.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी आ गतँ सुतं गीर्भिर्नभो वरेण्यम् । अस्य पातं धियेषिता
verses.transliteration: indrAgnI A gata.N sutaM gIrbhirnabho vareNyam | asya pAtaM dhiyeShitA
verses.translation: Come, Indra and Agni, to the pressed soma, the desired one praised with songs; drink of it, urged by our thought.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी जरितुः सचा यज्ञो जिगाति चेतनः । अया पातमिमँ सुतम्
verses.transliteration: indrAgnI jarituH sachA yaj~no jigAti chetanaH | ayA pAtamima.N sutam
verses.translation: Indra and Agni, together with the singer, the conscious sacrifice goes forth; drink this pressed soma.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रमग्निं कविच्छदा यज्ञस्य जूत्या वृणे । ता सोमस्येह तृम्पताम्
verses.transliteration: indramagniM kavichChadA yaj~nasya jUtyA vR^iNe | tA somasyeha tR^impatAm
verses.translation: I choose Indra and Agni, with the covering of the wise, for the drive of the sacrifice; let them be satisfied here with the soma.

verses.sanskrit: उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि सद्भूम्या ददे । उग्रँ शर्म महि श्रवः
verses.transliteration: uchchA te jAtamandhaso divi sadbhUmyA dade | ugra.N sharma mahi shravaH
verses.translation: Your high birth of the drink is placed in heaven and on earth; fierce shelter, great fame.

verses.sanskrit: स न इन्द्राय यज्यवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । वरिवोवित्परि स्रव
verses.transliteration: sa na indrAya yajyave varuNAya marudbhyaH | varivovitpari srava
verses.translation: May you, finder of wealth, flow around for us, for worshipful Indra, for Varuna, for the Maruts.

verses.sanskrit: एना विश्वान्यर्य आ द्युम्नानि मानुषाणाम् । सिषासन्तो वनामहे
verses.transliteration: enA vishvAnyarya A dyumnAni mAnuShANAm | siShAsanto vanAmahe
verses.translation: By this, in the lord, we win all the splendors of men, desiring to win them.

verses.sanskrit: पुनानः सोम धारयापो वसानो अर्षसि । आ रत्नधा योनिमृतस्य सीदस्युत्सो देवो हिरण्ययः
verses.transliteration: punAnaH soma dhArayApo vasAno arShasi | A ratnadhA yonimR^itasya sIdasyutso devo hiraNyayaH
verses.translation: Purified, Soma, with the stream you move clad in waters; giver of jewels, you sit in the seat of truth, the golden god fountain.

verses.sanskrit: दुहान ऊधर्दिव्यं मधु प्रियं प्रत्नँ सधस्थमासदत् । आपृच्छ्यं धरुणं वाज्यर्षसि नृभिर्धौतो विचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: duhAna UdhardivyaM madhu priyaM pratna.N sadhasthamAsadat | ApR^ichChyaM dharuNaM vAjyarShasi nR^ibhirdhauto vichakShaNaH
verses.translation: Milking the divine honey from the udder, the dear, he sat in the ancient seat; you flow, a racer to be asked, upholding, washed by men, the all-seeing.

verses.sanskrit: प्र तु द्रव परि कोशं नि षीद नृभिः पुनानो अभि वाजमर्ष । अश्वं न त्वा वाजिनं मर्जयन्तोऽच्छा बर्ही रशनाभिर्नयन्ति
verses.transliteration: pra tu drava pari koshaM ni ShIda nR^ibhiH punAno abhi vAjamarSha | ashvaM na tvA vAjinaM marjayanto.achChA barhI rashanAbhirnayanti
verses.translation: Run forth, sit around the vessel, purified by men, flow toward strength; they cleanse you like a swift horse and lead you with reins to the grass.

verses.sanskrit: स्वायुधः पवते देव इन्दुरशस्तिहा वृजना रक्षमाणः । पिता देवानां जनिता सुदक्षो विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पृथिव्याः
verses.transliteration: svAyudhaH pavate deva indurashastihA vR^ijanA rakShamANaH | pitA devAnAM janitA sudakSho viShTambho divo dharuNaH pR^ithivyAH
verses.translation: The well-armed god, the drop, flows, slayer of slander, guarding the ways; father of the gods, begetter, most skilful, the prop of heaven, support of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिर्विप्रः पुरएता जनानामृभुर्धीर उशना काव्येन । स चिद्विवेद निहितं यदासामपीच्या३ं गुह्यं नाम गोनाम्
verses.transliteration: R^iShirvipraH puraetA janAnAmR^ibhurdhIra ushanA kAvyena | sa chidviveda nihitaM yadAsAmapIchyA3M guhyaM nAma gonAm
verses.translation: The sage, the inspired leader of the peoples, Ribhu, steadfast, with the poetry of Ushanas; he indeed knew the hidden, secret name of the cows.

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा शूर नोनुमोऽदुग्धा इव धेनवः । ईशानमस्य जगतः स्वर्दृशमीशानमिन्द्र तस्थुषः
verses.transliteration: abhi tvA shUra nonumo.adugdhA iva dhenavaH | IshAnamasya jagataH svardR^ishamIshAnamindra tasthuShaH
verses.translation: We cry to you, O hero, like unmilked cows — you who rule this world, who see the sun, who rule what stands, Indra.

verses.sanskrit: न त्वावाँ अन्यो दिव्यो न पार्थिवो न जातो न जनिष्यते । अश्वायन्तो मघवन्निन्द्र वाजिनो गव्यन्तस्त्वा हवामहे
verses.transliteration: na tvAvA.N anyo divyo na pArthivo na jAto na janiShyate | ashvAyanto maghavannindra vAjino gavyantastvA havAmahe
verses.translation: None like you, divine or earthly, has been born or will be born; desiring horses, bounteous Indra, with strength, desiring cattle, we call you.

verses.sanskrit: कया नश्चित्र आ भुवदूती सदावृधः सखा । कया शचिष्ठया वृता
verses.transliteration: kayA nashchitra A bhuvadUtI sadAvR^idhaH sakhA | kayA shachiShThayA vR^itA
verses.translation: By what wondrous help shall he come to us, an ever-growing friend? By what mighty company?

verses.sanskrit: कस्त्वा सत्यो मदानां मँहिष्ठो मत्सदन्धसः । दृढा चिदारुजे वसु
verses.transliteration: kastvA satyo madAnAM ma.NhiShTho matsadandhasaH | dR^iDhA chidAruje vasu
verses.translation: What true, most exhilarating drink of the stalk delights you? You break even the firm to win wealth.

verses.sanskrit: अभी षु णः सखीनामविता जरितॄणाम् । शतं भवास्यूतये
verses.transliteration: abhI Shu NaH sakhInAmavitA jaritR^INAm | shataM bhavAsyUtaye
verses.translation: Be to us a helper of friends and singers, a hundredfold, for protection.

verses.sanskrit: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः । अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे
verses.transliteration: taM vo dasmamR^itIShahaM vasormandAnamandhasaH | abhi vatsaM na svasareShu dhenava indraM gIrbhirnavAmahe
verses.translation: Him, your wondrous victor over foes, rejoicing in the soma-drink of the Vasu — with songs we praise Indra anew, as cows their calf in their stalls.

verses.sanskrit: द्युक्षँ सुदानुं तविषीभिरावृतं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसम् । क्षुमन्तं वाजँ शतिनँ सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे
verses.transliteration: dyukSha.N sudAnuM taviShIbhirAvR^itaM giriM na purubhojasam | kShumantaM vAja.N shatina.N sahasriNaM makShU gomantamImahe
verses.translation: We ask for the heaven-dwelling, good giver, surrounded by powers, like a mountain, much-nourishing, wealth with cattle, hundreds and thousands, swiftly.

verses.sanskrit: तरोभिर्वो विदद्वसुमिन्द्रँ सबाध ऊतये । बृहद्गायन्तः सुतसोमे अध्वरे हुवे भरं न कारिणम्
verses.transliteration: tarobhirvo vidadvasumindra.N sabAdha Utaye | bR^ihadgAyantaH sutasome adhvare huve bharaM na kAriNam
verses.translation: With strengths I invoke Indra, finder of wealth, together with our fellows for help, at the soma-pressing sacrifice, singing loudly, as one calls a worker for his burden.

verses.sanskrit: न यं दुध्रा वरन्ते न स्थिरा मुरो मदेषु शिप्रमन्धसः । य आदृत्या शशमानाय सुन्वते दाता जरित्र उक्थ्यम्
verses.transliteration: na yaM dudhrA varante na sthirA muro madeShu shipramandhasaH | ya AdR^ityA shashamAnAya sunvate dAtA jaritra ukthyam
verses.translation: Him whom neither the violent nor the obstinate turn aside in the joys of the drink, who with reverence gives a worthy praise to the singer who presses.

verses.sanskrit: स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया । इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः
verses.transliteration: svAdiShThayA madiShThayA pavasva soma dhArayA | indrAya pAtave sutaH
verses.translation: Flow, Soma, with the sweetest, most exhilarating stream; pressed for Indra to drink.

verses.sanskrit: रक्षोहा विश्वचर्षणिरभि योनिमयोहते । द्रोणे सधस्थमासदत्
verses.transliteration: rakShohA vishvacharShaNirabhi yonimayohate | droNe sadhasthamAsadat
verses.translation: The demon-slayer, all-seeing, goes to his iron-free nest; he sat in the seat in the trough.

verses.sanskrit: वरिवोधातमो भुवो मँहिष्ठो वृत्रहन्तमः । पर्षि राधो मघोनाम्
verses.transliteration: varivodhAtamo bhuvo ma.NhiShTho vR^itrahantamaH | parShi rAdho maghonAm
verses.translation: Be the best giver of room, the greatest, the best Vritra-slayer; you carry the bounty of the bounteous.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व मधुमत्तम इन्द्राय सोम क्रतुवित्तमो मदः । महि द्युक्षतमो मदः
verses.transliteration: pavasva madhumattama indrAya soma kratuvittamo madaH | mahi dyukShatamo madaH
verses.translation: Flow, most honeyed, for Indra, O Soma, the most skilled exhilaration, the great, most heavenly exhilaration.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ते पीत्वा वृषभो वृषायतेऽस्य पीत्वा स्वर्विदः । स सुप्रकेतो अभ्यक्रमीदिषोऽच्छा वाजं नैतशः
verses.transliteration: yasya te pItvA vR^iShabho vR^iShAyate.asya pItvA svarvidaH | sa supraketo abhyakramIdiSho.achChA vAjaM naitashaH
verses.translation: He who, having drunk of you, the bull acts as a bull; having drunk of it, the heaven-finder, the well-marked, has come forward for food, like Etasha for the strength.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रमच्छ सुता इमे वृषणं यन्तु हरयः । श्रुष्टे जातास इन्दवः स्वर्विदः
verses.transliteration: indramachCha sutA ime vR^iShaNaM yantu harayaH | shruShTe jAtAsa indavaH svarvidaH
verses.translation: Let these pressed bay drops go to Indra the bull; drops born in the hearing, finders of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अयं भराय सानसिरिन्द्राय पवते सुतः । सोमो जैत्रस्य चेतति यथा विदे
verses.transliteration: ayaM bharAya sAnasirindrAya pavate sutaH | somo jaitrasya chetati yathA vide
verses.translation: This victor-gainer flows, pressed for Indra's carrying; the soma is known for the victory as he wishes.

verses.sanskrit: अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा ग्राभं गृभ्णाति सानसिम् । वज्रं च वृषणं भरत्समप्सुजित्
verses.transliteration: asyedindro madeShvA grAbhaM gR^ibhNAti sAnasim | vajraM cha vR^iShaNaM bharatsamapsujit
verses.translation: In the joys of this, Indra takes hold of the victor's grasp, and bears the thunderbolt, the bull, conqueror in the waters.

verses.sanskrit: पुरोजिती वो अन्धसः सुताय मादयित्नवे । अप श्वानँ श्नथिष्टन सखायो दीर्घजिह्व्यम्
verses.transliteration: purojitI vo andhasaH sutAya mAdayitnave | apa shvAna.N shnathiShTana sakhAyo dIrghajihvyam
verses.translation: For the pressed, exhilarating drink, you who go before — drive away the dog of long tongue, O friends.

verses.sanskrit: यो धारया पावकया परिप्रस्यन्दते सुतः । इन्दुरश्वो न कृत्व्यः
verses.transliteration: yo dhArayA pAvakayA pariprasyandate sutaH | indurashvo na kR^itvyaH
verses.translation: The pressed one flows around with the purifying stream, the drop, like a skilled horse.

verses.sanskrit: तं दुरोषमभी नरः सोमं विश्वाच्या धिया । यज्ञाय सन्त्वद्रयः
verses.transliteration: taM duroShamabhI naraH somaM vishvAchyA dhiyA | yaj~nAya santvadrayaH
verses.translation: Men, press that hard-to-seize soma with all-turning thought; let the stones be for the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्रियाणि पवते चनोहितो नामानि यह्वो अधि येषु वर्धते । आ सूर्यस्य बृहतो बृहन्नधि रथं विष्वञ्चमरुहद्विचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: abhi priyANi pavate chanohito nAmAni yahvo adhi yeShu vardhate | A sUryasya bR^ihato bR^ihannadhi rathaM viShva~nchamaruhadvichakShaNaH
verses.translation: The great, set in food, flows toward dear things, the names in which he grows; he, the all-seeing, mounted the all-turning chariot of the great Sun.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतस्य जिह्वा पवते मधु प्रियं वक्ता पतिर्धियो अस्या अदाभ्यः । दधाति पुत्रः पित्रोरपीच्या३ं नाम तृतीयमधि रोचनं दिवः
verses.transliteration: R^itasya jihvA pavate madhu priyaM vaktA patirdhiyo asyA adAbhyaH | dadhAti putraH pitrorapIchyA3M nAma tR^itIyamadhi rochanaM divaH
verses.translation: The tongue of truth flows, the dear honey, the speaker, lord of this thought, unconquerable; the son holds the secret name of the parents, the third light of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अव द्युतानः कलशाँ अचिक्रदन्नृभिर्येमाणः कोश आ हिरण्यये । अभी ऋतस्य दोहना अनूषताधि त्रिपृष्ठ उषसो वि राजसि
verses.transliteration: ava dyutAnaH kalashA.N achikradannR^ibhiryemANaH kosha A hiraNyaye | abhI R^itasya dohanA anUShatAdhi tripR^iShTha uShaso vi rAjasi
verses.translation: Shining, he has roared down into the vessels, held by men in the golden receptacle; they praised the milkings of truth; on the three-backed one you shine over the dawns.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञायज्ञा वो अग्नये गिरागिरा च दक्षसे । प्रप्र वयममृतं जातवेदसं प्रियं मित्रं न शँसिषम्
verses.transliteration: yaj~nAyaj~nA vo agnaye girAgirA cha dakShase | prapra vayamamR^itaM jAtavedasaM priyaM mitraM na sha.NsiSham
verses.translation: At every sacrifice and with every song we honor Agni for his skill; let me praise the immortal Jatavedas, dear like a friend.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपातँ स हिनायमस्मयुर्दाशेम हव्यदातये । भुवद्वाजेष्वविता भुवद्वृध उत त्राता तनूनाम्
verses.transliteration: Urjo napAta.N sa hinAyamasmayurdAshema havyadAtaye | bhuvadvAjeShvavitA bhuvadvR^idha uta trAtA tanUnAm
verses.translation: Grandson of strength, desiring us, may we give to him who gives offerings; may he be a helper in battles, a strengthener, and protector of bodies.

verses.sanskrit: एह्यू षु ब्रवाणि तेऽग्न इत्थेतरा गिरः । एभिर्वर्धास इन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration: ehyU Shu bravANi te.agna itthetarA giraH | ebhirvardhAsa indubhiH
verses.translation: Come, let me speak to you, Agni, other words as well; grow strong through these soma-drops.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र क्व च ते मनो दक्षं दधस उत्तरम् । तत्रा योनिं कृणवसे
verses.transliteration: yatra kva cha te mano dakShaM dadhasa uttaram | tatrA yoniM kR^iNavase
verses.translation: Wherever your mind sets its skill higher, there you make your seat.

verses.sanskrit: न हि ते पूर्तमक्षिपद्भुवन्नेमानां पते । अथा दुवो वनवसे
verses.transliteration: na hi te pUrtamakShipadbhuvannemAnAM pate | athA duvo vanavase
verses.translation: For your fullness has not disappeared, O lord of the ends; therefore you win worship.

verses.sanskrit: वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरन्तोऽवस्यवः । वज्रिञ्चित्रँ हवामहे
verses.transliteration: vayamu tvAmapUrvya sthUraM na kachchidbharanto.avasyavaH | vajri~nchitra.N havAmahe
verses.translation: We, O unprecedented, bring to you like a pillar nothing, longing for help; O thunderbolt-bearer, we call on the wonderful.

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धृषत् । त्वामिध्यवितारं ववृमहे सखाय इन्द्र सानसिम्
verses.transliteration: upa tvA karmannUtaye sa no yuvograshchakrAma yo dhR^iShat | tvAmidhyavitAraM vavR^imahe sakhAya indra sAnasim
verses.translation: We approach you in the work for help; may that youth, the fierce, who dares, come; we choose you, the kindled helper, friends, Indra, the victor.

verses.sanskrit: अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा काम ईमहे ससृग्महे । उदेव ग्मन्त उदभिः
verses.transliteration: adhA hIndra girvaNa upa tvA kAma Imahe sasR^igmahe | udeva gmanta udabhiH
verses.translation: So now, O lover of songs, Indra, we approach you with desire; we come together like waters flowing to waters.

verses.sanskrit: वार्ण त्वा यव्याभिर्वर्धन्ति शूर ब्रह्माणि । ववृध्वाँसं चिदद्रिवो दिवेदिवे
verses.transliteration: vArNa tvA yavyAbhirvardhanti shUra brahmANi | vavR^idhvA.NsaM chidadrivo divedive
verses.translation: They strengthen you, hero, with prayers in the barley-fields, you who have grown, O stone-bearer, day by day.

verses.sanskrit: युञ्जन्ति हरी इषिरस्य गाथयोरौ रथ उरुयुगे वचोयुजा । इन्द्रवाहा स्वर्विदा
verses.transliteration: yu~njanti harI iShirasya gAthayorau ratha uruyuge vachoyujA | indravAhA svarvidA
verses.translation: They yoke the two bay horses to the song of the swift one, on the wide chariot with a wide yoke, speech-yoked, carriers of Indra, finders of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । विश्वासाहँ शत्क्रतुं मँहिष्ठं चर्षणीनाम्
verses.transliteration: pAntamA vo andhasa indramabhi pra gAyata | vishvAsAha.N shatkratuM ma.NhiShThaM charShaNInAm
verses.translation: Sing to Indra, the best protector of your drink, the all-conquering, hundred-powered, greatest of the peoples.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतं गाथान्या३ँ सनश्रुतम् । इन्द्र इति ब्रवीतन
verses.transliteration: puruhUtaM puruShTutaM gAthAnyA3.N sanashrutam | indra iti bravItana
verses.translation: Invoked by many, praised by many, heard in ancient songs — call him Indra.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र इन्नो महोनां दाता वाजानां नृतुः । महाँ अभिज्ञ्वा यमत्
verses.transliteration: indra inno mahonAM dAtA vAjAnAM nR^ituH | mahA.N abhij~nvA yamat
verses.translation: Indra is our giver of great strengths, the dancer; may the great one restrain.

verses.sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय मादनँ हर्यश्वाय गायत । सखायः सोमपाव्ने
verses.transliteration: pra va indrAya mAdana.N haryashvAya gAyata | sakhAyaH somapAvne
verses.translation: Sing the exhilarating song for Indra of the bay horses, friends — for the drinker of soma.

verses.sanskrit: शँसेदुक्थँ सुदानव उत द्युक्षं यथ नरः । चकृमा सत्यराधसे
verses.transliteration: sha.Nseduktha.N sudAnava uta dyukShaM yatha naraH | chakR^imA satyarAdhase
verses.translation: Let the good givers praise the hymn and the heavenly one, as men; we have made for the true-bountiful.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्र वाजयुस्त्वं गव्युः शतक्रतो । त्वँ हिरण्ययुर्वसो
verses.transliteration: tvaM na indra vAjayustvaM gavyuH shatakrato | tva.N hiraNyayurvaso
verses.translation: You, Indra, desiring strength; you, hundred-powered, desiring cattle; you, O Vasu, desiring gold.

verses.sanskrit: वयमु त्वा तदिदर्था इन्द्र त्वायन्तः सखायः । कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते
verses.transliteration: vayamu tvA tadidarthA indra tvAyantaH sakhAyaH | kaNvA ukthebhirjarante
verses.translation: We, O Indra, longing for you, friends with this very aim, the Kanvas, praise you with hymns.

verses.sanskrit: न घेमन्यदा पपन वज्रिन्नपसो नविष्टौ । तवेदु स्तोमैश्चिकेत
verses.transliteration: na ghemanyadA papana vajrinnapaso naviShTau | tavedu stomaishchiketa
verses.translation: Never indeed have I drunk of another, thunderbolt-bearer, in the newest of works; by your hymns alone is it known.

verses.sanskrit: इच्छन्ति देवाः सुन्वन्तं न स्वप्नाय स्पृहयन्ति । यन्ति प्रमादमतन्द्राः
verses.transliteration: ichChanti devAH sunvantaM na svapnAya spR^ihayanti | yanti pramAdamatandrAH
verses.translation: The gods seek the one who presses; they do not long for sleep; the untiring go to carelessness.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय मद्व्ने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः । अर्कमर्च्चन्तु कारवः
verses.transliteration: indrAya madvne sutaM pari ShTobhantu no giraH | arkamarchchantu kAravaH
verses.translation: Let our songs resound around for exhilarating Indra pressed; let the singers sing the hymn.

verses.sanskrit: यस्मिन्विश्वा अधि श्रियो रणन्ति सप्त सँसदः । इन्द्रँ सुते हवामहे
verses.transliteration: yasminvishvA adhi shriyo raNanti sapta sa.NsadaH | indra.N sute havAmahe
verses.translation: In whom all glories rejoice, the seven assemblies — we call Indra at the pressing.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत । तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः
verses.transliteration: trikadrukeShu chetanaM devAso yaj~namatnata | tamidvardhantu no giraH
verses.translation: The gods stretched out the conscious sacrifice in the Trikadrukas; let our songs strengthen him.

verses.sanskrit: अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि । एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब
verses.transliteration: ayaM ta indra somo nipUto adhi barhiShi | ehImasya dravA piba
verses.translation: This soma of yours, O Indra, is purified on the grass; come, hasten and drink it.

verses.sanskrit: शाचिगो शाचिपूजनायँ रणाय ते सुतः । आखण्डल प्र हूयसे
verses.transliteration: shAchigo shAchipUjanAya.N raNAya te sutaH | AkhaNDala pra hUyase
verses.translation: O strong one, for worship of the strong, for the delight, your soma is pressed; O Akhandala, you are invoked.

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते शृङ्गवृषो णपात्प्रणपात्कुण्डपाय्यः । न्यस्मिं दध्र आ मनः
verses.transliteration: yaste shR^i~NgavR^iSho NapAtpraNapAtkuNDapAyyaH | nyasmiM dadhra A manaH
verses.translation: Your horn-bull, grandson, great-grandson, the cup-drinker — set the mind upon him.

verses.sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभँ सं गृभाय । महाहस्ति दक्षिणेन
verses.transliteration: A tU na indra kShumantaM chitraM grAbha.N saM gR^ibhAya | mahAhasti dakShiNena
verses.translation: Now, Indra, grasp for us the wondrous, abundant grasp, great-handed, with your right hand.

verses.sanskrit: विद्मा हि त्वा तुविकूर्मिं तुविदेष्णं तुवीमघम् । तुविमात्रमवोभिः
verses.transliteration: vidmA hi tvA tuvikUrmiM tuvideShNaM tuvImagham | tuvimAtramavobhiH
verses.translation: We know you, much active, much giving, much bounteous, of great measure, with your helps.

verses.sanskrit: न हि त्वा शूर देवा न मर्तासो दित्सन्तम् । भीमं न गां वारयन्ते
verses.transliteration: na hi tvA shUra devA na martAso ditsantam | bhImaM na gAM vArayante
verses.translation: Neither gods nor mortals restrain you, O hero, when you wish to give, as they do not hold back a terrible cow.

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतँ सृजामि पीतये । तृम्पा व्यश्नुही मदम्
verses.transliteration: abhi tvA vR^iShabhA sute suta.N sR^ijAmi pItaye | tR^impA vyashnuhI madam
verses.translation: O bull, I pour out the pressed soma for you to drink; be satisfied and attain exhilaration.

verses.sanskrit: मा त्वा मूरा अविष्यवो मोपहस्वान आ दभन् । मा कीं ब्रह्मद्विषं वनः
verses.transliteration: mA tvA mUrA aviShyavo mopahasvAna A dabhan | mA kIM brahmadviShaM vanaH
verses.translation: Let not the foolish, nor the mockers, nor the harmful hurt you; do not love the hater of prayer.

verses.sanskrit: इह त्वा गोपरीणसं महे मन्दन्तु राधसे । सरो गौरो यथा पिब
verses.transliteration: iha tvA goparINasaM mahe mandantu rAdhase | saro gauro yathA piba
verses.translation: May they gladden you here, the cow-surrounded, for great wealth; drink like a wild buffalo at a lake.

verses.sanskrit: इदम् वसो सुतमन्धः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरम् । अनाभयिन्ररिमा ते
verses.transliteration: idam vaso sutamandhaH pibA supUrNamudaram | anAbhayinrarimA te
verses.translation: Drink, O Vasu, this pressed drink, filling the belly; fearless, may we be yours.

verses.sanskrit: नृभिर्धौतः सुतो अश्नैरव्या वारैः परिपूतः । अश्वो न निक्तो नदीषु
verses.transliteration: nR^ibhirdhautaH suto ashnairavyA vAraiH paripUtaH | ashvo na nikto nadIShu
verses.translation: Washed by men, pressed by stones, purified through woolen sieves, like a horse cleansed in rivers.

verses.sanskrit: तं ते यवं यथा गोभिः स्वादुमकर्म श्रीणन्तः । इन्द्र त्वास्मिन्त्सधमादे
verses.transliteration: taM te yavaM yathA gobhiH svAdumakarma shrINantaH | indra tvAsmintsadhamAde
verses.translation: We have made your barley sweet with cows, delighting it, Indra, in this shared feast.

verses.sanskrit: इदँ ह्यन्वोजसा सुतँ राधानां पते । पिबा त्वा३स्य गिर्वणः
verses.transliteration: ida.N hyanvojasA suta.N rAdhAnAM pate | pibA tvA3sya girvaNaH
verses.translation: This has been pressed with strength, O lord of bounties; drink of it, you who love songs.

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते अनु स्वधामसत्सुते नि यच्छ तन्वम् । स त्वा ममत्तु सोम्यम्
verses.transliteration: yaste anu svadhAmasatsute ni yachCha tanvam | sa tvA mamattu somyam
verses.translation: Whoever is in your own way, at the pressing, steady your body; let that soma-drink delight you.

verses.sanskrit: प्र ते अश्नोतु कुक्ष्योः प्रेन्द्र ब्रह्मणा शिरः । प्र बाहू शूर राधसा
verses.transliteration: pra te ashnotu kukShyoH prendra brahmaNA shiraH | pra bAhU shUra rAdhasA
verses.translation: May it reach your belly, Indra; may the prayer reach your head; may your arms, O hero, with wealth.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वेता नि षीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । सखाय स्तोमवाहसः
verses.transliteration: A tvetA ni ShIdatendramabhi pra gAyata | sakhAya stomavAhasaH
verses.translation: Come and sit; sing to Indra, friends, bearing the hymn.

verses.sanskrit: पुरूतमं पुरूणामीशानं वार्याणाम् । इन्द्रँ सोमे सचा सुते
verses.transliteration: purUtamaM purUNAmIshAnaM vAryANAm | indra.N some sachA sute
verses.translation: Indra, the greatest of many, ruler of desirable things, in the pressed soma together.

verses.sanskrit: स घा नो योग आ भुवत्स राये स पुरन्ध्या । गमद्वाजेभिरा स नः
verses.transliteration: sa ghA no yoga A bhuvatsa rAye sa purandhyA | gamadvAjebhirA sa naH
verses.translation: May he be at our yoking, for wealth, for abundance; may he come to us with strengths.

verses.sanskrit: योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये
verses.transliteration: yogeyoge tavastaraM vAjevAje havAmahe | sakhAya indramUtaye
verses.translation: At every yoking, at every battle, we, friends, invoke Indra, the mightiest, for help.

verses.sanskrit: अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसो हुवे तुविप्रतिं नरम् । यं ते पूर्वं पिता हुवे
verses.transliteration: anu pratnasyaukaso huve tuvipratiM naram | yaM te pUrvaM pitA huve
verses.translation: I call after the ancient dwelling the man of many fronts, whom your father called before.

verses.sanskrit: आ घा गमद्यदि श्रवत्सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिः । वाजेभिरुप नो हवम्
verses.transliteration: A ghA gamadyadi shravatsahasriNIbhirUtibhiH | vAjebhirupa no havam
verses.translation: May he come, if he hears, with thousandfold helps and strengths to our call.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीष उक्थ्यम् । विदे वृधस्य दक्षस्य महाँ हि षः
verses.transliteration: indra suteShu someShu kratuM punISha ukthyam | vide vR^idhasya dakShasya mahA.N hi ShaH
verses.translation: Indra, among the pressed somas you purify the wisdom worthy of praise; he is great, for he knows the strengthening skill.

verses.sanskrit: स प्रथमे व्योमनि देवानाँ सदने वृधः । सुपारः सुश्रवस्तमः समप्सुजित्
verses.transliteration: sa prathame vyomani devAnA.N sadane vR^idhaH | supAraH sushravastamaH samapsujit
verses.translation: He grows in the first heaven, in the seat of the gods; good to cross, most famous, a conqueror in the waters.

verses.sanskrit: तमु हुवे वाजसातय इन्द्रं भराय शुष्मिणम् । भवा नः सुम्ने अन्तमः सखा वृधे
verses.transliteration: tamu huve vAjasAtaya indraM bharAya shuShmiNam | bhavA naH sumne antamaH sakhA vR^idhe
verses.translation: I call on Indra, strong, for the winning of strength, for the battle; be our nearest in favor, a friend for growth.

verses.sanskrit: एना वो अग्निं नमसोर्जो नपातमा हुवे । प्रियं चेतिष्ठमरतिँ स्वध्वरं विश्वस्य दूतममृतम्
verses.transliteration: enA vo agniM namasorjo napAtamA huve | priyaM chetiShThamarati.N svadhvaraM vishvasya dUtamamR^itam
verses.translation: With this homage I call Agni, the grandson of strength; dear, most conscious, unhurried, of good sacrifice, the immortal messenger of all.

verses.sanskrit: स योजते अरुषा विश्वभोजसा स दुद्रवत्स्वाहुतः । सुब्रह्मा यज्ञः सुशमी वसूनां देवँ राधो जनानाम्
verses.transliteration: sa yojate aruShA vishvabhojasA sa dudravatsvAhutaH | subrahmA yaj~naH sushamI vasUnAM deva.N rAdho janAnAm
verses.translation: He yokes the ruddy two that feed all, he runs well-offered; the good prayer, sacrifice, good pacifier of the Vasus, the god's bounty to the people.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यु अदर्श्यायत्यू३च्छन्ती दुहिता दिवः । अपो मही वृणुते चक्षुषा तमो ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरी
verses.transliteration: pratyu adarshyAyatyU3chChantI duhitA divaH | apo mahI vR^iNute chakShuShA tamo jyotiShkR^iNoti sUnarI
verses.translation: The daughter of heaven, coming, has been seen, shining; the great one uncovers the waters; with her eye she makes darkness into light, O fair one.

verses.sanskrit: उदुस्रियाः सृजते सूर्यः सचा उद्यन्नक्षत्रमर्चिवत् । तवेदुषो व्युषि सूर्यस्य च सं भक्तेन गमेमहि
verses.transliteration: udusriyAH sR^ijate sUryaH sachA udyannakShatramarchivat | taveduSho vyuShi sUryasya cha saM bhaktena gamemahi
verses.translation: The Sun together releases the cows, rising like a flaming star; at your dawning and the sun's, may we be united with our share.

verses.sanskrit: इमा उ वां दिविष्टय उस्रा हवन्ते अश्विना । अयं वामह्वेऽवसे शचीवसू विशंविशँ हि गच्छथः
verses.transliteration: imA u vAM diviShTaya usrA havante ashvinA | ayaM vAmahve.avase shachIvasU vishaMvisha.N hi gachChathaH
verses.translation: These cows of the dawn call you, O Ashvins, to heaven's sacrifice; I call you here for help, O you of power and wealth, for you go to every clan.

verses.sanskrit: युवं चित्रं ददथुर्भोजनं नरा चोदेथाँ सूनृतावते । अर्वाग्रथँ समनसा नि यच्छतं पिबतँ सोम्यं मधु
verses.transliteration: yuvaM chitraM dadathurbhojanaM narA chodethA.N sUnR^itAvate | arvAgratha.N samanasA ni yachChataM pibata.N somyaM madhu
verses.translation: You, O men, gave wondrous food; urge on the truthful one; bring your chariot together, of one mind, and drink the soma honey.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य प्रत्नामनु द्युतँ शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः । पयः सहस्रसामृषिम्
verses.transliteration: asya pratnAmanu dyuta.N shukraM duduhre ahrayaH | payaH sahasrasAmR^iShim
verses.translation: After his ancient light the unfailing milked the bright one, the milk, the sage of a thousand songs.

verses.sanskrit: अयँ सूर्य इवोपदृगयँ सराँसि धावति । सप्त प्रवत आ दिवम्
verses.transliteration: aya.N sUrya ivopadR^igaya.N sarA.Nsi dhAvati | sapta pravata A divam
verses.translation: This one is like the sun in sight; this one runs to the lakes, the seven streams to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अयं विश्वानि तिष्ठति पुनानो भुवनोपरि । सोमो देवो न सूर्यः
verses.transliteration: ayaM vishvAni tiShThati punAno bhuvanopari | somo devo na sUryaH
verses.translation: This stands above all worlds, purifying, Soma the god, like the sun.

verses.sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति
verses.transliteration: eSha pratnena janmanA devo devebhyaH sutaH | hariH pavitre arShati
verses.translation: This god, by ancient birth, is pressed for the gods; the bay one flows in the filter.

verses.sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन मन्मना देवो देवेभ्यस्परि । कविर्विप्रेण वावृधे
verses.transliteration: eSha pratnena manmanA devo devebhyaspari | kavirvipreNa vAvR^idhe
verses.translation: This god, by ancient thought, around the gods; the seer grows by the sage.

verses.sanskrit: दुहानः प्रत्नमित्पयः पवित्रे परि षिच्यसे । क्रन्दं देवाँ अजीजनः
verses.transliteration: duhAnaH pratnamitpayaH pavitre pari Shichyase | krandaM devA.N ajIjanaH
verses.translation: Milking the ancient milk, you are poured into the filter; roaring, you begat the gods.

verses.sanskrit: उप शिक्षापतस्थुषो भियसमा धेहि शत्रवे । पवमान विदा रयिम्
verses.transliteration: upa shikShApatasthuSho bhiyasamA dhehi shatrave | pavamAna vidA rayim
verses.translation: Bring near to the one who stands, and set fear on the enemy; flowing, find wealth.

verses.sanskrit: उषो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् । इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः
verses.transliteration: uSho Shu jAtamapturaM gobhirbha~NgaM pariShkR^itam | induM devA ayAsiShuH
verses.translation: The gods have gone to the drop just born, water-crossing, adorned with the milk of cows.

verses.sanskrit: उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे । अभि देवाँ इयक्षते
verses.transliteration: upAsmai gAyatA naraH pavamAnAyendave | abhi devA.N iyakShate
verses.translation: Sing to him, men, the purifying drop; he seeks the gods.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोमासो विपश्चितोऽपो नयन्त ऊर्मयः । वनानि महिषा इव
verses.transliteration: pra somAso vipashchito.apo nayanta UrmayaH | vanAni mahiShA iva
verses.translation: The sage-somas, the waves, carry along the waters, like buffaloes through woods.

verses.sanskrit: अभि द्रोणानि बभ्रवः शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया । वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन्
verses.transliteration: abhi droNAni babhravaH shukrA R^itasya dhArayA | vAjaM gomantamakSharan
verses.translation: The brown, bright ones have flowed to the vessels with the stream of truth, bringing strength rich in cattle.

verses.sanskrit: सुता इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमा अर्षन्तु विष्णवे
verses.transliteration: sutA indrAya vAyave varuNAya marudbhyaH | somA arShantu viShNave
verses.translation: Pressed for Indra, Vayu, Varuna, the Maruts, may the somas flow to Vishnu.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोम देववीतये सिन्धुर्न पिप्ये अर्णसा । अँशोः पयसा मदिरो न जागृविरच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतम्
verses.transliteration: pra soma devavItaye sindhurna pipye arNasA | a.NshoH payasA madiro na jAgR^ivirachChA koshaM madhushchutam
verses.translation: Go forth, Soma, for the gods' feast; like a river you swell with the flood; with the milk of the stalk, joyful, wakeful, honey-dripping, toward the treasury.

verses.sanskrit: आ हर्यतो अर्जुनो अत्के अव्यत प्रियः सूनुर्न मर्ज्यः । तमीँ हिन्वन्त्यपसो यथा रथं नदीष्वा गभस्त्योः
verses.transliteration: A haryato arjuno atke avyata priyaH sUnurna marjyaH | tamI.N hinvantyapaso yathA rathaM nadIShvA gabhastyoH
verses.translation: The beloved bright one is covered in the garment, dear like a son to be cleansed; the workers send him as a chariot into the rivers from the hands.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनाम् । सुता विदथे अक्रमुः
verses.transliteration: pra somAso madachyutaH shravase no maghonAm | sutA vidathe akramuH
verses.translation: The exhilaration-dropping somas have gone forth for our fame and that of the bounteous, pressed at the ritual.

verses.sanskrit: आदीँ हँसो यथा गणं विश्वस्यावीवशन्मतिम् । अत्यो न गोभिरज्यते
verses.transliteration: AdI.N ha.Nso yathA gaNaM vishvasyAvIvashanmatim | atyo na gobhirajyate
verses.translation: Then like a swan to its flock he longed for the thought of all; like a horse he is anointed with cows.

verses.sanskrit: आदीं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिँ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये
verses.transliteration: AdIM tritasya yoShaNo hari.N hinvantyadribhiH | indumindrAya pItaye
verses.translation: Then the women of Trita cleanse the bay one with stones, the drop for Indra to drink.

verses.sanskrit: अया पवस्व देवयु रेभन्पवित्रं पर्येषि विश्वतः । मधोर्धारा असृक्षत
verses.transliteration: ayA pavasva devayu rebhanpavitraM paryeShi vishvataH | madhordhArA asR^ikShata
verses.translation: Flow with this, god-seeking, roaring; you pass through the filter on all sides; the streams of honey have been released.

verses.sanskrit: पवते हर्यतो हरिरति ह्वराँसि रँह्या । अभ्यर्ष स्तोतृभ्यो वीरवद्यशः
verses.transliteration: pavate haryato harirati hvarA.Nsi ra.NhyA | abhyarSha stotR^ibhyo vIravadyashaH
verses.translation: The beloved bay-colored flows swiftly over crookednesses; flow to the singers heroic glory.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सुन्वानास्यान्धसो मर्तो न वष्ट तद्वचः । अप श्वानमराधसँ हता मखं न भृगवः
verses.transliteration: pra sunvAnAsyAndhaso marto na vaShTa tadvachaH | apa shvAnamarAdhasa.N hatA makhaM na bhR^igavaH
verses.translation: Of the pressing stalk — let the mortal not desire that speech; drive away the grudging dog, as the Bhrigus smote the sacrifice-spoiler.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः सोम चित्राभिरूतिभिः । अभि विश्वानि काव्या
verses.transliteration: pavasva vAcho agriyaH soma chitrAbhirUtibhiH | abhi vishvAni kAvyA
verses.translation: Flow, Soma, first of speech, with wondrous helps, to all poetry.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ समुद्रिया अपोऽग्रियो वाच ईरयन् । पवस्व विश्वचर्षणे
verses.transliteration: tva.N samudriyA apo.agriyo vAcha Irayan | pavasva vishvacharShaNe
verses.translation: You, first, rousing the oceanic waters and speech — flow, all-seeing one.

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्येमा भुवना कवे महिम्ने सोम तस्थिरे । तुभ्यं धावन्ति धेनवः
verses.transliteration: tubhyemA bhuvanA kave mahimne soma tasthire | tubhyaM dhAvanti dhenavaH
verses.translation: For you, wise one, these worlds stand in greatness, Soma; for you the cows run.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः कृधी नो यशसो जने । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि
verses.transliteration: pavasvendo vR^iShA sutaH kR^idhI no yashaso jane | vishvA apa dviSho jahi
verses.translation: Flow, drop, the bull pressed; make us famous among the people; drive away all enemies.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ते सख्ये वयँ सासह्याम पृतन्यतः । तवेन्दो द्युम्न उत्तमे
verses.transliteration: yasya te sakhye vaya.N sAsahyAma pR^itanyataH | tavendo dyumna uttame
verses.translation: In your friendship, O drop, may we overcome those who attack, in your highest splendor.

verses.sanskrit: या ते भीमान्यायुधा तिग्मानि सन्ति धूर्वणे । रक्षा समस्य नो निदः
verses.transliteration: yA te bhImAnyAyudhA tigmAni santi dhUrvaNe | rakShA samasya no nidaH
verses.translation: Your terrible, sharp weapons which exist for the destroyer — protect us from every reviler.

verses.sanskrit: वृषा सोम द्युमाँ असि वृषा देव वृषव्रतः । वृषा धर्माणि दध्रिषे
verses.transliteration: vR^iShA soma dyumA.N asi vR^iShA deva vR^iShavrataH | vR^iShA dharmANi dadhriShe
verses.translation: Soma, you are a bull, splendid; god, a bull, of bull-like works; as a bull you hold the laws.

verses.sanskrit: वृष्णस्ते वृष्ण्यँ शवो वृषा वनं वृषा सुतः । स त्वं वृषन्वृषेदसि
verses.transliteration: vR^iShNaste vR^iShNya.N shavo vR^iShA vanaM vR^iShA sutaH | sa tvaM vR^iShanvR^iShedasi
verses.translation: Of you, the bull, is the bull's vigor; the bull is the forest, the bull is pressed; you, bull, are indeed the bull.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वो न चक्रदो वृषा सं गा इन्दो समर्वतः । वि नो राये दुरो वृधि
verses.transliteration: ashvo na chakrado vR^iShA saM gA indo samarvataH | vi no rAye duro vR^idhi
verses.translation: Like a neighing horse, a bull, drop, join cattle and horses; open for us the doors to wealth.

verses.sanskrit: वृषा ह्यसि भानुना द्युमन्तं त्वा हवामहे । पवमान स्वर्दृशम्
verses.transliteration: vR^iShA hyasi bhAnunA dyumantaM tvA havAmahe | pavamAna svardR^isham
verses.translation: You are a bull by your radiance; we call you, shining one, O flowing, seer of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यदद्भिः परिशिच्यसे मर्मृज्यमान आयुभिः । द्रोणे सधस्थमश्नुषे
verses.transliteration: yadadbhiH parishichyase marmR^ijyamAna AyubhiH | droNe sadhasthamashnuShe
verses.translation: When you are sprinkled with the waters, cleansed by the Ayus, you reach the shared seat in the trough.

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व सुवीर्यं मन्दमानः स्वायुध । इहो ष्विन्दवा गहि
verses.transliteration: A pavasva suvIryaM mandamAnaH svAyudha | iho ShvindavA gahi
verses.translation: Flow to us heroic strength, joyful, well-armed; come here indeed, O drop.

verses.sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते वयं पवित्रमभ्युन्दतः । सखित्वमा वृणीमहे
verses.transliteration: pavamAnasya te vayaM pavitramabhyundataH | sakhitvamA vR^iNImahe
verses.translation: We choose friendship of you who flow, as we make the filter flow.

verses.sanskrit: ये ते पवित्रमूर्मयोऽभिक्षरन्ति धारया । तेभिर्नः सोम मृडय
verses.transliteration: ye te pavitramUrmayo.abhikSharanti dhArayA | tebhirnaH soma mR^iDaya
verses.translation: With those waves of yours that flow with a stream onto the filter, be gracious to us, Soma.

verses.sanskrit: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं वीरवतीमिषम् ईशानः सोम विश्वतः
verses.transliteration: sa naH punAna A bhara rayiM vIravatImiSham IshAnaH soma vishvataH
verses.translation: Purified, bring us wealth and heroic food, ruling on all sides, O Soma.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: agniM dUtaM vR^iNImahe hotAraM vishvavedasam | asya yaj~nasya sukratum
verses.translation: We choose Agni as messenger, the priest who knows all things, the one skilled in this sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निमग्निँ हवीमभिः सदा हवन्त विश्पतिम् । हव्यवाहं पुरुप्रियम्
verses.transliteration: agnimagni.N havImabhiH sadA havanta vishpatim | havyavAhaM purupriyam
verses.translation: They always call Agni, lord of the people, with offerings — bearer of oblations, dear to many.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने देवाँ इहा वह जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे । असि होता न ईड्यः
verses.transliteration: agne devA.N ihA vaha jaj~nAno vR^iktabarhiShe | asi hotA na IDyaH
verses.translation: O Agni, bring the gods here, born for him who spreads the grass; you are our priest, worthy of praise.

verses.sanskrit: मित्रं वयँ हवामहे वरुणँ सोमपीतये । य जाता पूतदक्षसा
verses.transliteration: mitraM vaya.N havAmahe varuNa.N somapItaye | ya jAtA pUtadakShasA
verses.translation: We call Mitra and Varuna to drink the soma, who are born of pure skill.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतेन यावृतावृधावृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पती । ता मित्रावरुणा हुवे
verses.transliteration: R^itena yAvR^itAvR^idhAvR^itasya jyotiShaspatI | tA mitrAvaruNA huve
verses.translation: By truth, you two who strengthen truth, lords of the light of truth — I call Mitra and Varuna.

verses.sanskrit: वरुणः प्राविता भुवन्मित्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । करतां नः सुराधसः
verses.transliteration: varuNaH prAvitA bhuvanmitro vishvAbhirUtibhiH | karatAM naH surAdhasaH
verses.translation: May Varuna be helper, and Mitra with all helps; make us rich in bounty.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत
verses.transliteration: indramidgAthino bR^ihadindramarkebhirarkiNaH | indraM vANIranUShata
verses.translation: The singers sing to Indra great songs; those with hymns, with hymns; the voices praised Indra.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा सम्मिश्ल आ वचोयुजा । इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः
verses.transliteration: indra iddharyoH sachA sammishla A vachoyujA | indro vajrI hiraNyayaH
verses.translation: Indra alone is united with the two bay horses, bound by speech; Indra the thunderbolt-bearer, golden.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र वाजेषु नोऽव सहस्रप्रधनेषु च । उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः
verses.transliteration: indra vAjeShu no.ava sahasrapradhaneShu cha | ugra ugrAbhirUtibhiH
verses.translation: Protect us, Indra, in contests and in thousandfold battles, O fierce one, with fierce helps.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यँ रोहयद्दिवि । वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत्
verses.transliteration: indro dIrghAya chakShasa A sUrya.N rohayaddivi | vi gobhiradrimairayat
verses.translation: Indra caused the sun to rise in heaven for long sight; he sent the mountain apart with the cows.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रे अग्ना नमो बृहत्सुवृक्तिमेरयामहे । धिया धेना अवस्यवः
verses.transliteration: indre agnA namo bR^ihatsuvR^iktimerayAmahe | dhiyA dhenA avasyavaH
verses.translation: We offer a great homage, well-praised, to Indra and Agni; with thought we seek help for our cows.

verses.sanskrit: ता हि शश्वन्त ईडत इत्था विप्रास ऊतये । सबाधो वाजसातये
verses.transliteration: tA hi shashvanta IData itthA viprAsa Utaye | sabAdho vAjasAtaye
verses.translation: For them forever the sages invoke thus for help, together, for the winning of strength.

verses.sanskrit: ता वां गीर्भिर्विपन्युवः प्रयस्वन्तो हवामहे । मेधसाता सनिष्यवः
verses.transliteration: tA vAM gIrbhirvipanyuvaH prayasvanto havAmahe | medhasAtA saniShyavaH
verses.translation: We, praisers, with songs, offering food, call you two, bringers of wisdom, desiring to win.

verses.sanskrit: वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः । दिश्वा दधान ओजसा
verses.transliteration: vR^iShA pavasva dhArayA marutvate cha matsaraH | dishvA dadhAna ojasA
verses.translation: Flow as a bull with the stream, joyful for the Maruts too, bearing all with strength.

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा धर्त्तारमोण्यो३ः पवमान स्वर्दृशम् । हिन्वे वाजेषु वाजिनम्
verses.transliteration: taM tvA dharttAramoNyo3H pavamAna svardR^isham | hinve vAjeShu vAjinam
verses.translation: You, the upholder, flowing, seer of heaven, I urge on in battles, the strong one.

verses.sanskrit: अया चित्तो विपानया हरिः पवस्व धारया । युजं वाजेषु चोदय
verses.transliteration: ayA chitto vipAnayA hariH pavasva dhArayA | yujaM vAjeShu chodaya
verses.translation: With this thought, bay one, flow with the drinking stream; urge on your fellow in battles.

verses.sanskrit: वृषा शोणो अभिकनिक्रदद्गा नदयन्नेषि पृथिवीमुत द्याम् । इन्द्रस्येव वग्नुरा शृण्व आजौ प्रचोदयन्नर्षसि वाचमेमाम्
verses.transliteration: vR^iShA shoNo abhikanikradadgA nadayanneShi pR^ithivImuta dyAm | indrasyeva vagnurA shR^iNva Ajau prachodayannarShasi vAchamemAm
verses.translation: The red bull, roaring toward the cows, you go sounding through earth and heaven; like Indra's call heard in the contest, you send forth this word.

verses.sanskrit: रसाय्यः पयसा पिन्वमान ईरयन्नेषि मधुमन्तमँशुम् । पवमान सन्तनिमेषि कृण्वन्निन्द्राय सोम परिषिच्यमानः
verses.transliteration: rasAyyaH payasA pinvamAna IrayanneShi madhumantama.Nshum | pavamAna santanimeShi kR^iNvannindrAya soma pariShichyamAnaH
verses.translation: Swelling with milk, delightful, you go, stirring the honeyed stalk; flowing, you go making continuity, sprinkled around for Indra, Soma.

verses.sanskrit: एवा पवस्व मदिरो मदायोदग्राभस्य नमयन्वधस्नुम् । परि वर्णं भरमाणो रुशन्तं गव्युर्नो अर्ष परि सोम सिक्तः
verses.transliteration: evA pavasva madiro madAyodagrAbhasya namayanvadhasnum | pari varNaM bharamANo rushantaM gavyurno arSha pari soma siktaH
verses.translation: So flow, joyful, for exhilaration, bowing the slayer of the one with raised grasp; bearing a shining hue, desiring cattle, flow around us, sprinkled, Soma.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामिद्धि हवामहे सातौ वाजस्य कारवः । त्वां वृत्रेष्विन्द्र सत्पतिं नरस्त्वां काष्ठास्वर्वतः
verses.transliteration: tvAmiddhi havAmahe sAtau vAjasya kAravaH | tvAM vR^itreShvindra satpatiM narastvAM kAShThAsvarvataH
verses.translation: We singers call on you alone in the winning of strength; you, Indra, lord of the good among Vritras; men call on you, as racers at the goals.

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं नश्चित्र वज्रहस्त धृष्णुया मह स्तवानो अद्रिवः । गामश्वँ रथ्यमिन्द्र सं किर सत्रा वाजं न जिग्युषे
verses.transliteration: sa tvaM nashchitra vajrahasta dhR^iShNuyA maha stavAno adrivaH | gAmashva.N rathyamindra saM kira satrA vAjaM na jigyuShe
verses.translation: You, wondrous, thunderbolt-handed, great, praised, O stone-bearer — scatter for us cows, horses and chariots, Indra, as strength to a winner.

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति
verses.transliteration: abhi pra vaH surAdhasamindramarcha yathA vide | yo jaritR^ibhyo maghavA purUvasuH sahasreNeva shikShati
verses.translation: Praise Indra, bounteous, as one who knows, who gives to singers, rich in wealth, giving as if by thousands.

verses.sanskrit: शतानीकेव प्र जिगाति धृष्णुया हन्ति वृत्राणि दाशुषे । गिरेरिव प्र रसा अस्य पिन्विरे दत्राणि पुरुभोजसः
verses.transliteration: shatAnIkeva pra jigAti dhR^iShNuyA hanti vR^itrANi dAshuShe | gireriva pra rasA asya pinvire datrANi purubhojasaH
verses.translation: He goes boldly forth like a hundred-fold host; he slays Vritras for the giver; his streams swell like those of a mountain, the gifts of the much-nourishing.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः । स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहस इह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि
verses.transliteration: tvAmidA hyo naro.apIpyanvajrinbhUrNayaH | sa indra stomavAhasa iha shrudhyupa svasaramA gahi
verses.translation: Men, the nourishing, swelled you yesterday, thunderbolt-bearer; you, O Indra, bearer of hymns, hear here and come to the dwelling.

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्वा सुशिप्रिन्हरिवस्तमीमहे त्वया भूषन्ति वेधसः । तव श्रवाँस्युपमान्युक्थ्य सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः
verses.transliteration: matsvA sushiprinharivastamImahe tvayA bhUShanti vedhasaH | tava shravA.NsyupamAnyukthya suteShvindra girvaNaH
verses.translation: Rejoice, O fair-jawed, bay-horsed one; we ask of you; through you the ordainers are adorned; your praiseworthy glories are comparable, O lover of songs, at the pressings, Indra.

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा । देवावीरघशँसहा
verses.transliteration: yaste mado vareNyastenA pavasvAndhasA | devAvIraghasha.NsahA
verses.translation: By the choicest exhilaration of yours, flow with the drink, guardian of the gods, slayer of the evil-speaking.

verses.sanskrit: जघ्निर्वृत्रममित्रियँ सस्निर्वाजं दिवेदिवे । गोषातिरश्वसा असि
verses.transliteration: jaghnirvR^itramamitriya.N sasnirvAjaM divedive | goShAtirashvasA asi
verses.translation: Slayer of the hostile Vritra, winner of strength day by day, you are the giver of cattle and horses.

verses.sanskrit: सम्मिश्लो अरुषो भुवः सूपस्थाभिर्न धेनुभि । सीदं च्छ्येनो न योनिमा
verses.transliteration: sammishlo aruSho bhuvaH sUpasthAbhirna dhenubhi | sIdaM chChyeno na yonimA
verses.translation: Be mixed, red one, like cows with good udders; settling like a falcon into its nest.

verses.sanskrit: अयं पूषा रयिर्भगः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । पतिर्विश्वस्य भूमनो व्यख्यद्रोदसी उभे
verses.transliteration: ayaM pUShA rayirbhagaH somaH punAno arShati | patirvishvasya bhUmano vyakhyadrodasI ubhe
verses.translation: This Pushan, wealth, Bhaga, Soma, flows purifying; lord of all abundance, he has lit up both worlds.

verses.sanskrit: समु प्रिया अनूषत गावो मदाय घृष्वयः । सोमासः कृण्वते पथः पवमानास इन्दवः
verses.transliteration: samu priyA anUShata gAvo madAya ghR^iShvayaH | somAsaH kR^iNvate pathaH pavamAnAsa indavaH
verses.translation: The cows, the bold ones, have sung together for exhilaration; the flowing drops of soma make paths.

verses.sanskrit: य ओजिष्ठस्तमा भर पवमान श्रवाय्यम् । यः पञ्च चर्षणीरभि रयिं येन वनामहे
verses.transliteration: ya ojiShThastamA bhara pavamAna shravAyyam | yaH pa~ncha charShaNIrabhi rayiM yena vanAmahe
verses.translation: Bring, flowing one, the most vigorous, famed wealth, which overcomes the five peoples, by which we may win.

verses.sanskrit: वृषा मतीनां पवते विचक्षणः सोमो अह्नां प्रतरीतोषसां दिवः । प्राणा सिन्धूनां कलशाँ अचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन्मनीषिभिः
verses.transliteration: vR^iShA matInAM pavate vichakShaNaH somo ahnAM pratarItoShasAM divaH | prANA sindhUnAM kalashA.N achikradadindrasya hArdyAvishanmanIShibhiH
verses.translation: The bull of thoughts flows, the seer, Soma, the day-crosser of dawns and heaven; he roared in the vessels at the breath of the rivers, entering Indra's heart with the wise.

verses.sanskrit: मनीषिभिः पवते पूर्व्यः कविर्नृभिर्यतः परि कोशाँ असिष्यदत् । त्रितस्य नाम जनयन्मधु क्षरन्निन्द्रस्य वायूँ सख्याय वर्धयन्
verses.transliteration: manIShibhiH pavate pUrvyaH kavirnR^ibhiryataH pari koshA.N asiShyadat | tritasya nAma janayanmadhu kSharannindrasya vAyU.N sakhyAya vardhayan
verses.translation: The ancient seer flows with the wise, held by men, and has run round the vessels; creating the name of Trita, dripping honey, he increases Indra and Vayu for friendship.

verses.sanskrit: अयं पुनान उषसो अरोचयदयँ सिन्धुभ्यो अभवदु लोककृत् । अयं त्रिः सप्त दुदुहान आशिरँ सोमो हृदे पवते चारु मत्सरः
verses.transliteration: ayaM punAna uShaso arochayadaya.N sindhubhyo abhavadu lokakR^it | ayaM triH sapta duduhAna Ashira.N somo hR^ide pavate chAru matsaraH
verses.translation: This one, purifying, made the dawns shine; this one became a world-maker for the rivers; milking thrice seven mixtures, Soma flows, a lovely exhilaration for the heart.

verses.sanskrit: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरह् । एवा ते राध्यं मनः
verses.transliteration: evA hyasi vIrayurevA shUra uta sthirah | evA te rAdhyaM manaH
verses.translation: So indeed you are hero-loving, so brave and steady; so your mind is to be won.

verses.sanskrit: एवा रातिस्तुवीमघ विश्वेभिर्धायि धातृभिः । अधा चिदिन्द्र नः सचा
verses.transliteration: evA rAtistuvImagha vishvebhirdhAyi dhAtR^ibhiH | adhA chidindra naH sachA
verses.translation: So is your gift, O much-bountiful, set by all supporters; then, Indra, be with us.

verses.sanskrit: मो षु ब्रह्मेव तदिन्द्रयुर्भुवो वाजानां पते । मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः
verses.transliteration: mo Shu brahmeva tadindrayurbhuvo vAjAnAM pate | matsvA sutasya gomataH
verses.translation: Do not, like the prayer, be Indra's own, O lord of strengths; rejoice in the pressed soma with cattle.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः । रथीतमँ रथीनां वाजानाँ सत्पतिं पतिम्
verses.transliteration: indraM vishvA avIvR^idhantsamudravyachasaM giraH | rathItama.N rathInAM vAjAnA.N satpatiM patim
verses.translation: The songs have strengthened Indra, who is wide as the ocean, the best of charioteers, lord of strengths, lord of the good.

verses.sanskrit: सख्ये त इन्द्र वाजिनो मा भेम शवसस्पते । त्वामभि प्र नोनुमो जेतारमपराजितम्
verses.transliteration: sakhye ta indra vAjino mA bhema shavasaspate | tvAmabhi pra nonumo jetAramaparAjitam
verses.translation: In your friendship, Indra, we strong ones fear not, lord of strength; we praise you, victorious and unconquered.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वीरिन्द्रस्य रातयो न वि दस्यन्त्यूतयः । यदा वाजस्य गोमत स्तोतृभ्यो मँहते मघम्
verses.transliteration: pUrvIrindrasya rAtayo na vi dasyantyUtayaH | yadA vAjasya gomata stotR^ibhyo ma.Nhate magham
verses.translation: The many gifts of Indra, his helps, are not lost, when he bestows bounty of strength with cattle upon singers.

verses.sanskrit: एत असृग्रमिन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः । विश्वान्यभि सौभगा
verses.transliteration: eta asR^igramindavastiraH pavitramAshavaH | vishvAnyabhi saubhagA
verses.translation: These drops have been released, swift, across the filter, to all good fortunes.

verses.sanskrit: विघ्नन्तो दुरिता पुरु सुगा तोकाय वाजिनः । त्मना कृण्वन्तो अर्वतः
verses.transliteration: vighnanto duritA puru sugA tokAya vAjinaH | tmanA kR^iNvanto arvataH
verses.translation: Driving away many evils, the strong give good paths for offspring, making the horses by themselves.

verses.sanskrit: कृण्वन्तो वरिवो गवेऽभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिम् । इडामस्मभ्यँ संयतम्
verses.transliteration: kR^iNvanto varivo gave.abhyarShanti suShTutim | iDAmasmabhya.N saMyatam
verses.translation: Making room for the cow, they flow toward fair praise, for us a regulated Ida.

verses.sanskrit: राजा मेधाभिरीयते पवमानो मनावधि । अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे
verses.transliteration: rAjA medhAbhirIyate pavamAno manAvadhi | antarikSheNa yAtave
verses.translation: The king goes with wisdom, flowing over Manu, to travel through the air.

verses.sanskrit: आ नः सोम सहो जुवो रूपं न वर्चसे भर । सुष्वाणो देववीतये
verses.transliteration: A naH soma saho juvo rUpaM na varchase bhara | suShvANo devavItaye
verses.translation: O Soma, bring us strength, speedy, like a form for splendor; as you are pressed for the gods' feast.

verses.sanskrit: आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं गवां पोषँ स्वश्व्यम् । वहा भगत्तिमूतये
verses.transliteration: A na indo shatagvinaM gavAM poSha.N svashvyam | vahA bhagattimUtaye
verses.translation: Bring us, O drop, hundredfold cattle, nourishment with good horses; carry fortune for help.

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा नृम्णानि बिभ्रतँ सधस्थेषु महो दिवः । चारुँ सुकृत्ययेमहे
verses.transliteration: taM tvA nR^imNAni bibhrata.N sadhastheShu maho divaH | chAru.N sukR^ityayemahe
verses.translation: With good deeds we praise you, bearing manly treasures in the seats of great heaven, lovely.

verses.sanskrit: संवृक्तधृष्णुमुक्थ्यं महामहिव्रतं मदम् । शतं पुरो रुरुक्षणिम्
verses.transliteration: saMvR^iktadhR^iShNumukthyaM mahAmahivrataM madam | shataM puro rurukShaNim
verses.translation: The hymn-worthy, bold-grasping, great of great vows, exhilaration, breaker of a hundred forts.

verses.sanskrit: अतस्त्वा रयिरभ्ययद्राजानँ सुक्रतो दिवः । सुपर्णो अव्यथी भरत्
verses.transliteration: atastvA rayirabhyayadrAjAna.N sukrato divaH | suparNo avyathI bharat
verses.translation: From you wealth has come to the king, O skilful, from heaven; the fair-winged unfaltering has brought it.

verses.sanskrit: अधा हिन्वान इन्द्रियं ज्यायो महित्वमानशे । अभिष्टिकृद्विचर्षणिः
verses.transliteration: adhA hinvAna indriyaM jyAyo mahitvamAnashe | abhiShTikR^idvicharShaNiH
verses.translation: Then, urged on, he has gained greater power and greatness; the all-seeing fulfiller of wishes.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वस्मा इत्स्वर्दृशे साधारणँ रजस्तुरम् । गोपामृतस्य विर्भरत्
verses.transliteration: vishvasmA itsvardR^ishe sAdhAraNa.N rajasturam | gopAmR^itasya virbharat
verses.translation: To the whole world, to see the light, the common, space-crossing guardian of truth bears.

verses.sanskrit: इषे पवस्व धारया मृज्यमानो मनीषिभिः । इन्दो रुचाभि गा इहि
verses.transliteration: iShe pavasva dhArayA mR^ijyamAno manIShibhiH | indo ruchAbhi gA ihi
verses.translation: Flow for strength with the stream, adorned by the wise; O drop, come with light to the cows.

verses.sanskrit: पुनानो वरिवस्कृध्यूर्जं जनाय गिर्वणः । हरे सृजान आशिरम्
verses.transliteration: punAno varivaskR^idhyUrjaM janAya girvaNaH | hare sR^ijAna Ashiram
verses.translation: Purifying, make room, O lover of songs, bring strength to the people, O bay one, as you are released with the milk-mixture.

verses.sanskrit: पुनानो देववीतय इन्द्रस्य याहि निष्कृतम् । द्युतानो वाजिभिर्हितः
verses.transliteration: punAno devavItaya indrasya yAhi niShkR^itam | dyutAno vAjibhirhitaH
verses.translation: Purifying, go to the gods' feast, to the appointed place of Indra, shining, set by the racers.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा । हव्यवाड्जुह्वास्यः
verses.transliteration: agninAgniH samidhyate kavirgR^ihapatiryuvA | havyavADjuhvAsyaH
verses.translation: By Agni is Agni kindled, the seer, lord of the house, the youth, carrier of offering, whose mouth is the ladle.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त्वामग्ने हविष्पतिर्दूतं देव सपर्यति । तस्य स्म प्राविता भव
verses.transliteration: yastvAmagne haviShpatirdUtaM deva saparyati | tasya sma prAvitA bhava
verses.translation: O god Agni, the lord of offerings who honors you, the messenger — be his helper.

verses.sanskrit: यो अग्निं देववीतये हविष्माँ आविवासति । तस्मै पावक मृडय
verses.transliteration: yo agniM devavItaye haviShmA.N AvivAsati | tasmai pAvaka mR^iDaya
verses.translation: To him who, with offering, serves Agni for the gods' feast, be kind, O purifier.

verses.sanskrit: मित्रँ हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसम् । धियं घृताचीँ साधन्ता
verses.transliteration: mitra.N huve pUtadakShaM varuNaM cha rishAdasam | dhiyaM ghR^itAchI.N sAdhantA
verses.translation: I call Mitra of pure skill and Varuna the devourer of foes, who fulfill the ghee-dripping thought.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतेन मित्रावरुणावृतावृधावृतस्पृशा । क्रतुं बृहन्तमाशाथे
verses.transliteration: R^itena mitrAvaruNAvR^itAvR^idhAvR^itaspR^ishA | kratuM bR^ihantamAshAthe
verses.translation: By truth, Mitra and Varuna, strengtheners of truth, touching truth, you attained great skill.

verses.sanskrit: कवी नो मित्रावरुणा तुविजाता उरुक्षया । दक्षं दधाते अपसम्
verses.transliteration: kavI no mitrAvaruNA tuvijAtA urukShayA | dakShaM dadhAte apasam
verses.translation: Mitra and Varuna, our seers, born in many, widely dwelling, give skillful work.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रेण सँ हि दृक्षसे सञ्जग्मानो अबिभ्युषा । मन्दू समानवर्च्चसा
verses.transliteration: indreNa sa.N hi dR^ikShase sa~njagmAno abibhyuShA | mandU samAnavarchchasA
verses.translation: You are seen together with fearless Indra, joyful, with the same radiance.

verses.sanskrit: आदह स्वधामनु पुनर्गर्भत्वमेरिरे । दधाना नाम यज्ञियम्
verses.transliteration: Adaha svadhAmanu punargarbhatvamerire | dadhAnA nAma yaj~niyam
verses.translation: Then, by their own way, they again took on the state of embryo, bearing a sacrificial name.

verses.sanskrit: वीडु चिदारुजत्नुभिर्गुहा चिदिन्द्र वह्निभिः । अविन्द उस्रिया अनु
verses.transliteration: vIDu chidArujatnubhirguhA chidindra vahnibhiH | avinda usriyA anu
verses.translation: You found the cows firmly, even in the hidden place, with the carriers, Indra, with the strong.

verses.sanskrit: ता हुवे ययोरिदं पप्ने विश्वं पुरा कृतम् । इन्द्राग्नी न मर्धतः
verses.transliteration: tA huve yayoridaM papne vishvaM purA kR^itam | indrAgnI na mardhataH
verses.translation: I call on those two by whom all this was made of old; Indra and Agni are not harmed.

verses.sanskrit: उग्रा विघनिना मृध इन्द्राग्नी हवामहे । ता नो मृडात ईदृशे
verses.transliteration: ugrA vighaninA mR^idha indrAgnI havAmahe | tA no mR^iDAta IdR^ishe
verses.translation: We call Indra and Agni, fierce, smiting the enemies; may they be gracious to us in such a case.

verses.sanskrit: हथो वृत्राण्यार्या हथो दासानि सत्पती । हथो विश्वा अप द्विषः
verses.transliteration: hatho vR^itrANyAryA hatho dAsAni satpatI | hatho vishvA apa dviShaH
verses.translation: You slew the Aryan enemies, you slew the Dasa ones, lords of the good; you slew all hatreds.

verses.sanskrit: अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् । समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपे मनीषिणो मत्सरासो मदच्युतः
verses.transliteration: abhi somAsa AyavaH pavante madyaM madam | samudrasyAdhi viShTape manIShiNo matsarAso madachyutaH
verses.translation: The somas flow of the Ayus toward the joyful exhilaration, on the summit of the ocean; the wise, joyful, exhilaration-dropping.

verses.sanskrit: तरत्समुद्रं पवमान ऊर्मिणा राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् । अर्षा मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धर्मणा प्र हिन्वान ऋतं बृहत्
verses.transliteration: taratsamudraM pavamAna UrmiNA rAjA deva R^itaM bR^ihat | arShA mitrasya varuNasya dharmaNA pra hinvAna R^itaM bR^ihat
verses.translation: The flowing king, the god, crosses the sea with a wave, the great truth; flow by the law of Mitra and Varuna, urging the great truth.

verses.sanskrit: नृभिर्येमाणो हर्यतो विचक्षणो राजा देवः समुद्र्यः
verses.transliteration: nR^ibhiryemANo haryato vichakShaNo rAjA devaH samudryaH
verses.translation: Held by men, desirable, all-seeing, king, god of the sea.

verses.sanskrit: तिस्रो वाच ईरयति प्र वह्निरृतस्य धीतिं ब्रह्मणो मनीषाम् । गावो यन्ति गोपतिं पृच्छमानाः सोमं यन्ति मतयो वावशानाः
verses.transliteration: tisro vAcha Irayati pra vahnirR^itasya dhItiM brahmaNo manIShAm | gAvo yanti gopatiM pR^ichChamAnAH somaM yanti matayo vAvashAnAH
verses.translation: The carrier sends forth three speeches, the thought of truth, the wisdom of prayer; the cows go asking the lord of cattle; the prayers go to Soma, longing.

verses.sanskrit: सोमं गावो धेनवो वावशानाः सोमं विप्रा मतिभिः पृच्छमानाः । सोमः सुत ऋच्यते पूयमानः सोमे अर्कास्त्रिष्टुभः सं नवन्ते
verses.transliteration: somaM gAvo dhenavo vAvashAnAH somaM viprA matibhiH pR^ichChamAnAH | somaH suta R^ichyate pUyamAnaH some arkAstriShTubhaH saM navante
verses.translation: The cows and milch-cows long for Soma; the sages with thoughts ask for Soma; Soma, pressed, is praised, being purified; in Soma the hymns, the Trishtubhs, resound.

verses.sanskrit: एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमान आ पवस्व पूयमानः स्वस्ति । इन्द्रमा विश बृहता मदेन वर्धया वाचं जनया पुरन्धिम्
verses.transliteration: evA naH soma pariShichyamAna A pavasva pUyamAnaH svasti | indramA visha bR^ihatA madena vardhayA vAchaM janayA purandhim
verses.translation: So, Soma, being sprinkled, flow to us purified, with well-being; enter Indra with great exhilaration; strengthen speech, beget plenty.

verses.sanskrit: यद्द्याव इन्द्र ते शतँशतं भूमीरुत स्युः । न त्वा वज्रिन्त्सहस्रँ सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी
verses.transliteration: yaddyAva indra te shata.NshataM bhUmIruta syuH | na tvA vajrintsahasra.N sUryA anu na jAtamaShTa rodasI
verses.translation: Though a hundred heavens and a hundred earths were yours, Indra, a thousand suns would not equal you, O thunderbolt-bearer; the two worlds do not encompass you at birth.

verses.sanskrit: आ पप्राथ महिना वृष्ण्या वृषन्विश्वा शविष्ठ शवसा । अस्माँ अव मघवन्गोमति व्रजे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः
verses.transliteration: A paprAtha mahinA vR^iShNyA vR^iShanvishvA shaviShTha shavasA | asmA.N ava maghavangomati vraje vajri~nchitrAbhirUtibhiH
verses.translation: You, bull, have filled all with your manly greatness, O strongest; protect us, bounteous, in the cow-pen, thunderbolt-bearer, with wondrous helps.

verses.sanskrit: वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः । पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते
verses.transliteration: vayaM gha tvA sutAvanta Apo na vR^iktabarhiShaH | pavitrasya prasravaNeShu vR^itrahanpari stotAra Asate
verses.translation: We who have pressed the soma for you, Vritra-slayer, and spread the grass, sit around the streams of the filter, as the waters.

verses.sanskrit: स्वरन्ति त्वा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः । कदा सुतं तृषाण ओक आ गम इन्द्र स्वब्दीव वँसगः
verses.transliteration: svaranti tvA sute naro vaso nireka ukthinaH | kadA sutaM tR^iShANa oka A gama indra svabdIva va.NsagaH
verses.translation: The men sing to you at the pressing, O Vasu, in solitude, with hymns; when, thirsty, will you come to the pressed soma, to the house, Indra, like a bull to the cow.

verses.sanskrit: कण्वेभिर्धृष्णवा धृषद्वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणम् । पिशङ्गरूपं मघवन्विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे
verses.transliteration: kaNvebhirdhR^iShNavA dhR^iShadvAjaM darShi sahasriNam | pisha~NgarUpaM maghavanvicharShaNe makShU gomantamImahe
verses.translation: With the Kanvas, bold one, you give boldly a thousandfold strength; O bounteous, all-seeing, tawny-formed, we swiftly ask for cattle-rich wealth.

verses.sanskrit: तरणिरित्सिषासति वाजं पुरन्ध्या युजा । आ व इन्द्रं पुरुहूतं नमे गिरा नेमिं तष्टेव सुद्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: taraNiritsiShAsati vAjaM purandhyA yujA | A va indraM puruhUtaM name girA nemiM taShTeva sudruvam
verses.translation: The swift one desires strength with his yoked fullness; with song I bow to Indra, invoked by many, as a carpenter to a well-running wheel-rim.

verses.sanskrit: न दुष्टुतिर्द्रविणोदेषु शस्यते न स्रेधन्तँ रयिर्नशत् । सुशक्तिरिन्मघवं तुभ्यं मावते देष्णं यत्पार्ये दिवि
verses.transliteration: na duShTutirdraviNodeShu shasyate na sredhanta.N rayirnashat | sushaktirinmaghavaM tubhyaM mAvate deShNaM yatpArye divi
verses.translation: Ill praise is not spoken among the givers of wealth; wealth does not reach the unyielding; good power, bounteous, belongs to you, to give to one like me, which is in the farther heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः । हरिरेति कनिक्रदत्
verses.transliteration: tisro vAcha udIrate gAvo mimanti dhenavaH | harireti kanikradat
verses.translation: Three speeches arise; the cows low; the bay-colored one goes roaring.

verses.sanskrit: अभि ब्रह्मीरनूषत यह्वीरृतस्य मातरः । मर्जयन्तीर्दिवः शिशुम्
verses.transliteration: abhi brahmIranUShata yahvIrR^itasya mAtaraH | marjayantIrdivaH shishum
verses.translation: The great mothers of truth have sung, adorning the child of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: रायः समुद्राँश्चतुरोऽस्मभ्यँ सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणः
verses.transliteration: rAyaH samudrA.Nshchaturo.asmabhya.N soma vishvataH | A pavasva sahasriNaH
verses.translation: Four oceans of wealth for us from all sides, Soma; flow to us a thousandfold.

verses.sanskrit: सुतासो मधुमत्तमाः सोमा इन्द्राय मन्दिनः । पवित्रवन्तो अक्षरं देवान्गच्छन्तु वो मदाः
verses.transliteration: sutAso madhumattamAH somA indrAya mandinaH | pavitravanto akSharaM devAngachChantu vo madAH
verses.translation: The pressed, most honeyed, exhilarating somas for Indra have flowed with the filter; may your exhilarations go to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: इन्दुरिन्द्राय पवत इति देवासो अब्रुवन् । वाचस्पतिर्मखस्यते विश्वस्येशान ओजसाः
verses.transliteration: indurindrAya pavata iti devAso abruvan | vAchaspatirmakhasyate vishvasyeshAna ojasAH
verses.translation: "The drop flows for Indra," said the gods; the lord of speech, master of the rite, ruler of all by might.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रधारः पवते समुद्रो वाचमीङ्खयः । सोमस्पती रयीणाँ सखेन्द्रस्य दिवेदिवे
verses.transliteration: sahasradhAraH pavate samudro vAchamI~NkhayaH | somaspatI rayINA.N sakhendrasya divedive
verses.translation: The thousand-streamed ocean flows, rousing speech; lord of Soma, of riches, friend of Indra day by day.

verses.sanskrit: पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते प्रभुर्गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः । अतप्ततनूर्न तदामो अश्नुते शृतास इद्वहन्तः सं तदाशत
verses.transliteration: pavitraM te vitataM brahmaNaspate prabhurgAtrANi paryeShi vishvataH | ataptatanUrna tadAmo ashnute shR^itAsa idvahantaH saM tadAshata
verses.translation: Your filter is spread out, O lord of prayer; the mighty one, you pervade all the limbs on every side; the unheated body does not attain it; only the cooked, carrying, reach it together.

verses.sanskrit: तपोष्पवित्रं विततं दिवस्पदेऽर्चन्तो अस्य तन्तवो व्यस्थिरन् । अवन्त्यस्य पवीतारमाशवो दिवः पृष्ठमधि रोहन्ति तेजसा
verses.transliteration: tapoShpavitraM vitataM divaspade.archanto asya tantavo vyasthiran | avantyasya pavItAramAshavo divaH pR^iShThamadhi rohanti tejasA
verses.translation: The filter of heat is spread in heaven's place; his threads worship and stand apart; the swift ones protect his purifier; they climb the back of heaven with fire.

verses.sanskrit: अरूरुचदुषसः पृश्निरग्रिय उक्षा मिमेति भुवनेषु वाजयुः । मायाविनो ममिरे अस्य मायया नृचक्षसः पितरो गर्भमा दधुः
verses.transliteration: arUruchaduShasaH pR^ishniragriya ukShA mimeti bhuvaneShu vAjayuH | mAyAvino mamire asya mAyayA nR^ichakShasaH pitaro garbhamA dadhuH
verses.translation: The foremost dappled one made the dawns shine; the bull measures out in the worlds, seeking strength; the magicians measured by his magic; the fathers, seeing men, placed the embryo.

verses.sanskrit: प्र मँहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे । उपस्तुतासो अग्नये
verses.transliteration: pra ma.NhiShThAya gAyata R^itAvne bR^ihate shukrashochiShe | upastutAso agnaye
verses.translation: Sing to the greatest, to Agni, keeper of truth, mighty, with bright flame, praised from near.

verses.sanskrit: आ वँसते मघवा वीरवद्यशः समिद्धो द्युम्न्याहुतः । कुविन्नो अस्य सुमतिर्भवीयस्यच्छा वाजेभिरागमत्
verses.transliteration: A va.Nsate maghavA vIravadyashaH samiddho dyumnyAhutaH | kuvinno asya sumatirbhavIyasyachChA vAjebhirAgamat
verses.translation: The bounteous one clothes himself with heroic fame, kindled, shining, well offered; may his favor to us be ever greater; may he come with strengths.

verses.sanskrit: तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृक्षु सासहिम् । उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम्
verses.transliteration: taM te madaM gR^iNImasi vR^iShaNaM pR^ikShu sAsahim | u lokakR^itnumadrivo harishriyam
verses.translation: We praise that exhilaration of yours, the bull, victorious in battle, O stone-bearer, the world-maker, the beauty of the bay horses.

verses.sanskrit: येन ज्योतीँष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ । मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि
verses.transliteration: yena jyotI.NShyAyave manave cha viveditha | mandAno asya barhiSho vi rAjasi
verses.translation: By which you found lights for the Ayu and for Manu, rejoicing, you shine over his grass.

verses.sanskrit: तदद्या चित्त उक्थिनोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा । वृषपत्नीरपो जया दिवेदिवे
verses.transliteration: tadadyA chitta ukthino.anu ShTuvanti pUrvathA | vR^iShapatnIrapo jayA divedive
verses.translation: Today too the singers praise that of yours as before; win the bull-husbanded waters day by day.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति । सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महाँ असि
verses.transliteration: shrudhI havaM tirashchyA indra yastvA saparyati | suvIryasya gomato rAyaspUrdhi mahA.N asi
verses.translation: Hear the call of him, Indra, who worships you crookedly; fill us with heroic wealth and cattle; you are great.

verses.sanskrit: यस्त इन्द्र नवीयसीं गिरं मन्द्रामजीजनत् । चिकित्विन्मनसं धियं प्रत्नामृतस्य पिप्युषीम्
verses.transliteration: yasta indra navIyasIM giraM mandrAmajIjanat | chikitvinmanasaM dhiyaM pratnAmR^itasya pipyuShIm
verses.translation: Indra, whoever has brought forth for you the newest, joyful song, a wise thought, swelling the ancient of truth.

verses.sanskrit: तमु ष्टवाम यं गिर इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः । पुरूण्यस्य नौँस्या सिषासन्तो वनामहे
verses.transliteration: tamu ShTavAma yaM gira indramukthAni vAvR^idhuH | purUNyasya nau.NsyA siShAsanto vanAmahe
verses.translation: We praise him whom songs and hymns have strengthened, Indra; desiring to win many of his boats, we seek.

verses.sanskrit: प्र त आश्विनीः पवमान धेनवो दिव्या असृग्रन्पयसा धरीमणि । प्रान्तरिक्षात्स्थाविरीस्ते असृक्षत ये त्वा मृजन्त्यृषिषाण वेधसः
verses.transliteration: pra ta AshvinIH pavamAna dhenavo divyA asR^igranpayasA dharImaNi | prAntarikShAtsthAvirIste asR^ikShata ye tvA mR^ijantyR^iShiShANa vedhasaH
verses.translation: O flowing one, your Ashvini cows, the divine, have been released with milk to the holder; from the air your steadfast ones have been released, who adorn you, O creators of sages.

verses.sanskrit: उभयतः पवमानस्य रश्मयो ध्रुवस्य सतः परि यन्ति केतवः । यदी पवित्रे अधि मृज्यते हरिः सत्ता नि योनौ कलशेषु सीदति
verses.transliteration: ubhayataH pavamAnasya rashmayo dhruvasya sataH pari yanti ketavaH | yadI pavitre adhi mR^ijyate hariH sattA ni yonau kalasheShu sIdati
verses.translation: On both sides the rays of the flowing, the banners of the firm one, go around; when the bay one is cleansed on the filter, he sits settled in the nest, in the vessels.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वा धामानि विश्वचक्ष ऋभ्वसः प्रभोष्टे सतः परि यन्ति केतवः । व्यानशी पवसे सोम धर्मणा पतिर्विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि
verses.transliteration: vishvA dhAmAni vishvachakSha R^ibhvasaH prabhoShTe sataH pari yanti ketavaH | vyAnashI pavase soma dharmaNA patirvishvasya bhuvanasya rAjasi
verses.translation: All abodes, all-seeing; the banners of you, the skilful lord, go around you; you pervade, flow, Soma, by law; you are lord of all the worlds and reign.

verses.sanskrit: पवमानो अजीजनद्दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुम् । ज्योतिर्वैश्वानरं बृहत्
verses.transliteration: pavamAno ajIjanaddivashchitraM na tanyatum | jyotirvaishvAnaraM bR^ihat
verses.translation: The purifying one begot the wondrous thunder from heaven — the great light of Vaishvanara.

verses.sanskrit: पवमान रसस्तव मदो राजन्नदुच्छुनः । वि वारमव्यमर्षति
verses.transliteration: pavamAna rasastava mado rAjannaduchChunaH | vi vAramavyamarShati
verses.translation: O flowing king, your essence is exhilarating, free from distress; it runs to the woolen sieve.

verses.sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते रसो दक्षो वि राजति द्युमान् । ज्योतिर्विश्वँ स्वर्दृशे
verses.transliteration: pavamAnasya te raso dakSho vi rAjati dyumAn | jyotirvishva.N svardR^ishe
verses.translation: The essence of you, flowing one, shines skilful and radiant, light for the whole world to see.

verses.sanskrit: प्र यद्गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः । घ्नन्तः कृष्णामप त्वचम्
verses.transliteration: pra yadgAvo na bhUrNayastveShA ayAso akramuH | ghnantaH kR^iShNAmapa tvacham
verses.translation: When the radiant ones, like cattle, have gone swiftly, smiting the black skin.

verses.sanskrit: सुवितस्य मनामहेऽति सेतुं दुराय्यम् । साह्याम दस्युमव्रतम्
verses.transliteration: suvitasya manAmahe.ati setuM durAyyam | sAhyAma dasyumavratam
verses.translation: We think of the well-gone bridge, hard to cross; may we overcome the lawless Dasyu.

verses.sanskrit: शृण्वे वृष्टेरिव स्वनः पवमानस्य शुष्मिणः । चरन्ति विद्युतो दिवि
verses.transliteration: shR^iNve vR^iShTeriva svanaH pavamAnasya shuShmiNaH | charanti vidyuto divi
verses.translation: The sound of the strong flowing one is heard like that of rain; lightnings move in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व महीमिषं गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् । अश्ववत्सोम वीरवत्
verses.transliteration: A pavasva mahImiShaM gomadindo hiraNyavat | ashvavatsoma vIravat
verses.translation: Flow to us great food, drop, with cattle and gold, with horses, Soma, with heroes.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व विश्वचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पृण । उषाः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः
verses.transliteration: pavasva vishvacharShaNa A mahI rodasI pR^iNa | uShAH sUryo na rashmibhiH
verses.translation: Flow, all-seeing; fill the great heaven and earth, like Dawn, like the Sun with rays.

verses.sanskrit: परि नः शर्मयन्त्या धारया सोम विश्वतः । सरा रसेव विष्टपम्
verses.transliteration: pari naH sharmayantyA dhArayA soma vishvataH | sarA raseva viShTapam
verses.translation: Flow around us on all sides with the sheltering stream, Soma, like a moving essence the dwelling.

verses.sanskrit: आशुरर्ष बृहन्मते परि प्रियेण धाम्ना । यत्र देवा इति ब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: AshurarSha bR^ihanmate pari priyeNa dhAmnA | yatra devA iti bruvan
verses.translation: Swiftly go forth, O great-minded, around, with your dear abode, where the gods say "thus."

verses.sanskrit: परिष्कृण्वन्ननिष्कृतं जनाय यातयन्निषः । वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव
verses.transliteration: pariShkR^iNvannaniShkR^itaM janAya yAtayanniShaH | vR^iShTiM divaH pari srava
verses.translation: Preparing the unprepared for the people, urging on strengths, flow the rain of heaven around.

verses.sanskrit: अयँ स यो दिवस्परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ । सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरत्
verses.transliteration: aya.N sa yo divaspari raghuyAmA pavitra A | sindhorUrmA vyakSharat
verses.translation: This is he who, swift-moving from heaven, has flowed to the filter, the wave of the river.

verses.sanskrit: सुत एति पवित्र आ त्विषिं दधान ओजसा । विचक्षाणो विरोचयन्
verses.transliteration: suta eti pavitra A tviShiM dadhAna ojasA | vichakShANo virochayan
verses.translation: Pressed, he goes to the filter, bearing brilliance with strength, seeing and illuminating.

verses.sanskrit: आविवासन्परावतो अथो अर्वावतः सुतः । इन्द्राय सिच्यते मधु
verses.transliteration: AvivAsanparAvato atho arvAvataH sutaH | indrAya sichyate madhu
verses.translation: Pressed, he serves from far and near; honey is poured for Indra.

verses.sanskrit: समीचीना अनूषत हरिँ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये
verses.transliteration: samIchInA anUShata hari.N hinvantyadribhiH | indumindrAya pItaye
verses.translation: They sing together, they urge the bay one with stones, the drop for Indra's drinking.

verses.sanskrit: हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः स्वसारो जामयस्पतिम् । महामिन्दुं महीयुवः
verses.transliteration: hinvanti sUramusrayaH svasAro jAmayaspatim | mahAminduM mahIyuvaH
verses.translation: The cows urge the sun, the sisters their lord, great, the great drop, pleasing the great.

verses.sanskrit: पवमान रुचारुचा देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । विश्वा वसून्या विश
verses.transliteration: pavamAna ruchAruchA devo devebhyaH sutaH | vishvA vasUnyA visha
verses.translation: Flow, flowing one, with light after light, the god pressed for the gods; enter all treasures.

verses.sanskrit: आ पवमान सुष्टुतिं वृष्टिं देवेभ्यो दुवः । इषे पवस्व संयतम्
verses.transliteration: A pavamAna suShTutiM vR^iShTiM devebhyo duvaH | iShe pavasva saMyatam
verses.translation: Flow, flowing one, fair praise, rain, service for the gods; flow for strength, in well-regulated fashion.

verses.sanskrit: जनस्य गोपा अजनिष्ट जागृविरग्निः सुदक्षः सुविताय नव्यसे । घृतप्रतीको बृहता दिविस्पृषा द्युमद्वि भाति भरतेभ्यः शुचिः
verses.transliteration: janasya gopA ajaniShTa jAgR^iviragniH sudakShaH suvitAya navyase | ghR^itapratIko bR^ihatA divispR^iShA dyumadvi bhAti bharatebhyaH shuchiH
verses.translation: The wakeful guardian of the people has been born, Agni, the skilful, for the new well-being; with ghee-front, touching great heaven, he shines pure and splendid for the Bharatas.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामग्ने अङ्गिरसो गुहा हितमन्वविन्दञ्छिश्रियाणं वनेवने । स जायसे मथ्यमानः सहो महत्वामाहुः सहसस्पुत्रमङ्गिरः
verses.transliteration: tvAmagne a~Ngiraso guhA hitamanvavinda~nChishriyANaM vanevane | sa jAyase mathyamAnaH saho mahatvAmAhuH sahasasputrama~NgiraH
verses.translation: O Agni, the Angirases found you hidden in the cave, lodged in forest after forest; you are born when churned; they call you great in strength, son of strength, Angiras.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितमग्निं नरस्त्रिषधस्थे समिन्धते । इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथँ स बर्हिषि सीदन्नि होता यजथाय सुक्रतुः
verses.transliteration: yaj~nasya ketuM prathamaM purohitamagniM narastriShadhasthe samindhate | indreNa devaiH saratha.N sa barhiShi sIdanni hotA yajathAya sukratuH
verses.translation: The men kindle in the three-seated place Agni, the first household priest, banner of the sacrifice; he, sharing a chariot with Indra and the gods, sits on the grass, the skilful priest, to sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अयं वां मित्रावरुणा सुतः सोम ऋतावृधा । ममेदिह श्रुतँ हवम्
verses.transliteration: ayaM vAM mitrAvaruNA sutaH soma R^itAvR^idhA | mamediha shruta.N havam
verses.translation: This soma is pressed for you, Mitra and Varuna, strengtheners of truth; hear my call here.

verses.sanskrit: राजानावनभिद्रुहा ध्रुवे सदस्युत्तमे । सहस्रस्थूण आशाते
verses.transliteration: rAjAnAvanabhidruhA dhruve sadasyuttame | sahasrasthUNa AshAte
verses.translation: Kings, not harming, in the firm highest seat, you two attain the thousand-pillared hall.

verses.sanskrit: ता सम्राजा घृतासुती आदित्या दानुनस्पती । सचेते अनवह्वरम्
verses.transliteration: tA samrAjA ghR^itAsutI AdityA dAnunaspatI | sachete anavahvaram
verses.translation: They, the two sovereigns, with ghee-pouring, Adityas, lords of the giver, go together unfailing.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो दधीचो अस्थभिर्वृत्राण्यप्रतिष्कुतः । जघान नवतीर्नव
verses.transliteration: indro dadhIcho asthabhirvR^itrANyapratiShkutaH | jaghAna navatIrnava
verses.translation: Indra, with the bones of Dadhyanch, unresisted, slew the Vritras, ninety-nine times.

verses.sanskrit: इच्छन्नश्वस्य यच्छिरः पर्वतेष्वपश्रितम् । तद्विदच्छर्यणावति
verses.transliteration: ichChannashvasya yachChiraH parvateShvapashritam | tadvidachCharyaNAvati
