verses.transliteration: samI vatsaM na mAtR^ibhiH sR^ijatA gayasAdhanam | devAvyA3M madamabhi dvishavasam
verses.translation: Release together like a calf with its mothers the house-prosperer, the god-guarding exhilaration, of double strength.

verses.sanskrit: पुनाता दक्षसाधनं यथा शर्धाय वीतये । यथा मित्राय वरुणाय शन्तमम्
verses.transliteration: punAtA dakShasAdhanaM yathA shardhAya vItaye | yathA mitrAya varuNAya shantamam
verses.translation: Cleanse the skill-accomplisher, as for strength and feast, as most blessed for Mitra and Varuna.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वाज्यक्षाः सहस्रधारस्तिरः पवित्रं वि वारमव्यम्
verses.transliteration: pra vAjyakShAH sahasradhArastiraH pavitraM vi vAramavyam
verses.translation: The racer with axle, thousand-streamed, has gone forth across the filter, through the woolen sieve.

verses.sanskrit: स वाज्यक्षाः सहस्ररेता अद्भिर्मृजानो गोभिः श्रीणानः
verses.transliteration: sa vAjyakShAH sahasraretA adbhirmR^ijAno gobhiH shrINAnaH
verses.translation: That axle-racer, of a thousand seeds, is cleansed by waters, mingled with cows.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सोम याहीन्द्रस्य कुक्षा नृभिर्येमानो अद्रिभिः सुतः
verses.transliteration: pra soma yAhIndrasya kukShA nR^ibhiryemAno adribhiH sutaH
verses.translation: Go forth, Soma, to Indra's belly, held by men, pressed by stones.

verses.sanskrit: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे । ये वादः शर्यणावति
verses.transliteration: ye somAsaH parAvati ye arvAvati sunvire | ye vAdaH sharyaNAvati
verses.translation: The somas pressed far away, and those pressed near, and those in Sharyanavat.

verses.sanskrit: य आर्जीकेषु कृत्वसु ये मध्ये पस्त्यानाम् । ये वा जनेषु पञ्चसु
verses.transliteration: ya ArjIkeShu kR^itvasu ye madhye pastyAnAm | ye vA janeShu pa~nchasu
verses.translation: Those among the Arjika tribes, among the active ones, those among the dwellers, or among the five peoples.

verses.sanskrit: ते नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् । स्वाना देवास इन्दवः
verses.transliteration: te no vR^iShTiM divaspari pavantAmA suvIryam | svAnA devAsa indavaH
verses.translation: May those, the sounding divine drops, flow for us rain from heaven and heroic strength.

verses.sanskrit: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् । अग्ने त्वां कामये गिरा
verses.transliteration: A te vatso mano yamatparamAchchitsadhasthAt | agne tvAM kAmaye girA
verses.translation: Your calf has turned its mind to you from the farthest dwelling; O Agni, I long for you with my song.

verses.sanskrit: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि दिशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः । समत्सु त्वा हवामहे
verses.transliteration: purutrA hi sadR^i~N~Nasi disho vishvA anu prabhuH | samatsu tvA havAmahe
verses.translation: For you are everywhere alike, lord over all quarters; we call you in battles.

verses.sanskrit: समत्स्वग्निमवसे वाजयन्तो हवामहे । वाजेषु चित्रराधसम्
verses.transliteration: samatsvagnimavase vAjayanto havAmahe | vAjeShu chitrarAdhasam
verses.translation: In battles we call on Agni for help, desiring strength — wondrous in bounty in contests.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्रा भर ओजो नृम्णँ शतक्रतो विचर्षणे । आ वीरं पृतनासहम्
verses.transliteration: tvaM na indrA bhara ojo nR^imNa.N shatakrato vicharShaNe | A vIraM pR^itanAsaham
verses.translation: Bring us, Indra, strength and manly power, O hundred-powered, all-seeing, a hero who overcomes armies.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ हि नः पिता वसो त्वं माता शतक्रतो बभूविथ । अथा ते सुम्नमीमहे
verses.transliteration: tva.N hi naH pitA vaso tvaM mAtA shatakrato babhUvitha | athA te sumnamImahe
verses.translation: For you are our father, O Vasu; you, hundred-powered, have been our mother; so we ask your favor.

verses.sanskrit: त्वाँ शुष्मिन्पुरुहूत वाजयन्तमुप ब्रुवे सहस्कृत । स नो रास्व सुवीर्यम्
verses.transliteration: tvA.N shuShminpuruhUta vAjayantamupa bruve sahaskR^ita | sa no rAsva suvIryam
verses.translation: I speak to you, O strong, much-invoked, strength-seeking, born of might; give us heroic strength.

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र चित्र म इह नास्ति त्वादातमद्रिवः । राधस्तन्नो विदद्वस उभयाहस्त्या भर
verses.transliteration: yadindra chitra ma iha nAsti tvAdAtamadrivaH | rAdhastanno vidadvasa ubhayAhastyA bhara
verses.translation: Whatever wondrous wealth, Indra, is not here with me, which is given by you, O stone-bearer — bring that wealth, Vasu, with both hands.

verses.sanskrit: यन्मन्यसे वरेण्यमिन्द्र द्युक्षं तदा भर । विद्याम तस्य ते वयमकूपारस्य दावनः
verses.transliteration: yanmanyase vareNyamindra dyukShaM tadA bhara | vidyAma tasya te vayamakUpArasya dAvanaH
verses.translation: Whatever you think choice, Indra, heavenly, bring that; may we know that bounty of yours, the unfailing giver.

verses.sanskrit: यत्ते दिक्षु प्रराध्यं मनो अस्ति श्रुतं बृहत् । तेन दृढा चिदद्रिव आ वाजं दर्षि सातये
verses.transliteration: yatte dikShu prarAdhyaM mano asti shrutaM bR^ihat | tena dR^iDhA chidadriva A vAjaM darShi sAtaye
verses.translation: By that famed great mind of yours, accomplished in every direction, O stone-bearer, you break even the firm to win strength.

verses.sanskrit: शिशुं जज्ञानँ हर्यतं मृजन्ति शुम्भन्ति विप्रं मरुतो गणेन । कविर्गीर्भिः काव्येना कविः सन्त्सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन्
verses.transliteration: shishuM jaj~nAna.N haryataM mR^ijanti shumbhanti vipraM maruto gaNena | kavirgIrbhiH kAvyenA kaviH santsomaH pavitramatyeti rebhan
verses.translation: They cleanse the newborn desirable child; the Maruts adorn the sage with their troop; the seer with songs and poetry, the seer, Soma, passes through the filter roaring.

verses.sanskrit: ऋषिमना य ऋषिकृत्स्वर्षाः सहस्रनीथः पदवीः कवीनाम् । तृतीयं धाम महिषः सिषासन्त्सोमो विराजमनु राजति ष्टुप्
verses.transliteration: R^iShimanA ya R^iShikR^itsvarShAH sahasranIthaH padavIH kavInAm | tR^itIyaM dhAma mahiShaH siShAsantsomo virAjamanu rAjati ShTup
verses.translation: The sage-minded, who makes sages, gaining heaven, of a thousand guides, the leader of the seers; the great one, desiring the third realm, Soma, rules after Viraj, the Stubh.

verses.sanskrit: चमूषच्छ्येनः शकुनो विभृत्वा गोविन्दुर्द्रप्स आयुधानि बिभ्रत् । अपामूर्मिँ सचमानः समुद्रं तुरीयं धाम महिषो विवक्ति
verses.transliteration: chamUShachChyenaH shakuno vibhR^itvA govindurdrapsa AyudhAni bibhrat | apAmUrmi.N sachamAnaH samudraM turIyaM dhAma mahiSho vivakti
verses.translation: The falcon, sitting in the vessel, the bird, the all-bearing, cow-finder, drop, bearing weapons; joining the wave of the waters, the great one speaks to the sea, the fourth realm.

verses.sanskrit: एते सोमा अभि प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काममक्षरन् । वर्धन्तो अस्य वीर्यम्
verses.transliteration: ete somA abhi priyamindrasya kAmamakSharan | vardhanto asya vIryam
verses.translation: These somas have flowed toward Indra's dear desire, increasing his heroic strength.

verses.sanskrit: पुनानासश्चमूषदो गच्छन्तो वायुमश्विना । ते नो धत्त सुवीर्यम्
verses.transliteration: punAnAsashchamUShado gachChanto vAyumashvinA | te no dhatta suvIryam
verses.translation: Purified, sitting in the vessels, going to Vayu and the Ashvins — bestow on us heroic strength.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे पुनानो हार्दि चोदय । देवानां योनिमासदम्
verses.transliteration: indrasya soma rAdhase punAno hArdi chodaya | devAnAM yonimAsadam
verses.translation: For Indra's bounty, Soma, flowing, urge on the heart; sit in the seat of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: मृजन्ति त्वा देश क्षिपो हिन्वन्ति सप्त धीतयः । अनु विप्रा अमादिषुः
verses.transliteration: mR^ijanti tvA desha kShipo hinvanti sapta dhItayaH | anu viprA amAdiShuH
verses.translation: The ten fingers cleanse you, the seven thoughts urge you on; the sages have rejoiced after you.

verses.sanskrit: देवेभ्यस्त्वा मदाय कँ सृजानमति मेष्यः । स गोभिर्वासयामसि
verses.transliteration: devebhyastvA madAya ka.N sR^ijAnamati meShyaH | sa gobhirvAsayAmasi
verses.translation: For the gods, for exhilaration, you are released across the wool; we clothe you with cows.

verses.sanskrit: पुनानः कलशेष्वा वस्त्राण्यरुषो हरिः । परि गव्यान्यव्यत
verses.transliteration: punAnaH kalasheShvA vastrANyaruSho hariH | pari gavyAnyavyata
verses.translation: Purified in the vessels, the ruddy bay one guards the cattle-treasures with garments.

verses.sanskrit: मघोन आ पवस्व नो जहि विश्वा अप द्विषः । इन्दो सखायमा विश
verses.transliteration: maghona A pavasva no jahi vishvA apa dviShaH | indo sakhAyamA visha
verses.translation: Flow for us to the bounteous; drive away all enemies; O drop, enter as a friend.

verses.sanskrit: नृचक्षसं त्वा वयमिन्द्रपीतँ स्वर्विदम् । भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषम्
verses.transliteration: nR^ichakShasaM tvA vayamindrapIta.N svarvidam | bhakShImahi prajAmiSham
verses.translation: We would enjoy you, Indra-drunk, man-watching, finder of heaven, with offspring and food.

verses.sanskrit: वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव द्युम्नं पृथिव्या अधि । सहो नः सोम पृत्सु धाः
verses.transliteration: vR^iShTiM divaH pari srava dyumnaM pR^ithivyA adhi | saho naH soma pR^itsu dhAH
verses.translation: Flow the rain of heaven and splendor upon the earth; set strength in us in battles, Soma.

verses.sanskrit: सोमः पुनानो अर्षति सहस्रधारो अत्यविः । वायोरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: somaH punAno arShati sahasradhAro atyaviH | vAyorindrasya niShkR^itam
verses.translation: Soma purifying flows, thousand-streamed, across the wool, to the appointed place of Vayu and Indra.

verses.sanskrit: पवमानमवस्यवो विप्रमभि प्र गायत । सुष्वाणं देववीतये
verses.transliteration: pavamAnamavasyavo vipramabhi pra gAyata | suShvANaM devavItaye
verses.translation: Seeking help, sing to the sage who is flowing, who is pressed for the gods' feast.

verses.sanskrit: पवन्ते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः । गृणाना देववीतये
verses.transliteration: pavante vAjasAtaye somAH sahasrapAjasaH | gR^iNAnA devavItaye
verses.translation: The somas flow for the winning of strength, of a thousandfold vigor, praised for the gods' feast.

verses.sanskrit: उत नो वाजसातये पवस्व बृहतीरिषः । द्युमदिन्दो सुवीर्यम्
verses.transliteration: uta no vAjasAtaye pavasva bR^ihatIriShaH | dyumadindo suvIryam
verses.translation: And flow for us for the winning of strength, great nourishment, O drop, splendid heroic vigor.

verses.sanskrit: अत्या हियाना न हेतृभिरसृग्रं वाजसातये । वि वारमव्यमाशवः
verses.transliteration: atyA hiyAnA na hetR^ibhirasR^igraM vAjasAtaye | vi vAramavyamAshavaH
verses.translation: They have been released like swift mares urged on by the drivers, for the winning of strength, the swift ones to the woolen sieve.

verses.sanskrit: ते नः सहस्रिणँ रयिं पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् । सुवाना देवास इन्दवः
verses.transliteration: te naH sahasriNa.N rayiM pavantAmA suvIryam | suvAnA devAsa indavaH
verses.translation: May those pressed divine drops flow to us a thousandfold wealth and heroic strength.

verses.sanskrit: वाश्रा अर्षन्तीन्दवोऽभि वत्सं न मातरः । दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः
verses.transliteration: vAshrA arShantIndavo.abhi vatsaM na mAtaraH | dadhanvire gabhastyoH
verses.translation: The longing drops flow toward their calf like mothers; they have been held in the hands.

verses.sanskrit: जुष्ट इन्द्राय मत्सरः पवमान कनिक्रदत् । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि
verses.transliteration: juShTa indrAya matsaraH pavamAna kanikradat | vishvA apa dviSho jahi
verses.translation: Pleasing to Indra, the exhilaration, flowing, roaring, drive away all enemies.

verses.sanskrit: अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः पवमानाः स्वर्दृशः । योनावृतस्य सीदत
verses.transliteration: apaghnanto arAvNaH pavamAnAH svardR^ishaH | yonAvR^itasya sIdata
verses.translation: Smiting the niggards, flowing, seeing heaven — sit in the seat of truth.

verses.sanskrit: सोमा असृग्रमिन्दवः सुता ऋतस्य धारया । इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमाः
verses.transliteration: somA asR^igramindavaH sutA R^itasya dhArayA | indrAya madhumattamAH
verses.translation: The somas, the drops, have been released, pressed with the stream of truth, most honeyed for Indra.

verses.sanskrit: अभि विप्रा अनूषत गावो वत्सं न धेनवः । इन्द्रँ सोमस्य पीतये
verses.transliteration: abhi viprA anUShata gAvo vatsaM na dhenavaH | indra.N somasya pItaye
verses.translation: The sages sang toward Indra like milch-cows to their calf, to drink the soma.

verses.sanskrit: मदच्युत्क्षेति सादने सिन्धोरूर्मा विपश्चित् । सोमो गौरी अधि श्रितः
verses.transliteration: madachyutkSheti sAdane sindhorUrmA vipashchit | somo gaurI adhi shritaH
verses.translation: The exhilaration-dropping, wise wave of the river sits in the seat; Soma is lodged on the cow-skin.

verses.sanskrit: दिवो नाभा विचक्षणोऽव्यो वारे महीयते । सोमो यः सुक्रतुः कविः
verses.transliteration: divo nAbhA vichakShaNo.avyo vAre mahIyate | somo yaH sukratuH kaviH
verses.translation: The navel of heaven, the all-seeing, is honored in the woolen sieve — Soma, the skilful seer.

verses.sanskrit: यः सोमः कलशेष्वा अन्तः पवित्र आहितः । तमिन्दुः परि षस्वजे
verses.transliteration: yaH somaH kalasheShvA antaH pavitra AhitaH | taminduH pari Shasvaje
verses.translation: The soma that is placed in the vessels, within the filter — the drop has embraced it all around.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वाचमिन्दुरिष्यति समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि । जिन्वन्कोशं मधुश्चुतम्
verses.transliteration: pra vAchaminduriShyati samudrasyAdhi viShTapi | jinvankoshaM madhushchutam
verses.translation: The drop drives speech on the ridge of the ocean, urging the honey-dripping vessel.

verses.sanskrit: नित्यस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिर्धेनामन्तः सबर्दुघाम् । हिन्वानो मानुषा युजा
verses.transliteration: nityastotro vanaspatirdhenAmantaH sabardughAm | hinvAno mAnuShA yujA
verses.translation: The lord of the forest, ever praised, among the cow that gives milk, urging the human work.

verses.sanskrit: आ पवमान धारय रयिँ सहस्रवर्चसम् । अस्मे इन्दो स्वाभुवम्
verses.transliteration: A pavamAna dhAraya rayi.N sahasravarchasam | asme indo svAbhuvam
verses.translation: Flowing one, bring wealth of a thousand splendors; for us, O drop, a self-existing one.

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्रिया दिवः कविर्विप्रः स धारया सुतः । सोमो हिन्वे परावति
verses.transliteration: abhi priyA divaH kavirvipraH sa dhArayA sutaH | somo hinve parAvati
verses.translation: The sage of heaven, the wise, is pressed with the stream toward the dear ones; Soma, I urge far away.

verses.sanskrit: उत्ते शुष्मास ईरते सिन्धोरूर्मेरिव स्वनः । वाणस्य चोदया पविम्
verses.transliteration: utte shuShmAsa Irate sindhorUrmeriva svanaH | vANasya chodayA pavim
verses.translation: Your strengths rise like the sound of the river wave; urge the arrow's flow.

verses.sanskrit: प्रसवे त उदीरते तिस्रो वाचो मखस्युवः । यदव्य एषि सानवि
verses.transliteration: prasave ta udIrate tisro vAcho makhasyuvaH | yadavya eShi sAnavi
verses.translation: At your impulse three speeches rise up, the sacrifice-seeking ones, when you go to the woolen height.

verses.sanskrit: अव्या वारैः परि प्रियँ हरिँ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । पवमानं मधुश्चुतम्
verses.transliteration: avyA vAraiH pari priya.N hari.N hinvantyadribhiH | pavamAnaM madhushchutam
verses.translation: They urge the dear bay one with the woolen sieves with stones, the flowing honey-dropping one.

verses.sanskrit: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम्
verses.transliteration: A pavasva madintama pavitraM dhArayA kave | arkasya yonimAsadam
verses.translation: Flow to us, most exhilarating, through the filter with the stream, seer; sit in the seat of the hymn.

verses.sanskrit: स पवस्व मदिन्तम गोभिरञ्जानो अक्तुभिः । एन्द्रस्य जठरं विश
verses.transliteration: sa pavasva madintama gobhira~njAno aktubhiH | endrasya jaTharaM visha
verses.translation: Flow, most exhilarating, anointed with cows and nights; enter Indra's belly.

verses.sanskrit: अया वीती परि स्रव यस्त इन्दो मदेष्वा । अवाहन्नवतीर्नव
verses.transliteration: ayA vItI pari srava yasta indo madeShvA | avAhannavatIrnava
verses.translation: With this feast flow around, O drop, you who in the joys slew ninety-nine.

verses.sanskrit: पुरः सद्य इत्थाधिये दिवोदासाय शम्बरम् । अध त्यं तुर्वशं यदुम् ॥ १२१च्ल्स्दिर् परि नो अश्वमश्वविद्गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् । क्षरा सहस्रिणीरिषः
verses.transliteration: puraH sadya itthAdhiye divodAsAya shambaram | adha tyaM turvashaM yadum || 121chlsdir pari no ashvamashvavidgomadindo hiraNyavat | kSharA sahasriNIriShaH
verses.translation: Then at once he broke the forts for Divodasa, Shambara — and then that Turvasha, Yadu. [Next:] Flow around us, O drop, wealth of horses, cattle and gold; stream a thousandfold nourishments.

verses.sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवते मृधोऽप सोमो अराव्णः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: apaghnanpavate mR^idho.apa somo arAvNaH | gachChannindrasya niShkR^itam
verses.translation: Smiting enemies he flows, Soma, smiting the niggardly, going to the portion of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: महो नो राय आ भर पवमान जही मृधः । रास्वेन्दो वीरवद्यशः
verses.transliteration: maho no rAya A bhara pavamAna jahI mR^idhaH | rAsvendo vIravadyashaH
verses.translation: Bring us great wealth, flowing one; drive away foes; give heroic fame, O drop.

verses.sanskrit: न त्वा शतं च न ह्रुतो राधो दित्सन्तमा मिनन् । यत्पुनानो मखस्यसे
verses.transliteration: na tvA shataM cha na hruto rAdho ditsantamA minan | yatpunAno makhasyase
verses.translation: Not a hundred nor the crooked ones diminish your bounty, when, purified, you are for the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अया पवस्व धारया यया सूर्यमरोचयः । हिन्वानो मानुषीरपः
verses.transliteration: ayA pavasva dhArayA yayA sUryamarochayaH | hinvAno mAnuShIrapaH
verses.translation: Flow with this stream by which you made the sun shine, urging on the human waters.

verses.sanskrit: अयुक्त सूर एतशं पवमानो मनावधि । अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे
verses.transliteration: ayukta sUra etashaM pavamAno manAvadhi | antarikSheNa yAtave
verses.translation: The Sun yoked his horse Etasha, the flowing one, over Manu, to travel through the air.

verses.sanskrit: उत त्या हरितो रथे सूरो अयुक्त यातवे । इन्दुरिन्द्र इति ब्रुवन्
verses.transliteration: uta tyA harito rathe sUro ayukta yAtave | indurindra iti bruvan
verses.translation: And the Sun yoked those bay mares for the journey; the drop is Indra, so they say.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं वो देवमग्निभिः सजोषा यजिष्ठं दूतमध्वरे कृणुध्वम् । यो मर्त्येषु निध्रुविरृतावा तपुर्मूर्धा घृतान्नः पावकः
verses.transliteration: agniM vo devamagnibhiH sajoShA yajiShThaM dUtamadhvare kR^iNudhvam | yo martyeShu nidhruvirR^itAvA tapurmUrdhA ghR^itAnnaH pAvakaH
verses.translation: Make Agni, with fires, the god, together-minded, the best sacrificer, a messenger at the rite — who among mortals is steadfast, true, hot-headed, ghee-fed, pure.

verses.sanskrit: प्रोथदश्वो न यवसेऽविष्यन्यदा महः संवरणाद्व्यस्थात् । आदस्य वातो अनु वाति शोचिरध स्म ते व्रजनं कृष्णमस्ति
verses.transliteration: prothadashvo na yavase.aviShyanyadA mahaH saMvaraNAdvyasthAt | Adasya vAto anu vAti shochiradha sma te vrajanaM kR^iShNamasti
verses.translation: Like a horse eager for fodder, when he stands out of the great enclosure, then the wind follows his flame, and then your path is black.

verses.sanskrit: उद्यस्य ते नवजातस्य वृष्णोऽग्ने चरन्त्यजरा इधानाः । अच्छा द्यामरुषो धूम एषि सं दूतो अग्न ईयसे हि देवान्
verses.transliteration: udyasya te navajAtasya vR^iShNo.agne charantyajarA idhAnAH | achChA dyAmaruSho dhUma eShi saM dUto agna Iyase hi devAn
verses.translation: When, O Agni, the new-born bull's ageless flames rise, you go to heaven, ruddy, with smoke; you are sent as messenger to the gods.

verses.sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे । स वृषा वृषभो भुवत्
verses.transliteration: tamindraM vAjayAmasi mahe vR^itrAya hantave | sa vR^iShA vR^iShabho bhuvat
verses.translation: We strengthen that Indra for the slaying of the great Vritra; may he be the bull, the bull.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स बले हितः । द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः
verses.transliteration: indraH sa dAmane kR^ita ojiShThaH sa bale hitaH | dyumnI shlokI sa somyaH
verses.translation: Indra is made for giving, the most powerful, set in strength, splendid, praised, the soma-drinker.

verses.sanskrit: गिरा वज्रो न सम्भृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः । ववक्ष उग्रो अस्तृतः
verses.transliteration: girA vajro na sambhR^itaH sabalo anapachyutaH | vavakSha ugro astR^itaH
verses.translation: Like a thunderbolt gathered by song, mighty, unshaken, fierce, unconquered, he carries.

verses.sanskrit: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतँ सोमं पवित्र आ नय । पुनाहीन्द्राय पातवे
verses.transliteration: adhvaryo adribhiH suta.N somaM pavitra A naya | punAhIndrAya pAtave
verses.translation: O Adhvaryu, bring the soma pressed by stones to the filter; purify it for Indra's drinking.

verses.sanskrit: तव त्य इन्दो अन्धसो देवा मधोर्व्याशत । पवमानस्य मरुतः
verses.transliteration: tava tya indo andhaso devA madhorvyAshata | pavamAnasya marutaH
verses.translation: Those gods, O drop, have attained your honey-drink, the Maruts of the flowing one.

verses.sanskrit: दिवः पीयूषमुत्तमँ सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । सुनोता मधुमत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: divaH pIyUShamuttama.N somamindrAya vajriNe | sunotA madhumattamam
verses.translation: Press for Indra the thunderbolt-bearer the best nectar of heaven, the most honeyed soma.

verses.sanskrit: धर्त्ता दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो दक्षो देवानामनुमाद्यो नृभिः । हरिः सृजानो अत्यो न सत्वभिर्वृथा पाजाँसि कृणुषे नदीष्वा
verses.transliteration: dharttA divaH pavate kR^itvyo raso dakSho devAnAmanumAdyo nR^ibhiH | hariH sR^ijAno atyo na satvabhirvR^ithA pAjA.Nsi kR^iNuShe nadIShvA
verses.translation: The upholder of heaven flows, the skilful essence, the skill of the gods, to be rejoiced in by men; the bay one, released like a horse among the strong, you vainly make strength in the rivers.

verses.sanskrit: शूरो न धत्त आयुधा गभस्त्योः स्वा३ः सिषासन्रथिरो गविष्टिषु । इन्द्रस्य शुष्ममीरयन्नपस्युभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते मनीषिभिः
verses.transliteration: shUro na dhatta AyudhA gabhastyoH svA3H siShAsanrathiro gaviShTiShu | indrasya shuShmamIrayannapasyubhirindurhinvAno ajyate manIShibhiH
verses.translation: Like a hero he takes weapons in his hands, desiring heaven, a charioteer seeking cattle; urging Indra's strength with the workers, the drop is urged and anointed by the wise.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य सोम पवमान ऊर्मिणा तविष्यमाणो जठरेष्वा विश । प्र नः पिन्व विद्युदभ्रेव रोदसी धिया नो वाजाँ उप माहि शश्वतः
verses.transliteration: indrasya soma pavamAna UrmiNA taviShyamANo jaThareShvA visha | pra naH pinva vidyudabhreva rodasI dhiyA no vAjA.N upa mAhi shashvataH
verses.translation: O Soma of Indra, flowing with a wave, strong, enter his belly; swell heaven and earth for us like lightning in the cloud; with thought bring us everlasting strengths.

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः । सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे
verses.transliteration: yadindra prAgapAguda~NnyagvA hUyase nR^ibhiH | simA purU nR^iShUto asyAnave.asi prashardha turvashe
verses.translation: Indra, when you are called by men from east, west, north and south, from many places — you are the mighty protector of Anu, Turvasha, praised for strength.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वा रुमे रुशमे श्यावके कृप इन्द्र मादयसे सचा । कण्वासस्त्वा स्तोमेभिर्ब्रह्मवाहस इन्द्रा यच्छन्त्या गहि
verses.transliteration: yadvA rume rushame shyAvake kR^ipa indra mAdayase sachA | kaNvAsastvA stomebhirbrahmavAhasa indrA yachChantyA gahi
verses.translation: Or when among the Rumas, Rushamas, Shyavaka, in the Krupa, Indra, you rejoice together; the Kanvas, with hymns and prayer-driven, hold you; come, Indra.

verses.sanskrit: उभयँ शृणवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः । सत्राच्या मघवान्त्सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत्
verses.transliteration: ubhaya.N shR^iNavachcha na indro arvAgidaM vachaH | satrAchyA maghavAntsomapItaye dhiyA shaviShTha A gamat
verses.translation: Let Indra hear both of ours, this word of ours here; the strongest, bounteous one comes with thought, together, to drink the soma.

verses.sanskrit: तँ हि स्वराजं वृषभं तमोजसा धिषणे निष्टतक्षतुः । उतोपमानां प्रथमो नि षीदसि सोमकामँ हि ते मनः
verses.transliteration: ta.N hi svarAjaM vR^iShabhaM tamojasA dhiShaNe niShTatakShatuH | utopamAnAM prathamo ni ShIdasi somakAma.N hi te manaH
verses.translation: Him indeed, the self-ruler, the bull, the two cups shaped with might; and you sit first of equals, for your mind longs for soma.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व देव आयुषगिन्द्रं गच्छतु ते मदः । वायुमा रोह धर्मणा
verses.transliteration: pavasva deva AyuShagindraM gachChatu te madaH | vAyumA roha dharmaNA
verses.translation: Flow, god, for life; may your exhilaration go to Indra; mount Vayu by your law.

verses.sanskrit: पवमान नि तोशसे रयिँ सोम श्रवाय्यम् । इन्दो समुद्रमा विश
verses.transliteration: pavamAna ni toshase rayi.N soma shravAyyam | indo samudramA visha
verses.translation: Flowing one, you stir wealth, praiseworthy Soma; O drop, enter the sea.

verses.sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवसे मृधः क्रतुवित्सोम मत्सरः । नुदस्वादेवयुं जनम्
verses.transliteration: apaghnanpavase mR^idhaH kratuvitsoma matsaraH | nudasvAdevayuM janam
verses.translation: Smiting enemies, you flow, O Soma, the wise, exhilarating; drive away the godless man.

verses.sanskrit: अभी नो वाजसातमँ रयिमर्ष शतस्पृहम् । इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसं तुविद्युम्नं विभासहम्
verses.transliteration: abhI no vAjasAtama.N rayimarSha shataspR^iham | indo sahasrabharNasaM tuvidyumnaM vibhAsaham
verses.translation: Flow to us, O drop, wealth, the best strength-winner, a hundredfold desired, a thousand-nourishing, of great splendor, overcoming.

verses.sanskrit: वयं ते अस्य राधसो वसोर्वसो पुरुस्पृहः । नि नेदिष्ठतमा इषः स्याम सुम्ने ते आध्रिगो
verses.transliteration: vayaM te asya rAdhaso vasorvaso puruspR^ihaH | ni nediShThatamA iShaH syAma sumne te Adhrigo
verses.translation: We, O Vasu of every Vasu, much-desired, would be nearest to your nourishments, in your favor, unconquerable.

verses.sanskrit: परि स्य स्वानो अक्षरिदिन्दुरव्ये मदच्युतः । धारा य ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरे भ्राजा न याति गव्ययुः
verses.transliteration: pari sya svAno akSharidinduravye madachyutaH | dhArA ya Urdhvo adhvare bhrAjA na yAti gavyayuH
verses.translation: The sounding exhilaration-dropping drop flows around in the woolen sieve; the stream that rises at the sacrifice goes like light, desiring cattle.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम महान्त्समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम
verses.transliteration: pavasva soma mahAntsamudraH pitA devAnAM vishvAbhi dhAma
verses.translation: Flow, Soma, great ocean, father of the gods, to all realms.

verses.sanskrit: शुक्रः पवस्व देवेभ्यः सोम दिवे पृथिव्यै शं च प्रजाभ्यः
verses.transliteration: shukraH pavasva devebhyaH soma dive pR^ithivyai shaM cha prajAbhyaH
verses.translation: Bright, flow for the gods, Soma, for heaven and earth, and bless the offspring.

verses.sanskrit: दिवो धर्त्तासि शुक्रः पीयूषः सत्ये विधर्मन्वाजी पवस्व
verses.transliteration: divo dharttAsi shukraH pIyUShaH satye vidharmanvAjI pavasva
verses.translation: You are the upholder of heaven, bright nectar; in the true rite, racer, flow.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिर्थिँ स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियम् । अग्ने रथं न वेद्यम्
verses.transliteration: preShThaM vo atirthi.N stuShe mitramiva priyam | agne rathaM na vedyam
verses.translation: I praise your dearest guest, beloved like a friend — Agni, who is to be known like a chariot.

verses.sanskrit: कविमिव प्रशँस्यं यं देवास इति द्विता । नि मर्त्येष्वादधुः
verses.transliteration: kavimiva prasha.NsyaM yaM devAsa iti dvitA | ni martyeShvAdadhuH
verses.translation: Like a seer to be praised, whom the gods in two ways have placed among mortals.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄँपाहि शृणुही गिरः । रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना
verses.transliteration: tvaM yaviShTha dAshuSho nR^I.NpAhi shR^iNuhI giraH | rakShA tokamuta tmanA
verses.translation: You, youngest, protect the men of the giver; hear our songs; guard our offspring and ourselves.

verses.sanskrit: एन्द्र नो गधि प्रिय सत्राजिदगोह्य । गिरिर्न विश्वतः पृथुः पतिर्दिवः
verses.transliteration: endra no gadhi priya satrAjidagohya | girirna vishvataH pR^ithuH patirdivaH
verses.translation: Come to us, dear Indra, the ever-victorious, unhidden, broad like a mountain on all sides, lord of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अभि हि सत्य सोमपा उभे बभूथ रोदसी । इन्द्रासि सुन्वतो वृधः पतिर्दिवः
verses.transliteration: abhi hi satya somapA ubhe babhUtha rodasI | indrAsi sunvato vR^idhaH patirdivaH
verses.translation: You are truly, soma-drinker, over both worlds; you are Indra, strengthener of the presser, lord of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ हि शश्वतीनामिन्द्र धर्त्ता पुरामसि । हन्ता दस्योर्मनोर्वृधः पतिर्दिवः
verses.transliteration: tva.N hi shashvatInAmindra dharttA purAmasi | hantA dasyormanorvR^idhaH patirdivaH
verses.translation: You, Indra, are the upholder of the eternal forts; slayer of the Dasyu, strengthener of Manu, lord of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत । इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्त्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः
verses.transliteration: purAM bhinduryuvA kaviramitaujA ajAyata | indro vishvasya karmaNo dharttA vajrI puruShTutaH
verses.translation: The breaker of forts, young, wise, of measureless strength was born — Indra, the upholder of all work, wielder of the thunderbolt, much praised.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वलस्य गोमतोऽपावरद्रिवो बिलम् । त्वां देवा अबिभ्युषस्तुज्यमानास आविषुः
verses.transliteration: tvaM valasya gomato.apAvaradrivo bilam | tvAM devA abibhyuShastujyamAnAsa AviShuH
verses.translation: You uncovered the cave of Vala, rich in cattle, O stone-bearer; the gods, fearless, urged by you, came forward.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रमीशानमोजसाभि स्तोमैरनूषत । सहस्रं यस्य रातय उत वा सन्ति भूयसीः
verses.transliteration: indramIshAnamojasAbhi stomairanUShata | sahasraM yasya rAtaya uta vA santi bhUyasIH
verses.translation: They have praised Indra the ruler with hymns, by might; whose gifts are a thousand, or even more.

verses.sanskrit: अक्रान्त्समुद्रः प्रथमे विधर्मं जनयन्प्रजा भुवनस्य गोपाः । वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्ये बृहत्सोमो वावृधे स्वानो अद्रिः
verses.transliteration: akrAntsamudraH prathame vidharmaM janayanprajA bhuvanasya gopAH | vR^iShA pavitre adhi sAno avye bR^ihatsomo vAvR^idhe svAno adriH
verses.translation: The ocean has stepped out in the first rite, begetting offspring, the guardian of the world; the bull upon the high woolen peak, great Soma, sounding stone, has grown.

verses.sanskrit: मत्सि वायुमिष्टये राधसे च मत्सि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः । मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान्मत्सि द्यावापृथिवी देव सोम
verses.transliteration: matsi vAyumiShTaye rAdhase cha matsi mitrAvaruNA pUyamAnaH | matsi shardho mArutaM matsi devAnmatsi dyAvApR^ithivI deva soma
verses.translation: Rejoice, O Vayu, for worship and bounty; rejoice Mitra and Varuna, as you are purified; rejoice the Marut host; rejoice the gods; rejoice heaven and earth, god Soma.

verses.sanskrit: महत्तत्सोमो महिषश्चकारापां यद्गर्भोऽवृणीत देवान् । अदधादिन्द्रे पवमान ओजोऽजनयत्सूर्ये ज्योतिरिन्दुः
verses.transliteration: mahattatsomo mahiShashchakArApAM yadgarbho.avR^iNIta devAn | adadhAdindre pavamAna ojo.ajanayatsUrye jyotirinduH
verses.translation: Soma, the great, the mighty, did that great deed when, the embryo of the waters, he chose the gods; the flowing one placed strength in Indra and the drop made light in the sun.

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो अमर्त्यः पर्णवीरिव दीयते । अभि द्रोणान्यासदम्
verses.transliteration: eSha devo amartyaH parNavIriva dIyate | abhi droNAnyAsadam
verses.translation: This immortal god is given like a leaf-bird, to sit in the troughs.

verses.sanskrit: एष विप्रैरभिष्टुतोऽपो देवो वि गाहते । दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे
verses.transliteration: eSha viprairabhiShTuto.apo devo vi gAhate | dadhadratnAni dAshuShe
verses.translation: This god, praised by the sages, plunges into the waters, giving jewels to the giver.

verses.sanskrit: एष विश्वानि वार्या शूरो यन्निव सत्वभिः । पवमानः सिषासति
verses.transliteration: eSha vishvAni vAryA shUro yanniva satvabhiH | pavamAnaH siShAsati
verses.translation: This one seeks all desirable things like a hero with his troops, flowing.

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो रथर्यति पवमानो दिशस्यति । आविष्कृणोति वग्वनुम्
verses.transliteration: eSha devo ratharyati pavamAno dishasyati | AviShkR^iNoti vagvanum
verses.translation: This god drives like a charioteer, flowing, he reveals the way.

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो विपन्युभिः पवमान ऋतायुभिः । हरिर्वाजाय मृज्यते
verses.transliteration: eSha devo vipanyubhiH pavamAna R^itAyubhiH | harirvAjAya mR^ijyate
verses.translation: This god is cleansed by the wise, truth-loving, the bay one, for strength.

verses.sanskrit: एष देवो विपा कृतोऽति ह्वराँसि धावति । पवमानो अदाभ्यः
verses.transliteration: eSha devo vipA kR^ito.ati hvarA.Nsi dhAvati | pavamAno adAbhyaH
verses.translation: This god made by the sage runs over crookednesses, flowing, unconquerable.

verses.sanskrit: एष दिवं वि धावति तिरो रजाँसि धारया । पवमानः कनिक्रदत्
verses.transliteration: eSha divaM vi dhAvati tiro rajA.Nsi dhArayA | pavamAnaH kanikradat
verses.translation: This one runs through heaven with the stream across the spaces, flowing, roaring.

verses.sanskrit: एष दिवं व्यासरत्तिरो रजाँस्यस्पृतः । पवमानः स्वध्वरः
verses.transliteration: eSha divaM vyAsarattiro rajA.NsyaspR^itaH | pavamAnaH svadhvaraH
verses.translation: This one has spread over heaven across the spaces, untouched, flowing, of good sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति
verses.transliteration: eSha pratnena janmanA devo devebhyaH sutaH | hariH pavitre arShati
verses.translation: This god, by ancient birth, is pressed for the gods; the bay one flows in the filter.

verses.sanskrit: एष उ स्य पुरुव्रतो जज्ञानो जनयन्निषः । धारया पवते सुतः
verses.transliteration: eSha u sya puruvrato jaj~nAno janayanniShaH | dhArayA pavate sutaH
verses.translation: This one of many vows, being born, begetting nourishments, flows pressed with the stream.

verses.sanskrit: एष धिया यात्यण्व्य शूरो रथेभिराशुभिः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: eSha dhiyA yAtyaNvya shUro rathebhirAshubhiH | gachChannindrasya niShkR^itam
verses.translation: This hero goes with thought, swift with his chariots, going to the appointed place of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: एष पुरू धियायते बृहते देवतातये । यत्रामृतास आशत
verses.transliteration: eSha purU dhiyAyate bR^ihate devatAtaye | yatrAmR^itAsa Ashata
verses.translation: This one goes with many thoughts for the great worship of the gods, where the immortals have reached.

verses.sanskrit: एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यमुप द्रोणेष्वायवः । प्रचक्राणं महीरिषः
verses.transliteration: etaM mR^ijanti marjyamupa droNeShvAyavaH | prachakrANaM mahIriShaH
verses.translation: The Ayus cleanse this cleansable one in the troughs, who brings great nourishments.

verses.sanskrit: एष हितो वि नीयतेऽन्तः शुन्ध्यावता पथा । यदी तुञ्जन्ति भूर्णयः
verses.transliteration: eSha hito vi nIyate.antaH shundhyAvatA pathA | yadI tu~njanti bhUrNayaH
verses.translation: This one is set and led along the pure path, when the swift ones hurry.

verses.sanskrit: एष रुक्मिभिरीयते वाजि शुभ्रेभिरँशुभिः । पतिः सिन्धूनां भवन्
verses.transliteration: eSha rukmibhirIyate vAji shubhrebhira.NshubhiH | patiH sindhUnAM bhavan
verses.translation: This racer is driven with golden bright rays, becoming lord of the rivers.

verses.sanskrit: एष शृङ्गाणि दोधुवच्छिशीते यूथ्यो३ वृषा । नृम्णा दधान ओजसा
verses.transliteration: eSha shR^i~NgANi dodhuvachChishIte yUthyo3 vR^iShA | nR^imNA dadhAna ojasA
verses.translation: This herd-bull shakes his horns, sharpens them, holding manly power by might.

verses.sanskrit: एष वसूनि पिब्दनः परुषा ययिवाँ अति । अव शादेषु गच्छति
verses.transliteration: eSha vasUni pibdanaH paruShA yayivA.N ati | ava shAdeShu gachChati
verses.translation: This one, drinking the treasures, passes beyond the hard places; he goes down into the stalks.

verses.sanskrit: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो हरिँ हिवन्ति यातवे । स्वायुधं मदिन्तमम्
verses.transliteration: etamu tyaM dasha kShipo hari.N hivanti yAtave | svAyudhaM madintamam
verses.translation: This bay one the ten fingers urge on to go, well-armed, most exhilarating.

verses.sanskrit: एष उ स्य वृषा रथोऽव्या वारेभिरव्यत । गच्छन्वाजँ सहस्रिणम्
verses.transliteration: eSha u sya vR^iShA ratho.avyA vArebhiravyata | gachChanvAja.N sahasriNam
verses.translation: This bull-chariot has been cleansed through the woolen sieves, going to a thousandfold strength.

verses.sanskrit: एतं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिँ हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये
verses.transliteration: etaM tritasya yoShaNo hari.N hinvantyadribhiH | indumindrAya pItaye
verses.translation: The women of Trita urge this bay one with stones, the drop for Indra to drink.

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य मानुषीष्वा श्येनो न विक्षु सीदति । गच्छं जारो न योषितम्
verses.transliteration: eSha sya mAnuShIShvA shyeno na vikShu sIdati | gachChaM jAro na yoShitam
verses.translation: This one sits among the human clans like a falcon, going like a lover to his beloved.

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य मद्यो रसोऽव चष्टे दिवः शिशुः । य इन्दुर्वारमाविशत्
verses.transliteration: eSha sya madyo raso.ava chaShTe divaH shishuH | ya indurvAramAvishat
verses.translation: This exhilarating essence looks down, the child of heaven, the drop that entered the woolen sieve.

verses.sanskrit: एष स्य पीतये सुतो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । क्रन्दन्योनिमभि प्रियम्
verses.transliteration: eSha sya pItaye suto harirarShati dharNasiH | krandanyonimabhi priyam
verses.translation: This one is pressed for drinking; the bay sustainer runs, roaring to his dear nest.

verses.sanskrit: एतं त्यँ हरितो दश मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः । याभिर्मदाय शुम्भते
verses.transliteration: etaM tya.N harito dasha marmR^ijyante apasyuvaH | yAbhirmadAya shumbhate
verses.translation: This one the ten bay mares, the workers, adorn, by which he is decorated for exhilaration.

verses.sanskrit: एष वाजी हितो नृभिर्विश्वविन्मनसस्पतिः । अव्यो वारं वि धावति
verses.transliteration: eSha vAjI hito nR^ibhirvishvavinmanasaspatiH | avyo vAraM vi dhAvati
verses.translation: This racer is set by men, all-knowing, lord of the mind; he runs to the woolen sieve.

verses.sanskrit: एष पवित्रे अक्षरत्सोमो देवेभ्यः सुतः । विश्वा धामान्याविशन्
verses.transliteration: eSha pavitre akSharatsomo devebhyaH sutaH | vishvA dhAmAnyAvishan
verses.translation: This soma has flowed in the filter, pressed for the gods, entering all abodes.

verses.sanskrit: एष देवः शुभायतेऽधि योनावमर्त्यः । वृत्रहा देववीतमः
verses.transliteration: eSha devaH shubhAyate.adhi yonAvamartyaH | vR^itrahA devavItamaH
verses.translation: This god shines in his nest, immortal, Vritra-slayer, best at the gods' feast.

verses.sanskrit: एष वृषा कनिक्रदद्दशभिर्जामिभिर्यतः । अभि द्रोणानि धावति
verses.transliteration: eSha vR^iShA kanikradaddashabhirjAmibhiryataH | abhi droNAni dhAvati
verses.translation: This bull roared, held by the ten sisters, runs to the vessels.

verses.sanskrit: एष सूर्यमरोचयत्पवमानो अधि द्यवि । पवित्रे मत्सरो मदः
verses.transliteration: eSha sUryamarochayatpavamAno adhi dyavi | pavitre matsaro madaH
verses.translation: This one made the sun shine, flowing in the sky; in the filter, the exhilarating drink.

verses.sanskrit: एष सूर्येण हासते संवसानो विवस्वता । पतिर्वाचो अदाभ्यः
verses.transliteration: eSha sUryeNa hAsate saMvasAno vivasvatA | patirvAcho adAbhyaH
verses.translation: This one is shining with the sun, together with Vivasvat, the unconquerable lord of speech.

verses.sanskrit: एष कविरभिष्टुतः पवित्रे अधि तोशते । पुनानो घ्नन्नप द्विषः
verses.transliteration: eSha kavirabhiShTutaH pavitre adhi toshate | punAno ghnannapa dviShaH
verses.translation: This seer is praised and urged in the filter, purifying, smiting enemies.

verses.sanskrit: एष इन्द्राय वायवे स्वर्जित्परि षिच्यते । पवित्रे दक्षसाधनः
verses.transliteration: eSha indrAya vAyave svarjitpari Shichyate | pavitre dakShasAdhanaH
verses.translation: This one, heaven-winner, is poured round for Indra and Vayu, in the filter, accomplisher of skill.

verses.sanskrit: एष नृभिर्वि नीयते दिवो मूर्धा वृषा सुतः । सोमो वनेषु विश्ववित्
verses.transliteration: eSha nR^ibhirvi nIyate divo mUrdhA vR^iShA sutaH | somo vaneShu vishvavit
verses.translation: This pressed bull, head of heaven, is led by men — Soma in the woods, all-knowing.

verses.sanskrit: एष गव्युरचिक्रदत्पवमानो हिरण्ययुः । इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः
verses.transliteration: eSha gavyurachikradatpavamAno hiraNyayuH | induH satrAjidastR^itaH
verses.translation: This cattle-loving, gold-loving flowing drop has roared, the always-victorious, unconquered.

verses.sanskrit: एष शुष्म्यसिष्यददन्तरिक्षे वृषा हरिः । पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा
verses.transliteration: eSha shuShmyasiShyadadantarikShe vR^iShA hariH | punAna indurindramA
verses.translation: This strong bull, the bay one, ran in the air; the purified drop to Indra.

verses.sanskrit: एष शुष्म्यदाभ्यः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । देवावीरघशँसहा
verses.transliteration: eSha shuShmyadAbhyaH somaH punAno arShati | devAvIraghasha.NsahA
verses.translation: This strong, unconquerable Soma flows purifying, guardian of the gods, slayer of the evil-speaking.

verses.sanskrit: स सुतः पीतये वृषा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षाँसि देवयुः
verses.transliteration: sa sutaH pItaye vR^iShA somaH pavitre arShati | vighnanrakShA.Nsi devayuH
verses.translation: That pressed bull Soma flows in the filter for drinking, smiting demons, god-seeking.

verses.sanskrit: स पवित्रे विचक्षणो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । अभि योनिं कनिक्रदत्
verses.transliteration: sa pavitre vichakShaNo harirarShati dharNasiH | abhi yoniM kanikradat
verses.translation: That all-seeing bay one flows in the filter, the sustainer, roaring toward his nest.

verses.sanskrit: स वाजी रोचना दिवः पवमानो वि धावति । रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम्
verses.transliteration: sa vAjI rochanA divaH pavamAno vi dhAvati | rakShohA vAramavyayam
verses.translation: That racer, flowing, runs through the lights of heaven, demon-slayer, to the woolen sieve.

verses.sanskrit: स त्रितस्याधि सानवि पवमानो अरोचयत् । जामिभिः सूर्यँ सह
verses.transliteration: sa tritasyAdhi sAnavi pavamAno arochayat | jAmibhiH sUrya.N saha
verses.translation: He, flowing, made the sun shine on the heights of Trita, together with the sisters.

verses.sanskrit: स वृत्रहा वृषा सुतो वरिवोविददाभ्यः । सोमो वाजमिवासरत्
verses.transliteration: sa vR^itrahA vR^iShA suto varivovidadAbhyaH | somo vAjamivAsarat
verses.translation: That Vritra-slayer, bull, pressed, finder of room, unconquerable, Soma, runs like strength.

verses.sanskrit: स देवः कविनेषितो३ऽभि द्रोणानि धावति । इन्दुरिन्द्राय मँहयन्
verses.transliteration: sa devaH kavineShito3.abhi droNAni dhAvati | indurindrAya ma.Nhayan
verses.translation: That god, urged by the seer, runs to the vessels, the drop glorifying Indra.

verses.sanskrit: यः पावमानीरध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतँ रसम् । सर्वँ स पूतमश्नाति स्वदितं मातरिश्वना
verses.transliteration: yaH pAvamAnIradhyetyR^iShibhiH sambhR^ita.N rasam | sarva.N sa pUtamashnAti svaditaM mAtarishvanA
verses.translation: Whoever studies the Pavamani verses, the essence gathered by the sages, eats all that is purified, sweetened by Matarishvan.

verses.sanskrit: पावमानीर्यो अध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतँ रसम् । तस्मै सरस्वती दुहे क्षीरँ सर्पिर्मधूदकम्
verses.transliteration: pAvamAnIryo adhyetyR^iShibhiH sambhR^ita.N rasam | tasmai sarasvatI duhe kShIra.N sarpirmadhUdakam
verses.translation: To him who studies the Pavamani verses, the essence gathered by sages, Sarasvati yields milk, ghee, honey and water.

verses.sanskrit: पावमानीः स्वस्त्ययनीः सुदुघा हि घृतश्चुतः । ऋषिभिः सम्भृतो रसो ब्राह्मणेष्वमृतँ हितम्
verses.transliteration: pAvamAnIH svastyayanIH sudughA hi ghR^itashchutaH | R^iShibhiH sambhR^ito raso brAhmaNeShvamR^ita.N hitam
verses.translation: The Pavamani verses bring welfare, good milkers, ghee-dripping; the essence gathered by the sages is placed among the Brahmins as immortality.

verses.sanskrit: पावमानीर्दधन्तु न इमं लोकमथो अमुम् । कामान्त्समर्धयन्तु नो देवीर्देवैः समाहृताः
verses.transliteration: pAvamAnIrdadhantu na imaM lokamatho amum | kAmAntsamardhayantu no devIrdevaiH samAhR^itAH
verses.translation: May the Pavamanis support us in this world and the next; may the goddesses, brought together with the gods, fulfill our desires.

verses.sanskrit: येन देवाः पवित्रेणात्मानं पुनते सदा । तेन सहस्रधारेण पावमानीः पुनन्तु नः
verses.transliteration: yena devAH pavitreNAtmAnaM punate sadA | tena sahasradhAreNa pAvamAnIH punantu naH
verses.translation: By the filter with which the gods ever purify themselves, by that thousand-streamed one may the Pavamanis purify us.

verses.sanskrit: पावमानीः स्वस्त्ययनीस्ताभिर्गच्छति नान्दनम् । पुण्याँश्च भक्षान्भक्षयत्यमृतत्वं च गच्छति
verses.transliteration: pAvamAnIH svastyayanIstAbhirgachChati nAndanam | puNyA.Nshcha bhakShAnbhakShayatyamR^itatvaM cha gachChati
verses.translation: By the Pavamanis, bringers of welfare, he goes to joy; he enjoys pure foods and attains immortality.

verses.sanskrit: अगन्म महा नमसा यविष्ठं यो दीदाय समिद्धः स्वे दुरोणे । चित्रभानुँ रोदसी अन्तरुर्वी स्वाहुतं विश्वतः प्रत्यञ्चम्
verses.transliteration: aganma mahA namasA yaviShThaM yo dIdAya samiddhaH sve duroNe | chitrabhAnu.N rodasI antarurvI svAhutaM vishvataH pratya~ncham
verses.translation: With great homage we have approached the youngest, who shone kindled in his own house — of wondrous splendor, between the wide worlds, well offered, facing all sides.

verses.sanskrit: स मह्ना विश्वा दुरितानि साह्वानग्नि ष्टवे दम आ जातवेदाः । स नो रक्षिषद्दुरितादवद्यादस्मान्गृणत उत नो मघोनः
verses.transliteration: sa mahnA vishvA duritAni sAhvAnagni ShTave dama A jAtavedAH | sa no rakShiShadduritAdavadyAdasmAngR^iNata uta no maghonaH
verses.translation: He, overcoming all evils by his greatness, Agni, I praise in the house, Jatavedas; may he protect us from evil and blame, us who sing and our bounteous ones.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं वरुण उत मित्रो अग्ने त्वां वर्धन्ति मतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः । त्वे वसु सुषणनानि सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः
verses.transliteration: tvaM varuNa uta mitro agne tvAM vardhanti matibhirvasiShThAH | tve vasu suShaNanAni santu yUyaM pAta svastibhiH sadA naH
verses.translation: You, Agni, are Varuna and Mitra; the Vasishthas strengthen you with thoughts; in you may be good wealth; protect us always with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: महाँ इन्द्रो य ओजसा पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव । स्तोमैर्वत्सस्य वावृधे
verses.transliteration: mahA.N indro ya ojasA parjanyo vR^iShTimA.N iva | stomairvatsasya vAvR^idhe
verses.translation: Great is Indra, who by strength, like rain-bringing Parjanya, has grown by the hymns of Vatsa.

verses.sanskrit: कण्वा इन्द्रं यदक्रत स्तोमैर्यज्ञस्य साधनम् । जामि ब्रुवत आयुधा
verses.transliteration: kaNvA indraM yadakrata stomairyaj~nasya sAdhanam | jAmi bruvata AyudhA
verses.translation: When the Kanvas made Indra the accomplisher of the sacrifice with hymns, they speak their weapons as kin.

verses.sanskrit: प्रजामृतस्य पिप्रतः प्र यद्भरन्त वह्नयः । विप्रा ऋतस्य वाहसा
verses.transliteration: prajAmR^itasya piprataH pra yadbharanta vahnayaH | viprA R^itasya vAhasA
verses.translation: When the carriers bear the offspring of truth, the sages carry along the truth.

verses.sanskrit: पवमानस्य जिघ्नतो हरेश्चन्द्रा असृक्षत । जीरा अजिरशोचिषः
verses.transliteration: pavamAnasya jighnato hareshchandrA asR^ikShata | jIrA ajirashochiShaH
verses.translation: The shining, swift drops of the flowing slayer, the bay one, have been released, with ageless flame.

verses.sanskrit: पवमानो रथीतमः शुभ्रेभिः शुभ्रशस्तमः । हरिश्चन्द्रो मरुद्गणः
verses.transliteration: pavamAno rathItamaH shubhrebhiH shubhrashastamaH | harishchandro marudgaNaH
verses.translation: Flowing, the best charioteer, with bright ones the most glorious in praise, the golden-bay with the Marut host.

verses.sanskrit: पवमान् व्यश्नुहि रश्मिभिर्वाजसातमः । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम्
verses.transliteration: pavamAn vyashnuhi rashmibhirvAjasAtamaH | dadhatstotre suvIryam
verses.translation: Flowing one, pervade with your rays, best winner of strength, giving heroic vigor to the praiser.

verses.sanskrit: परीतो षिञ्चता सुतँ सोमो य उत्तमँ हविः । दधन्वाँ यो नर्यो अप्स्वा३न्तरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः
verses.transliteration: parIto Shi~nchatA suta.N somo ya uttama.N haviH | dadhanvA.N yo naryo apsvA3ntarA suShAva somamadribhiH
verses.translation: Pour around the pressed soma, which is the highest oblation; the manly who is among the waters has pressed soma with stones.

verses.sanskrit: नूनं पुनानोऽविभिः परि स्रवादब्धः सुरभिन्तरः । सुते चित्वाप्सु मदामो अन्धसा श्रीणन्तो गोभिरुत्तरम्
verses.transliteration: nUnaM punAno.avibhiH pari sravAdabdhaH surabhintaraH | sute chitvApsu madAmo andhasA shrINanto gobhiruttaram
verses.translation: Now purified by the wool, flow around, unharmed, most fragrant; at the pressing, in the waters, we rejoice with the drink, mixing with cows for the higher.

verses.sanskrit: परि स्वानश्चक्षसे देवमादनः क्रतुरिन्दुर्विचक्षणः
verses.transliteration: pari svAnashchakShase devamAdanaH kraturindurvichakShaNaH
verses.translation: Sounding around for seeing, delight of the gods, the skill, the drop, the all-seeing.

verses.sanskrit: असावि सोमो अरुषो वृषा हरी राजेव दस्मो अभि गा अचिक्रदत् । पुनानो वारमत्येष्यव्ययँ श्येनो न योनिं घृतवन्तमासदत्
verses.transliteration: asAvi somo aruSho vR^iShA harI rAjeva dasmo abhi gA achikradat | punAno vAramatyeShyavyaya.N shyeno na yoniM ghR^itavantamAsadat
verses.translation: The red Soma, the bull, the bay, has been pressed, like a wondrous king; he has roared to the cows; purified, he passes the sheep's wool and sits in the ghee-rich nest like a falcon.

verses.sanskrit: पर्जन्यः पिता महिषस्य पर्णिनो नाभा पृथिव्या गिरिषु क्षयं दधे । स्वसार आपो अभि गा उदासरन्त्सं ग्रावभिर्वसते वीते अध्वरे
verses.transliteration: parjanyaH pitA mahiShasya parNino nAbhA pR^ithivyA giriShu kShayaM dadhe | svasAra Apo abhi gA udAsarantsaM grAvabhirvasate vIte adhvare
verses.translation: Parjanya, father of the great winged one, holds a dwelling on the navel of earth in the mountains; the sister waters flow toward the cows; with stones he dwells at the rite of the feast.

verses.sanskrit: कविर्वेधस्या पर्येषि माहिनमत्यो न मृष्टो अभि वाजमर्षसि । अपसेधन्दुरिता सोम नो मृड घृता वसानः परि यासि निर्णिजम्
verses.transliteration: kavirvedhasyA paryeShi mAhinamatyo na mR^iShTo abhi vAjamarShasi | apasedhanduritA soma no mR^iDa ghR^itA vasAnaH pari yAsi nirNijam
verses.translation: The seer goes around the great one by the ordainer's way; like a horse cleansed, you go toward strength; driving away evils, Soma, be gracious to us; clad in ghee, you go to the cleansing.

verses.sanskrit: श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत । वसूनि जातो जनिमान्योजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिमः
verses.transliteration: shrAyanta iva sUryaM vishvedindrasya bhakShata | vasUni jAto janimAnyojasA prati bhAgaM na dIdhimaH
verses.translation: They seek the sun as if resting; enjoy all that belongs to Indra; born, the born wins wealth by might; we shine to claim our share.

verses.sanskrit: अलर्षिरातिं वसुदामुप स्तुहि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः । यो अस्य कामं विधतो न रोषति मनो दानाय चोदयन्
verses.transliteration: alarShirAtiM vasudAmupa stuhi bhadrA indrasya rAtayaH | yo asya kAmaM vidhato na roShati mano dAnAya chodayan
verses.translation: Praise the unwearying giver, the giver of wealth; Indra's gifts are good; he who is not angered by the wish of the one who serves him, urging his mind to give.

verses.sanskrit: यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभ्यं कृधि । मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतये वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि
verses.transliteration: yata indra bhayAmahe tato no abhyaM kR^idhi | maghava~nChagdhi tava tanna Utaye vi dviSho vi mR^idho jahi
verses.translation: From whatever, Indra, we fear, from that make us safe; bounteous one, help us for our protection; drive away foes and enemies.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ हि राधस्पते राधसो महः क्षयस्यासि विध्रत्ता । तं त्वा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे
verses.transliteration: tva.N hi rAdhaspate rAdhaso mahaH kShayasyAsi vidhrattA | taM tvA vayaM maghavannindra girvaNaH sutAvanto havAmahe
verses.translation: You, lord of bounty, are the upholder of great bounty and dwelling; we, O bounteous Indra, lover of songs, having pressed, call you.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ सोमासि धारयुर्मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो अध्वरे । पवस्व मँहयद्रयिः
verses.transliteration: tva.N somAsi dhArayurmandra ojiShTho adhvare | pavasva ma.NhayadrayiH
verses.translation: You, Soma, are holding, joyful, most vigorous at the sacrifice; flow, wealth magnifying.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ सुतो मदिन्तमो दधन्वान्मत्सरिन्तमः । इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः
verses.transliteration: tva.N suto madintamo dadhanvAnmatsarintamaH | induH satrAjidastR^itaH
verses.translation: You, pressed, most exhilarating, vigorous, most joyful drop, ever-victorious, unconquered.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ सुष्वाणो अद्रिभिरभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् । द्युमन्तँ शुष्मा भर
verses.transliteration: tva.N suShvANo adribhirabhyarSha kanikradat | dyumanta.N shuShmA bhara
verses.translation: You, pressed by stones, flow roaring; bring splendid strength.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व देववीतय इन्दो धाराभिरोजसा । आ कलशं मधुमान्त्सोम नः सदः
verses.transliteration: pavasva devavItaya indo dhArAbhirojasA | A kalashaM madhumAntsoma naH sadaH
verses.translation: Flow, drop, with streams and strength for the feast of the gods; come to our vessel, honeyed Soma, sit.

verses.sanskrit: तव द्रप्सा उदप्रुत इन्द्रं मदाय वावृधुः । त्वां देवासो अमृताय कं पपुः
verses.transliteration: tava drapsA udapruta indraM madAya vAvR^idhuH | tvAM devAso amR^itAya kaM papuH
verses.translation: Your drops, water-leaping, grew Indra for exhilaration; the gods drank you for immortality.

verses.sanskrit: आ नः सुतास इन्दवः पुनाना धावता रयिम् । वृष्टिद्यावो रीत्यापः स्वर्विदः
verses.transliteration: A naH sutAsa indavaH punAnA dhAvatA rayim | vR^iShTidyAvo rItyApaH svarvidaH
verses.translation: Run to us, pressed, purifying drops, bringing wealth, the rain-giving, flowing waters, finders of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: परि त्यँ हर्यतँ हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण । यो देवान्विश्वाँ इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति
verses.transliteration: pari tya.N haryata.N hariM babhruM punanti vAreNa | yo devAnvishvA.N itpari madena saha gachChati
verses.translation: They purify with the sieve that beloved bay-brown one, who goes with exhilaration around all the gods.

verses.sanskrit: द्विर्यं पञ्च स्वयशसँ सखायो अद्रिसँहतम् । प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यं प्रस्नापयन्त ऊर्मयः
verses.transliteration: dviryaM pa~ncha svayashasa.N sakhAyo adrisa.Nhatam | priyamindrasya kAmyaM prasnApayanta UrmayaH
verses.translation: Whom the friends, twice five, of self-glory, united with the stone; the waves cleanse Indra's dear, desirable one.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे । नरे च दक्षिणावते वीराय सदनासदे
verses.transliteration: indrAya soma pAtave vR^itraghne pari Shichyase | nare cha dakShiNAvate vIrAya sadanAsade
verses.translation: For Indra, to drink, Soma, you are sprinkled around — for the Vritra-slayer, the man, and the hero who gives gifts, sitting in the seat.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम महे दक्षायाश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय
verses.transliteration: pavasva soma mahe dakShAyAshvo na nikto vAjI dhanAya
verses.translation: Flow, Soma, for great skill, like a decked horse, strong, for wealth.

verses.sanskrit: प्र ते सोतारो रसं मदाय पुनन्ति सोमं महे द्युम्नाय
verses.transliteration: pra te sotAro rasaM madAya punanti somaM mahe dyumnAya
verses.translation: The pressers cleanse for exhilaration your essence, the soma, for great splendor.

verses.sanskrit: शिशुं जज्ञानँ हरिं मृजन्ति पवित्रे सोमं देवेभ्य इन्दुम्
verses.transliteration: shishuM jaj~nAna.N hariM mR^ijanti pavitre somaM devebhya indum
verses.translation: They cleanse the newborn bay child, soma, the drop in the filter for the gods.

verses.sanskrit: उषो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् । इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः
verses.transliteration: uSho Shu jAtamapturaM gobhirbha~NgaM pariShkR^itam | induM devA ayAsiShuH
verses.translation: The gods have gone to the drop just born, water-crossing, adorned with the milk of cows.

verses.sanskrit: तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरो वत्सँ सँशिश्वरीरिव । य इन्द्रस्य हृदँसनिः
verses.transliteration: tamidvardhantu no giro vatsa.N sa.NshishvarIriva | ya indrasya hR^ida.NsaniH
verses.translation: Let our songs strengthen him, like women the calf — who is the heart's gift of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: अर्षा नः सोम शं गवे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम् । वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम्
verses.transliteration: arShA naH soma shaM gave dhukShasva pipyuShImiSham | vardhA samudramukthyam
verses.translation: Flow for us, Soma, welfare for the cow; milk the swelling nourishment; strengthen the praiseworthy ocean.

verses.sanskrit: आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा
verses.transliteration: A ghA ye agnimindhate stR^iNanti barhirAnuShak | yeShAmindro yuvA sakhA
verses.translation: Those who kindle Agni and constantly spread the grass — to them Indra is the youthful friend.

verses.sanskrit: बृहन्निदिध्म एषां भूरि शस्त्रं पृथुः स्वरुः । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा
verses.transliteration: bR^ihannididhma eShAM bhUri shastraM pR^ithuH svaruH | yeShAmindro yuvA sakhA
verses.translation: Great is the fuel of those, abundant the praise, wide the sound, of whom Indra is the youthful friend.

verses.sanskrit: अयुद्ध इद्युधा वृतँ शूर आजति सत्वभिः । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा
verses.transliteration: ayuddha idyudhA vR^ita.N shUra Ajati satvabhiH | yeShAmindro yuvA sakhA
verses.translation: The hero goes among the troops with the unfought, surrounded by fighters, of whom Indra is the youthful friend.

verses.sanskrit: य एक इद्विदयते वसु मर्त्ताय दाशुषे । ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुत इन्द्रो अङ्ग
verses.transliteration: ya eka idvidayate vasu marttAya dAshuShe | IshAno apratiShkuta indro a~Nga
verses.translation: He who alone distributes wealth to the giving mortal, the ruler, not to be gainsaid — indeed Indra.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चिद्धि त्वा बहुभ्य आ सुतावाँ आविवासति । उग्रं तत्पत्यते शव इन्द्रो अङ्ग
verses.transliteration: yashchiddhi tvA bahubhya A sutAvA.N AvivAsati | ugraM tatpatyate shava indro a~Nga
verses.translation: Whoever, for many, serves you after pressing, that fierce strength lords — indeed Indra.

verses.sanskrit: कदा मर्त्तमराधसं पदा क्षुम्पमिव स्फुरत् । कदा नः शुश्रवद्गिर इन्द्रो अङ्ग
verses.transliteration: kadA marttamarAdhasaM padA kShumpamiva sphurat | kadA naH shushravadgira indro a~Nga
verses.translation: When will he crush the ungenerous mortal under foot like a mushroom? When will Indra hear our songs?

verses.sanskrit: गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणोऽर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः । ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद्वँशमिव येमिरे
verses.transliteration: gAyanti tvA gAyatriNo.archantyarkamarkiNaH | brahmANastvA shatakrata udva.Nshamiva yemire
verses.translation: The Gayatri-singers sing to you, the hymn-makers hymn the hymn; the Brahmins, O hundred-powered, have raised you up like a bamboo pole.

verses.sanskrit: यत्सानोः सान्वारुहो भूर्यस्पष्ट कर्त्त्वम् । तदिन्द्रो अर्थं चेतति यूथेन वृष्णिरेजति
verses.transliteration: yatsAnoH sAnvAruho bhUryaspaShTa karttvam | tadindro arthaM chetati yUthena vR^iShNirejati
verses.translation: When he climbs from peak to peak, much must be done; Indra perceives the aim; the bull stirs with his herd.

verses.sanskrit: युङ्क्ष्वा हि केशिना हरी वृषणा कक्ष्यप्रा । अथा न इन्द्र सोमपा गिरामुपश्रुतिं चर
verses.transliteration: yu~NkShvA hi keshinA harI vR^iShaNA kakShyaprA | athA na indra somapA girAmupashrutiM chara
verses.translation: Yoke your two long-maned bay horses, fertile and filling the girths; then, O soma-drinking Indra, come to hear our songs.

verses.sanskrit: सुषमिद्धो न आ वह देवाँ अग्ने हविष्मते । होतः पावक यक्षि च
verses.transliteration: suShamiddho na A vaha devA.N agne haviShmate | hotaH pAvaka yakShi cha
verses.translation: Kindled well, bring the gods for the offerer, O priest, O purifier; and worship.

verses.sanskrit: मधुमन्तं तनूनपाद्यज्ञं देवेषु नः कवे । अद्या कृणुय्हूतये
verses.transliteration: madhumantaM tanUnapAdyaj~naM deveShu naH kave | adyA kR^iNuyhUtaye
verses.translation: Honeyed, O Tanunapat, make our sacrifice among the gods, O seer; today do it for the call.

verses.sanskrit: नराशँसमिह प्रियमस्मिन्यज्ञ उप ह्वये । मधुजिह्वँ हविष्कृतम्
verses.transliteration: narAsha.Nsamiha priyamasminyaj~na upa hvaye | madhujihva.N haviShkR^itam
verses.translation: I call here the dear Narashamsa to this sacrifice, honey-tongued, offering-maker.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने सुखतमे रथे देवाँ ईडित आ वह । असि होता मनुर्हितः
verses.transliteration: agne sukhatame rathe devA.N IDita A vaha | asi hotA manurhitaH
verses.translation: O Agni, in your most comfortable chariot, praised, bring the gods; you are the priest set by Manu.

verses.sanskrit: यदद्य सूर उदितेऽनागा मित्रो अर्यमा । सुवाति सविता भगः
verses.transliteration: yadadya sUra udite.anAgA mitro aryamA | suvAti savitA bhagaH
verses.translation: Today at the sun's rising may sinless Mitra, Aryaman, Savitar and Bhaga bring forth.

verses.sanskrit: सुप्रावीरस्तु स क्षयः प्र नु यामन्त्सुदानवः । ये नो अँहोऽतिपिप्रति
verses.transliteration: suprAvIrastu sa kShayaH pra nu yAmantsudAnavaH | ye no a.Nho.atipiprati
verses.translation: May that dwelling be well protected, and the good givers speedily go, who help us across sin.

verses.sanskrit: उत स्वराजो अदितिरदब्धस्य व्रतस्य ये । महो राजान ईशते
verses.transliteration: uta svarAjo aditiradabdhasya vratasya ye | maho rAjAna Ishate
verses.translation: And the self-rulers, Aditi, and those of the unharmed law, great kings, rule.

verses.sanskrit: उ त्वा मन्दन्तु सोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः । अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि
verses.transliteration: u tvA mandantu somAH kR^iNuShva rAdho adrivaH | ava brahmadviSho jahi
verses.translation: May the soma-drops delight you; make us rich, O stone-bearer; strike down the haters of prayer.

verses.sanskrit: पदा पणीनराधसो नि बाधस्व महाँ असि । न हि त्वा कश्च न प्रति
verses.transliteration: padA paNInarAdhaso ni bAdhasva mahA.N asi | na hi tvA kashcha na prati
verses.translation: Press down with your foot the ungenerous Panis; you are great; for none is equal to you.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमीशिषे सुतानामिन्द्र त्वमसुतानाम् । त्वँ राजा जनानाम्
verses.transliteration: tvamIshiShe sutAnAmindra tvamasutAnAm | tva.N rAjA janAnAm
verses.translation: You rule the pressed and the unpressed, Indra; you are king of the peoples.

verses.sanskrit: आ जागृविर्विप्र ऋतां मतीनाँ सोमः पुनानो असदच्चमूषु । सपन्ति यं मिथुनासो निकामा अध्वर्यवो रथिरासः सुहस्ताः
verses.transliteration: A jAgR^ivirvipra R^itAM matInA.N somaH punAno asadachchamUShu | sapanti yaM mithunAso nikAmA adhvaryavo rathirAsaH suhastAH
verses.translation: The wakeful sage of the thoughts of truth, Soma, flowing, sat in the vessels; to whom the pairs, the desirous, the Adhvaryus, the charioteers of fair hands, offer service.

verses.sanskrit: स पुनान उप सूरे दधान ओबे अप्रा रोदसी वि ष आवः । प्रिया चिद्यस्य प्रियसास ऊती सतो धनं कारिणे न प्र यँसत्
verses.transliteration: sa punAna upa sUre dadhAna obe aprA rodasI vi Sha AvaH | priyA chidyasya priyasAsa UtI sato dhanaM kAriNe na pra ya.Nsat
verses.translation: He, purifying, placing near the sun in the fleece, filled heaven and earth, wide; whose dear helpers, dearly gained, never withhold the wealth from the doer.

verses.sanskrit: स वर्धिता वर्धनः पूयमानः सोमो मीढ्वाँ अभि नो ज्योतिषावीत् । यत्र नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञाः स्वर्विदो अभि गा अद्रिमिष्णन्
verses.transliteration: sa vardhitA vardhanaH pUyamAnaH somo mIDhvA.N abhi no jyotiShAvIt | yatra naH pUrve pitaraH padaj~nAH svarvido abhi gA adrimiShNan
verses.translation: He the increaser, the strengthener, flowing, Soma the bountiful, has helped us with light; where our ancient fathers, knowing the step, finders of heaven, sought the cattle and the rock.

verses.sanskrit: मा चिदन्यद्वि शँसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत । इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वृषणँ सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शँसत
verses.transliteration: mA chidanyadvi sha.Nsata sakhAyo mA riShaNyata | indramitstotA vR^iShaNa.N sachA sute muhurukthA cha sha.Nsata
verses.translation: Friends, praise no other; do not wish harm. Praise Indra the bull together at the pressing, and recite the hymns again and again.

verses.sanskrit: अवक्रक्षिणं वृषभं यथा जुवं गां न चर्षणीसहम् । विद्वेषणँ संवननमुभयङ्करं मँहिष्ठमुभयाविनम्
verses.transliteration: avakrakShiNaM vR^iShabhaM yathA juvaM gAM na charShaNIsaham | vidveShaNa.N saMvananamubhaya~NkaraM ma.NhiShThamubhayAvinam
verses.translation: Not bending, the bull swift like a cow, overcoming men; hateful, desirable, doing both, the greatest, with both.

verses.sanskrit: उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिर स्तोमास ईरते । सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजन्तो रथा इव
verses.transliteration: udu tye madhumattamA gira stomAsa Irate | satrAjito dhanasA akShitotayo vAjanto rathA iva
verses.translation: These sweetest songs and hymns of praise rise up — victory-winning, wealth-giving, unfailing helpers, striving like chariots.

verses.sanskrit: कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद्धीतमाशत । इन्द्रँ स्तोमेभिर्महयन्त आयवः प्रियमेधासो अस्वरन्
verses.transliteration: kaNvA iva bhR^igavaH sUryA iva vishvamiddhItamAshata | indra.N stomebhirmahayanta AyavaH priyamedhAso asvaran
verses.translation: Like the Kanvas and the Bhrigus, like suns, they obtained all that thought desired; the Ayus, glorifying Indra with hymns, the Priyamedhas sounded.

verses.sanskrit: पर्यू षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः । द्विषस्तरध्या ऋणया न ईरसे
verses.transliteration: paryU Shu pra dhanva vAjasAtaye pari vR^itrANi sakShaNiH | dviShastaradhyA R^iNayA na Irase
verses.translation: Flow well around for the winning of strength; overcoming Vritras all around; you pass over the enemies, you drive us to pay debts.

verses.sanskrit: अजीजनो हि पवमान सूर्यं विधारे शक्मना पयः । गोजीरया रँहमानः पुरन्ध्या
verses.transliteration: ajIjano hi pavamAna sUryaM vidhAre shakmanA payaH | gojIrayA ra.NhamAnaH purandhyA
verses.translation: You have brought forth the sun, flowing one, and in the rite by skill the milk; rushing with cow-quickening thought.

verses.sanskrit: अनु हि त्वा सुतँ सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये । वाजाँ अभि पवमान प्र गाहसे
verses.transliteration: anu hi tvA suta.N soma madAmasi mahe samaryarAjye | vAjA.N abhi pavamAna pra gAhase
verses.translation: We have rejoiced in you, pressed Soma, for great sovereignty in the battle; as you flow, you plunge into strengths.

verses.sanskrit: परि प्र धन्वेन्द्राय सोम स्वादुर्मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय
verses.transliteration: pari pra dhanvendrAya soma svAdurmitrAya pUShNe bhagAya
verses.translation: Flow around, O Soma, for Indra, sweet, for Mitra, Pushan and Bhaga.

verses.sanskrit: एवामृताय महे क्षयाय स शुक्रो अर्ष दिव्यः पीयूषः
verses.transliteration: evAmR^itAya mahe kShayAya sa shukro arSha divyaH pIyUShaH
verses.translation: Thus for the immortal great dwelling, flow bright, divine, nectar.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्ते सोम सुतस्य पेयात्क्रत्वे दक्षाय विश्वे च देवाः
verses.transliteration: indraste soma sutasya peyAtkratve dakShAya vishve cha devAH
verses.translation: May Indra drink of your pressed soma for skill and strength, and all the gods.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो द्रावयित्नवो मत्सरासः प्रसुतः साकमीरते । तन्तुं ततं परि सर्गास आशवो नेन्द्रादृते पवते धाम किं चन
verses.transliteration: sUryasyeva rashmayo drAvayitnavo matsarAsaH prasutaH sAkamIrate | tantuM tataM pari sargAsa Ashavo nendrAdR^ite pavate dhAma kiM chana
verses.translation: Like the sun's rays, the quickening, exhilarating ones, pressed forth, are sent together; the swift ones spread around the stretched thread; nothing flows to its abode without Indra.

verses.sanskrit: उपो मतिः पृच्यते सिच्यते मधु मन्द्राजनी चोदते अन्तरासनि । पवमानः सन्तनिः सुन्वतामिव मधुमान्द्रप्सः परि वारमर्षति
verses.transliteration: upo matiH pR^ichyate sichyate madhu mandrAjanI chodate antarAsani | pavamAnaH santaniH sunvatAmiva madhumAndrapsaH pari vAramarShati
verses.translation: The thought is mingled, honey is poured; the joyful one is urged within the mouth; the flowing continuous one, like the pressers', honeyed drop flows toward the sheep's wool.

verses.sanskrit: उक्षा मिमेति प्रति यन्ति धेनवो देवस्य देवीरुप यन्ति निष्कृतम् । अत्यक्रमीदर्जुनं वारमव्ययमत्कं न निक्तं परि सोमो अव्यत
verses.transliteration: ukShA mimeti prati yanti dhenavo devasya devIrupa yanti niShkR^itam | atyakramIdarjunaM vAramavyayamatkaM na niktaM pari somo avyata
verses.translation: The bull measures out, the cows go to meet him; they go to the divine one's appointed place; he passed beyond the white woolen sieve, Soma purified as a cleansed cloth.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं नरो दीधितिभिररण्योर्हस्तच्युतं जनयत प्रशस्तम् । दूरेदृशं गृहपतिमथव्युम्
verses.transliteration: agniM naro dIdhitibhiraraNyorhastachyutaM janayata prashastam | dUredR^ishaM gR^ihapatimathavyum
verses.translation: Men with their fingers bring forth Agni from the two fire-sticks, the praised one released from the hand, the far-seeing lord of the house.

verses.sanskrit: तमग्निमस्ते वसवो न्यृण्वन्त्सुप्रतिचक्षमवसे कुतश्चित् । दक्षाय्यो यो दम आस नित्यः
verses.transliteration: tamagnimaste vasavo nyR^iNvantsupratichakShamavase kutashchit | dakShAyyo yo dama Asa nityaH
verses.translation: That Agni the Vasus set down at the dwelling, well seen, for help from anywhere — the skilful one, who was ever in the house.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेद्धो अग्ने दीदिहि पुरो नोऽजस्रया सूर्म्या यविष्ठ । त्वाँ शश्वन्त उप यन्ति वाजाः
verses.transliteration: preddho agne dIdihi puro no.ajasrayA sUrmyA yaviShTha | tvA.N shashvanta upa yanti vAjAH
verses.translation: Kindled, Agni, shine in front of us with ceaseless flame, O youngest; to you the eternal strengths come.

verses.sanskrit: आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन्मातरं पुरः । पितरं च प्रयन्त्स्वः
verses.transliteration: AyaM gauH pR^ishnirakramIdasadanmAtaraM puraH | pitaraM cha prayantsvaH
verses.translation: This dappled bull has come, he sat before his mother, and the father, going to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अन्तश्चरति रोचनास्य प्राणादपानती । व्यख्यन्महिषो दिवम्
verses.transliteration: antashcharati rochanAsya prANAdapAnatI | vyakhyanmahiSho divam
verses.translation: Within moves its light, breathing out from breath; the great one has lit up the sky.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिँशद्धाम वि राजति वाक्पतङ्गाय धीयते । प्रति वस्तोरह द्युभिः
verses.transliteration: tri.NshaddhAma vi rAjati vAkpata~NgAya dhIyate | prati vastoraha dyubhiH
verses.translation: The thirty-seat abode shines; speech is set for the bird; in front of the dwelling by days.

verses.sanskrit: उपप्रयन्तो अध्वरं मन्त्रं वोचेमाग्नये । आरे अस्मे च शृण्वते
verses.transliteration: upaprayanto adhvaraM mantraM vochemAgnaye | Are asme cha shR^iNvate
verses.translation: Approaching the sacrifice, let us speak a mantra to Agni, who hears both near and far.

verses.sanskrit: यः स्नीहितीषु पूर्व्यः सञ्जग्मानासु कृष्टिषु । अरक्षद्दाशुषे गयम्
verses.transliteration: yaH snIhitIShu pUrvyaH sa~njagmAnAsu kR^iShTiShu | arakShaddAshuShe gayam
verses.translation: Who was first among the loving, the united peoples — he protected the house for the giver.

verses.sanskrit: स नो वेदो अमात्यमग्नी रक्षतु शन्तमः । उतास्मान्पात्वँहसः
verses.transliteration: sa no vedo amAtyamagnI rakShatu shantamaH | utAsmAnpAtva.NhasaH
verses.translation: May the most comfortable Agni protect our wealth in the house, and guard us from distress.

verses.sanskrit: उत ब्रुवन्तु जन्तव उदग्निर्वृत्रहाजनि । धनञ्जयो रणेरणे
verses.transliteration: uta bruvantu jantava udagnirvR^itrahAjani | dhana~njayo raNeraNe
verses.translation: Let the creatures also say: Agni, the Vritra-slayer, has been born, the winner of wealth in battle after battle.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने युङ्क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वासो देव साधवः । अरं वहन्त्याशवः
verses.transliteration: agne yu~NkShvA hi ye tavAshvAso deva sAdhavaH | araM vahantyAshavaH
verses.translation: O Agni, yoke your horses, god — the good, swift ones that carry you well.

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा नो याह्या वहाभि प्रयाँसि वीतये । आ देवान्त्सोमपीतये
verses.transliteration: achChA no yAhyA vahAbhi prayA.Nsi vItaye | A devAntsomapItaye
verses.translation: Come to us, bring to the feast the offerings, bring the gods to drink the soma.

verses.sanskrit: उदग्ने भारत द्युमदजस्रेण दविद्युतत् । शोचा वि भाह्यजर
verses.transliteration: udagne bhArata dyumadajasreNa davidyutat | shochA vi bhAhyajara
verses.translation: Arise, Agni, Bharata, shine brilliantly with ceaseless light; blaze, shine, ageless one.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सुन्वानायान्धसो मर्त्तो न वष्ट तद्वचः । अप श्वानमराधसँ हता मखं न भृगवः
verses.transliteration: pra sunvAnAyAndhaso martto na vaShTa tadvachaH | apa shvAnamarAdhasa.N hatA makhaM na bhR^igavaH
verses.translation: Let the mortal not desire that speech of the pressed stalk; drive away the grudging dog, as the Bhrigus smote the sacrifice-spoiler.

verses.sanskrit: आ जामिरत्के अव्यत भुजे न पुत्र ओण्योः । सरज्जारो न योषणां वरो न योनिमासदम्
verses.transliteration: A jAmiratke avyata bhuje na putra oNyoH | sarajjAro na yoShaNAM varo na yonimAsadam
verses.translation: The kinsman has come to the dwelling like a child to be nourished in the two enclosures; like a lover to a woman, like a bridegroom to the home.

verses.sanskrit: स वीरो दक्षसाधनो वि यस्तस्तम्भ रोदसी । हरिः पवित्रे अव्यत वेधा न योनिमासदम्
verses.transliteration: sa vIro dakShasAdhano vi yastastambha rodasI | hariH pavitre avyata vedhA na yonimAsadam
verses.translation: That hero, accomplisher of skill, who propped heaven and earth, the bay one in the filter, the ordainer sitting in his seat.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि । युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे
verses.transliteration: abhrAtR^ivyo anA tvamanApirindra januShA sanAdasi | yudhedApitvamichChase
verses.translation: Without a rival, without kin, you, Indra, have been forever by nature; for battle you wish for kinship.

verses.sanskrit: न की रेवन्तँ सख्याय विन्दसे पीयन्ति ते सुराश्वः । यदा कृणोषि नदनुँ समूहस्यादित्पितेव हूयसे
verses.transliteration: na kI revanta.N sakhyAya vindase pIyanti te surAshvaH | yadA kR^iNoShi nadanu.N samUhasyAditpiteva hUyase
verses.translation: You find no wealthy man for friendship; your horses drink well; when you make the sound, then you are invoked like a father.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये । ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये
verses.transliteration: A tvA sahasramA shataM yuktA rathe hiraNyaye | brahmayujo haraya indra keshino vahantu somapItaye
verses.translation: May a thousand, a hundred, yoked to your golden chariot, your prayer-yoked, long-maned bay horses carry you, Indra, to drink the soma.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा रथे हिरण्यये हरी मयूरशेप्या । शितिपृष्ठा वहतां मध्वो अन्धसो विवक्षणस्य पीतये
verses.transliteration: A tvA rathe hiraNyaye harI mayUrashepyA | shitipR^iShThA vahatAM madhvo andhaso vivakShaNasya pItaye
verses.translation: May your two bay horses with peacock plumes, dun-backed, carry you in the golden chariot to drink the honeyed, enjoyed drink.

verses.sanskrit: पिबा त्वा३स्य गिर्वणः सुतस्य पूर्वपा इव । परिष्कृतस्य रसिन इयमासुतिश्चारुर्मदाय पत्यते
verses.transliteration: pibA tvA3sya girvaNaH sutasya pUrvapA iva | pariShkR^itasya rasina iyamAsutishchArurmadAya patyate
verses.translation: Drink of this pressed soma, lover of songs, like the first drinkers; this pouring of the adorned, juicy one goes for exhilaration, lovely.

verses.sanskrit: आ सोता परि षिञ्चताश्वं न स्तोममप्तुरँ रजस्तुरम् । वनप्रक्षमुदप्रुतम्
verses.transliteration: A sotA pari Shi~nchatAshvaM na stomamaptura.N rajasturam | vanaprakShamudaprutam
verses.translation: Come, pressers, pour around, like a swift horse, a hymn that crosses the air, wood-sprinkled, water-leaping.

verses.sanskrit: सहस्रधारं वृषभं पयोदुहं प्रियं देवाय जन्मने । ऋतेन य ऋतजातो विवावृधे राजा देव ऋतं बृहत्
verses.transliteration: sahasradhAraM vR^iShabhaM payoduhaM priyaM devAya janmane | R^itena ya R^itajAto vivAvR^idhe rAjA deva R^itaM bR^ihat
verses.translation: The thousand-streamed bull, milking milk, dear to the god at his birth, who, born by truth, grew by truth; king, god, the great truth.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्वृत्राणि जङ्घनद्द्रविणस्युर्विपन्यया । समिद्धः शुक्र आहुतः
verses.transliteration: agnirvR^itrANi ja~NghanaddraviNasyurvipanyayA | samiddhaH shukra AhutaH
verses.translation: Agni, kindled, bright and well-fed with offerings, strikes down obstacles; seeking wealth, he is praised with devotion.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भे मातुः पितुष्पिता विदिद्युतानो अक्षरे । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा
verses.transliteration: garbhe mAtuH pituShpitA vididyutAno akShare | sIdannR^itasya yonimA
verses.translation: In the mother's womb, father of the father, shining in the imperishable, sitting in the seat of truth.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म प्रजावदा भर जातवेदो विचर्षणे । अग्ने यद्दीदयद्दिवि
verses.transliteration: brahma prajAvadA bhara jAtavedo vicharShaNe | agne yaddIdayaddivi
verses.translation: Bring a prayer with offspring, Jatavedas, all-seeing, Agni, who shine in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य प्रेषा हेमना पूयमानो देवो देवेभिः समपृक्त रसम् । सुतः पवित्रं पर्येति रेभन्मितेव सद्म पशुमन्ति होता
verses.transliteration: asya preShA hemanA pUyamAno devo devebhiH samapR^ikta rasam | sutaH pavitraM paryeti rebhanmiteva sadma pashumanti hotA
verses.translation: Purified by the golden sending forth, the god mingled his essence with the gods; the pressed one goes around the filter roaring, like the priest around a house rich in cattle.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रा वस्त्रा समन्याऽऽ३ वसानो महान्कविर्निवचनानि शँसन् । आ वच्यस्व चम्वोः पूयमानो विचक्षणो जागृविर्देववीतौ
verses.transliteration: bhadrA vastrA samanyA.a.a3 vasAno mahAnkavirnivachanAni sha.Nsan | A vachyasva chamvoH pUyamAno vichakShaNo jAgR^ivirdevavItau
verses.translation: Clothing himself with auspicious garments, the great seer, speaking words, be proclaimed, purified in the vessels, all-seeing, wakeful at the gods' feast.

verses.sanskrit: समु प्रियो मृज्यते सानो अव्ये यशस्तरो यशसां क्षैतो अस्मे । अभि स्वर धन्वा पूयमानो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः
verses.transliteration: samu priyo mR^ijyate sAno avye yashastaro yashasAM kShaito asme | abhi svara dhanvA pUyamAno yUyaM pAta svastibhiH sadA naH
verses.translation: The dear one is cleansed on the woolen ridge, the most famous of the famed, the dweller with us; sound, bow, being purified; protect us always with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रँ स्तवाम शुद्धँ शुद्धेन साम्ना । शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वाँसँ शुद्धैराशीर्वान्ममत्तु
verses.transliteration: eto nvindra.N stavAma shuddha.N shuddhena sAmnA | shuddhairukthairvAvR^idhvA.Nsa.N shuddhairAshIrvAnmamattu
verses.translation: Come, let us praise Indra, the pure, with a pure song; with pure hymns he grows; may he rejoice with pure blessings.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र शुद्धो न आ गहि शुद्धः शुद्धाभिरूतिभिः । शुद्धो रयिं नि धारय शुद्धो ममद्धि सोम्य
verses.transliteration: indra shuddho na A gahi shuddhaH shuddhAbhirUtibhiH | shuddho rayiM ni dhAraya shuddho mamaddhi somya
verses.translation: Come to us pure, Indra, pure with pure helps; pure, bestow wealth; pure, rejoice, soma-drinker.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र शुद्धो हि नो रयिँ शुद्धो रत्नानि दाशुषे । शुद्धो वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे शुद्धो वाजँ सिषाससि
verses.transliteration: indra shuddho hi no rayi.N shuddho ratnAni dAshuShe | shuddho vR^itrANi jighnase shuddho vAja.N siShAsasi
verses.translation: Pure, Indra, give us wealth; pure, give jewels to the giver; pure, you slay Vritras; pure, you seek strength.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने स्तोमं मनामहे सिध्रमद्य दिविस्पृशः । देवस्य द्रविणस्यवः
verses.transliteration: agne stomaM manAmahe sidhramadya divispR^ishaH | devasya draviNasyavaH
verses.translation: Agni, we think of the hymn, the effective one, today, touching heaven, we who seek the god's wealth.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्जुषत नो गिरो होता यो मानुषेष्वा । स यक्षद्दैव्यं जनम्
verses.transliteration: agnirjuShata no giro hotA yo mAnuSheShvA | sa yakShaddaivyaM janam
verses.translation: May Agni accept our songs — the priest among men; may he worship the divine host.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने सप्रथा असि जुष्टो होता वरेण्यः । त्वया यज्ञं वि तन्वते
verses.transliteration: tvamagne saprathA asi juShTo hotA vareNyaH | tvayA yaj~naM vi tanvate
verses.translation: You, Agni, are wide, welcomed, the choice priest; by you they extend the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्रिपृष्ठं वृषणं वयोधामाङ्गोषिणमवावशन्त वाणीः । वना वसानो वरुणो न सिन्धूर्वि रत्नधा दयते वार्याणि
verses.transliteration: abhi tripR^iShThaM vR^iShaNaM vayodhAmA~NgoShiNamavAvashanta vANIH | vanA vasAno varuNo na sindhUrvi ratnadhA dayate vAryANi
