verses.translation: The voices have desired the three-backed bull, giver of vigor, the one sounding; clothed in woods like Varuna in rivers, the jewel-giver distributes desirable things.

verses.sanskrit: शूरग्रामः सर्ववीरः सहावान्जेता पवस्व सनिता धनानि । तिग्मायुधः क्षिप्रधन्वा समत्स्वषाढः साह्वान्पृतनासु शत्रून्
verses.transliteration: shUragrAmaH sarvavIraH sahAvAnjetA pavasva sanitA dhanAni | tigmAyudhaH kShipradhanvA samatsvaShADhaH sAhvAnpR^itanAsu shatrUn
verses.translation: The troop of heroes, with all heroes, strong, victorious, flow as winner of wealth; sharp-armed, swift-bowed, unconquerable in battles, overcoming foes in armies.

verses.sanskrit: उरुगव्यूतिरभयानि कृण्वन्त्समीचीने आ पवस्वा पुरन्धी । अपः सिषासन्नुषसः स्वा३र्गाः सं चिक्रदो महो अस्मभ्यं वाजान्
verses.transliteration: urugavyUtirabhayAni kR^iNvantsamIchIne A pavasvA purandhI | apaH siShAsannuShasaH svA3rgAH saM chikrado maho asmabhyaM vAjAn
verses.translation: Wide-pastured, making fearless, flow together to the two, O plentiful; seeking waters, dawns, heaven and cattle, roar greatly to bring us strength.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पतिः । त्वं वृत्राणि हँस्यप्रतीन्येक इत्पुर्वनुत्तश्चर्षणीधृतिः
verses.transliteration: tvamindra yashA asyR^ijIShI shavasaspatiH | tvaM vR^itrANi ha.NsyapratInyeka itpurvanuttashcharShaNIdhR^itiH
verses.translation: You, Indra, are glorious, the receiver of the pressed soma, lord of strength; you alone slay the unopposed Vritras, the supporter of peoples, urged on by many.

verses.sanskrit: तमु त्वा नूनमसुर प्रचेतसँ राधो भागमिवेमहे । महीव कृत्तिः शरणा त इन्द्र प्र ते सुम्ना नो अश्नवन्
verses.transliteration: tamu tvA nUnamasura prachetasa.N rAdho bhAgamivemahe | mahIva kR^ittiH sharaNA ta indra pra te sumnA no ashnavan
verses.translation: Him indeed, now, O lord, the wise, we ask for bounty as a share; like a great protective hide are your shelters, Indra; may your favors reach us.

verses.sanskrit: यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: yajiShThaM tvA vavR^imahe devaM devatrA hotAramamartyam | asya yaj~nasya sukratum
verses.translation: We choose you, best of sacrificers, god, among the gods, the immortal priest, skilful in this sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अपां नपातँ सुभगँ सुदीदितिमग्निमु श्रेष्ठशोचिषम् । स नो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य सो अपामा सुम्नं यक्षते दिवि
verses.transliteration: apAM napAta.N subhaga.N sudIditimagnimu shreShThashochiSham | sa no mitrasya varuNasya so apAmA sumnaM yakShate divi
verses.translation: Agni, the grandson of the waters, fortunate, well-shining, of best flame; may he give us the favor of Mitra and Varuna and of the waters in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यमग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यमवा वाजेषु यं जुनाः । स यन्ता शश्वतीरिषः
verses.transliteration: yamagne pR^itsu martyamavA vAjeShu yaM junAH | sa yantA shashvatIriShaH
verses.translation: The mortal, O Agni, whom you aid in battles, whom you urge in contests — he restrains eternal strengths.

verses.sanskrit: न किरस्य सहन्त्य पर्येता कयस्य चित् । वाजो अस्ति श्रवाय्यः
verses.transliteration: na kirasya sahantya paryetA kayasya chit | vAjo asti shravAyyaH
verses.translation: None overcomes his going around of any; strength is praiseworthy.

verses.sanskrit: स वाजं विश्वचर्षणिरर्वद्भिरस्तु तरुता । विप्रेभिरस्तु सनिता
verses.transliteration: sa vAjaM vishvacharShaNirarvadbhirastu tarutA | viprebhirastu sanitA
verses.translation: May he, all-seeing, be crossing strength with horses; may he be a winner with the sages.

verses.sanskrit: साकमुक्षो मर्जयन्त स्वसारो दश धीरस्य धीतयो धनुत्रीः । हरिः पर्यद्रवज्जाः सूर्यस्य द्रोणं ननक्षे अत्यो न वाजी
verses.transliteration: sAkamukSho marjayanta svasAro dasha dhIrasya dhItayo dhanutrIH | hariH paryadravajjAH sUryasya droNaM nanakShe atyo na vAjI
verses.translation: Together the ten sisters, the thoughts of the wise, the pressing hands, cleansed the bull; the bay one ran around, born of the sun; like a swift horse he reached the trough.

verses.sanskrit: सं मातृभिर्न शिशुर्वावशानो वृषा दधन्वे पुरुवारो अद्भिः । मर्यो न योषामभि निष्कृतं यन्त्सं गच्छते कलश उस्रियाभिः
verses.transliteration: saM mAtR^ibhirna shishurvAvashAno vR^iShA dadhanve puruvAro adbhiH | maryo na yoShAmabhi niShkR^itaM yantsaM gachChate kalasha usriyAbhiH
verses.translation: Like a child longing with his mothers, the bull is held by the waters, much-chosen; like a man to a woman he goes to the appointed place; he joins the vessel with the milk.

verses.sanskrit: उत प्र पिप्य ऊधरघ्न्याया इन्दुर्धाराभिः सचते सुमेधाः । मूर्धानं गावः पयसा चमूष्वभि श्रीणन्ति वसुभिर्न निक्तैः
verses.transliteration: uta pra pipya UdharaghnyAyA indurdhArAbhiH sachate sumedhAH | mUrdhAnaM gAvaH payasA chamUShvabhi shrINanti vasubhirna niktaiH
verses.translation: The udder of the cow has swelled; the drop with streams joins the wise; the cows with milk in the vessels mix at the head, with bright garments.

verses.sanskrit: पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः । आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्ये वृधे३ऽस्माँ अवन्तु ते धियः
verses.transliteration: pibA sutasya rasino matsvA na indra gomataH | Apirno bodhi sadhamAdye vR^idhe3.asmA.N avantu te dhiyaH
verses.translation: Drink the flavored pressed soma, Indra, and rejoice for us, rich in cattle; be our kinsman in the shared feast; may your thoughts protect us.

verses.sanskrit: भूयाम ते सुमतौ वाजिनो वयं मा न स्तरभिमातये । अस्मां चित्राभिरवतादभिष्टिभिरा नः सुम्नेषु यामय
verses.transliteration: bhUyAma te sumatau vAjino vayaM mA na starabhimAtaye | asmAM chitrAbhiravatAdabhiShTibhirA naH sumneShu yAmaya
verses.translation: May we be in your favor, O racer; do not cast us down to the enemy; protect us with wondrous helps, bring us to your good fortunes.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिरस्मै सप्त धेनवो दुदुह्रिरे सत्यामाशिरं परमे व्योमनि । चत्वार्यन्या भुवनानि निर्णिजे चारूणि चक्रे यदृतैरवर्धत
verses.transliteration: trirasmai sapta dhenavo duduhrire satyAmAshiraM parame vyomani | chatvAryanyA bhuvanAni nirNije chArUNi chakre yadR^itairavardhata
verses.translation: For him seven cows yielded thrice the true mixture in the highest sky; the other four worlds he made lovely for adornment when he grew by the truths.

verses.sanskrit: स भक्षमाणो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे द्यावा काव्येना वि शश्रथे । तेजिष्ठा अपो मँहना परि व्यत यदी देवस्य श्रवसा सदो विदुः
verses.transliteration: sa bhakShamANo amR^itasya chAruNa ubhe dyAvA kAvyenA vi shashrathe | tejiShThA apo ma.NhanA pari vyata yadI devasya shravasA sado viduH
verses.translation: He, enjoying the lovely immortality, shook both heaven and earth with poetry; the sharpest waters surrounded him by greatness when they knew the seat by the god's fame.

verses.sanskrit: ते अस्य सन्तु केतवोऽमृत्यवोऽदाभ्यासो जनुषी उभे अनु । येभिर्नृम्णा च देव्या च पुनत आदिद्राजानं मनना अगृभ्णत
verses.transliteration: te asya santu ketavo.amR^ityavo.adAbhyAso januShI ubhe anu | yebhirnR^imNA cha devyA cha punata AdidrAjAnaM mananA agR^ibhNata
verses.translation: May these banners of his be immortal, unconquerable, following both births; by which he purifies manly and divine strengths and then the kings grasp him with thought.

verses.sanskrit: अभि वायुं वीत्यर्षा गृणानो३ऽभि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः । अभी नरं धीजवनँ रथेष्ठामभीन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुम्
verses.transliteration: abhi vAyuM vItyarShA gR^iNAno3.abhi mitrAvaruNA pUyamAnaH | abhI naraM dhIjavana.N ratheShThAmabhIndraM vR^iShaNaM vajrabAhum
verses.translation: Flow toward Vayu for the feast, praised; toward Mitra and Varuna, purified; toward the man swift as thought, standing on the chariot; toward Indra, the bull, with thunderbolt in his arms.

verses.sanskrit: अभि वस्त्रा सुवसनान्यर्षाभि धेनूः सुदुघाः पूयमानः । अभि चन्द्रा भर्त्तवे नो हिरण्याभ्यश्वान्रथिनो देव सोम
verses.transliteration: abhi vastrA suvasanAnyarShAbhi dhenUH sudughAH pUyamAnaH | abhi chandrA bharttave no hiraNyAbhyashvAnrathino deva soma
verses.translation: Flow toward fair garments, toward good-milking cows, purified; toward shining gold for our bearing, toward horses and chariot-warriors, god Soma.

verses.sanskrit: अभी नो अर्ष दिव्या वसून्यभि विश्वा पार्थिवा पूयमानः । अभि येन द्रविणमश्नवामाभ्यार्षेयं जमदग्निवन्नः
verses.transliteration: abhI no arSha divyA vasUnyabhi vishvA pArthivA pUyamAnaH | abhi yena draviNamashnavAmAbhyArSheyaM jamadagnivannaH
verses.translation: Flow to us toward heavenly treasures, toward all earthly ones, purified; flow to us by which we may gain wealth, the Arsheya, like Jamadagni.

verses.sanskrit: यज्जायथा अपूर्व्य मघवन्वृत्रहत्याय । तत्पृथिवीमप्रथयस्तदस्तभ्ना उतो दिवम्
verses.transliteration: yajjAyathA apUrvya maghavanvR^itrahatyAya | tatpR^ithivImaprathayastadastabhnA uto divam
verses.translation: When you were born, unprecedented, bounteous, for the slaying of Vritra, then you spread the earth and also propped up heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तत्ते यज्ञो अजायत तदर्क उत हस्कृतिः । तद्विश्वमभिभूरसि यज्जातं यच्च जन्त्वम्
verses.transliteration: tatte yaj~no ajAyata tadarka uta haskR^itiH | tadvishvamabhibhUrasi yajjAtaM yachcha jantvam
verses.translation: From that the sacrifice was born, from that the hymn and the sound; you overcome all that is born and that will be born.

verses.sanskrit: आमासु पक्वमैरय आ सूर्यँ रोहयो दिवि । घर्मं न सामं तपता सुवृक्तिभिर्जुष्टं गिर्वणसे बृहत्
verses.transliteration: AmAsu pakvamairaya A sUrya.N rohayo divi | gharmaM na sAmaM tapatA suvR^iktibhirjuShTaM girvaNase bR^ihat
verses.translation: You sent the ripened milk into the raw, you raised the Sun in heaven; heat the Saman like the hot milk with fair praises, the great song pleasing to the lover of hymns.

verses.sanskrit: मत्स्यपायि ते महः पात्रस्येव हरिवो मत्सरो मदः । वृषा ते वृष्ण इन्दुर्वाजी सहस्रसातमः
verses.transliteration: matsyapAyi te mahaH pAtrasyeva harivo matsaro madaH | vR^iShA te vR^iShNa indurvAjI sahasrasAtamaH
verses.translation: Your great, delighting exhilaration, O bay-horsed, has been drunk like a cup; your drop, the bull's, is a racer, the best winner of thousands.

verses.sanskrit: आ नस्ते गन्तु मत्सरो वृषा मदो वरेण्यः । सहावाँ इन्द्र सानसिः पृतनषाडमर्त्यः
verses.transliteration: A naste gantu matsaro vR^iShA mado vareNyaH | sahAvA.N indra sAnasiH pR^itanaShADamartyaH
verses.translation: May your delighting, bull-like, choice exhilaration come to us, Indra, strong, victorious, conquering armies, immortal.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ हि शूरः सनिता चोदयो मनुषो रथम् । सहावान्दस्युमव्रतमोषः पात्रं न शोचिषा
verses.transliteration: tva.N hi shUraH sanitA chodayo manuSho ratham | sahAvAndasyumavratamoShaH pAtraM na shochiShA
verses.translation: For you are a hero, the winner; urge the chariot of Manu; strong, you burned the lawless Dasyu like a vessel with flame.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व वृष्टिमा सु नोऽपामूर्मिं दिवस्परि । अयक्ष्मा बृहतीरिषः
verses.transliteration: pavasva vR^iShTimA su no.apAmUrmiM divaspari | ayakShmA bR^ihatIriShaH
verses.translation: Flow us rain, the wave of waters from heaven, and great strengths free from disease.

verses.sanskrit: तया पवस्व धारया यया गाव इहागमन् । जन्यास उप नो गृहम्
verses.transliteration: tayA pavasva dhArayA yayA gAva ihAgaman | janyAsa upa no gR^iham
verses.translation: Flow with that stream by which the cows came here, the folk to our house.

verses.sanskrit: घृतं पवस्व धारया यज्ञेषु देववीतमः । अस्मभ्यं वृष्टिमा पव
verses.transliteration: ghR^itaM pavasva dhArayA yaj~neShu devavItamaH | asmabhyaM vR^iShTimA pava
verses.translation: Flow ghee with the stream, best at the gods' feast in the sacrifices; flow rain to us.

verses.sanskrit: स न ऊर्जे व्या३व्ययं पवित्रं धाव धारया । देवासः शृणवन्हि कम्
verses.transliteration: sa na Urje vyA3vyayaM pavitraM dhAva dhArayA | devAsaH shR^iNavanhi kam
verses.translation: For strength, run through the woolen filter with the stream; the gods hear for happiness.

verses.sanskrit: पवमानो असिष्यदद्रक्षाँस्यपजङ्घनत् । प्रत्नवद्रोचयन्रुचः
verses.transliteration: pavamAno asiShyadadrakShA.Nsyapaja~Nghanat | pratnavadrochayanruchaH
verses.translation: Flowing, he ran, smiting the demons, making the lights shine as of old.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यस्मै पिपीषते विश्वानि विदुषे भर । अरङ्गमाय जग्मयेऽपश्चादध्वने नरः
verses.transliteration: pratyasmai pipIShate vishvAni viduShe bhara | ara~NgamAya jagmaye.apashchAdadhvane naraH
verses.translation: Bring everything in turn to him, the knower, who wishes to drink; to the ready, the active, the one who goes forward and not back, O men.

verses.sanskrit: एमेनं प्रत्येतन सोमेभिः सोमपातमम् । अमत्रेभिरृजीषिणमिन्द्रँ सुतेभिरिन्दुभिः
verses.transliteration: emenaM pratyetana somebhiH somapAtamam | amatrebhirR^ijIShiNamindra.N sutebhirindubhiH
verses.translation: Come to him with the somas, the best soma-drinker; with cups, the master of the residue, Indra, with the pressed drops.

verses.sanskrit: यदी सुतेभिरिन्दुभिः सोमेभिः प्रतिभूषथ । वेदा विश्वस्य मेधिरो धृषत्तन्तमिदेषते
verses.transliteration: yadI sutebhirindubhiH somebhiH pratibhUShatha | vedA vishvasya medhiro dhR^iShattantamideShate
verses.translation: If you adorn him with the pressed drops, the somas — the wise knower of all seeks him the bold one.

verses.sanskrit: अस्मास्मा इदन्धसोऽध्वर्यो प्र भरा सुतम् । कुवित्समस्य जेन्यस्य शर्धतोऽभिशस्तेरवस्वरत्
verses.transliteration: asmAsmA idandhaso.adhvaryo pra bharA sutam | kuvitsamasya jenyasya shardhato.abhishasteravasvarat
verses.translation: For him alone bring the pressed stalk, Adhvaryu; often he has given voice against the curse of the victorious one who strives.

verses.sanskrit: बभ्रवे नु स्वतवसेऽरुणाय दिविस्पृशे । सोमाय गाथमर्चत
verses.transliteration: babhrave nu svatavase.aruNAya divispR^ishe | somAya gAthamarchata
verses.translation: Sing a song to Soma, the brown, self-strong, ruddy, touching heaven.

verses.sanskrit: हस्तच्युतेभिरद्रिभिः सुतँ सोमं पुनीतन । मधावा धावता मधु
verses.transliteration: hastachyutebhiradribhiH suta.N somaM punItana | madhAvA dhAvatA madhu
verses.translation: Cleanse the pressed soma with stones released from the hand; run, honey-bearer, run, honey.

verses.sanskrit: नमसेदुप सीदत दध्नेदभि श्रीणीतन । इन्दुमिन्द्रे दधातन
verses.transliteration: namasedupa sIdata dadhnedabhi shrINItana | indumindre dadhAtana
verses.translation: With homage sit near; with curds mix; place the drop in Indra.

verses.sanskrit: अमित्रहा विचर्षणिः पवस्व सोम शं गवे । देवेभ्यो अनुकामकृत्
verses.transliteration: amitrahA vicharShaNiH pavasva soma shaM gave | devebhyo anukAmakR^it
verses.translation: Foe-slayer, all-seeing, flow, Soma, for the welfare of the cow, fulfilling the wishes of the gods.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे मदाय परि षिच्यसे । मनश्चिन्मनसस्पतिः
verses.transliteration: indrAya soma pAtave madAya pari Shichyase | manashchinmanasaspatiH
verses.translation: For Indra to drink, Soma, you are poured around for exhilaration, the mind, lord of mind.

verses.sanskrit: पवमान सुवीर्यँ रयिँ सोम रिरीहि नः । इन्दविन्द्रेण नो युजा
verses.transliteration: pavamAna suvIrya.N rayi.N soma rirIhi naH | indavindreNa no yujA
verses.translation: Flowing one, give us wealth with heroic strength, Soma; O drop, with Indra as our ally.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषमं नर्यापसम् । अस्तारमेषि सूर्य
verses.transliteration: uddhedabhi shrutAmaghaM vR^iShamaM naryApasam | astArameShi sUrya
verses.translation: You rise, O Sun, toward the famed bounteous bull, the man of good works, the archer.

verses.sanskrit: नव यो नवतिं पुरो बिभेद बाह्वोजसा । अहिं च वृत्रहावधीत्
verses.transliteration: nava yo navatiM puro bibheda bAhvojasA | ahiM cha vR^itrahAvadhIt
verses.translation: Who by the strength of his arm split ninety-nine forts, and the Vritra-slayer slew the serpent.

verses.sanskrit: स न इन्द्रः शिवः सखाश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत् । उरुधारेव दोहते
verses.transliteration: sa na indraH shivaH sakhAshvAvadgomadyavamat | urudhAreva dohate
verses.translation: That Indra is our kind friend, with horses, cattle and barley; he milks like a wide stream.

verses.sanskrit: विभ्राड् बृहत्पिबतु सोम्यं मध्वायुर्दधद्यज्ञपतावविह्रुतम् । वातजूतो यो अभिरक्षति त्मना प्रजाः पिपर्ति बहुधा वि राजति
verses.transliteration: vibhrAD bR^ihatpibatu somyaM madhvAyurdadhadyaj~napatAvavihrutam | vAtajUto yo abhirakShati tmanA prajAH piparti bahudhA vi rAjati
verses.translation: May the shining, great one drink the honeyed soma, giving unharmed life to the lord of the sacrifice; urged by the wind, he guards by himself, nourishes offspring, and shines in many ways.

verses.sanskrit: विभ्राड् बृहत्सुभृतं वाजसातमं धर्मं दिवो धरुणे सत्यमर्पितम् । अमित्रहा वृत्रहा दस्युहन्तमं ज्योतिर्जज्ञे असुरहा सपत्नहा
verses.transliteration: vibhrAD bR^ihatsubhR^itaM vAjasAtamaM dharmaM divo dharuNe satyamarpitam | amitrahA vR^itrahA dasyuhantamaM jyotirjaj~ne asurahA sapatnahA
verses.translation: The shining, great, well-borne, best winner of strength, the truth set in heaven's support; foe-slayer, Vritra-slayer, best Dasyu-slayer, the light was born, slayer of Asuras, slayer of rivals.

verses.sanskrit: इदँ श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरुत्तमं विश्वजिद्धनजिदुच्यते बृहत् । विश्वभ्राड् भ्राजो महि सूर्यो दृश उरु पप्रथे सह ओजो अच्युतम्
verses.transliteration: ida.N shreShThaM jyotiShAM jyotiruttamaM vishvajiddhanajiduchyate bR^ihat | vishvabhrAD bhrAjo mahi sUryo dR^isha uru paprathe saha ojo achyutam
verses.translation: This best light of lights, highest, all-conquering, wealth-winning, great, is said; all-shining, the great Sun, to be seen, has spread wide with unshaken power.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा । शिक्षा णो अस्मिन्पुरुहूत यामनि जीव ज्योतिरशीमहि
verses.transliteration: indra kratuM na A bhara pitA putrebhyo yathA | shikShA No asminpuruhUta yAmani jIva jyotirashImahi
verses.translation: Bring us wisdom, Indra, as a father to his sons; teach us in this course, O much-invoked, that living we may attain the light.

verses.sanskrit: मा नो अज्ञाता वृजना दुराध्यो३ माशिवासोऽव क्रमुः । त्वया वयं प्रवतः शश्वतीरपोऽति शूर तरामसि
verses.transliteration: mA no aj~nAtA vR^ijanA durAdhyo3 mAshivAso.ava kramuH | tvayA vayaM pravataH shashvatIrapo.ati shUra tarAmasi
verses.translation: Let neither unknown crookednesses and evil thoughts nor the inauspicious overcome us; with you, O hero, we cross the eternal waters over the slopes.

verses.sanskrit: अद्याद्या श्वःश्व इन्द्र त्रास्व परे च नः । विश्वा च नो जरितॄन्त्सत्पते अहा दिवा नक्तं च रक्षिषः
verses.transliteration: adyAdyA shvaHshva indra trAsva pare cha naH | vishvA cha no jaritR^Intsatpate ahA divA naktaM cha rakShiShaH
verses.translation: Today and tomorrow, Indra, save us, and on the far days; O lord of the good, protect all our singers, by day and night.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभङ्गी शूरो मघवा तुवीमघः सम्मिश्लो विर्याय कम् । उभा ते बाहू वृषणा शतक्रतो नि या वज्रं मिमिक्षतुः
verses.transliteration: prabha~NgI shUro maghavA tuvImaghaH sammishlo viryAya kam | ubhA te bAhU vR^iShaNA shatakrato ni yA vajraM mimikShatuH
verses.translation: The breaker, hero, bounteous, of much bounty, mingled for heroism; both your arms, O hundred-powered, are bull-like, holding the thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: जनीयन्तो न्वग्रवः पुत्रीयन्तः सुदानवः । सरस्वन्तँ हवामहे
verses.transliteration: janIyanto nvagravaH putrIyantaH sudAnavaH | sarasvanta.N havAmahe
verses.translation: Desiring women, desiring sons, good givers, we call Sarasvati.

verses.sanskrit: उत नः प्रिया प्रियासु सप्तस्वसा सुजुष्टा । सरस्वती स्तोम्या भूत्
verses.transliteration: uta naH priyA priyAsu saptasvasA sujuShTA | sarasvatI stomyA bhUt
verses.translation: And may Sarasvati, dearest of the dear, sister of seven, well-pleased, be to be praised by us.

verses.sanskrit: तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि । धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्
verses.transliteration: tatsaviturvareNyaM bhargo devasya dhImahi | dhiyo yo naH prachodayAt
verses.translation: We meditate on that choicest radiance of the god Savitar, who may urge on our thoughts.

verses.sanskrit: सोमानाँ स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते । कक्षीवन्तँ य औशिजः
verses.transliteration: somAnA.N svaraNaM kR^iNuhi brahmaNaspate | kakShIvanta.N ya aushijaH
verses.translation: Make the soma-sounds ring, O Brahmanaspati, for Kakshivan, the son of Ushij.

verses.sanskrit: अग्न आयूँषि पवसे आ सुवोर्जं इषं च नः । आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम्
verses.transliteration: agna AyU.NShi pavase A suvorjaM iShaM cha naH | Are bAdhasva duchChunAm
verses.translation: O Agni, you purify our lives; bring us energy and food; drive far away evil dogs.

verses.sanskrit: ता नः शक्तं पार्थिवस्य महो रायो दिव्यस्य । महि वा क्षत्रं देवेषु
verses.transliteration: tA naH shaktaM pArthivasya maho rAyo divyasya | mahi vA kShatraM deveShu
verses.translation: Make us able for the great earthly and heavenly wealth; great is your power among the gods.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतमृतेन सपन्तेषिरं दक्षमाशाते । अद्रुहा देवौ वर्धेते
verses.transliteration: R^itamR^itena sapanteShiraM dakShamAshAte | adruhA devau vardhete
verses.translation: By truth they follow truth and attain the swift skill; the two unharming gods grow strong.

verses.sanskrit: वृष्टिद्यावा रीत्यापेषस्पती दानुमत्याः । बृहन्तं गर्त्तमाशाते
verses.transliteration: vR^iShTidyAvA rItyApeShaspatI dAnumatyAH | bR^ihantaM garttamAshAte
verses.translation: The rain-bringers, flowing, lords of strength, from the giver's cloud, attain the vast chasm.

verses.sanskrit: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परि तस्थुषः । रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि
verses.transliteration: yu~njanti bradhnamaruShaM charantaM pari tasthuShaH | rochante rochanA divi
verses.translation: They yoke the ruddy, moving one, the bay, around the standing; the lights shine in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे । शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसा
verses.transliteration: yu~njantyasya kAmyA harI vipakShasA rathe | shoNA dhR^iShNU nR^ivAhasA
verses.translation: His two dear bay horses are yoked, with side-wings, on the chariot, red, bold, bearing men.

verses.sanskrit: केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे । समुषद्भिरजायथाः
verses.transliteration: ketuM kR^iNvannaketave pesho maryA apeshase | samuShadbhirajAyathAH
verses.translation: Making a banner for the bannerless, form for the formless, O men, you were born with the dawns.

verses.sanskrit: अयँ सोम इन्द्र तुभ्यँ सुन्वे तुभ्यं पवते त्वमस्य पाहि । त्वँ ह यं चकृषे त्वं ववृष इन्दुं मदाय युज्याय सोमम्
verses.transliteration: aya.N soma indra tubhya.N sunve tubhyaM pavate tvamasya pAhi | tva.N ha yaM chakR^iShe tvaM vavR^iSha induM madAya yujyAya somam
verses.translation: This soma, Indra, is pressed for you, flows for you; protect it; you who have made it, you who have rained the drop for friendly exhilaration.

verses.sanskrit: स ईँ रथो न भुरिषाडयोजि महः पुरूणि सातये वसूनि । आदीं विश्वा नहुष्याणि जाता स्वर्षाता वन ऊर्ध्वा नवन्त
verses.transliteration: sa I.N ratho na bhuriShADayoji mahaH purUNi sAtaye vasUni | AdIM vishvA nahuShyANi jAtA svarShAtA vana UrdhvA navanta
verses.translation: That chariot like a carrier of burdens is yoked for the winning of many great treasures; then all the human clans, born, in the winning of heaven, have bowed the woods high.

verses.sanskrit: शुष्मी शर्धो न मारुतं पवस्वानभिशस्ता दिव्या यथा विट् । आपो न मक्षू सुमतिर्भवा नः सहस्राप्साः पृतनाषाण्न यज्ञः
verses.transliteration: shuShmI shardho na mArutaM pavasvAnabhishastA divyA yathA viT | Apo na makShU sumatirbhavA naH sahasrApsAH pR^itanAShANna yaj~naH
verses.translation: Strong, like the Marut host in strength, flow free from blame, as the divine people; like waters, be swiftly favorable to us; thousandfold-working, like a sacrifice that overcomes armies.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमग्ने यज्ञानाँ होता विश्वेषाँ हितः । देवेभिर्मानुषे जने
verses.transliteration: tvamagne yaj~nAnA.N hotA vishveShA.N hitaH | devebhirmAnuShe jane
verses.translation: You, O Agni, are the priest of all sacrifices, placed among the gods for the people of men.

verses.sanskrit: स नो मन्द्राभिरध्वरे जिह्वाभिर्यजा महः । आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च
verses.transliteration: sa no mandrAbhiradhvare jihvAbhiryajA mahaH | A devAnvakShi yakShi cha
verses.translation: With your joyful tongues at the sacrifice, worship the great ones for us; bring the gods and worship.

verses.sanskrit: वेत्था हि वेधो अध्वनः पथश्च देवाञ्जसा । अग्ने यज्ञेषु सुक्रतो
verses.transliteration: vetthA hi vedho adhvanaH pathashcha devA~njasA | agne yaj~neShu sukrato
verses.translation: For you know, O ordainer, the ways and paths of the gods directly, Agni, at sacrifices, skilful one.

verses.sanskrit: होता देवो अमर्त्यः पुरस्तादेति मायया । विदथानि प्रचोदयन्
verses.transliteration: hotA devo amartyaH purastAdeti mAyayA | vidathAni prachodayan
verses.translation: The priest, the immortal god, goes before with skill, urging on the rites.

verses.sanskrit: वाजी वाजेषु धीयतेऽध्वरेषु प्र णीयते । विप्रो यज्ञस्य साधनः
verses.transliteration: vAjI vAjeShu dhIyate.adhvareShu pra NIyate | vipro yaj~nasya sAdhanaH
verses.translation: The racer is set among strengths, led forward at sacrifices, the sage, accomplisher of the rite.

verses.sanskrit: धिया चक्रे वरेण्यो भूतानां गर्भमा दधे । दक्षस्य पितरं तना
verses.transliteration: dhiyA chakre vareNyo bhUtAnAM garbhamA dadhe | dakShasya pitaraM tanA
verses.translation: By thought he made the choice; he placed the embryo of beings; father of skill, by his extension.

verses.sanskrit: आ सुते सिञ्चत श्रियँ रोदस्योरभिश्रियम् । रसा दधीत वृषभम्
verses.transliteration: A sute si~nchata shriya.N rodasyorabhishriyam | rasA dadhIta vR^iShabham
verses.translation: Pour out the glory at the pressing, the glory of both worlds; with essences let them hold the bull.

verses.sanskrit: ते जानत स्वमोक्या३ँ सं वत्सासो न मातृभिः । मिथो नसन्त जामिभिः
verses.transliteration: te jAnata svamokyA3.N saM vatsAso na mAtR^ibhiH | mitho nasanta jAmibhiH
verses.translation: They know their own home, like calves with their mothers; they are joined together with their kin.

verses.sanskrit: उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतः कृण्वते धरुणं दिवि । इन्द्रे अग्ना नमः स्वः
verses.transliteration: upa srakveShu bapsataH kR^iNvate dharuNaM divi | indre agnA namaH svaH
verses.translation: In the ladles, those who toil make the support in heaven; to Indra and Agni homage, heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तदिदास भुवनेषु ज्येष्टं यतो जज्ञा उग्रस्त्वेषनृम्णः । सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रूननु यं विश्वे मदन्त्यूमाः
verses.transliteration: tadidAsa bhuvaneShu jyeShTaM yato jaj~nA ugrastveShanR^imNaH | sadyo jaj~nAno ni riNAti shatrUnanu yaM vishve madantyUmAH
verses.translation: That indeed was the eldest in the worlds, whence fierce, bright-mannered you were born; being born, at once he strikes enemies, in whom all the helpers rejoice.

verses.sanskrit: वावृधानः शवसा भूर्योजाः शत्रुर्दासाय भियसं दधाति । अव्यनच्च व्यनच्च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेषु
verses.transliteration: vAvR^idhAnaH shavasA bhUryojAH shatrurdAsAya bhiyasaM dadhAti | avyanachcha vyanachcha sasni saM te navanta prabhR^itA madeShu
verses.translation: Growing by strength, of abundant vigor, the enemy puts fear into the Dasa; sounding and unsounding, the winner; they sing you at the carrying in the joys.

verses.sanskrit: त्वे क्रतुमपि वृञ्जन्ति विश्वे द्विर्यदेते त्रिर्भवन्त्यूमाः । स्वादोः स्वादीयः स्वादुना सृजा समदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीः
verses.transliteration: tve kratumapi vR^i~njanti vishve dviryadete trirbhavantyUmAH | svAdoH svAdIyaH svAdunA sR^ijA samadaH su madhu madhunAbhi yodhIH
verses.translation: In you all choose skill, when these helpers become twice and thrice; with the sweet make it sweeter, with sweet honey fight with honey.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु महिषो यवाशिरं तुविशुष्मस्तृम्पत्सोममपिबद्विष्णुना सुतं यथावशम् । स ईं ममाद महि कर्म कर्तवे महामुरुँ सैनँ सश्चद्देवो देवँ सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम्
verses.transliteration: trikadrukeShu mahiSho yavAshiraM tuvishuShmastR^impatsomamapibadviShNunA sutaM yathAvasham | sa IM mamAda mahi karma kartave mahAmuru.N saina.N sashchaddevo deva.N satya induH satyamindram
verses.translation: In the Trikadrukas the great one, of great strength, satisfied, drank the soma pressed with Vishnu, as he wished; he rejoiced to perform the great deed; the true god-drop, the true Indra, joins the great, wide god.

verses.sanskrit: साकं जातः क्रतुना साकमोजसा ववक्षिथ साकं वृद्धो वीर्यैः सासहिर्मृधो विचर्षणिः । दाता राध स्तुवते काम्यं वसु प्रचेतन सैनँ सश्चद्देवो देवँ सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम्
verses.transliteration: sAkaM jAtaH kratunA sAkamojasA vavakShitha sAkaM vR^iddho vIryaiH sAsahirmR^idho vicharShaNiH | dAtA rAdha stuvate kAmyaM vasu prachetana saina.N sashchaddevo deva.N satya induH satyamindram
verses.translation: Born together with skill, together with might you have carried, grown together with powers, conqueror of enemies, all-seeing; giver of bounty, desirable wealth to the praiser, O wise; the true god-drop, the true Indra, joins the great god.

verses.sanskrit: अध त्विषीमाँ अभ्योजसा कृविं युधाभवदा रोदसी अपृणदस्य मज्मना प्र वावृधे । अधत्तान्यं जठरे प्रेमरिच्यत प्र चेतय सैनँ सश्चद्देवो देवँ सत्य इन्दुः सत्यमिन्द्रम्
verses.transliteration: adha tviShImA.N abhyojasA kR^iviM yudhAbhavadA rodasI apR^iNadasya majmanA pra vAvR^idhe | adhattAnyaM jaThare premarichyata pra chetaya saina.N sashchaddevo deva.N satya induH satyamindram
verses.translation: Then, brilliant, by might you overcame in battle the active; you filled both worlds by your power and grew great; you placed the other in your belly; he passed; awaken; the true god-drop, the true Indra, joins the great god.

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे । मूनुँ सत्यस्य सत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: abhi pra gopatiM girendramarcha yathA vide | mUnu.N satyasya satpatim
verses.translation: Praise Indra, lord of cattle, with song as one who knows — son of truth, lord of the good.

verses.sanskrit: आ हरयः ससृज्रिरेऽरुषीरधि बर्हिषि । यत्राभि संनवामहे
verses.transliteration: A harayaH sasR^ijrire.aruShIradhi barhiShi | yatrAbhi saMnavAmahe
verses.translation: The bay horses have been yoked on the red grass where we sing together.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय गाव आशिरं दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु । यत्सीमुपह्वरे विदत्
verses.transliteration: indrAya gAva AshiraM duduhre vajriNe madhu | yatsImupahvare vidat
verses.translation: The cows milked a mixture for Indra the thunderbolt-bearer, honey, which he found in the fold.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो विश्वासु हव्यमिन्द्रँ समत्सु भूषत । उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहन्परमज्या ऋचीषम
verses.transliteration: A no vishvAsu havyamindra.N samatsu bhUShata | upa brahmANi savanAni vR^itrahanparamajyA R^ichIShama
verses.translation: Honor Indra, to be called in all battles; come to our prayers and soothing offerings, Vritra-slayer, with highest verses.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं दाता प्रथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानकृत् । तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वृणीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः
verses.transliteration: tvaM dAtA prathamo rAdhasAmasyasi satya IshAnakR^it | tuvidyumnasya yujyA vR^iNImahe putrasya shavaso mahaH
verses.translation: You are the first giver of bounties, true, maker of rulers; we choose the associate of the much-splendid son of great power.

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्नं पीयूषं पूर्व्यं यदुक्थ्यं महो गाहद्दिव आ निरधुक्षत । इन्द्रमभि जायमानँ समस्वरन्
verses.transliteration: pratnaM pIyUShaM pUrvyaM yadukthyaM maho gAhaddiva A niradhukShata | indramabhi jAyamAna.N samasvaran
verses.translation: The ancient, first nectar, the praiseworthy, the great one entered heaven and milked it; they sang together to Indra being born.

verses.sanskrit: आदीं के चित्पश्यमानास आप्यं वसुरुचो दिव्या अभ्यनूषत । दिवो न वारँ सविता व्यूर्णुते
verses.transliteration: AdIM ke chitpashyamAnAsa ApyaM vasurucho divyA abhyanUShata | divo na vAra.N savitA vyUrNute
verses.translation: Then some, seeing their kin, the heavenly ones of wealthy radiance, praised; Savitar uncovers the choice of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अध यदिमे पवमान रोदसी इमा च विश्वा भुवनाभि मज्मना । यूथे न निष्ठा वृषभो वि राजसि
verses.transliteration: adha yadime pavamAna rodasI imA cha vishvA bhuvanAbhi majmanA | yUthe na niShThA vR^iShabho vi rAjasi
verses.translation: And when, flowing, these two worlds and all these worlds by your might — like a bull in a herd you shine forth.

verses.sanskrit: इममू षु त्वमस्माकँ सनिं गायत्रं नव्याँसम् । अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः
verses.transliteration: imamU Shu tvamasmAka.N saniM gAyatraM navyA.Nsam | agne deveShu pra vochaH
verses.translation: O Agni, speak among the gods for this our new Gayatri hymn, our offering of praise.

verses.sanskrit: विभक्तासि चित्रभानो सिन्धोरूर्मा उपाक आ । सद्यो दाशुषे क्षरसि
verses.transliteration: vibhaktAsi chitrabhAno sindhorUrmA upAka A | sadyo dAshuShe kSharasi
verses.translation: You are divided, O wondrous-splendored one, near the wave of the river; at once you flow to the giver.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो भज परमेष्वा वाजेषु मध्यमेषु । शिक्षा वस्वो अन्तमस्य
verses.transliteration: A no bhaja parameShvA vAjeShu madhyameShu | shikShA vasvo antamasya
verses.translation: Bring us a share in the highest and middle strengths; teach us the nearest of the wealth.

verses.sanskrit: अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रह । अहँ सूर्य इवाजनि
verses.transliteration: ahamiddhi pituShpari medhAmR^itasya jagraha | aha.N sUrya ivAjani
verses.translation: I have taken hold of the wisdom of truth from my father; I have been born like the sun.

verses.sanskrit: अहं प्रत्नेन जन्मना गिरः शुम्भामि कण्ववत् । येनेन्द्रः शुष्ममिद्दधे
verses.transliteration: ahaM pratnena janmanA giraH shumbhAmi kaNvavat | yenendraH shuShmamiddadhe
verses.translation: By ancient birth I adorn songs like Kanva, by which Indra took strength.

verses.sanskrit: ये त्वामिन्द्र न तुष्टुवुरृषयो ये च तुष्टुवुः । ममेद्वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः
verses.transliteration: ye tvAmindra na tuShTuvurR^iShayo ye cha tuShTuvuH | mamedvardhasva suShTutaH
verses.translation: The sages who did not praise you, Indra, and those who did — grow strong, well-praised, in my song.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने विश्वेभिरग्निभिर्जोषि ब्रह्म सहस्कृत । ये देवत्रा य आयुषु तेभिर्नो महया गिरः
verses.transliteration: agne vishvebhiragnibhirjoShi brahma sahaskR^ita | ye devatrA ya AyuShu tebhirno mahayA giraH
verses.translation: Agni, with all fires, accept the prayer, O born of strength; with those among the gods and among the Ayus, magnify our songs.

verses.sanskrit: प्र स विश्वेभिरग्निभिरग्निः स यस्य वाजिनः । तनये तोके अस्मदा सम्यङ्वाजैः परीवृतः
verses.transliteration: pra sa vishvebhiragnibhiragniH sa yasya vAjinaH | tanaye toke asmadA samya~NvAjaiH parIvR^itaH
verses.translation: Forth with all the fires is that Agni whose racer is — for offspring and children, from us, surrounded by strengths together.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्ने अग्निभिर्ब्रह्म यज्ञं च वर्धय । त्वं नो देवतातये रायो दानाय चोदय
verses.transliteration: tvaM no agne agnibhirbrahma yaj~naM cha vardhaya | tvaM no devatAtaye rAyo dAnAya chodaya
verses.translation: You, Agni, with fires, increase our prayer and sacrifice; urge us for the gods' feast, for giving wealth.

verses.sanskrit: त्वे सोम प्रथमा वृक्तबर्हिषो महे वाजाय श्रवसे धियन् दधुः । स त्वं नो वीर वीर्याय चोदय
verses.transliteration: tve soma prathamA vR^iktabarhiSho mahe vAjAya shravase dhiyan dadhuH | sa tvaM no vIra vIryAya chodaya
verses.translation: In you, Soma, the grass-strewers first set thought for great strength and fame; you, hero, urge us to heroism.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यभि हि श्रवसा ततर्दिथोत्सं न कं चिज्जनपानमक्षितम् । शर्याभिर्न भरमाणो गभस्त्योः
verses.transliteration: abhyabhi hi shravasA tatardithotsaM na kaM chijjanapAnamakShitam | sharyAbhirna bharamANo gabhastyoH
verses.translation: You have crossed over with glory like a fountain, an unfailing drink for the people; bearing in the hands like arrows.

verses.sanskrit: अजीजनो अमृत मर्त्याय अमृतस्य धर्मन्नमृतस्य चारुणः । सदासरो वाजमच्छा सनिष्यदत्
verses.transliteration: ajIjano amR^ita martyAya amR^itasya dharmannamR^itasya chAruNaH | sadAsaro vAjamachChA saniShyadat
verses.translation: You, immortal, have begotten for the mortal, in the law of the immortal, of the lovely immortal; ever running, going to win strength.

verses.sanskrit: एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु । प्र राधाँसि चोदयते महित्वना
verses.transliteration: endumindrAya si~nchata pibAti somyaM madhu | pra rAdhA.Nsi chodayate mahitvanA
verses.translation: Pour the drop for Indra; he drinks the soma honey; by his greatness he urges on gifts.

verses.sanskrit: उपो हरीणां पतिँ राधः पृञ्चन्तमब्रवम् । नूनँ श्रुधि स्तुवतो अश्व्यस्य
verses.transliteration: upo harINAM pati.N rAdhaH pR^i~nchantamabravam | nUna.N shrudhi stuvato ashvyasya
verses.translation: I spoke to the lord of the bay horses, who fills with bounty; now hear, the praiser of the horse-giver.

verses.sanskrit: न ह्याङ्३ग पुरा च न जज्ञे वीरतरस्त्वत् । न की राया नैवथा न भन्दना
verses.transliteration: na hyA~N3ga purA cha na jaj~ne vIratarastvat | na kI rAyA naivathA na bhandanA
verses.translation: For never before was one born more heroic than you; neither by wealth nor by help nor by joy.

verses.sanskrit: नदं व ओदतीनां नदं योयुवतीनाम् । पतिं वो अघ्न्यानां धेनूनामिषुध्यसि
verses.transliteration: nadaM va odatInAM nadaM yoyuvatInAm | patiM vo aghnyAnAM dhenUnAmiShudhyasi
verses.translation: The bull of you who give, the bull of you who unite; you urge the lord of the milch-cows.

verses.sanskrit: देवो वो द्रविणोदाः पूर्णां विवष्ट्वासिचम् । उद्वा सिञ्चध्वमुप वा पृणध्वमादिद्वो देव ओहते
verses.transliteration: devo vo draviNodAH pUrNAM vivaShTvAsicham | udvA si~nchadhvamupa vA pR^iNadhvamAdidvo deva ohate
verses.translation: May the god, giver of wealth, bring you the full pouring-vessel; pour it out or fill it up — then the god carries it on to you.

verses.sanskrit: तँ होतारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं वह्निं देवा अकृण्वत । दधाति रत्नं विधते सुवीर्यमग्निर्जनाय दाशुषे
verses.transliteration: ta.N hotAramadhvarasya prachetasaM vahniM devA akR^iNvata | dadhAti ratnaM vidhate suvIryamagnirjanAya dAshuShe
verses.translation: The gods made him the priest of the sacrifice, the wise carrier; Agni bestows jewels, heroic strength, on the giver.

verses.sanskrit: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः । उपोषु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्तु नो गिरः
verses.transliteration: adarshi gAtuvittamo yasminvratAnyAdadhuH | upoShu jAtamAryasya vardhanamagniM nakShantu no giraH
verses.translation: He has been seen, the best knower of the way, in whom the sacred rites are placed; may our songs reach Agni, the newborn increaser of the Aryan.

verses.sanskrit: यस्माद्रेजन्त कृष्टयश्चर्कृत्यानि कृण्वतः । सहस्रसां मेधसाताविव त्मनाग्निं धीभिर्नमस्यत
verses.transliteration: yasmAdrejanta kR^iShTayashcharkR^ityAni kR^iNvataH | sahasrasAM medhasAtAviva tmanAgniM dhIbhirnamasyata
verses.translation: From whom the peoples tremble when he does terrible deeds — worship Agni, winner of thousands, with thoughts as in the winning of wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देव इन्द्रो न मज्मना । अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य शर्मणि
verses.transliteration: pra daivodAso agnirdeva indro na majmanA | anu mAtaraM pR^ithivIM vi vAvR^ite tasthau nAkasya sharmaNi
verses.translation: Agni, the god, son of Divodasa, like Indra in might, has gone forth; he moves after his mother Earth and stands in the shelter of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अग्न आयूँषि पवसे आसुवोर्जमिषं च नः । आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम्
verses.transliteration: agna AyU.NShi pavase AsuvorjamiShaM cha naH | Are bAdhasva duchChunAm
verses.translation: O Agni, you purify our lives; bring us energy and food; drive far away evil dogs.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरृषिः पवमानः पाञ्चजन्यः पुरोहितः । तमीमहे महागयम्
verses.transliteration: agnirR^iShiH pavamAnaH pA~nchajanyaH purohitaH | tamImahe mahAgayam
verses.translation: Agni is the sage, the flowing, of the five peoples, the household priest; we ask for him of great house.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने पवस्व स्वपा अस्मे वर्चः सुवीर्यम् । दधद्रयिं मयि योषम्
verses.transliteration: agne pavasva svapA asme varchaH suvIryam | dadhadrayiM mayi yoSham
verses.translation: Agni, flow, of good works; bring us splendor and heroic strength, setting wealth upon me and a maid.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने पावक रोचिषा मन्द्रया देव जिह्वया । आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च
verses.transliteration: agne pAvaka rochiShA mandrayA deva jihvayA | A devAnvakShi yakShi cha
verses.translation: Agni, purifier, with joyful flame, god, with the tongue, bring the gods and worship.

verses.sanskrit: तं त्वा घृतस्नवीमहे चित्रभानो स्वर्दृशम् । देवाँ आ वीतये वह
verses.transliteration: taM tvA ghR^itasnavImahe chitrabhAno svardR^isham | devA.N A vItaye vaha
verses.translation: That ghee-bathed one we call, O wonder-radiant, seeing heaven; bring the gods for the feast.

verses.sanskrit: वीतिहोत्रं त्वा कवे द्युमन्तँ समिधीमहि । अग्ने बृहन्तमध्वरे
verses.transliteration: vItihotraM tvA kave dyumanta.N samidhImahi | agne bR^ihantamadhvare
verses.translation: We kindle you, seer, of the feast offering, radiant, great, at the sacrifice, Agni.

verses.sanskrit: अवा नो अग्न ऊतिभिर्गायत्रस्य प्रभर्मणि । विश्वासु धीषु वन्द्य
verses.transliteration: avA no agna UtibhirgAyatrasya prabharmaNi | vishvAsu dhIShu vandya
verses.translation: Protect us, Agni, with help in the Gayatri offering; to be praised in all thoughts.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो अग्ने रयिं भर सत्रासाहं वरेण्यम् । विश्वासु पृत्सु दुष्टरम्
verses.transliteration: A no agne rayiM bhara satrAsAhaM vareNyam | vishvAsu pR^itsu duShTaram
verses.translation: Bring us wealth, Agni, ever-victorious, choice, hard to overcome in all battles.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो अग्ने सुचेतुना रयिं विश्वायुपोषसम् । मार्डीकं धेहि जीवसे
verses.transliteration: A no agne suchetunA rayiM vishvAyupoShasam | mArDIkaM dhehi jIvase
verses.translation: Bring us, Agni, with fair wisdom, wealth that nourishes the whole life; place comfort for our living.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निँ हिन्वन्तु नो धियः सप्तिमाशुमिवाजिषु । तेन जेष्म धनन्धनम्
verses.transliteration: agni.N hinvantu no dhiyaH saptimAshumivAjiShu | tena jeShma dhanandhanam
verses.translation: Let our thoughts urge Agni, like a swift horse in the races; by him may we win wealth after wealth.

verses.sanskrit: यया गा आकरामहै सेनयाग्ने तवोत्या । तां नो हिन्व मघत्तये
verses.transliteration: yayA gA AkarAmahai senayAgne tavotyA | tAM no hinva maghattaye
verses.translation: By whatever army, Agni, with your help we gain cattle — urge that on us for bounty.

verses.sanskrit: आग्ने स्थूरँ रयिं भर पृथुं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । अन्धि खं वर्त्तया पविम्
verses.transliteration: Agne sthUra.N rayiM bhara pR^ithuM gomantamashvinam | andhi khaM varttayA pavim
verses.translation: Bring, Agni, solid wealth, wide, with cattle and horses; open the space, drive the wheel-rim.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने नक्षत्रमजरमा सूर्यँ रोहयो दिवि । दधज्ज्योतिर्जनेभ्यः
verses.transliteration: agne nakShatramajaramA sUrya.N rohayo divi | dadhajjyotirjanebhyaH
verses.translation: Agni, you made the ageless star, the Sun, rise in heaven, giving light to the people.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने केतुर्विशामसि प्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठ उपस्थसत् । बोधा स्तोत्रे वयो दधत्
verses.transliteration: agne keturvishAmasi preShThaH shreShTha upasthasat | bodhA stotre vayo dadhat
verses.translation: Agni, you are the banner of the clans, dearest, best, seated near; awaken and give vigor to the praiser.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम् । अपाँ रेताँसि जिन्वति
verses.transliteration: agnirmUrdhA divaH kakutpatiH pR^ithivyA ayam | apA.N retA.Nsi jinvati
verses.translation: Agni is the head and summit of heaven, the lord of the earth; he quickens the seeds of the waters.

verses.sanskrit: ईशिषे वार्यस्य हि दात्रस्याग्ने स्वःपतिः । स्तोता स्यां तव शर्मणि
verses.transliteration: IshiShe vAryasya hi dAtrasyAgne svaHpatiH | stotA syAM tava sharmaNi
verses.translation: You rule over desirable gifts, Agni, lord of heaven; may I be the praiser in your shelter.

verses.sanskrit: उदग्ने शुचयस्तव शुक्रा भ्राजन्त ईरते । तव ज्योतीँष्यर्चयः
verses.transliteration: udagne shuchayastava shukrA bhrAjanta Irate | tava jyotI.NShyarchayaH
verses.translation: Up, Agni, your bright pure flames rise shining; your light-rays.

verses.sanskrit: कस्ते जामिर्जनानामग्ने को दाश्वध्वरः । को ह कस्मिन्नसि श्रितः
verses.transliteration: kaste jAmirjanAnAmagne ko dAshvadhvaraH | ko ha kasminnasi shritaH
verses.translation: Who is your kinsman among the people, Agni? Who is a sacrificer? Who, in what do you rest?

verses.sanskrit: त्वं जामिर्जनानामग्ने मित्रो असि प्रियः । सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः
verses.transliteration: tvaM jAmirjanAnAmagne mitro asi priyaH | sakhA sakhibhya IDyaH
verses.translation: You are the kinsman of the people, Agni; you are dear Mitra, a friend to be praised among friends.

verses.sanskrit: यजा नो मित्रावरुणा यजा देवाँ ऋतं बृहत् । अग्ने यक्षि स्वं दमम्
verses.transliteration: yajA no mitrAvaruNA yajA devA.N R^itaM bR^ihat | agne yakShi svaM damam
verses.translation: Worship Mitra and Varuna for us; worship the gods and the great truth; Agni, worship your own house.

verses.sanskrit: ईडेन्यो नमस्यस्तिरस्तमाँसि दर्शतः । समग्निरिध्यते वृषा
verses.transliteration: IDenyo namasyastirastamA.Nsi darshataH | samagniridhyate vR^iShA
verses.translation: To be praised, to be revered, driving away darkness, beautiful, the bull Agni is kindled.

verses.sanskrit: वृषो अग्निः समिध्यतेऽश्वो न देववाहनः । तँ हविष्मन्त ईडते
verses.transliteration: vR^iSho agniH samidhyate.ashvo na devavAhanaH | ta.N haviShmanta IDate
verses.translation: The bull Agni is kindled like a horse that carries the gods; with offering they praise him.

verses.sanskrit: वृषणं त्वा वयं वृषन्वृषणः समिधीमहि । अग्ने दीद्यतं बृहत्
verses.transliteration: vR^iShaNaM tvA vayaM vR^iShanvR^iShaNaH samidhImahi | agne dIdyataM bR^ihat
verses.translation: We kindle you, the bull, O bull; Agni, shine greatly.

verses.sanskrit: उत्ते बृहन्तो अर्चयः समिधानस्य दीदिवः । अग्ने शुक्रास ईरते
verses.transliteration: utte bR^ihanto archayaH samidhAnasya dIdivaH | agne shukrAsa Irate
verses.translation: Your great flames of the kindled, brilliant one rise, Agni, bright ones.

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वा जुह्वो३ मम घृताचीर्यन्तु हर्यत । अग्ने हव्या जुषस्व नः
verses.transliteration: upa tvA juhvo3 mama ghR^itAchIryantu haryata | agne havyA juShasva naH
verses.translation: Let my ladles come to you with ghee, beloved; Agni, accept our offerings.

verses.sanskrit: मन्द्रँ होतारमृत्विजं चित्रभानुं विभावसुम् । अग्निमीडे स उ श्रवत्
verses.transliteration: mandra.N hotAramR^itvijaM chitrabhAnuM vibhAvasum | agnimIDe sa u shravat
verses.translation: I praise Agni, joyful priest, seasonal, wondrous-radiant, shining with riches; may he hear.

verses.sanskrit: पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्यू३त द्वितीयया । पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो
verses.transliteration: pAhi no agna ekayA pAhyU3ta dvitIyayA | pAhi gIrbhistisR^ibhirUrjAM pate pAhi chatasR^ibhirvaso
verses.translation: Protect us, Agni, with one verse, protect us with a second; protect us with three songs, lord of strength, protect us with four, O Vasu.

verses.sanskrit: पाहि विश्वस्माद्रक्षसो अराव्णः प्र स्म वाजेषु नोऽव । त्वामिद्धि नेदिष्ठं देवतातय आपिं नक्षामहे वृधे
verses.transliteration: pAhi vishvasmAdrakShaso arAvNaH pra sma vAjeShu no.ava | tvAmiddhi nediShThaM devatAtaya ApiM nakShAmahe vR^idhe
verses.translation: Protect us from every demon, ungenerous; help us in battles; for you, nearest, we, O friend, reach for the gods' feast, for growth.

verses.sanskrit: इनो राजन्नरतिः समिद्धो रौद्रो दक्षाय सुषुमाँ अदर्शि । चिकिद्वि भाति भासा बृहतासिक्नीमेति रुशतीमपाजन्
verses.transliteration: ino rAjannaratiH samiddho raudro dakShAya suShumA.N adarshi | chikidvi bhAti bhAsA bR^ihatAsiknImeti rushatImapAjan
verses.translation: O king, the unfriendly one kindled is seen, fierce, for skill, well pressed; he shines with great light and goes to the ruddy bright one, driving away the black.

verses.sanskrit: कृष्णां यदेनीमभि वर्पसाभूज्जनयन्योषां बृहतः पितुर्जाम् । ऊर्ध्वं भानुँ सूर्यस्य स्तभायन्दिवो वसुभिररतिर्वि भाति
verses.transliteration: kR^iShNAM yadenImabhi varpasAbhUjjanayanyoShAM bR^ihataH piturjAm | UrdhvaM bhAnu.N sUryasya stabhAyandivo vasubhiraratirvi bhAti
verses.translation: When he appeared in form to the dark mare, begetting the woman, sister of the great father, raising the Sun's light on high, he shines with the Vasus of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रो भद्रया सचमान आगात्स्वसारं जारो अभ्येति पश्चात् । सुप्रकेतैर्द्युभिरग्निर्वितिष्ठन्रुशद्भिर्वर्णैरभि राममस्थात्
verses.transliteration: bhadro bhadrayA sachamAna AgAtsvasAraM jAro abhyeti pashchAt | supraketairdyubhiragnirvitiShThanrushadbhirvarNairabhi rAmamasthAt
verses.translation: The auspicious came joining the auspicious, the lover goes after the sister; Agni stands apart with bright days, with shining colors, and has stood toward the dark.

verses.sanskrit: कया ते अग्ने अङ्गिर ऊर्जो नपादुपस्तुतिम् । वराय देव मन्यवे
verses.transliteration: kayA te agne a~Ngira Urjo napAdupastutim | varAya deva manyave
verses.translation: With what praise, Agni Angiras, grandson of strength, shall I choose for you, god, a great fury?

verses.sanskrit: दाशेम कस्य मनसा यज्ञस्य सहसो यहो । कदु वोच इदं नमः
verses.transliteration: dAshema kasya manasA yaj~nasya sahaso yaho | kadu vocha idaM namaH
verses.translation: In what mind shall we give for the sacrifice, O son of strength? What shall I say, this homage?

verses.sanskrit: अधा त्वँ हि नस्करो विश्वा अस्मभ्यँ सुक्षितीः । वाजद्रविणसो गिरः
verses.transliteration: adhA tva.N hi naskaro vishvA asmabhya.N sukShitIH | vAjadraviNaso giraH
verses.translation: Then you are indeed our maker; all good dwellings for us, songs rich in strength and wealth.

verses.sanskrit: अग्न आ याह्यग्निभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे । आ त्वामनक्तु प्रयता हविष्मती यजिष्ठं बर्हिरासदे
verses.transliteration: agna A yAhyagnibhirhotAraM tvA vR^iNImahe | A tvAmanaktu prayatA haviShmatI yajiShThaM barhirAsade
verses.translation: Agni, come with the fires; we choose you as priest; let the ready, offering-laden grass anoint you, the best sacrificer, to sit.

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा हि त्वा सहसः सूनो अङ्गिरः स्रुचश्चरन्त्यध्वरे । ऊर्जो नपातं घृतकेशमीमहेऽग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम्
verses.transliteration: achChA hi tvA sahasaH sUno a~NgiraH sruchashcharantyadhvare | Urjo napAtaM ghR^itakeshamImahe.agniM yaj~neShu pUrvyam
verses.translation: To you, son of strength, Angiras, the ladles go at the sacrifice; we ask Agni, grandson of strength, ghee-haired, first at sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: अच्छा नः शीरशोचिषं गिरो यन्तु दर्शतम् । अच्छा यज्ञासो नमसा पुरूवसुं पुरुप्रशस्तमूतये
verses.transliteration: achChA naH shIrashochiShaM giro yantu darshatam | achChA yaj~nAso namasA purUvasuM puruprashastamUtaye
verses.translation: Let our songs go to the sharp-flamed, the beautiful; let the sacrifices go with homage to the much-wealthy, much-praised, for help.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निँ सूनुँ सहसो जातवेदसं दानाय वार्याणाम् । द्विता यो भूदमृतो मर्त्येष्वा होता मन्द्रतमो विशि
verses.transliteration: agni.N sUnu.N sahaso jAtavedasaM dAnAya vAryANAm | dvitA yo bhUdamR^ito martyeShvA hotA mandratamo vishi
verses.translation: Agni, son of strength, Jatavedas, to give desirable things; who became twofold, immortal among mortals, the most joyful priest among the people.

verses.sanskrit: अदाभ्यः पुरएता विशामग्निर्मानुषीणाम् । तूर्णी रथः सदा नवः
verses.transliteration: adAbhyaH puraetA vishAmagnirmAnuShINAm | tUrNI rathaH sadA navaH
verses.translation: The unconquerable leader of the human clans, Agni — a swift chariot, ever new.

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्रयाँसि वाहसा दाश्वाँ अश्नोति मर्त्यः । क्षयं पावकशोचिषः
verses.transliteration: abhi prayA.Nsi vAhasA dAshvA.N ashnoti martyaH | kShayaM pAvakashochiShaH
verses.translation: The giving mortal obtains offerings and the dwelling of the pure-flamed by the carrier.

verses.sanskrit: साह्वान्विश्वा अभियुजः क्रतुर्देवानाममृक्तः । अग्निस्तुविश्रवस्तमः
verses.transliteration: sAhvAnvishvA abhiyujaH kraturdevAnAmamR^iktaH | agnistuvishravastamaH
verses.translation: Overcomer of all attackers, unharmed wisdom of the gods, Agni, most famous.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः । भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः
verses.transliteration: bhadro no agnirAhuto bhadrA rAtiH subhaga bhadro adhvaraH | bhadrA uta prashastayaH
verses.translation: Auspicious for us is Agni to whom the offering is poured; auspicious is the gift, O fortunate one; auspicious the sacrifice, and auspicious the praises.

verses.sanskrit: भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये येना समत्सु सासहिः । अव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धतां वनेमा ते अभिष्टये
verses.transliteration: bhadraM manaH kR^iNuShva vR^itratUrye yenA samatsu sAsahiH | ava sthirA tanuhi bhUri shardhatAM vanemA te abhiShTaye
verses.translation: Make your mind auspicious in the Vritra-battle, by which you overcame in battles; break the firm ones, many who strive; we would serve you for your help.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने वाजस्य गोमत ईशानः सहसो यहो । अस्मे देहि जातवेदो महि श्रवः
verses.transliteration: agne vAjasya gomata IshAnaH sahaso yaho | asme dehi jAtavedo mahi shravaH
verses.translation: O Agni, lord of cattle-rich strength, son of might, give us, Jatavedas, great fame.

verses.sanskrit: स इधानो वसुष्कविरग्निरीडेन्यो गिरा । रेवदस्मभ्यं पुर्वणीक दीदिहि
verses.transliteration: sa idhAno vasuShkaviragnirIDenyo girA | revadasmabhyaM purvaNIka dIdihi
verses.translation: Kindled, the Vasu, the seer, Agni, praised with song, shine richly for us, O of many forms.

verses.sanskrit: क्षपो राजन्नुत त्मनाग्ने वस्तोरुतोषसः । स तिग्मजम्भ रक्षसो दह प्रति
verses.transliteration: kShapo rAjannuta tmanAgne vastorutoShasaH | sa tigmajambha rakShaso daha prati
verses.translation: O king, by night and by day, Agni, you yourself, O sharp-jawed, burn the demons in turn.

verses.sanskrit: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम् । अग्निं वो दुर्यं वच स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः
verses.transliteration: vishovisho vo atithiM vAjayantaH purupriyam | agniM vo duryaM vacha stuShe shUShasya manmabhiH
verses.translation: Desiring strength I praise Agni, the beloved guest of every clan, your door-guard, with the thoughts of the strong.

verses.sanskrit: यं जनासो हविष्मन्तो मित्रं न सर्पिरासुतिम् । प्रशँसन्ति प्रशस्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: yaM janAso haviShmanto mitraM na sarpirAsutim | prasha.Nsanti prashastibhiH
verses.translation: Whom the people with offerings praise with praises like Mitra, like the ghee-sprinkler.

verses.sanskrit: पन्याँसं जातवेदसं यो देवतात्युद्यता । हव्यान्यैरयद्दिवि
verses.transliteration: panyA.NsaM jAtavedasaM yo devatAtyudyatA | havyAnyairayaddivi
verses.translation: The most praised Jatavedas, who with raised offerings at the gods' service sent the oblations to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: समिद्धमग्निँ समिधा गिरा गृणे शुचिं पावकं पुरो अध्वरे ध्रुवम् । विप्रँ होतारं पुरुवारमद्रुहं कविँ सुम्नैरीमहे जातवेदसम्
verses.transliteration: samiddhamagni.N samidhA girA gR^iNe shuchiM pAvakaM puro adhvare dhruvam | vipra.N hotAraM puruvAramadruhaM kavi.N sumnairImahe jAtavedasam
verses.translation: I praise Agni kindled with the kindling-stick, with song, the pure purifier, firm before the sacrifice; the sage, priest, much-chosen, guileless, the seer; with favors we ask Jatavedas.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां दूतमग्ने अमृतं युगेयुगे हव्यवाहं दधिरे पायुमीड्यम्। देवासश्च मर्त्तासश्च जागृविं विभुं विश्पतिं नमसा नि षेदिरे
verses.transliteration: tvAM dUtamagne amR^itaM yugeyuge havyavAhaM dadhire pAyumIDyam. devAsashcha marttAsashcha jAgR^iviM vibhuM vishpatiM namasA ni Shedire
verses.translation: You, Agni, messenger, immortal, in every age they set as carrier of oblations, protector, to be praised; both gods and mortals have sat with homage by the wakeful, all-pervading lord of the clans.

verses.sanskrit: विभूषन्नग्न उभयाँ अनु व्रता दूतो देवानाँ रजसी समीयसे । यत्ते धीतिँ सुमतिमावृणीमहेऽध स्मा नस्त्रिवरूथः शिवो भव
verses.transliteration: vibhUShannagna ubhayA.N anu vratA dUto devAnA.N rajasI samIyase | yatte dhIti.N sumatimAvR^iNImahe.adha smA nastrivarUthaH shivo bhava
verses.translation: Adorning both ways according to the laws, you go, messenger of the gods, between the two worlds; when we choose your thought and favor, then be for us a threefold shelter, kind.

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः । वायोरनीके अस्थिरन्
verses.transliteration: upa tvA jAmayo giro dedishatIrhaviShkR^itaH | vAyoranIke asthiran
verses.translation: The hymns of the offering-makers approach you like sisters, pointing the way; they have stood before the wind.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य त्रिधात्ववृतं बर्हिस्तस्थावसन्दिनम् । आपश्चिन्नि दधा पदम्
verses.transliteration: yasya tridhAtvavR^itaM barhistasthAvasandinam | Apashchinni dadhA padam
verses.translation: Whose threefold, uncovered grass stood unwithering; even the waters placed a step.

verses.sanskrit: पदं देवस्य मीढुषोऽनाधृष्टाभिरूतिभिः । भद्रा सूर्य इवोपदृक्
verses.transliteration: padaM devasya mIDhuSho.anAdhR^iShTAbhirUtibhiH | bhadrA sUrya ivopadR^ik
verses.translation: The step of the bountiful god, with unassailable helps; auspicious, like the sun in sight.

verses.sanskrit: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः । समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यम्
verses.transliteration: abhi tvA pUrvapItaya indra stomebhirAyavaH | samIchInAsa R^ibhavaH samasvaranrudrA gR^iNanta pUrvyam
verses.translation: The Ayus, with hymns, for your first drinking, O Indra; the Ribhus joined in one voice; the Rudras praised the ancient one.

verses.sanskrit: अस्येदिन्द्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यँ शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि । अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा
verses.transliteration: asyedindro vAvR^idhe vR^iShNya.N shavo made sutasya viShNavi | adyA tamasya mahimAnamAyavo.anu ShTuvanti pUrvathA
verses.translation: For this Indra grew in manly strength, in the joy of the soma pressed in Vishnu; today the Ayus praise his greatness as before.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वामर्चन्त्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः । इन्द्राग्नी इष आ वृणे
verses.transliteration: pra vAmarchantyukthino nIthAvido jaritAraH | indrAgnI iSha A vR^iNe
verses.translation: The singers, knowing the leading, offer you hymns; Indra and Agni, I choose strength.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतम् । साकमेकेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: indrAgnI navatiM puro dAsapatnIradhUnutam | sAkamekena karmaNA
verses.translation: Indra and Agni, you shook ninety forts of the Dasa-wives with one deed together.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी अपसस्पर्युप प्र यन्ति धीतयः । ऋतस्य पथ्याऽऽ३ अनु
verses.transliteration: indrAgnI apasasparyupa pra yanti dhItayaH | R^itasya pathyA.a.a3 anu
verses.translation: Indra and Agni, the thoughts go forth to your works, along the paths of truth.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी तविषाणी वाँ सधस्थानि प्रयाँसि च । युवोरप्तूर्यँ हितम्
verses.transliteration: indrAgnI taviShANI vA.N sadhasthAni prayA.Nsi cha | yuvoraptUrya.N hitam
verses.translation: Indra and Agni, your strengths, seats and strengthening offerings are set for the winning of water.

verses.sanskrit: शग्ध्यू३ षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि
verses.transliteration: shagdhyU3 Shu shachIpata indra vishvAbhirUtibhiH | bhagaM na hi tvA yashasaM vasuvidamanu shUra charAmasi
verses.translation: Be able, lord of power, Indra, with all your helps; for we follow you, O hero, as fortune, glorious, finder of wealth.

verses.sanskrit: पौरो अश्वस्य पुरुकृद्गवामस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः । न किर्हि दानं परि मर्धिषत्वे यद्यद्यामि तदा भर
verses.transliteration: pauro ashvasya purukR^idgavAmasyutso deva hiraNyayaH | na kirhi dAnaM pari mardhiShatve yadyadyAmi tadA bhara
verses.translation: The fountain of the horse of Puru, maker of many, of the cows, O golden god; no one hinders the gift when I ask; bring it then.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये । उद्वावृषस्व मधवन्गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये
verses.transliteration: tva.N hyehi cherave vidA bhagaM vasuttaye | udvAvR^iShasva madhavangaviShTaya udindrAshvamiShTaye
verses.translation: You come to the wanderer; find fortune for the winning of wealth; rise up, bounteous one, for the seeking of cattle, Indra, for the seeking of horses.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं पुरू सहस्राणि शतानि च यूथा दानाय मँहसे । आ पुरन्दरं चकृम विप्रवचस इन्द्रं गायन्तोऽवसे
verses.transliteration: tvaM purU sahasrANi shatAni cha yUthA dAnAya ma.Nhase | A purandaraM chakR^ima vipravachasa indraM gAyanto.avase
verses.translation: You, much, thousands and hundreds, give herds; we have made Indra the Purandara with wise words, singing for help.

verses.sanskrit: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानाम् । मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्वग्नये
verses.transliteration: yo vishvA dayate vasu hotA mandro janAnAm | madhorna pAtrA prathamAnyasmai pra stomA yantvagnaye
verses.translation: Whoever grants all treasures, the joyful priest of the peoples — to him first let our hymns go forth like cups of honey, to Agni.

verses.sanskrit: अश्व न गीर्भी रथ्यँ सुदानवो मर्मृज्यन्ते देवयवः । उभे तोके तनये दस्म विस्पते पर्षि राधो मघोनाम्
verses.transliteration: ashva na gIrbhI rathya.N sudAnavo marmR^ijyante devayavaH | ubhe toke tanaye dasma vispate parShi rAdho maghonAm
verses.translation: Like a horse by songs, the chariot, the good givers are adorned, god-seeking; protect both children and grandchildren, O wondrous lord of the clans, for you bring the bounty of the bounteous.

verses.sanskrit: इमं मे वरुण श्रुधी हवमद्या च मृडय । त्वामवस्युरा चके
verses.transliteration: imaM me varuNa shrudhI havamadyA cha mR^iDaya | tvAmavasyurA chake
verses.translation: Hear this my call, Varuna, and today be gracious; seeking help I have turned to you.

verses.sanskrit: कया त्वं न ऊत्याभि प्र मन्दसे वृषन् । कया स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
verses.transliteration: kayA tvaM na UtyAbhi pra mandase vR^iShan | kayA stotR^ibhya A bhara
verses.translation: With what help, bull, do you delight in us? With what do you bring to the singers?

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे । इन्द्रँ समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये
verses.transliteration: indramiddevatAtaya indraM prayatyadhvare | indra.N samIke vanino havAmaha indraM dhanasya sAtaye
verses.translation: We call on Indra for worship; Indra at the progressing sacrifice; Indra in battle, we the singers call, and Indra for the winning of wealth.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो मह्ना रोदसी पप्रथच्छव इन्द्रः सूर्यमरोचयत् । इन्द्रे ह विश्वा भुवनानि येमिर इन्द्रे सुवानास इन्दवः
verses.transliteration: indro mahnA rodasI paprathachChava indraH sUryamarochayat | indre ha vishvA bhuvanAni yemira indre suvAnAsa indavaH
verses.translation: Indra by greatness spread both worlds, strength; Indra made the Sun shine; in Indra all the worlds are restrained; in Indra the pressed drops.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वकर्मन्हविषा वावृधानः स्वयं यजस्व तन्वा३ँ स्वा हि ते । मुह्यन्त्वन्ये अभितो जनास इहास्माकं मघवा सूरिरस्तु
verses.transliteration: vishvakarmanhaviShA vAvR^idhAnaH svayaM yajasva tanvA3.N svA hi te | muhyantvanye abhito janAsa ihAsmAkaM maghavA sUrirastu
verses.translation: O Vishvakarman, strengthened by the offering, sacrifice yourself, for your body is your own; let others be bewildered all around; here may our bounteous one be the patron.

verses.sanskrit: अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा द्वेषाँसि तरति सयुग्वभिः सूरो न सयुग्वभिः । धारा पृष्ठस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः । विश्वा यद्रूपा परियास्यृक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिरृक्वभिः
verses.transliteration: ayA ruchA hariNyA punAno vishvA dveShA.Nsi tarati sayugvabhiH sUro na sayugvabhiH | dhArA pR^iShThasya rochate punAno aruSho hariH | vishvA yadrUpA pariyAsyR^ikvabhiH saptAsyebhirR^ikvabhiH
verses.translation: Purified by this golden light, he passes over all hatreds with his fellow-yoked, like the sun with his companions; the stream shines on the back, the purified red-bay one; when he goes around all forms with the singers, the seven-mouthed singers.

verses.sanskrit: प्राचीमनु प्रदिशं पाति चेकितत्सँ रश्मिभिर्यतते दर्शतो रथो दैव्यो दर्शतो रथः । अग्मन्नुक्थानि पौँस्येन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षयत । वज्रश्च यद्भवथो अनपच्युता समत्स्वनपच्युता
verses.transliteration: prAchImanu pradishaM pAti chekitatsa.N rashmibhiryatate darshato ratho daivyo darshato rathaH | agmannukthAni pau.NsyendraM jaitrAya harShayata | vajrashcha yadbhavatho anapachyutA samatsvanapachyutA
verses.translation: He guards after the eastern direction, knowing; he strives with the rays, a beautiful chariot, a beautiful divine chariot. The hymns have come with manly strength; delight Indra for victory. When you two are the thunderbolt unshaken and unshaken in battles.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यत्पणीनां विदो वसु सं मातृभिर्मर्जयसि स्व आ दम ऋतस्य धीतिभिर्दमे । परावतो न साम तद्यत्रा रणन्ति धीतयः । त्रिधातुभिररुषीभिर्वयो दधे रोचमानो वयो दधे
verses.transliteration: tvaM ha tyatpaNInAM vido vasu saM mAtR^ibhirmarjayasi sva A dama R^itasya dhItibhirdame | parAvato na sAma tadyatrA raNanti dhItayaH | tridhAtubhiraruShIbhirvayo dadhe rochamAno vayo dadhe
verses.translation: You indeed found the wealth of the Panis; you cleanse it with your mothers in your own home, in the house with the thoughts of truth. Like a Saman from afar, where the thoughts delight; with three-substance ruddy ones I place vigor; shining, I place vigor.

verses.sanskrit: उत नो गोषणिं धियमश्वसां वाजसामुत । नृवत्कृणुह्यूतये
verses.transliteration: uta no goShaNiM dhiyamashvasAM vAjasAmuta | nR^ivatkR^iNuhyUtaye
verses.translation: And for us thought that gains cattle, horses and strength — make it manful, for help.

verses.sanskrit: शशमानस्य वा नरः स्वेदस्य सत्यशवसः । विदा कामस्य वेनतः
verses.transliteration: shashamAnasya vA naraH svedasya satyashavasaH | vidA kAmasya venataH
verses.translation: Of the man who labors, the sweat of true strength — know the desire of the longing one.

verses.sanskrit: उप नः सूनवो गिरः शृण्वन्त्वमृतस्य ये । सुमृडीका भवन्तु नः
verses.transliteration: upa naH sUnavo giraH shR^iNvantvamR^itasya ye | sumR^iDIkA bhavantu naH
verses.translation: May the sons hear our songs near, those of immortality; may they be most gracious to us.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वां महि द्यवी अभ्युपस्तुतिं भरामहे । शुची उप प्रशस्तये
verses.transliteration: pra vAM mahi dyavI abhyupastutiM bharAmahe | shuchI upa prashastaye
verses.translation: We bring forth great praise to you two, heaven and earth, pure, for glorification.

verses.sanskrit: पुनाने तन्वा मिथः स्वेन दक्षेण राजथः । ऊह्याथे सनादृतम्
verses.transliteration: punAne tanvA mithaH svena dakSheNa rAjathaH | UhyAthe sanAdR^itam
verses.translation: Purifying each other with your own skill, you two rule; you carry eternal truth.

verses.sanskrit: मही मित्रस्य साधथस्तरन्ती पिप्रती ऋतम् । परि यज्ञं नि षेदथुः
verses.transliteration: mahI mitrasya sAdhathastarantI pipratI R^itam | pari yaj~naM ni ShedathuH
verses.translation: You two accomplish the great one of Mitra, crossing and filling truth; sit around the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अयमु ते समतसि कपोत इव गर्भधिम् । वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे
verses.transliteration: ayamu te samatasi kapota iva garbhadhim | vachastachchinna ohase
verses.translation: Here for you, in the contest, like a dove to its nest — you carry that word of ours as well.

verses.sanskrit: स्तोत्रँ राधानां पते गिर्वाहो वीर यस्य ते । विभूतिरस्तु सूनृता
verses.transliteration: stotra.N rAdhAnAM pate girvAho vIra yasya te | vibhUtirastu sUnR^itA
verses.translation: A hymn to the lord of bounties, O song-carried hero, whose is the might; let it be a pleasant offering.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा न ऊतयेऽस्मिन्वाजे शतक्रतो । समन्येषु ब्रवावहै
verses.transliteration: UrdhvastiShThA na Utaye.asminvAje shatakrato | samanyeShu bravAvahai
verses.translation: Stand up for our help, hundred-powered, in this contest; we shall speak together among others.

verses.sanskrit: गाव उप वदावटे महि यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा । उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया
verses.transliteration: gAva upa vadAvaTe mahi yaj~nasya rapsudA | ubhA karNA hiraNyayA
verses.translation: Speak to the cows in the pit, to the giver of the great sacrifice's song; both ears are golden.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यारमिदद्रयो निषिक्तं पुष्करे मधु । अवटस्य विसर्जने
verses.transliteration: abhyAramidadrayo niShiktaM puShkare madhu | avaTasya visarjane
verses.translation: Honey has been poured out in the lotus toward the pit-like cloud, at the release of the well.

verses.sanskrit: सिञ्चन्ति नमसावटमुच्चाचक्रं परिज्मानम् । नीचीनबारमक्षितम्
verses.transliteration: si~nchanti namasAvaTamuchchAchakraM parijmAnam | nIchInabAramakShitam
verses.translation: They pour with homage the well with its high wheel, all-moving, with its lower door unfailing.

verses.sanskrit: मा भेम मा श्रमिष्मोग्रस्य सख्ये तव । महत्ते वृष्णो अभिचक्ष्यं कृतं पश्येम तुर्वशं यदुम्
verses.transliteration: mA bhema mA shramiShmograsya sakhye tava | mahatte vR^iShNo abhichakShyaM kR^itaM pashyema turvashaM yadum
verses.translation: May we not fear, may we not tire, in friendship with your fierce self; great is your visible deed, bull; may we see Turvasha and Yadu.

verses.sanskrit: सव्यामनु स्फिग्यं वावसे वृष्ना न दानो अस्य रोषति । मध्वा सम्पृक्ताः सारघेण धेनवस्तूयमेहि द्रवा पिब
verses.transliteration: savyAmanu sphigyaM vAvase vR^iShnA na dAno asya roShati | madhvA sampR^iktAH sAragheNa dhenavastUyamehi dravA piba
verses.translation: To the left side you cover; his gift does not vex, like a bull's; the cows mixed with honey and bee-juice — come quickly, run, drink.

verses.sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम । पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत
verses.transliteration: imA u tvA purUvaso giro vardhantu yA mama | pAvakavarNAH shuchayo vipashchito.abhi stomairanUShata
verses.translation: May these songs of mine strengthen you, O rich in wealth; the pure, fire-colored sages have sung to you with hymns.

verses.sanskrit: अयँ सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्र इव पप्रथे । सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये
verses.transliteration: aya.N sahasramR^iShibhiH sahaskR^itaH samudra iva paprathe | satyaH so asya mahimA gR^iNe shavo yaj~neShu viprarAjye
verses.translation: This thousandfold one, made strong by the sages, has spread like the ocean; true is his greatness; I praise his strength at the sacrifices, in the kingdom of sages.

verses.sanskrit: यस्यायं विश्व आर्यो दासः शेवधिपा अरिः । तिरश्चिदर्ये रुशमे पवीरवि तुभ्येत्सो अज्यते रयिः
verses.transliteration: yasyAyaM vishva Aryo dAsaH shevadhipA ariH | tirashchidarye rushame pavIravi tubhyetso ajyate rayiH
verses.translation: Whose all this Aryan, Dasa, treasure-guarding enemy is; across the ruddy one, the lamp, to you alone this wealth is anointed.

verses.sanskrit: तुरण्यवो मधुमन्तं घृतश्चतं विप्रासो अर्कमानृचुः । अस्मे रयिः पप्रथे वृष्ण्यं शवोऽस्मे स्वानास इन्दवः
verses.transliteration: turaNyavo madhumantaM ghR^itashchataM viprAso arkamAnR^ichuH | asme rayiH paprathe vR^iShNyaM shavo.asme svAnAsa indavaH
verses.translation: The hasteners, the sages, have sung the honeyed ghee-dripping hymn; wealth has spread to us, manly strength, to us the sounding drops.

verses.sanskrit: गोमन्न इन्दो अश्ववत्सुतः सुदक्ष धनिव । शुचिं च वर्णमधि गोषु धार्य
verses.transliteration: gomanna indo ashvavatsutaH sudakSha dhaniva | shuchiM cha varNamadhi goShu dhArya
verses.translation: Drop, press for us a rich-in-cattle, rich-in-horses wealth, O skilful; hold the pure color in the cows.

verses.sanskrit: स नो हरीणां पत इन्दो देवप्सरस्तमः । सखेव सख्ये नर्यो रुचे भव
verses.transliteration: sa no harINAM pata indo devapsarastamaH | sakheva sakhye naryo ruche bhava
verses.translation: Be to us, lord of the bay horses, O drop, most divine in pleasure; like a friend to a friend, a leader, be for splendor.

verses.sanskrit: सनेमि त्वमस्मदा अदेवं कं चिदत्रिणम् । साह्वाँ इन्दो परि बाधो अप द्वयुम्
verses.transliteration: sanemi tvamasmadA adevaM kaM chidatriNam | sAhvA.N indo pari bAdho apa dvayum
verses.translation: You from of old, from us, drive away any godless devourer; overcoming, drop, drive off the oppressors and the double-minded.

verses.sanskrit: अञ्जते व्यञ्जते समञ्जते क्रतुँ रिहन्ति मध्वाभ्यञ्जते । सिन्धोरुऽच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणँ हिरण्यपावाः पशुमप्सु गृभ्णते
verses.transliteration: a~njate vya~njate sama~njate kratu.N rihanti madhvAbhya~njate | sindhoru.achChvAse patayantamukShaNa.N hiraNyapAvAH pashumapsu gR^ibhNate
verses.translation: They anoint, they adorn, they decorate; they lick the skill, they anoint with honey; at the breath of the river, the golden-purified take the bull flying in the waters.

verses.sanskrit: विपश्चिते पवमानाय गायत मही न धारात्यन्धो अर्षति । अहिर्न जूर्णामति सर्पति त्वचमत्यो न क्रीडन्नसरद्वृषा हरिः
verses.transliteration: vipashchite pavamAnAya gAyata mahI na dhArAtyandho arShati | ahirna jUrNAmati sarpati tvachamatyo na krIDannasaradvR^iShA hariH
verses.translation: Sing to the wise, flowing one; the drink flows like a great stream; like a snake creeping, it moves in its skin; like a horse in play the bay bull has run.

verses.sanskrit: अग्रेगो राजाप्यस्तविष्यते विमानो अह्नां भुवनेष्वर्पितः । हरिर्घृतस्नुः सुदृशीको अर्णवो ज्योतीरथः पवते राय ओक्यः
verses.transliteration: agrego rAjApyastaviShyate vimAno ahnAM bhuvaneShvarpitaH | harirghR^itasnuH sudR^ishIko arNavo jyotIrathaH pavate rAya okyaH
verses.translation: The king, foremost, to be praised in the waters, is strengthened; the measurer of days is set in the worlds; the bay, ghee-dropping, fair-faced ocean with light-chariot flows for wealth, a home-dweller.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिमं यज्ञमिदं वचः । चनो घाः सहसा यहो
verses.transliteration: vishvebhiragne agnibhirimaM yaj~namidaM vachaH | chano ghAH sahasA yaho
verses.translation: With all fires, Agni, to this sacrifice and this word, grant us, O son of strength, joy.

verses.sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि शश्वा तना देवन्देवं यजामहे । त्वे इद्धूयते हविः
verses.transliteration: yachchiddhi shashvA tanA devandevaM yajAmahe | tve iddhUyate haviH
verses.translation: Whatever we sacrifice to god after god in the eternal course, in you alone the offering is poured.

verses.sanskrit: प्रियो नो अस्तु विश्पतिर्होता मन्द्रो वरेण्यः । प्रियाः स्वग्नयो वयम्
verses.transliteration: priyo no astu vishpatirhotA mandro vareNyaH | priyAH svagnayo vayam
verses.translation: May the lord of the clans, the joyful, choice priest, be dear to us; may we be dear, with good fires.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः । अस्माकमस्तु केवलः
verses.transliteration: indraM vo vishvataspari havAmahe janebhyaH | asmAkamastu kevalaH
verses.translation: We call Indra from all sides for the people; may he be ours alone.

verses.sanskrit: स नो वृषन्नमुं चरुँ सत्रादावन्नपा वृधि । अस्मभ्यमप्रतिष्कुतः
verses.transliteration: sa no vR^iShannamuM charu.N satrAdAvannapA vR^idhi | asmabhyamapratiShkutaH
verses.translation: O bull, you, the giver of food, increase the waters and this pot for us, unrepelled.

verses.sanskrit: बृषा यूथेव वँसगः कृष्टीरियर्त्योजसा । ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुतः
verses.transliteration: bR^iShA yUtheva va.NsagaH kR^iShTIriyartyojasA | IshAno apratiShkutaH
verses.translation: Like a bull among the herds, a lord who wanders, he drives the peoples by might, ruling, unrepelled.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं नश्चित्र ऊत्या वसो राधाँसि चोदय । अस्य रायस्त्वमग्ने रथीरसि विदा गाधं तुचे तु नः
verses.transliteration: tvaM nashchitra UtyA vaso rAdhA.Nsi chodaya | asya rAyastvamagne rathIrasi vidA gAdhaM tuche tu naH
verses.translation: O wondrous one, O Vasu, urge on riches with your help; you, Agni, are the charioteer of this wealth; find for us a shallow ford for our offspring.

verses.sanskrit: पर्षि तोकं तनयं पर्तृभिष्ट्वमदब्धैरप्रयुत्वभिः । अग्ने हेडाँसि दैव्या युयोधि नोऽदेवानि हराँसि च
verses.transliteration: parShi tokaM tanayaM partR^ibhiShTvamadabdhairaprayutvabhiH | agne heDA.Nsi daivyA yuyodhi no.adevAni harA.Nsi cha
verses.translation: You save children and grandchildren with the unharmed, untiring protectors; Agni, drive away the divine anger and the godless forces from us.

verses.sanskrit: किमित्ते विष्णो परिचक्षि नाम प्र यद्ववक्षे शिपिविष्टो अस्मि । मा वर्पो अस्मदप गूह एतद्यदन्यरूपः समिथे बभूथ
verses.transliteration: kimitte viShNo parichakShi nAma pra yadvavakShe shipiviShTo asmi | mA varpo asmadapa gUha etadyadanyarUpaH samithe babhUtha
verses.translation: What is that name of yours, Vishnu, that you observe, when you declare "I am Shipivishta"? Do not hide from us this form, which you took in another shape in the battle.

verses.sanskrit: प्र तत्ते अद्य शिपिविष्ट हव्यमर्यः शँसामि वयुनानि विद्वान् । तं त्वा गृणामि तवसमतव्यान्क्षयन्तमस्य रजसः पराके
verses.transliteration: pra tatte adya shipiviShTa havyamaryaH sha.NsAmi vayunAni vidvAn | taM tvA gR^iNAmi tavasamatavyAnkShayantamasya rajasaH parAke
verses.translation: Today I proclaim that offering for you, O Shipivishta, knowing the ways; I praise you, the strong, who dwell at the far end of this space.

verses.sanskrit: वषट् ते विष्णवास आ कृणोमि तन्मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यम् । वर्धन्तु त्वा सुष्टुतयो गिरि मे यूयं पात स्वस्तभिः सदा नः
verses.transliteration: vaShaT te viShNavAsa A kR^iNomi tanme juShasva shipiviShTa havyam | vardhantu tvA suShTutayo giri me yUyaM pAta svastabhiH sadA naH
verses.translation: I make the vashat for you, Vishnu; accept my offering, O Shipivishta; may the good praises strengthen you; protect us always with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: वायो शुक्रो अयामि ते मध्वो अग्रं दिविष्टिषु । आ याहि सोमपीतये स्पार्हो देव नियुत्वता
verses.transliteration: vAyo shukro ayAmi te madhvo agraM diviShTiShu | A yAhi somapItaye spArho deva niyutvatA
verses.translation: O Vayu, I come with bright soma to you, the first of the honey, at the heavenly worship; come to drink the soma, desirable god with your team.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रश्च वायवेषाँ सोमानां पीतिमर्हथः । युवाँ हि यन्तीन्दवो निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक्
verses.transliteration: indrashcha vAyaveShA.N somAnAM pItimarhathaH | yuvA.N hi yantIndavo nimnamApo na sadhryak
verses.translation: Indra and Vayu, you deserve the drinking of these somas; for the drops go to you both, as waters flow down together.

verses.sanskrit: वायविन्द्रश्च शुष्मिणा सरथँ शवसस्पती । नियुत्वन्ता न ऊतय आ यातँ सोमपीतये
verses.transliteration: vAyavindrashcha shuShmiNA saratha.N shavasaspatI | niyutvantA na Utaya A yAta.N somapItaye
verses.translation: Vayu and Indra, strong, with one chariot, lords of strength, with your teams, come for help to drink the soma.

verses.sanskrit: अध क्षपा परिष्कृतो वाजाँ अभि प्र गाहते । यदी विवस्वतो धियो हरिँ हिन्वन्ति यातवे
verses.transliteration: adha kShapA pariShkR^ito vAjA.N abhi pra gAhate | yadI vivasvato dhiyo hari.N hinvanti yAtave
verses.translation: Then, adorned at night, he plunges into strengths when the thoughts of Vivasvat urge the bay one to go.

verses.sanskrit: तमस्य मर्जयामसि मदो य इन्द्रपातमः । यं गाव आसभिर्दधुः पुरा नूनं च सूरयः
verses.transliteration: tamasya marjayAmasi mado ya indrapAtamaH | yaM gAva AsabhirdadhuH purA nUnaM cha sUrayaH
verses.translation: We cleanse his exhilaration, which is best drunk by Indra, which the cows with their mouths and the sages set before and now.

verses.sanskrit: तं गाथया पुराण्या पुनानमभ्यनूषत । उतो कृपन्त धीतयो देवानां नाम बिभ्रतीः
verses.transliteration: taM gAthayA purANyA punAnamabhyanUShata | uto kR^ipanta dhItayo devAnAM nAma bibhratIH
verses.translation: They praised him, being purified, with an ancient song; and the thoughts, bearing the name of the gods, arranged.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः । सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम्
verses.transliteration: ashvaM na tvA vAravantaM vandadhyA agniM namobhiH | samrAjantamadhvarANAm
verses.translation: I praise you, Agni, like a horse with its mane, with homage — the sovereign of sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: स घा नः सूनुः शवसा पृथुप्रगामा सुशेवः । मीढ्वाँ अस्माकं बभूयात्
verses.transliteration: sa ghA naH sUnuH shavasA pR^ithupragAmA sushevaH | mIDhvA.N asmAkaM babhUyAt
verses.translation: May that son of ours, wide-going, kindly, generous, be strong.

verses.sanskrit: स नो दूराच्चासाच्च नि मर्त्यादघायोः । पाहि सदमिद्विश्वायुः
verses.transliteration: sa no dUrAchchAsAchcha ni martyAdaghAyoH | pAhi sadamidvishvAyuH
verses.translation: Protect us always from the mortal who intends evil, from far and near, you, all-living.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः । अशस्तिहा जनिता वृत्रतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः
verses.transliteration: tvamindra pratUrtiShvabhi vishvA asi spR^idhaH | ashastihA janitA vR^itratUrasi tvaM tUrya taruShyataH
