verses.translation: You, Indra, overcome all rivals in conflicts; you are the destroyer of slander, a begetter, the Vritra-smiter; you hasten the straining.

verses.sanskrit: अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयन्तमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा । विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयन्त मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिन्द्र तूर्वसि
verses.transliteration: anu te shuShmaM turayantamIyatuH kShoNI shishuM na mAtarA | vishvAste spR^idhaH shnathayanta manyave vR^itraM yadindra tUrvasi
verses.translation: Both worlds followed your speeding might, like mothers a child; all your enemies were broken at your wrath, when you, Indra, overcame Vritra.

verses.sanskrit: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् । चक्राण ओपशं दिवि
verses.transliteration: yaj~na indramavardhayadyadbhUmiM vyavartayat | chakrANa opashaM divi
verses.translation: The sacrifice made Indra grow when he turned the earth round, making a cover in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: व्या३न्तरिक्षमतिरन्मदे सोमस्य रोचना । इन्द्रो यदभिनद्वलम्
verses.transliteration: vyA3ntarikShamatiranmade somasya rochanA | indro yadabhinadvalam
verses.translation: In the exhilaration of soma he crossed the air and the lights, when Indra split Vala.

verses.sanskrit: उदगा आजदङ्गिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन्गुहा सतीः । अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलम्
verses.transliteration: udagA Ajada~Ngirobhya AviShkR^iNvanguhA satIH | arvA~nchaM nunude valam
verses.translation: He drove out the cows for the Angirases, revealing those hidden in the cave; he drove the nearest Vala.

verses.sanskrit: त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतम् । आ च्यावयस्यूतये
verses.transliteration: tyamu vaH satrAsAhaM vishvAsu gIrShvAyatam | A chyAvayasyUtaye
verses.translation: We praise him, who is conqueror in all battles, stretched out in all songs; may you bring him to help us.

verses.sanskrit: युध्मँ सन्तमनर्वाणँ सोमपामनपच्युतम् । नरमवार्यक्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: yudhma.N santamanarvANa.N somapAmanapachyutam | naramavAryakratum
verses.translation: The warrior, tireless, soma-drinker, unshaken, the man of irresistible skill.

verses.sanskrit: शिक्षा ण इन्द्र राय आ पुरु विद्वाँ ऋचीषम । अवा नः पार्ये धने
verses.transliteration: shikShA Na indra rAya A puru vidvA.N R^ichIShama | avA naH pArye dhane
verses.translation: Teach us, Indra, to wealth, knowing much, O praised with hymns; protect us in the farther gain.

verses.sanskrit: तव त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहत्तव दक्ष्ममुत क्रतुम् । वज्रँ शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यम्
verses.transliteration: tava tyadindriyaM bR^ihattava dakShmamuta kratum | vajra.N shishAti dhiShaNA vareNyam
verses.translation: Yours is that great power, Indra; yours the skill and wisdom; the thought sharpens the choice thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: तव द्यौरिन्द्र पौँस्यं पृथिवी वर्धति श्रवः । त्वामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे
verses.transliteration: tava dyaurindra pau.NsyaM pR^ithivI vardhati shravaH | tvAmApaH parvatAsashcha hinvire
verses.translation: Heaven, Indra, increases your manliness, earth your fame; the waters and mountains impel you.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां विष्णुर्बृहन्क्षयो मित्रो गृणाति वरुणः । त्वाँ शर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतम्
verses.transliteration: tvAM viShNurbR^ihankShayo mitro gR^iNAti varuNaH | tvA.N shardho madatyanu mArutam
verses.translation: Vishnu of great dwelling, Mitra, Varuna praise you; the Marut host exults after you.

verses.sanskrit: नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः । अमैरमित्रमर्दय
verses.transliteration: namaste agna ojase gR^iNanti deva kR^iShTayaH | amairamitramardaya
verses.translation: Homage to your might, O Agni; the peoples sing to you, O god. Crush our enemies with your strength.

verses.sanskrit: कुवित्सु नो गविष्टयेऽग्ने संवेषिषो रयिम् । उरुकृदुरु णस्कृधि
verses.transliteration: kuvitsu no gaviShTaye.agne saMveShiSho rayim | urukR^iduru NaskR^idhi
verses.translation: Surely, Agni, you will bring us wealth for the seeking of cattle; make wide, make wide for us.

verses.sanskrit: मा नो अग्ने महाधने परा वर्ग्भारभृद्यथा । संवर्गँ सँ रयिं जय
verses.transliteration: mA no agne mahAdhane parA vargbhArabhR^idyathA | saMvarga.N sa.N rayiM jaya
verses.translation: Agni, do not leave us in the great battle like a burden-bearer; win us the combined wealth.

verses.sanskrit: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः । समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः
verses.transliteration: samasya manyave visho vishvA namanta kR^iShTayaH | samudrAyeva sindhavaH
verses.translation: At his wrath the peoples bow, all the tribes, as rivers bow to the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: वि चिद्वृत्रस्य दोधतः शिरो बिभेद वृष्णिना । वज्रेण शतपर्वणा
verses.transliteration: vi chidvR^itrasya dodhataH shiro bibheda vR^iShNinA | vajreNa shataparvaNA
verses.translation: With the strong one he split the head of the quivering Vritra with the hundred-jointed thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit: ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्त्तयत् । इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी
verses.transliteration: ojastadasya titviSha ubhe yatsamavarttayat | indrashcharmeva rodasI
verses.translation: His might shone when he turned both, Indra, heaven and earth like a skin.

verses.sanskrit: सुमन्मा वस्वी रन्ती सूनरी
verses.transliteration: sumanmA vasvI rantI sUnarI
verses.translation: Well-minded, wealthy, delightful, kind.

verses.sanskrit: सरूप वृषन्ना गहीमौ भद्रौ धुर्यावभि । ताविमा उप सर्पतः
verses.transliteration: sarUpa vR^iShannA gahImau bhadrau dhuryAvabhi | tAvimA upa sarpataH
verses.translation: Come, bull of the same form; these two good yoke-bearers draw near to them.

verses.sanskrit: नीव शीर्षाणि मृढ्वं मध्य आपस्य तिष्ठति । शृङ्गेभिर्दशभिर्दिशन्
verses.transliteration: nIva shIrShANi mR^iDhvaM madhya Apasya tiShThati | shR^i~Ngebhirdashabhirdishan
verses.translation: The heads are bowed; in the middle of the water stands the gracious one, pointing with ten horns.

verses.sanskrit: पन्यंपन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय । सोमं वीराय शूराय
verses.transliteration: panyaMpanyamitsotAra A dhAvata madyAya | somaM vIrAya shUrAya
verses.translation: Run, pressers, to each praiseworthy one for exhilaration; press Soma for the hero, the brave.

verses.sanskrit: एह हरी ब्रह्मयुजा शग्मा वक्षतः सखायम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्गिर्वणसम्
verses.transliteration: eha harI brahmayujA shagmA vakShataH sakhAyam | indraM gIrbhirgirvaNasam
verses.translation: Come here, two prayer-yoked bay horses carrying the friend, Indra, who loves songs, with songs.

verses.sanskrit: पाता वृत्रहा सुतमा घा गमन्नारे अस्मत् । नि यमते शतमूतिः
verses.transliteration: pAtA vR^itrahA sutamA ghA gamannAre asmat | ni yamate shatamUtiH
verses.translation: The drinker, Vritra-slayer, comes to the pressed soma, far from us; the hundred-helper holds back.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते
verses.transliteration: A tvA vishantvindavaH samudramiva sindhavaH | na tvAmindrAti richyate
verses.translation: May the drops enter you as rivers the sea; none excels you, Indra.

verses.sanskrit: विव्यक्थ महिना वृषन्भक्षँ सोमस्य जागृवे । य इन्द्र जठरेषु ते
verses.transliteration: vivyaktha mahinA vR^iShanbhakSha.N somasya jAgR^ive | ya indra jaThareShu te
verses.translation: You have expanded, bull, by greatness, to enjoy the soma of the wakeful, which is, Indra, in your belly.

verses.sanskrit: अरं त इन्द्र कुक्षये सोमो भवतु वृत्रहन् । अरं धामभ्य इन्दवः
verses.transliteration: araM ta indra kukShaye somo bhavatu vR^itrahan | araM dhAmabhya indavaH
verses.translation: Let soma be enough for your belly, Vritra-slayer; the drops enough for the abodes.

verses.sanskrit: जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय । स्तोमँ रुद्राय दृशीकम्
verses.transliteration: jarAbodha tadviviDDhi vishevishe yaj~niyAya | stoma.N rudrAya dR^ishIkam
verses.translation: Awake the worshipful one; enter each clan for the sake of him who deserves worship — a pleasing hymn to Rudra.

verses.sanskrit: स नो महाँ अनिमानो धूमकेतुः पुरुश्चन्द्रः । धिये वाजाय हिन्वतु
verses.transliteration: sa no mahA.N animAno dhUmaketuH purushchandraH | dhiye vAjAya hinvatu
verses.translation: May the great, immeasurable, smoke-bannered, much-shining one urge us for thought and strength.

verses.sanskrit: स रेवाँ इव विश्पतिर्दैव्यः केतुः शृणोतु नः । उक्थैरग्निर्बृहद्भानुः
verses.transliteration: sa revA.N iva vishpatirdaivyaH ketuH shR^iNotu naH | ukthairagnirbR^ihadbhAnuH
verses.translation: May the lord of the clans, the divine banner, like a wealthy man, hear us; with hymns Agni of great light.

verses.sanskrit: तद्वो गाय सुते सचा पुरुहूताय सत्वने । शं यद्गवे न शाकिने
verses.transliteration: tadvo gAya sute sachA puruhUtAya satvane | shaM yadgave na shAkine
verses.translation: Sing to him together at the pressing, to the much-invoked, the mighty, for the blessing, like a cow for the powerful.

verses.sanskrit: न घा वसुर्नि यमते दानं वाजस्य गोमतः । यत्सीमुपश्रवद्गिरः
verses.transliteration: na ghA vasurni yamate dAnaM vAjasya gomataH | yatsImupashravadgiraH
verses.translation: The Vasu does not withhold the gift of cattle-rich strength when he hears the songs.

verses.sanskrit: कुवित्सस्य प्र हि व्रजं गोमन्तं दस्युहा गमत् । शचीभिरप नो वरत्
verses.transliteration: kuvitsasya pra hi vrajaM gomantaM dasyuhA gamat | shachIbhirapa no varat
verses.translation: Quickly the Dasyu-slayer indeed goes to the cattle-rich pen; with his powers may he protect us.

verses.sanskrit: इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा नि दधे पदम् । समूढमस्य पाँसुले
verses.transliteration: idaM viShNurvi chakrame tredhA ni dadhe padam | samUDhamasya pA.Nsule
verses.translation: Vishnu strode across this; he set his foot in three ways; the whole was gathered in his dusty step.

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि पदा वि चक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः । अतो धर्माणि धारयन्
verses.transliteration: trINi padA vi chakrame viShNurgopA adAbhyaH | ato dharmANi dhArayan
verses.translation: Vishnu, the unconquerable guardian, strode three steps, upholding laws thereby.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे । इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा
verses.transliteration: viShNoH karmANi pashyata yato vratAni paspashe | indrasya yujyaH sakhA
verses.translation: Behold the deeds of Vishnu, by which he touched the vows, the fit friend of Indra.

verses.sanskrit: तद्विष्णोः परमं पदँ सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः । दिवीव चक्षुराततम्
verses.transliteration: tadviShNoH paramaM pada.N sadA pashyanti sUrayaH | divIva chakShurAtatam
verses.translation: That highest step of Vishnu the seers always behold, like an eye spread in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: तद्विप्रासो विपन्युवो जागृवाँसः समिन्धते । विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: tadviprAso vipanyuvo jAgR^ivA.NsaH samindhate | viShNoryatparamaM padam
verses.translation: That, the sages, the wakeful, kindle together — the highest step of Vishnu.

verses.sanskrit: अतो देवा अवन्तु नो यतो विष्णुर्विचक्रमे । पृथिव्या अधि सानवि
verses.transliteration: ato devA avantu no yato viShNurvichakrame | pR^ithivyA adhi sAnavi
verses.translation: From where Vishnu strode, from there may the gods protect us, on the earth's summit.

verses.sanskrit: मो षु त्वा वाघतश्च नारे अस्मन्नि रीरमन् । आरात्ताद्व सधमादं न आ गहीह वा सन्नुप श्रुधि
verses.transliteration: mo Shu tvA vAghatashcha nAre asmanni rIraman | ArAttAdva sadhamAdaM na A gahIha vA sannupa shrudhi
verses.translation: Let not the ritual priests keep you from us far away; come to our shared feast from near or far, and listen here.

verses.sanskrit: इमे हि ते ब्रह्मकृतः सुते सचा मधौ न मक्ष आसते । इन्द्रे कामं जरितारो वसूयवो रथे न पादमा दधुः
verses.transliteration: ime hi te brahmakR^itaH sute sachA madhau na makSha Asate | indre kAmaM jaritAro vasUyavo rathe na pAdamA dadhuH
verses.translation: These prayer-makers sit together at the honey, like flies at the pressing; the singers, desiring wealth, place their desire in Indra as the foot upon the chariot.

verses.sanskrit: अस्तावि मन्म पूर्व्यं ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वोचत । पूर्वीरृतस्य बृहतीरनूषत स्तोतुर्मेधा असृक्षत
verses.transliteration: astAvi manma pUrvyaM brahmendrAya vochata | pUrvIrR^itasya bR^ihatIranUShata stoturmedhA asR^ikShata
verses.translation: An ancient thought has been praised; speak a prayer for Indra; they have sung the great ones of truth; the singer's wisdom has been released.

verses.sanskrit: समिन्द्रो रायो बृहतीरधूनुत सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यम् । सँ शुक्रासः शुचयः सं गवाशिरः सोमा इन्द्रममन्दिषुः
verses.transliteration: samindro rAyo bR^ihatIradhUnuta saM kShoNI samu sUryam | sa.N shukrAsaH shuchayaH saM gavAshiraH somA indramamandiShuH
verses.translation: Indra shook the great riches together, earth and Sun; the bright pure somas mixed with milk delighted Indra.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे । नरे च दक्षिणावते देवाय सदनासदे
verses.transliteration: indrAya soma pAtave vR^itraghne pari Shichyase | nare cha dakShiNAvate devAya sadanAsade
verses.translation: For Indra to drink, Soma, you are poured around for the Vritra-slayer, for the man, the giver of gifts, the god sitting in the seat.

verses.sanskrit: तँ सखायः पुरूरुचं यूयं वयं च सूरयः । अश्याम वाजगन्ध्यँ सनेम वाजपस्त्यम्
verses.transliteration: ta.N sakhAyaH purUruchaM yUyaM vayaM cha sUrayaH | ashyAma vAjagandhya.N sanema vAjapastyam
verses.translation: Friends, may we, the singers, attain that very radiant one, and win strength-giving wealth.

verses.sanskrit: परि त्यँ हर्यतँ हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण । यो देवान्विश्वाँ इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति
verses.transliteration: pari tya.N haryata.N hariM babhruM punanti vAreNa | yo devAnvishvA.N itpari madena saha gachChati
verses.translation: They purify with the sieve that beloved bay-brown one, who goes with exhilaration around all the gods.

verses.sanskrit: कस्तमिन्द्र त्वावसो मर्त्यो दधर्षति । श्रद्धा इत्तेमघवन् पार्ये दिवि वाजी वाजं सिषासति
verses.transliteration: kastamindra tvAvaso martyo dadharShati | shraddhA ittemaghavan pArye divi vAjI vAjaM siShAsati
verses.translation: What mortal, O Indra, dares to withstand you, Vasu? Faith in you, bounteous, in the farther heaven, the strong man wins strength.

verses.sanskrit: मघोनः स्म वृत्रहत्येषु चोदय ये ददति प्रिया वसु । तव प्रणीती हर्यश्व सूरिभिर्विश्वा तरेम दुरिता
verses.transliteration: maghonaH sma vR^itrahatyeShu chodaya ye dadati priyA vasu | tava praNItI haryashva sUribhirvishvA tarema duritA
verses.translation: Urge the bounteous in the Vritra-slayings, those who give dear wealth; by your guidance, bay-horsed one, with the patrons, may we cross all evils.

verses.sanskrit: एदु मधोर्मदिन्तरँ सिञ्चाध्वर्यो अन्धसः । एवा हि वीर स्तवते सदावृधः
verses.transliteration: edu madhormadintara.N si~nchAdhvaryo andhasaH | evA hi vIra stavate sadAvR^idhaH
verses.translation: Pour out, O Adhvaryu, the most exhilarating of the honeyed drink; so is the hero praised, ever growing.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र स्थातर्हरीणां न किष्टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिम् । उदानँश शवसा न भन्दना
verses.transliteration: indra sthAtarharINAM na kiShTe pUrvyastutim | udAna.Nsha shavasA na bhandanA
verses.translation: O Indra, stander on the bay horses, none reaches your ancient praise; none rejoices with might.

verses.sanskrit: तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि श्रवस्यवः । अप्रायुभिर्ज्ञेभिर्वावृधेन्यम्
verses.transliteration: taM vo vAjAnAM patimahUmahi shravasyavaH | aprAyubhirj~nebhirvAvR^idhenyam
verses.translation: We call him, lord of strengths, seeking fame, with ungrudging offerings, to be strengthened.

verses.sanskrit: तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे । देवत्रा हव्यमूहिषे
verses.transliteration: taM gUrdhayA svarNaraM devAso devamaratiM dadhanvire | devatrA havyamUhiShe
verses.translation: Praise him, the sun-leader, the god; the gods have set him as the unfailing god; you carry the offering among the gods.

verses.sanskrit: विभूतरातिं विप्र चित्रशोचिषमग्निमीडिष्व यन्तुरम् । अस्य मेधस्य सोम्यस्य सोभरे प्रेमध्वराय पूर्व्यम्
verses.transliteration: vibhUtarAtiM vipra chitrashochiShamagnimIDiShva yanturam | asya medhasya somyasya sobhare premadhvarAya pUrvyam
verses.translation: Praise Agni, giver of abundant bounty, O sage, of wondrous flame, the restrainer; at this rite of Soma, Sobhari, bring forth the first one for the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: आ सोम सवानो अद्रिभिस्तिरो वाराण्यव्यया । जनो न पुरि चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः सदो वनेषु दध्रिषे
verses.transliteration: A soma savAno adribhistiro vArANyavyayA | jano na puri chamvorvishaddhariH sado vaneShu dadhriShe
verses.translation: Come, Soma, sounding with the stones across the sheep's wool; like a man entering a city, the bay one enters the vessels, dwelling in the woods.

verses.sanskrit: स मामृजे तिरो अण्वानि मेष्यो मीड्वान्त्सप्तिर्न वाजयुः । अनुमाद्यः पवमानो मनीषिभिः सोमो विप्रेभिरृक्वभिः
verses.transliteration: sa mAmR^ije tiro aNvAni meShyo mIDvAntsaptirna vAjayuH | anumAdyaH pavamAno manIShibhiH somo viprebhirR^ikvabhiH
verses.translation: He is cleansed across the fine fleeces, the ram, the bountiful, like a horse seeking strength; to be rejoiced in, flowing, with the wise, Soma with the sages.

verses.sanskrit: वयमेनमिदा ह्योऽपीपेमेह वज्रिणम् । तस्मा उ अद्य सवने सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते
verses.transliteration: vayamenamidA hyo.apIpemeha vajriNam | tasmA u adya savane sutaM bharA nUnaM bhUShata shrute
verses.translation: We have indeed fed this thunderbolt-bearer here; today at the pressing bring the soma for him; honor now the famed one.

verses.sanskrit: वृकश्चिदस्य वारण उरामथिरा वयुनेषु भूषति । सेमं न स्तोमं जुजुषाण आ गहीन्द्र प्र चित्रया धिया
verses.transliteration: vR^ikashchidasya vAraNa urAmathirA vayuneShu bhUShati | semaM na stomaM jujuShANa A gahIndra pra chitrayA dhiyA
verses.translation: Even the wolf, at his barrier, adorns the wise among the observant; accepting this hymn of ours, come, Indra, with a wondrous thought.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी रोचना दिवः परि वाजेषु भूषथः । तद्वां चेति प्र वीर्यम्
verses.transliteration: indrAgnI rochanA divaH pari vAjeShu bhUShathaH | tadvAM cheti pra vIryam
verses.translation: Indra and Agni, you adorn the lights of heaven in battles; that heroism of yours is known.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी अपसस्परि उप प्र यन्ति धीतयः । ऋतस्य पथ्या अनु
verses.transliteration: indrAgnI apasaspari upa pra yanti dhItayaH | R^itasya pathyA anu
verses.translation: Indra and Agni, the thoughts go forth to your works, along the paths of truth.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी तविषाणि वाम् सधस्थानि प्रयाँसि च । युवोरप्तूर्यं हितम्
verses.transliteration: indrAgnI taviShANi vAm sadhasthAni prayA.Nsi cha | yuvoraptUryaM hitam
verses.translation: Indra and Agni, your strengths, seats and strengthening offerings are set for the winning of water.

verses.sanskrit: क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद्वयो दधे । अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्रयन्धसः
verses.transliteration: ka IM veda sute sachA pibantaM kadvayo dadhe | ayaM yaH puro vibhinattyojasA mandAnaH shiprayandhasaH
verses.translation: Who knows him, drinking with us at the pressing? What strength has he won? He who, delighted by the soma-drink of the fair-jawed, breaks the forts with might.

verses.sanskrit: दाना मृगो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे । न किष्ट्वा नि यमदा सुते गमो महाँश्चरस्योजसा
verses.transliteration: dAnA mR^igo na vAraNaH purutrA charathaM dadhe | na kiShTvA ni yamadA sute gamo mahA.NshcharasyojasA
verses.translation: Like a wild beast driven by gifts, you place your movement in many places; none restrains you at the pressing; great, you move by might.

verses.sanskrit: य उग्रः सन्ननिष्टृतः स्थिरो रणाय सँस्कृतः । यदि स्तोतुर्मघवा शृणवद्धवं नेन्द्रो योषत्या गमत्
verses.transliteration: ya ugraH sannaniShTR^itaH sthiro raNAya sa.NskR^itaH | yadi stoturmaghavA shR^iNavaddhavaM nendro yoShatyA gamat
verses.translation: He who is fierce, unfallen, firm, prepared for battle; if the bounteous one hears the call of the singer, Indra does not neglect, but comes.

verses.sanskrit: पवमाना असृक्षत सोमाः शुक्रास इन्दवः । अभि विश्वानि काव्या
verses.transliteration: pavamAnA asR^ikShata somAH shukrAsa indavaH | abhi vishvAni kAvyA
verses.translation: The flowing somas have been released, the bright drops, toward all poetry.

verses.sanskrit: पवमाना दिवस्पर्यन्तरिक्षादसृक्षत । पृथिव्या अधि सानवि
verses.transliteration: pavamAnA divasparyantarikShAdasR^ikShata | pR^ithivyA adhi sAnavi
verses.translation: The flowing ones have been released from heaven and from the air, on the summit of the earth.

verses.sanskrit: पवमानास आशवः शुभ्रा असृग्रमिन्दवः । घ्नन्तो विश्वा अप द्विषः
verses.transliteration: pavamAnAsa AshavaH shubhrA asR^igramindavaH | ghnanto vishvA apa dviShaH
verses.translation: The swift flowing, bright drops have been released, smiting all enemies.

verses.sanskrit: तोशा वृत्रहणा हुवे सजित्वानापराजिता । इन्द्राग्नी वाजसातमा
verses.transliteration: toshA vR^itrahaNA huve sajitvAnAparAjitA | indrAgnI vAjasAtamA
verses.translation: I call the swift, Vritra-slaying, victorious, unconquered ones, best winners of strength, Indra and Agni.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वामर्चन्त्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः । इन्द्राग्नी इष आ वृणे
verses.transliteration: pra vAmarchantyukthino nIthAvido jaritAraH | indrAgnI iSha A vR^iNe
verses.translation: The singers, knowing the leading, offer you hymns; Indra and Agni, I choose strength.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतम् । साकमेकेन कर्मणा
verses.transliteration: indrAgnI navatiM puro dAsapatnIradhUnutam | sAkamekena karmaNA
verses.translation: Indra and Agni, you shook ninety forts of the Dasa-wives with one deed together.

verses.sanskrit: उप त्वा रण्वसन्दृशं प्रयस्वन्तः सहस्कृत । अग्ने ससृज्महे गिरः
verses.transliteration: upa tvA raNvasandR^ishaM prayasvantaH sahaskR^ita | agne sasR^ijmahe giraH
verses.translation: We approach you, of pleasing sight, O born of strength, with offerings; Agni, we send songs.

verses.sanskrit: उप च्छायामिव घृणेरगन्म शर्म ते वयम् । अग्ने हिरण्यसन्दृशः
verses.transliteration: upa chChAyAmiva ghR^iNeraganma sharma te vayam | agne hiraNyasandR^ishaH
verses.translation: We have come to your shelter like shade from heat, O Agni, golden-seen.

verses.sanskrit: य उग्र इव शर्यहा तिग्मशृङ्गो न वँसगः । अग्ने पुरो रुरोजिथ
verses.transliteration: ya ugra iva sharyahA tigmashR^i~Ngo na va.NsagaH | agne puro rurojitha
verses.translation: You, Agni, who like a fierce archer, like a sharp-horned bull, broke the forts.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतावानं वैश्वानरमृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पतिम् । अजस्रं घर्ममीमहे
verses.transliteration: R^itAvAnaM vaishvAnaramR^itasya jyotiShaspatim | ajasraM gharmamImahe
verses.translation: We ask for the unceasing hot offering to Agni Vaishvanara, the truthful, lord of the light of truth.

verses.sanskrit: य इदं प्रतिपप्रथे यज्ञस्य स्वरुत्तिरन् । ऋतूनुत्सृजते वशी
verses.transliteration: ya idaM pratipaprathe yaj~nasya svaruttiran | R^itUnutsR^ijate vashI
verses.translation: He who has spread this out, crossing the sacrifice's sound, the master releases the seasons.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः प्रियेषु धामसु कामो भूतस्य भव्यस्य । सभ्राडेको वि राजति
verses.transliteration: agniH priyeShu dhAmasu kAmo bhUtasya bhavyasya | sabhrADeko vi rAjati
verses.translation: Agni in his dear abodes is the desire of what has been and will be; the one sovereign shines.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निः प्रत्नेन जन्मना शुम्भानस्तन्वा३ँ स्वाम् । कविर्विप्रेण ववृधे
verses.transliteration: agniH pratnena janmanA shumbhAnastanvA3.N svAm | kavirvipreNa vavR^idhe
verses.translation: Agni, adorning his own body by ancient birth, the seer has grown through the sage.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ज्जो नपातमा हुवेऽग्निं पावकशोचिषम् । अस्मिन्यज्ञे स्वध्वरे
verses.transliteration: Urjjo napAtamA huve.agniM pAvakashochiSham | asminyaj~ne svadhvare
verses.translation: I call Agni, grandson of strength, of pure flame, at this well-ordered sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: स नो मित्रमहस्त्वमग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा । देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि
verses.transliteration: sa no mitramahastvamagne shukreNa shochiShA | devairA satsi barhiShi
verses.translation: You, Agni, great friend, with bright flame, sit with the gods on the grass.

verses.sanskrit: उत्ते शुष्मासो अस्थू रक्षो भिन्दन्तो अद्रिवः । नुदस्व याः परिस्पृधः
verses.transliteration: utte shuShmAso asthU rakSho bhindanto adrivaH | nudasva yAH parispR^idhaH
verses.translation: Your strengths have risen, splitting the demons, O stone-bearer; drive away those who contend.

verses.sanskrit: अया निजघ्निरोजसा रथसङ्गे धने हिते । स्तवा अबिभ्युषा हृदा
verses.transliteration: ayA nijaghnirojasA rathasa~Nge dhane hite | stavA abibhyuShA hR^idA
verses.translation: With this might he struck down at the meeting of the chariots, when wealth is set; I praise with a fearless heart.

verses.sanskrit: अस्य व्रतानि नाधृषे पवमानस्य दूढ्या । रुज यस्त्वा पृतन्यति
verses.transliteration: asya vratAni nAdhR^iShe pavamAnasya dUDhyA | ruja yastvA pR^itanyati
verses.translation: The vows of this flowing one cannot be assailed; break him who attacks you.

verses.sanskrit: तँ हिन्वन्ति मदच्युतँ हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् । इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम्
verses.transliteration: ta.N hinvanti madachyuta.N hariM nadIShu vAjinam | indumindrAya matsaram
verses.translation: They urge on that exhilaration-dropping bay racer in the rivers, the drop for Indra, joyful.

verses.sanskrit: आ मन्द्रैरिन्द्र हरिभिर्याहि मयूररोमभिः । मा त्वा के चिन्नि येमुरिन्न पाशिनोऽति धन्वेव ताँ इहि
verses.transliteration: A mandrairindra haribhiryAhi mayUraromabhiH | mA tvA ke chinni yemurinna pAshino.ati dhanveva tA.N ihi
verses.translation: Come, Indra, with your joyful bay horses, with peacock-feathered coats; let none, though they bind you, hold you back; pass beyond them like an archer.

verses.sanskrit: वृत्रखादो वलँ रुजः पुरां दर्मो अपामजः । स्थाता रथस्य हर्योरभिस्वर इन्द्रो दृढा चिदारुजः
verses.transliteration: vR^itrakhAdo vala.N rujaH purAM darmo apAmajaH | sthAtA rathasya haryorabhisvara indro dR^iDhA chidArujaH
verses.translation: Devourer of Vritra, breaker of Vala, destroyer of forts, driver of the waters; standing on the chariot of the bay horses, loudly, Indra breaks even the firm.

verses.sanskrit: गम्भीराँ उदधीँरिव क्रतुं पुष्यसि गा इव । प्र सुगोपा यवसं धेनवो यथा ह्रदं कुल्या इवाशत
verses.transliteration: gambhIrA.N udadhI.Nriva kratuM puShyasi gA iva | pra sugopA yavasaM dhenavo yathA hradaM kulyA ivAshata
verses.translation: Like deep oceans you nourish skill, like cattle; like good herdsmen, like cows to fodder, like channels to a lake they reach.

verses.sanskrit: यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणम् । आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब
verses.transliteration: yathA gauro apA kR^itaM tR^iShyannetyaveriNam | Apitve naH prapitve tUyamA gahi kaNveShu su sachA piba
verses.translation: As a thirsty wild buffalo goes to the prepared water, so come swiftly in our kinship and our approach; drink well among the Kanvas.

verses.sanskrit: मन्दन्तु त्वा मघवन्निन्द्रेन्दवो राधोदेयाय सुन्वते । आमुष्या सोममपिबश्चमू सुतं ज्येष्ठं तद्दधिषे सहः
verses.transliteration: mandantu tvA maghavannindrendavo rAdhodeyAya sunvate | AmuShyA somamapibashchamU sutaM jyeShThaM taddadhiShe sahaH
verses.translation: May the drops delight you, bounteous Indra, so that you give wealth to the presser; you drank the soma pressed in the vessels — that eldest strength you hold.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमङ्ग प्र शुँसिषो देवः शविष्ठ मर्त्यम् । न त्वदन्यो मघवन्नस्ति मर्डितेन्द्र ब्रवीमि ते वचः
verses.transliteration: tvama~Nga pra shu.NsiSho devaH shaviShTha martyam | na tvadanyo maghavannasti marDitendra bravImi te vachaH
verses.translation: You indeed, O mightiest god, are praised for the mortal; there is no other than you, bounteous one, to be gracious; Indra, I speak this word to you.

verses.sanskrit: मा ते राधाँसि मा त ऊतयो वसोऽस्मान्कदा चना दभन् । विश्वा च न उपमिमीहि मानुष वसूनि चर्षणिभ्य आ
verses.transliteration: mA te rAdhA.Nsi mA ta Utayo vaso.asmAnkadA chanA dabhan | vishvA cha na upamimIhi mAnuSha vasUni charShaNibhya A
verses.translation: Let neither your bounties nor your helps ever harm us, O Vasu; and bring all treasures to us, to the peoples, O Manu.

verses.sanskrit: प्रति ष्या सूनरी जनी व्युच्छन्ती परि स्वसुः । दिवो अदर्शि दुहिता
verses.transliteration: prati ShyA sUnarI janI vyuchChantI pari svasuH | divo adarshi duhitA
verses.translation: Facing, the good leader of men, the one who shines around the sister, the daughter of heaven has been seen.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वेव चित्रारुषी माता गवामृतावरी । सखा भूदश्विनोरुषाः
verses.transliteration: ashveva chitrAruShI mAtA gavAmR^itAvarI | sakhA bhUdashvinoruShAH
verses.translation: Like a mare, wondrous, ruddy, mother of cows, truthful — Dawn became the friend of the Ashvins.

verses.sanskrit: उत सखास्यश्विनोरुत माता गवामसि । उतोषो वस्व ईशिषे
verses.transliteration: uta sakhAsyashvinoruta mAtA gavAmasi | utoSho vasva IshiShe
verses.translation: You are the friend of the Ashvins and the mother of cows; and, O Dawn, you rule over wealth.

verses.sanskrit: एषो उषा अपूर्व्य व्युच्छति प्रिया दिवः । स्तुषे वामश्विना बृहत्
verses.transliteration: eSho uShA apUrvya vyuchChati priyA divaH | stuShe vAmashvinA bR^ihat
verses.translation: This incomparable Dawn dawns, the beloved of heaven; I praise you, Ashvins, loudly.

verses.sanskrit: या दस्रा सिन्धुमातरा मनोतरा रयीणाम् । धिया देवा वसुविदा
verses.transliteration: yA dasrA sindhumAtarA manotarA rayINAm | dhiyA devA vasuvidA
verses.translation: Who are the wonder-workers, children of the river, swifter than thought of riches, finders of wealth with the gods by thought.

verses.sanskrit: वच्यन्ते वां ककुहासो जूर्णायामधि विष्टपि । यद्वाँ रथो विभिष्पतात्
verses.transliteration: vachyante vAM kakuhAso jUrNAyAmadhi viShTapi | yadvA.N ratho vibhiShpatAt
verses.translation: Your humps are spoken of on the old peak, where your chariot flew with the birds.

verses.sanskrit: उषस्तच्चित्रमा भरास्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति । येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे
verses.transliteration: uShastachchitramA bharAsmabhyaM vAjinIvati | yena tokaM cha tanayaM cha dhAmahe
verses.translation: O Dawn, bring that wondrous thing to us, O rich in strength, by which we may hold children and grandchildren.

verses.sanskrit: उषो अद्येह गोमत्यश्वावति विभावरि । रेवदस्मे व्युच्छ सूनृतावति
verses.transliteration: uSho adyeha gomatyashvAvati vibhAvari | revadasme vyuchCha sUnR^itAvati
verses.translation: O Dawn, today here, rich in cattle and horses, shining one, dawn richly for us, O truthful.

verses.sanskrit: युङ्क्ष्वा हि वाजिनीवत्यश्वाँ अद्यारुणाँ उषः । अथा नो विश्वा सौभगान्या वह
verses.transliteration: yu~NkShvA hi vAjinIvatyashvA.N adyAruNA.N uShaH | athA no vishvA saubhagAnyA vaha
verses.translation: Yoke, O Dawn, the ruddy horses, rich in strength, today; then bring us all good fortunes.

verses.sanskrit: अश्विना वर्तिरस्मदा गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् । अर्वाग्रथँ समनसा नि यच्छतम्
verses.transliteration: ashvinA vartirasmadA gomaddasrA hiraNyavat | arvAgratha.N samanasA ni yachChatam
verses.translation: Ashvins, bring your path to us with cattle and gold, wonder-workers; bring your chariot near, of one mind.

verses.sanskrit: एह देवा मयोभुवा दस्रा हिरण्यवर्त्तनी । उषर्बुधो वहन्तु सोमपीतये
verses.transliteration: eha devA mayobhuvA dasrA hiraNyavarttanI | uSharbudho vahantu somapItaye
verses.translation: Come here, gods, gladdening wonder-workers, golden-pathed; may the dawn-wakers carry you to drink the soma.

verses.sanskrit: यावित्था श्लोकमा दिवो ज्योतिर्जनाय चक्रथुः । आ न ऊर्जं वहतमश्विना युवम्
verses.transliteration: yAvitthA shlokamA divo jyotirjanAya chakrathuH | A na UrjaM vahatamashvinA yuvam
verses.translation: You who thus made the praise of heaven's light for the people, Ashvins, bring us strength.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निं तं मन्ये यो वसुरस्तं यं यन्ति धेनवः । अस्तमर्वन्त आशवोस्तं नित्यासो वाजिन इषँ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
verses.transliteration: agniM taM manye yo vasurastaM yaM yanti dhenavaH | astamarvanta AshavostaM nityAso vAjina iSha.N stotR^ibhya A bhara
verses.translation: I regard Agni as the one who is wealth, to whom the cows come home; home the swift horses, home the steadfast strong ones; bring food to the singers.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्हि वाजिनं विशे ददाति विश्वचर्षणिः । अग्नी राये स्वाभुवँ स प्रीतो याति वार्यमिषँ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
verses.transliteration: agnirhi vAjinaM vishe dadAti vishvacharShaNiH | agnI rAye svAbhuva.N sa prIto yAti vAryamiSha.N stotR^ibhya A bhara
verses.translation: For Agni, all-seeing, gives a racer to the clan; Agni gives wealth, self-existing; pleased, he goes to the choice; bring food to the singers.

verses.sanskrit: सो अग्निर्यो वसुर्गृणे सं यमायन्ति धेनवः । समर्वन्तो रघुद्रुवः सँ सुजातासः सूरय इषँ स्तोतृभ्य आ भर
verses.transliteration: so agniryo vasurgR^iNe saM yamAyanti dhenavaH | samarvanto raghudruvaH sa.N sujAtAsaH sUraya iSha.N stotR^ibhya A bhara
verses.translation: He is Agni, the Vasu, who is praised, to whom the cows come together, the swift horses, together the well-born sages; bring food to the singers.

verses.sanskrit: महे नो अद्य बोधयोषो राये दिवित्मती । यथा चिन्नो अबोधयः सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते
verses.transliteration: mahe no adya bodhayoSho rAye divitmatI | yathA chinno abodhayaH satyashravasi vAyye sujAte ashvasUnR^ite
verses.translation: Awaken us today to great wealth, O Dawn of heaven, as you have awakened us, true-famed, O Vayya, well-born, bringer of horses and good speech.

verses.sanskrit: या सुनीथे शौचद्रथे व्यौच्छो दुहितर्दिवः । सा व्युच्छ सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते
verses.transliteration: yA sunIthe shauchadrathe vyauchCho duhitardivaH | sA vyuchCha sahIyasi satyashravasi vAyye sujAte ashvasUnR^ite
verses.translation: You who dawned for the good leader Shaucadratha, daughter of heaven — dawn, then, upon the more strong, true-famed Vayya, well-born, rich in horses and truth.

verses.sanskrit: सा नो अद्याभरद्वसुर्व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवः । यो व्यौच्छः सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि याय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते
verses.transliteration: sA no adyAbharadvasurvyuchChA duhitardivaH | yo vyauchChaH sahIyasi satyashravasi yAyye sujAte ashvasUnR^ite
verses.translation: Bring us wealth today, Vasu; dawn, daughter of heaven, you who dawned on the stronger, true-famed, well-born, rich in horses and truth.

verses.sanskrit: प्रति प्रियतमँ रथं वृशणं वसुवाहनम् । स्तोता वामश्विनावृषि स्तोमेभिर्भूषति प्रति माध्वी मम श्रुतँ हवम्
verses.transliteration: prati priyatama.N rathaM vR^ishaNaM vasuvAhanam | stotA vAmashvinAvR^iShi stomebhirbhUShati prati mAdhvI mama shruta.N havam
verses.translation: Your best-loved chariot, the bull, carrier of wealth, O Ashvins — the singer adorns it with hymns; O honeyed ones, hear my call.

verses.sanskrit: अत्यायातमश्विना तिरो विश्वा अहँ सना । दस्रा हिरण्यवर्त्तनी सुषुम्णा सिन्धुवाहसा माध्वी मम श्रुतँ हवम्
verses.transliteration: atyAyAtamashvinA tiro vishvA aha.N sanA | dasrA hiraNyavarttanI suShumNA sindhuvAhasA mAdhvI mama shruta.N havam
verses.translation: Come across all sins, Ashvins, wonder-workers, golden-pathed, bringing happiness, river-carrying; O honeyed ones, hear my call.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो रत्नानि बिभ्रतावश्विना गच्छतं युवम् । रुद्रा हिरण्यवर्त्तनी जुषाणा वाजिनीवसू माध्वी मम श्रुतँ हवम्
verses.transliteration: A no ratnAni bibhratAvashvinA gachChataM yuvam | rudrA hiraNyavarttanI juShANA vAjinIvasU mAdhvI mama shruta.N havam
verses.translation: Bring us jewels, Ashvins; come, Rudras, golden-pathed, delighted, rich in strength; O honeyed ones, hear my call.

verses.sanskrit: अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासम् । यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सस्रते नाकमच्छ
verses.transliteration: abodhyagniH samidhA janAnAM prati dhenumivAyatImuShAsam | yahvA iva pra vayAmujjihAnAH pra bhAnavaH sasrate nAkamachCha
verses.translation: Agni has awakened with the kindling of the people, like Dawn approaching like a cow; like branches shooting up, his rays spread toward heaven.

verses.sanskrit: अबोधि होता यजथाय देवानूर्ध्वो अग्निः सुमनाः प्रातरस्थात् । समिद्धस्य रुशददर्शि पाजो महान्देवस्तमसो निरमोचि
verses.transliteration: abodhi hotA yajathAya devAnUrdhvo agniH sumanAH prAtarasthAt | samiddhasya rushadadarshi pAjo mahAndevastamaso niramochi
verses.translation: The priest has been awakened to worship the gods; Agni stands high, well-minded, in the morning; of the kindled his shining strength has been seen; the great god is freed from darkness.

verses.sanskrit: यदीं गणस्य रशनामजीगः शुचिरङ्क्ते शुचिभिर्गोभिरग्निः । आद्दक्षिणा युज्यते वाजयन्त्युत्तानामूर्ध्वो अधयज्जुहूभिः
verses.transliteration: yadIM gaNasya rashanAmajIgaH shuchira~Nkte shuchibhirgobhiragniH | AddakShiNA yujyate vAjayantyuttAnAmUrdhvo adhayajjuhUbhiH
verses.translation: When he pulled the girdle of the troop, the pure Agni anoints with pure cows; then the right fire-stick is yoked, striving; standing high, he eats with the ladles the stretched out.

verses.sanskrit: इदँ श्रेष्ठं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरागाच्चित्रः प्रकेतो अजनिष्ट विभ्वा । यथा प्रसूता सवितुः सवायैवा रात्र्युषसे योनिमारैक्
verses.transliteration: ida.N shreShThaM jyotiShAM jyotirAgAchchitraH praketo ajaniShTa vibhvA | yathA prasUtA savituH savAyaivA rAtryuShase yonimAraik
verses.translation: This best light of lights has come; the wondrous banner has been born, pervading; as the night, sent forth by Savitar for his impulse, gave way to the dawn.

verses.sanskrit: रुशाद्वत्सा रुशती श्वेत्यागादारैगु कृष्णा सदनान्यस्याः । समानबन्धू अमृते अनूची द्यावा वर्णं चरत आमिनाने
verses.transliteration: rushAdvatsA rushatI shvetyAgAdAraigu kR^iShNA sadanAnyasyAH | samAnabandhU amR^ite anUchI dyAvA varNaM charata AminAne
verses.translation: The white one has come, calf-bearing, shining; the dark has left her abodes; two immortal kinswomen, following one another, move, changing color, heaven's color.

verses.sanskrit: समानो अध्वा स्वस्रोरनन्तस्तमन्यान्या चरतो देवशिष्टे । न मेथेते न तस्थतुः सुमेके नक्तोषासा समनसा विरूपे
verses.transliteration: samAno adhvA svasroranantastamanyAnyA charato devashiShTe | na methete na tasthatuH sumeke naktoShAsA samanasA virUpe
verses.translation: The path of the two sisters is common and endless; they travel it in turn, taught by the gods; they do not hinder nor stand still, the two good-formed, night and dawn, of one mind, of different forms.

verses.sanskrit: आ भात्यग्निरुषसामनीकमुद्विप्राणां देवया वाचो अस्थुः । अर्वाञ्चा नूनँ रथ्येह यातं पीपिवाँसमश्विना घर्ममच्छ
verses.transliteration: A bhAtyagniruShasAmanIkamudviprANAM devayA vAcho asthuH | arvA~nchA nUna.N rathyeha yAtaM pIpivA.NsamashvinA gharmamachCha
verses.translation: Agni shines, the face of the dawns; the speeches of the sages, godly, have risen; come now here, you two charioteers, to the swollen hot milk, Ashvins.

verses.sanskrit: न सँस्कृतं प्र मिमीतो गमिष्ठान्ति नूनमश्विनोपस्तुतेह । दिवाभिपित्वेवसागमिष्ठा प्रत्यवर्त्तिं दाशुषे शम्भविष्ठा
verses.transliteration: na sa.NskR^itaM pra mimIto gamiShThAnti nUnamashvinopastuteha | divAbhipitvevasAgamiShThA pratyavarttiM dAshuShe shambhaviShThA
verses.translation: The two do not break the prepared offering; may they come near, Ashvins, now praised here; at day-time, on the evening, to the giver, the best-bringing, most blessed, the returning.

verses.sanskrit: उता यातँ सङ्गवे प्रातरह्नो मध्यन्दिन उदिता सूर्यस्य । दिवा नक्तमवसा शन्तमेन नेदानीं पीतिरश्विना ततान
verses.transliteration: utA yAta.N sa~Ngave prAtarahno madhyandina uditA sUryasya | divA naktamavasA shantamena nedAnIM pItirashvinA tatAna
verses.translation: And come at the milking in the morning of the day, and at midday at the rising of the sun; by day and night with most comfortable help; the drinking of you two has not yet been spread, Ashvins.

verses.sanskrit: एता उ त्या उषसः केतुमक्रत पूर्वे अर्धे रजसो भानुमञ्जते । निष्कृण्वाना आयुधानीव धृष्णवः प्रति गावोऽरुषीर्यन्ति मातरः
verses.transliteration: etA u tyA uShasaH ketumakrata pUrve ardhe rajaso bhAnuma~njate | niShkR^iNvAnA AyudhAnIva dhR^iShNavaH prati gAvo.aruShIryanti mAtaraH
verses.translation: These dawns have made a banner; in the eastern half of space they adorn their light; like bold ones preparing weapons, the ruddy cows, the mothers, go forward.

verses.sanskrit: उदपप्तन्नरुणा भानवो वृथा स्वायुजो अरुषीर्गा अयुक्षत । अक्रन्नुषासो वयुनानि पूर्वथा रुशन्तं भानुमरुषीरशिश्रयुः
verses.transliteration: udapaptannaruNA bhAnavo vR^ithA svAyujo aruShIrgA ayukShata | akrannuShAso vayunAni pUrvathA rushantaM bhAnumaruShIrashishrayuH
verses.translation: The ruddy rays have flown up in vain; the well-yoked ones yoked the ruddy cows; the dawns made the signs as before; the ruddy ones rested on the shining light.

verses.sanskrit: अर्चन्ति नारीरपसो न विष्टिभिः समानेन योजनेना परावतः । इषं वहन्तीः सुकृते सुदानवे विश्वेदह यजमानाय सुन्वते
verses.transliteration: archanti nArIrapaso na viShTibhiH samAnena yojanenA parAvataH | iShaM vahantIH sukR^ite sudAnave vishvedaha yajamAnAya sunvate
verses.translation: They sing like women in their works, with one yoking from afar, bringing nourishment for the good doer, the good giver, for the sacrificer who presses every day.

verses.sanskrit: अबोध्यग्निर्ज्म उदेति सूर्यो व्यू३षाश्चन्द्रा मह्यावो अर्चिषा । आयुक्षातामश्विना यातवे रथं प्रासावीद्देवः सविता जगत्पृथक्
verses.transliteration: abodhyagnirjma udeti sUryo vyU3ShAshchandrA mahyAvo archiShA | AyukShAtAmashvinA yAtave rathaM prAsAvIddevaH savitA jagatpR^ithak
verses.translation: Agni has been awakened; the Sun rises from the earth; Dawn, the moon, has shone with great light; the Ashvins have yoked their chariot to go; the god Savitar has impelled the world apart.

verses.sanskrit: यद्युञ्जाथे वृषणमश्विना रथं घृतेन नो मधुना क्षत्रमुक्षतम् । अस्माकं ब्रह्म पृतनासु जिन्वतं वयं धना शूरसाता भजेमहि
verses.transliteration: yadyu~njAthe vR^iShaNamashvinA rathaM ghR^itena no madhunA kShatramukShatam | asmAkaM brahma pR^itanAsu jinvataM vayaM dhanA shUrasAtA bhajemahi
verses.translation: When, Ashvins, you yoke the bull-chariot, sprinkle our kingly power with ghee and honey; strengthen our prayer in battles; may we win wealth in hero-contests.

verses.sanskrit: अर्वाङ्त्रिचक्रो मधुवाहनो रथो जीराश्वो अश्विनोर्यातु सुष्टुतः । त्रिवन्धुरो मघवा विश्वसौभगः शं न आ वक्षद्द्विपदे चतुष्पदे
verses.transliteration: arvA~Ntrichakro madhuvAhano ratho jIrAshvo ashvinoryAtu suShTutaH | trivandhuro maghavA vishvasaubhagaH shaM na A vakShaddvipade chatuShpade
verses.translation: Let the three-wheeled, honey-carrying chariot of the Ashvins, with swift horses, well praised, come near; three-seated, bounteous, giving all good fortune, may it bring well-being to our two-footed and four-footed.

verses.sanskrit: प्र ते धारा असश्चतो दिवो न यन्ति वृष्टयः । अच्छा वाजँ सहस्रिणम्
verses.transliteration: pra te dhArA asashchato divo na yanti vR^iShTayaH | achChA vAja.N sahasriNam
verses.translation: Your unattached streams go like rains from heaven toward a thousandfold strength.

verses.sanskrit: अभि प्रियाणि काव्या विश्वा चक्षाणो अर्षति । हरिस्तुञ्जान आयुधा
verses.transliteration: abhi priyANi kAvyA vishvA chakShANo arShati | haristu~njAna AyudhA
verses.translation: Looking toward dear poems and all, the bay one flows, pressing weapons.

verses.sanskrit: स मर्मृजान आयुभिरिभो राजेव सुव्रतः । श्येनो न वँसु षीदति
verses.transliteration: sa marmR^ijAna Ayubhiribho rAjeva suvrataH | shyeno na va.Nsu ShIdati
verses.translation: He, cleansed by the Ayus, a king of good vows, sits in the fleece like a falcon on wealth.

verses.sanskrit: स नो विश्वा दिवो वसूतो पृथिव्या अधि । पुनान इन्दवा भर
verses.transliteration: sa no vishvA divo vasUto pR^ithivyA adhi | punAna indavA bhara
verses.translation: Bring us, O drop, all treasures from heaven and from the earth, purifying.

verses.sanskrit: प्रास्य धारा अक्षरन्वृष्णः सुतस्यौजसा । देवाँ अनु प्रभूषतः
verses.transliteration: prAsya dhArA akSharanvR^iShNaH sutasyaujasA | devA.N anu prabhUShataH
verses.translation: His streams have flowed forth by the might of the pressed bull, adorning toward the gods.

verses.sanskrit: सप्तिं मृजन्ति वेधसो गृणन्तः कारवो गिरा । ज्योतिर्जज्ञानमुक्थ्यम्
verses.transliteration: saptiM mR^ijanti vedhaso gR^iNantaH kAravo girA | jyotirjaj~nAnamukthyam
verses.translation: The ordainers cleanse the horse, the singers praise with song, the light being born, worthy of praise.

verses.sanskrit: सुषहा सोम तानि ते पुनानाय प्रभूवसो । वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम्
verses.transliteration: suShahA soma tAni te punAnAya prabhUvaso | vardhA samudramukthyam
verses.translation: Those are easily overcome by you, Soma, flowing, O lord of wealth; strengthen the praiseworthy ocean.

verses.sanskrit: एष ब्रह्मा य ऋत्विय इन्द्रो नाम श्रुतो गृणे
verses.transliteration: eSha brahmA ya R^itviya indro nAma shruto gR^iNe
verses.translation: This is the prayer, the seasonal; I praise Indra, the famed by name.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामिच्छवसस्पते यन्ति गिरो न संयतः
verses.transliteration: tvAmichChavasaspate yanti giro na saMyataH
verses.translation: To you, lord of strength, the songs go like restrained ones.

verses.sanskrit: वि स्रुतयो यथा पथा इन्द्र त्वद्यन्तु रातयः
verses.transliteration: vi srutayo yathA pathA indra tvadyantu rAtayaH
verses.translation: Like streams on paths, may your gifts, Indra, go forth in all directions.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा रथं यथोतये सुम्नाय वर्त्तयामसि । तुविकूर्मिमृतीषहमिन्द्रं शविष्ठ सत्पतिम्
verses.transliteration: A tvA rathaM yathotaye sumnAya varttayAmasi | tuvikUrmimR^itIShahamindraM shaviShTha satpatim
verses.translation: We turn you toward help and favor like a chariot — the strong-acting, helper, bountiful, mightiest Indra, lord of the good.

verses.sanskrit: तुविशुष्म तुविक्रतो शचीवो विश्वया मते । आ पप्राथ महित्वना
verses.transliteration: tuvishuShma tuvikrato shachIvo vishvayA mate | A paprAtha mahitvanA
verses.translation: O of great strength, of great wisdom, rich in power, with all your thought you have filled all by your greatness.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य ते महिना महः परि ज्मायन्तमीयतुः । हस्ता वज्रँ हिरण्ययम्
verses.transliteration: yasya te mahinA mahaH pari jmAyantamIyatuH | hastA vajra.N hiraNyayam
verses.translation: Whose greatness, Indra, the two hands, holding the golden thunderbolt, went around the earth.

verses.sanskrit: आ यः पुरं नार्मिणीमदीदेदत्यः कविर्नभन्यो३ नार्व । सूरो न रुरुक्वाञ्छतात्मा
verses.transliteration: A yaH puraM nArmiNImadIdedatyaH kavirnabhanyo3 nArva | sUro na rurukvA~nChatAtmA
verses.translation: Who lit up the fort of the Narmin, the seer in the cloud, like a bright young bull, a sun-like shining one, hundred-souled.

verses.sanskrit: अभि द्विजन्मा त्री रोचनानि विश्वा रजाँसि शुशुचनो अस्थात् । होता यजिष्ठो अपाँ सधस्थे
verses.transliteration: abhi dvijanmA trI rochanAni vishvA rajA.Nsi shushuchano asthAt | hotA yajiShTho apA.N sadhasthe
verses.translation: Twice-born, he has stood shining over the three lights and all spaces; the best sacrificing priest in the seat of the waters.

verses.sanskrit: अयँ स होता यो द्विजन्मा विश्वा दधे वार्याणि श्रवस्या । मर्तो यो अस्मै सुतुको ददाश
verses.transliteration: aya.N sa hotA yo dvijanmA vishvA dadhe vAryANi shravasyA | marto yo asmai sutuko dadAsha
verses.translation: This is the priest who, twice-born, holds all desirable and famous things; to the mortal, good in children, who gives to him.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने तमद्याष्वं न स्तोमैः क्रतुं न भद्रँ हृदिस्पृषम् । ऋध्यामा त ओहैः
verses.transliteration: agne tamadyAShvaM na stomaiH kratuM na bhadra.N hR^idispR^iSham | R^idhyAmA ta ohaiH
verses.translation: Agni, today we make you succeed with praises, like a horse, as skill that touches the heart, with our offerings.

verses.sanskrit: अधा ह्यग्ने क्रतोर्भद्रस्य दक्षस्य साधोः । रथीरृतस्य बृहतो बभूथ
verses.transliteration: adhA hyagne kratorbhadrasya dakShasya sAdhoH | rathIrR^itasya bR^ihato babhUtha
verses.translation: Then, Agni, you are the charioteer of auspicious, skilful, effective skill, of the great truth.

verses.sanskrit: एभिर्नो अर्कैर्भवा नो अर्वाङ्क्स्वा३र्ण ज्योतिः । अग्ने विश्वेभिः सुमना अनीकैः
verses.transliteration: ebhirno arkairbhavA no arvA~NksvA3rNa jyotiH | agne vishvebhiH sumanA anIkaiH
verses.translation: With these hymns, be favorable to us, light like heaven; Agni, with all your flames, be kind.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने विवस्वदुषसश्चित्रँ राधो अमर्त्य । आ दाशुषे जातवेदो वहा त्वमद्या देवाँ उषर्बुधः
verses.transliteration: agne vivasvaduShasashchitra.N rAdho amartya | A dAshuShe jAtavedo vahA tvamadyA devA.N uSharbudhaH
verses.translation: O Agni, immortal, bring bright wondrous wealth with the dawn; carry the gods who wake with the dawn to the giver today.

verses.sanskrit: जुष्टो हि दूतो असि हव्यवाहनोऽग्ने रथीरध्वराणाम् । सजूरश्विभ्यामुषसा सुवीर्यमस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहत्
verses.transliteration: juShTo hi dUto asi havyavAhano.agne rathIradhvarANAm | sajUrashvibhyAmuShasA suvIryamasme dhehi shravo bR^ihat
verses.translation: You are a beloved messenger, carrier of offerings, Agni, charioteer of sacrifices; together with the Ashvins and Dawn, give us heroic fame, great.

verses.sanskrit: विधुं दद्राणँ समने बहूनां युवानँ सन्तं पलितो जगार । देवस्य पश्य काव्यं महित्वाद्या ममार स ह्यः समान
verses.transliteration: vidhuM dadrANa.N samane bahUnAM yuvAna.N santaM palito jagAra | devasya pashya kAvyaM mahitvAdyA mamAra sa hyaH samAna
verses.translation: The gray one swallowed the shaker, the youth, in the gathering of many; see the poem of the god in its greatness — today he is dead, yesterday he lived.

verses.sanskrit: शाक्मना शाको अरुणः सुपर्ण आ यो महः शूरः सनादनीडः । यच्चिकेत सत्यमित्तन्न मोघं वसु स्पार्हमुत जेतोत दाता
verses.transliteration: shAkmanA shAko aruNaH suparNa A yo mahaH shUraH sanAdanIDaH | yachchiketa satyamittanna moghaM vasu spArhamuta jetota dAtA
verses.translation: The able one by his power, the ruddy fair-winged, the great hero, ever-dwelling; what he knows is true and not in vain, the desirable treasure, he is both winner and giver.

verses.sanskrit: ऐभिर्ददे वृष्ण्या पौँस्यानि येभिरौक्षद्वृत्रहत्याय वज्री । ये कर्मणः क्रियमाणस्य मह्न ऋतेकर्ममुदजायन्त देवाः
verses.transliteration: aibhirdade vR^iShNyA pau.NsyAni yebhiraukShadvR^itrahatyAya vajrI | ye karmaNaH kriyamANasya mahna R^itekarmamudajAyanta devAH
verses.translation: With these he took the manly powers by which the thunderbolt-bearer slew Vritra; the gods who were born from the work, from the greatness of the work being done, without work.

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति सोमो अयँ सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः । उत स्वराजो अश्विना
verses.transliteration: asti somo aya.N sutaH pibantyasya marutaH | uta svarAjo ashvinA
verses.translation: This soma has been pressed; the Maruts drink of it, and also the self-ruling Ashvins.

verses.sanskrit: पिबन्ति मित्रो अर्यमा तना पूतस्य वरुणः । त्रिषधस्थस्य जावतः
verses.transliteration: pibanti mitro aryamA tanA pUtasya varuNaH | triShadhasthasya jAvataH
verses.translation: Mitra, Aryaman and Varuna drink of the extended purified one, of the three-seated, vigorous.

verses.sanskrit: उतो न्वस्य जोषमा इन्द्रः सुतस्य गोमतः । प्रातर्होतेव मत्सति
verses.transliteration: uto nvasya joShamA indraH sutasya gomataH | prAtarhoteva matsati
verses.translation: And now Indra enjoys the pressed soma with cattle; he rejoices like the morning priest.

verses.sanskrit: बण्महाँ असि सूर्य बडादित्य महाँ असि । महस्ते सतो महिमा पनिष्तम मह्ना देव महाँ असि
verses.transliteration: baNmahA.N asi sUrya baDAditya mahA.N asi | mahaste sato mahimA paniShtama mahnA deva mahA.N asi
verses.translation: Indeed you are great, O Sun; indeed, O Aditya, you are great; the greatness of you who exist is most to be praised; by might, O god, you are great.

verses.sanskrit: बट् सूर्य श्रवसा महाँ असि सत्रा देव महाँ असि । मह्ना देवानामसुर्यः पुरोहितो विभु ज्योतिरदाभ्यम्
verses.transliteration: baT sUrya shravasA mahA.N asi satrA deva mahA.N asi | mahnA devAnAmasuryaH purohito vibhu jyotiradAbhyam
verses.translation: Indeed, Sun, by fame you are great; ever, god, you are great; by greatness the lord-power of the gods, the household priest, all-pervading, unconquerable light.

verses.sanskrit: उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम्
verses.transliteration: upa no haribhiH sutaM yAhi madAnAM pate | upa no haribhiH sutam
verses.translation: Come to us with your bay horses to the pressed soma, lord of exhilarations; come to us with your bay horses to the pressed soma.

verses.sanskrit: द्विता यो वृत्रहन्तमो विद इन्द्रः शतक्रतुः । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम्
verses.transliteration: dvitA yo vR^itrahantamo vida indraH shatakratuH | upa no haribhiH sutam
verses.translation: Who in two ways is the best Vritra-slayer, known, Indra, the hundred-powered; come to the pressed soma with your bay horses.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ हि वृत्रहन्नेषां पाता सोमानामसि । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम्
verses.transliteration: tva.N hi vR^itrahanneShAM pAtA somAnAmasi | upa no haribhiH sutam
verses.translation: For you, Vritra-slayer, are the drinker of these somas; come to the pressed soma with your bay horses.

verses.sanskrit: प्र वो महे महेवृधे भरध्वं प्रचेतसे प्र सुमतिं कृणुध्वम् । विशः पूर्वीः प्र चर चर्षणिप्राः
verses.transliteration: pra vo mahe mahevR^idhe bharadhvaM prachetase pra sumatiM kR^iNudhvam | vishaH pUrvIH pra chara charShaNiprAH
verses.translation: Bring your offering to the great, who grows by greatness; make favor to the wise one; roam through the ancient clans, fulfilling the peoples.

verses.sanskrit: उरुव्यचसे महिने सुवृक्तिमिन्द्राय ब्रह्म जनयन्त विप्राः । तस्य व्रतानि न मिनन्ति धीराः
verses.transliteration: uruvyachase mahine suvR^iktimindrAya brahma janayanta viprAH | tasya vratAni na minanti dhIrAH
verses.translation: The sages brought forth a fair praise, a prayer, for the wide-going great Indra; the steadfast do not break his vows.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं वाणीरनुत्तमन्युमेव सत्रा राजानं दधिरे सहध्यै । हर्यश्वाय बर्हया समापीन्
verses.transliteration: indraM vANIranuttamanyumeva satrA rAjAnaM dadhire sahadhyai | haryashvAya barhayA samApIn
verses.translation: The songs have set Indra, whose wrath is unyielded, as king in order to overcome; they swelled with great strength for the bay-horsed.

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्र यावतस्त्वमेतावदहमीशीय । स्तोतारमिद्दधिषे रदावसो न पापत्वाय रँसिषम्
verses.transliteration: yadindra yAvatastvametAvadahamIshIya | stotAramiddadhiShe radAvaso na pApatvAya ra.NsiSham
verses.translation: Indra, as much as you are, I would be master of so much; I would nourish your praiser, O giver of wealth, and I would not exult in evil.

verses.sanskrit: शिक्षेयमिन्महयते दिवेदिवे राय आ कुहचिद्विदे । न हि त्वदन्यन्मघवन्न आप्यं वस्यो अस्ति पिता च न
verses.transliteration: shikSheyaminmahayate divedive rAya A kuhachidvide | na hi tvadanyanmaghavanna ApyaM vasyo asti pitA cha na
verses.translation: May I be able to teach this one, honoring day by day, to wealth somewhere; for there is nothing other than you, bounteous one, no better kinsman, and no father.

verses.sanskrit: श्रुधी हवं विपिपानस्याद्रेर्बोधा विप्रस्यार्चतो मनीषाम् । कृष्वा दुवाँस्यन्तमा सचेमा
verses.transliteration: shrudhI havaM vipipAnasyAdrerbodhA viprasyArchato manIShAm | kR^iShvA duvA.NsyantamA sachemA
verses.translation: Hear the call of the drinker of the stone-pressed soma; heed the thought of the sage who sings; make our service nearest; may we be joined.

verses.sanskrit: न ते गिरो अपि मृष्ये तुरस्य न सुष्टुतिमसुर्यस्य विद्वान् । सदा ते नाम स्वयशो विवक्मि
verses.transliteration: na te giro api mR^iShye turasya na suShTutimasuryasya vidvAn | sadA te nAma svayasho vivakmi
verses.translation: I do not forget your songs of the swift, nor the good praise of the mighty one, knowing; I always speak your name of self-glory.

verses.sanskrit: भूरि हि ते सवना मानुषेषु भूरि मनीषी हवते त्वामित् । मारे अस्मन्मघवञ्ज्योक्कः
verses.transliteration: bhUri hi te savanA mAnuSheShu bhUri manIShI havate tvAmit | mAre asmanmaghava~njyokkaH
verses.translation: Many are your pressings among men; the wise one invokes you alone; do not send us far away, bounteous one, for long.

verses.sanskrit: प्रो ष्वस्मै पुरोरथमिन्द्राय शूषमर्चत । अभीके चिदु लोककृत्सङ्गे समत्सु वृत्रह । अस्माकं बोधि चोदिता नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु
verses.transliteration: pro Shvasmai purorathamindrAya shUShamarchata | abhIke chidu lokakR^itsa~Nge samatsu vR^itraha | asmAkaM bodhi choditA nabhantAmanyakeShAM jyAkA adhi dhanvasu
verses.translation: Honor well this Indra with strength in front of his chariot; the world-maker even in the near, in the meeting, in battles, Vritra-slayer; be our urger; let the bowstrings of our enemies break on their bows.

verses.sanskrit: त्वँ सिन्धूँरवासृजोऽधराचो अहन्नहिम् । अशत्रुरिन्द्र जज्ञिषे विश्वं पुष्यसि वार्यम् । तं त्वा परि ष्वजामहे नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु
verses.transliteration: tva.N sindhU.NravAsR^ijo.adharAcho ahannahim | ashatrurindra jaj~niShe vishvaM puShyasi vAryam | taM tvA pari ShvajAmahe nabhantAmanyakeShAM jyAkA adhi dhanvasu
verses.translation: You released the rivers downward and slew the serpent; unfoed, Indra, you were born; you nourish all desirable things; we embrace you; let the bowstrings of our enemies break on their bows.

verses.sanskrit: वि षु विश्वा अरातयोऽर्यो नशन्त नो धियः । अस्तासि शत्रवे वधं यो न इन्द्र जिघाँसति । या ते रातिर्ददिवसु नभन्तामन्यकेषां ज्याका अधि धन्वसु
verses.transliteration: vi Shu vishvA arAtayo.aryo nashanta no dhiyaH | astAsi shatrave vadhaM yo na indra jighA.Nsati | yA te rAtirdadivasu nabhantAmanyakeShAM jyAkA adhi dhanvasu
verses.translation: Let all grudges and enemies vanish from our thoughts; you throw the weapon at the foe who wishes to slay us, Indra; whatever bounty you have given — let the bowstrings of our enemies break on their bows.

verses.sanskrit: रेवाँ इद्रेवत स्तोता स्यात्त्वावतो मघोनः । प्रेदु हरिवः सुतस्य
verses.transliteration: revA.N idrevata stotA syAttvAvato maghonaH | predu harivaH sutasya
verses.translation: Let the praiser be wealthy, one like you, bounteous and wealthy; flow forth, O bay-horsed, to the pressed soma.

verses.sanskrit: उक्थं च न शस्यमानं नागो रयिरा चिकेत । न गायत्रं गीयमानम्
verses.transliteration: ukthaM cha na shasyamAnaM nAgo rayirA chiketa | na gAyatraM gIyamAnam
verses.translation: Neither the recited hymn nor the wealth is known to be praised; nor is the Gayatri sung.

verses.sanskrit: मा न इन्द्र पीयत्नवे मा शर्धते परा दाः । शिक्षा शचीवः शचीभिः
verses.transliteration: mA na indra pIyatnave mA shardhate parA dAH | shikShA shachIvaH shachIbhiH
verses.translation: Do not give us up, Indra, to the one who would drink us up, nor to the violent; teach with your powers, O powerful one.

verses.sanskrit: एन्द्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिम् । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो
verses.transliteration: endra yAhi haribhirupa kaNvasya suShTutim | divo amuShya shAsato divaM yaya divAvaso
verses.translation: Come, Indra, with your bay horses to the fair praise of Kanva; go to heaven, to that heaven that rules, O Vasu of the day.

verses.sanskrit: अत्रा वि नेमिरेषामुरां न धूनुते वृकः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो
verses.transliteration: atrA vi nemireShAmurAM na dhUnute vR^ikaH | divo amuShya shAsato divaM yaya divAvaso
verses.translation: Here the wheel-rim of these is shaken like the wolf shakes the sheep; go to heaven, to that heaven which rules, O Vasu of the day.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा ग्रावा वदनीह सोमी घोषेण वक्षतु । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो
verses.transliteration: A tvA grAvA vadanIha somI ghoSheNa vakShatu | divo amuShya shAsato divaM yaya divAvaso
verses.translation: Let the soma-pressing stone sound for you here and bring you with its voice; go to heaven, to that heaven which rules, O Vasu of the day.

verses.sanskrit: पवस्व सोम मन्दयन्निन्द्राय मधुमत्तमः
verses.transliteration: pavasva soma mandayannindrAya madhumattamaH
verses.translation: Flow, Soma, delighting Indra, most honeyed.

verses.sanskrit: ते सुतासो विपश्चितः शुक्रा वायुमसृक्षत
verses.transliteration: te sutAso vipashchitaH shukrA vAyumasR^ikShata
verses.translation: Those pressed, wise, bright ones released themselves to Vayu.

verses.sanskrit: असृग्रं देववीतये वाजयन्तो रथा इव
verses.transliteration: asR^igraM devavItaye vAjayanto rathA iva
verses.translation: They have been released for the gods' feast, like chariots seeking strength.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निँ होतारं मन्ये दास्वन्तं वसोः सूनुँ सहसो जातवेदसं विप्रं न जातवेदसम् । य ऊर्ध्वरो स्वध्वरो देवो देवाच्या कृपा । घृतस्य विभ्राष्टिमनु शुक्रशोचिष आजुह्वानस्य सर्पिषः
verses.transliteration: agni.N hotAraM manye dAsvantaM vasoH sUnu.N sahaso jAtavedasaM vipraM na jAtavedasam | ya Urdhvaro svadhvaro devo devAchyA kR^ipA | ghR^itasya vibhrAShTimanu shukrashochiSha AjuhvAnasya sarpiShaH
verses.translation: I regard Agni as the priest, the giver, the son of the Vasu, born of strength, Jatavedas, the sage; the god who goes well-sacrificing with his high-reaching grace to the gods, after the shining of the ghee, of the bright-flamed one, the poured butter.

verses.sanskrit: यजिष्ठं त्वा यजमाना हुवेम ज्येष्ठमङ्गिरसां विप्र मन्मभिर्विप्रेभिः शुक्र मन्मभिः । परिज्मानमिव द्याँ होतारं चर्षणीनाम् । शोचिष्केशं वृषणं यमिमा विशः प्रावन्तु जूतये विशः
verses.transliteration: yajiShThaM tvA yajamAnA huvema jyeShThama~NgirasAM vipra manmabhirviprebhiH shukra manmabhiH | parijmAnamiva dyA.N hotAraM charShaNInAm | shochiShkeshaM vR^iShaNaM yamimA vishaH prAvantu jUtaye vishaH
verses.translation: We sacrificers call you, best of sacrificers, eldest of the Angirases, O sage, with thoughts, with the sages, bright one, with thoughts; like the sky surrounding, the priest of the peoples; of shining hair, the bull, whom these clans help for speed.

verses.sanskrit: स हि पुरू चिदोजसा विरुक्मता दीद्यानो भवति द्रुहन्तरः परशुर्न द्रुहन्तरः । वीडु चिद्यस्य समृतौ श्रुवद्वनेव यत्स्थिरम् । निष्षहमाणो यमते नायते धन्वासहा नायते
verses.transliteration: sa hi purU chidojasA virukmatA dIdyAno bhavati druhantaraH parashurna druhantaraH | vIDu chidyasya samR^itau shruvadvaneva yatsthiram | niShShahamANo yamate nAyate dhanvAsahA nAyate
verses.translation: For he shines with great strength with golden brightness, overcoming harmers, like an axe overcoming harmers; whose firm one, even in the clash, is heard like a forest; he subdues and restrains the foe, he does not go, he does not go from the bow.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने तव श्रवो वयो महि भ्राजन्ते अर्चयो विभावसो । बृहद्भानो शवसा वाजमुक्थ्य३ं दधासि दाशुषे कवे
verses.transliteration: agne tava shravo vayo mahi bhrAjante archayo vibhAvaso | bR^ihadbhAno shavasA vAjamukthya3M dadhAsi dAshuShe kave
verses.translation: Agni, your fame and vigor are great; your flames shine, O wealth-shiner; great-radiant, with strength you give praiseworthy force to the giver, O seer.

verses.sanskrit: पावकवर्चाः शुक्रवर्चा अनूनवर्चा उदियर्षि भानुना । पुत्रो मातरा विचरन्नुपावसि पृणक्षि रोदसी उभे
verses.transliteration: pAvakavarchAH shukravarchA anUnavarchA udiyarShi bhAnunA | putro mAtarA vicharannupAvasi pR^iNakShi rodasI ubhe
verses.translation: Of purifying splendor, bright splendor, undiminished splendor, you rise with light; a son moving between his parents, you protect and fill both worlds.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपाज्जातवेदः सुशस्तिभिर्मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः । त्वे इषः सं दधुर्भूरिवर्पसश्चित्रोतयो वामजाताः
verses.transliteration: Urjo napAjjAtavedaH sushastibhirmandasva dhItibhirhitaH | tve iShaH saM dadhurbhUrivarpasashchitrotayo vAmajAtAH
verses.translation: O grandson of strength, Jatavedas, rejoice with good praises, set by thought; in you the nourishments, of many forms, of wondrous help, unborn, have been gathered.

verses.sanskrit: इरज्यन्नग्ने प्रथयस्व जन्तुभिरस्मे रायो अमर्त्य । स दर्शतस्य वपुषो वि राजसि पृणक्षि दर्शतं क्रतुम्
verses.transliteration: irajyannagne prathayasva jantubhirasme rAyo amartya | sa darshatasya vapuSho vi rAjasi pR^iNakShi darshataM kratum
verses.translation: Moving, spread yourself, Agni, with creatures; for us wealth, immortal; you shine with the beautiful body; you fill the beautiful skill.

verses.sanskrit: इष्कर्त्तारमध्वरस्य प्रचेतसं क्षयन्तँ राधसो महः । रातिं वामस्य सुभगां महीमिषं दधासि सानसिँ रयिम्
verses.transliteration: iShkarttAramadhvarasya prachetasaM kShayanta.N rAdhaso mahaH | rAtiM vAmasya subhagAM mahImiShaM dadhAsi sAnasi.N rayim
verses.translation: The maker of the sacrifice, the wise, dwelling in great bounty; you bestow the fortunate gift of the desirable, great strength, the victorious wealth.

verses.sanskrit: ऋतावानं महिषं विश्वदर्शतमग्निँ सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जनाः । श्रुत्कर्णँ सप्रथस्तमं त्वा गिरा दैव्यं मानुषा युगा
verses.transliteration: R^itAvAnaM mahiShaM vishvadarshatamagni.N sumnAya dadhire puro janAH | shrutkarNa.N saprathastamaM tvA girA daivyaM mAnuShA yugA
verses.translation: The people in front set the truthful, great, all-seeing Agni for favor; listening, most widespread, divine; with song, in human ages.

verses.sanskrit: प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुविराभिस्तरति वाजकर्मभिः । यस्य त्वँ सख्यमाविथ
verses.transliteration: pra so agne tavotibhiH suvirAbhistarati vAjakarmabhiH | yasya tva.N sakhyamAvitha
verses.translation: That man crosses over, O Agni, with your helps and heroic deeds of strength — he whose friendship you have favored.

verses.sanskrit: तव द्रप्सो नीलवान्वाश ऋत्विय इन्धानः सिष्णवा ददे । त्वं महीनामुषसामसि प्रियः क्षपो वस्तुषु राजसि
verses.transliteration: tava drapso nIlavAnvAsha R^itviya indhAnaH siShNavA dade | tvaM mahInAmuShasAmasi priyaH kShapo vastuShu rAjasi
verses.translation: Your blue-gray drop is placed seasonally, kindled, sharply; you are dear to the great dawns; you shine in the dwellings of the night.

verses.sanskrit: तमोषधीर्दधिरे गर्भमृत्वियं तमापो अग्निं जनयन्त मातरः । तमित्समानं वनिनश्च वीरुधोऽन्तर्वतीश्च सुवते च विश्वहा
verses.transliteration: tamoShadhIrdadhire garbhamR^itviyaM tamApo agniM janayanta mAtaraH | tamitsamAnaM vaninashcha vIrudho.antarvatIshcha suvate cha vishvahA
verses.translation: The plants held him as the seasonal embryo; the waters, the mothers, begot Agni; the trees and the herbs, and those pregnant ones, give birth to him daily.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निरिन्द्राय पवते दिवि शुक्रो वि राजति । महिषीव वि जायते
verses.transliteration: agnirindrAya pavate divi shukro vi rAjati | mahiShIva vi jAyate
verses.translation: Agni flows for Indra; he shines bright in heaven; he is born like a great one.

verses.sanskrit: यो जागार तमृचः कामयन्ते यो जागार तमु सामानि यन्ति । यो जागार तमयँ सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः
verses.transliteration: yo jAgAra tamR^ichaH kAmayante yo jAgAra tamu sAmAni yanti | yo jAgAra tamaya.N soma Aha tavAhamasmi sakhye nyokAH
verses.translation: Him who is awake the verses desire; him who is awake the chants approach; him who is awake this Soma says, "I dwell in your friendship."

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्जागार तमृचः कामयन्तेग्निर्जागार तमु सामानि यन्ति । अग्निर्जागार तमयँ सोम आह तवाहमस्मि सख्ये न्योकाः
verses.transliteration: agnirjAgAra tamR^ichaH kAmayantegnirjAgAra tamu sAmAni yanti | agnirjAgAra tamaya.N soma Aha tavAhamasmi sakhye nyokAH
verses.translation: Agni is awake; the verses desire him; Agni is awake; the chants approach him; Agni is awake; this Soma says to him, "I dwell in your friendship."

verses.sanskrit: नमः सखिभ्यः पूर्वसद्भ्यो नमः साकन्निषेभ्यः । युञ्जे वाचँ शतपदीम्
verses.transliteration: namaH sakhibhyaH pUrvasadbhyo namaH sAkanniShebhyaH | yu~nje vAcha.N shatapadIm
verses.translation: Homage to the friends who sat before; homage to those who sit together; I yoke the hundred-footed speech.

verses.sanskrit: युञ्जे वाचँ शतपदीं गाये सहस्रवर्त्तनि । गायत्रं त्रैष्टुभं जगत्
verses.transliteration: yu~nje vAcha.N shatapadIM gAye sahasravarttani | gAyatraM traiShTubhaM jagat
verses.translation: I yoke the hundred-footed speech, sing in the thousand-fold course: Gayatra, Traishtubha, Jagata.

verses.sanskrit: गायत्रं त्रैष्टुभं जगद्विश्वा रूपाणि सम्भृता । देवा ओकाँसि चक्रिरे
verses.transliteration: gAyatraM traiShTubhaM jagadvishvA rUpANi sambhR^itA | devA okA.Nsi chakrire
verses.translation: The Gayatra, Traishtubha, Jagata — all forms gathered; the gods have made their dwellings.

verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्ज्योतिर्ज्योतिरग्निरिन्द्रो ज्योतिर्ज्योतिरिन्द्रः । सूर्यो ज्योतिर्ज्योतिः सूर्यः
verses.transliteration: agnirjyotirjyotiragnirindro jyotirjyotirindraH | sUryo jyotirjyotiH sUryaH
verses.translation: Agni is light, light is Agni; Indra is light, light is Indra; the Sun is light, light is the Sun.

verses.sanskrit: पुनरूर्जा नि वर्त्तस्व पुनरग्न इषायुषा । पुनर्नः पाह्यँहसः
verses.transliteration: punarUrjA ni varttasva punaragna iShAyuShA | punarnaH pAhya.NhasaH
verses.translation: Return again with strength, again, Agni, with food and life; again protect us from distress.

verses.sanskrit: सह रय्या नि वर्तस्वाग्ने पिन्वस्व धारया । विश्वप्स्न्या विश्वतस्परि
verses.transliteration: saha rayyA ni vartasvAgne pinvasva dhArayA | vishvapsnyA vishvataspari
verses.translation: Return with wealth, Agni, swell with the stream, all-formed, on all sides.

verses.sanskrit: यदिन्द्राहं यथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् । स्तोता मे गोसखा स्यात्
verses.transliteration: yadindrAhaM yathA tvamIshIya vasva eka it | stotA me gosakhA syAt
verses.translation: If I were as you are, Indra, alone ruling over wealth, my praiser would be a friend with cattle.

verses.sanskrit: शिक्षेयमस्मै दित्सेयँ शचीपते मनीषिणे । यदहं गोपतिः स्याम्
verses.transliteration: shikSheyamasmai ditseya.N shachIpate manIShiNe | yadahaM gopatiH syAm
verses.translation: May I be able to teach this wise man, and wish to give to him, O lord of powers, when I would be lord of cattle.

verses.sanskrit: धेनुष्ट इन्द्र सूनृता यजमानाय सुन्वते । गामश्वं पिप्युषी दुहे
verses.transliteration: dhenuShTa indra sUnR^itA yajamAnAya sunvate | gAmashvaM pipyuShI duhe
verses.translation: Your cow, Indra, truth, gives to the sacrificer who presses, swelling, milking cattle and horses.

verses.sanskrit: आपो हि ष्ठा मयोभुवस्ता न ऊर्जे दधातन । महे रणाय चक्षसे
verses.transliteration: Apo hi ShThA mayobhuvastA na Urje dadhAtana | mahe raNAya chakShase
verses.translation: You waters are indeed bringers of comfort; place us in strength, for great delight and sight.

verses.sanskrit: यो वः शिवतमो रसस्तस्य भाजयतेह नः । उशतीरिव मातरः
verses.transliteration: yo vaH shivatamo rasastasya bhAjayateha naH | ushatIriva mAtaraH
verses.translation: Give us here a share of your most auspicious essence, like longing mothers.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मा अरं गमाम वो यस्य क्षयाय जिन्वथ । आपो जनयथा च नः
verses.transliteration: tasmA araM gamAma vo yasya kShayAya jinvatha | Apo janayathA cha naH
verses.translation: We come fully to that for whose dwelling you quicken us, O waters; and you beget us.

verses.sanskrit: वात आ वातु बेषजँ शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे । प्र न अयूँषि तारिषत्
verses.transliteration: vAta A vAtu beShaja.N shambhu mayobhu no hR^ide | pra na ayU.NShi tAriShat
verses.translation: O wind, blow healing; bring comfort and joy to our hearts, and extend our lives.

verses.sanskrit: उत वात पितासि न उत भ्रातोत नः सखा । स नो जीवातवे कृधि
verses.transliteration: uta vAta pitAsi na uta bhrAtota naH sakhA | sa no jIvAtave kR^idhi
verses.translation: And, Wind, you are our father, and our brother and our friend; make us live.

verses.sanskrit: यददो वात ते गृहे३ऽमृतं निहितं गुहा । तस्यो नो देहि जीवसे
verses.transliteration: yadado vAta te gR^ihe3.amR^itaM nihitaM guhA | tasyo no dehi jIvase
verses.translation: O Wind, the immortality that lies hidden in your house — give us of that for life.

verses.sanskrit: अभि वाजी विश्वरूपो जनित्रँ हिरण्ययं बिभ्रदत्कँ सुपर्णः । सूर्यस्य भानुमृतुथा वसानः परि स्वयं मेधमृज्रो जजान
verses.transliteration: abhi vAjI vishvarUpo janitra.N hiraNyayaM bibhradatka.N suparNaH | sUryasya bhAnumR^ituthA vasAnaH pari svayaM medhamR^ijro jajAna
verses.translation: The racer, all-formed, carrying a golden womb, the fair-winged, taking the seasonal radiance of the sun, clothed by himself, the swift, begot wisdom.

verses.sanskrit: अप्सु रेतः शिश्रिये विश्वरूपं तेजः पृथिव्यामधि यत्सम्बभूव । अन्तरिक्षे स्वं महिमानं मिमानः कनिक्रन्ति वृष्णो अश्वस्य रेतः
verses.transliteration: apsu retaH shishriye vishvarUpaM tejaH pR^ithivyAmadhi yatsambabhUva | antarikShe svaM mahimAnaM mimAnaH kanikranti vR^iShNo ashvasya retaH
verses.translation: Seed lay in the waters, of all forms, the splendor that came into being on the earth; measuring his own greatness in the air, the seed of the bull-horse roars.

verses.sanskrit: अयँ सहस्रा परि युक्ता वसानः सूर्यस्य भानुं यज्ञो दाधार । सहस्रदाः शतदा भूरिदावा धर्त्ता दिवो भुवनस्य विश्पतिः
verses.transliteration: aya.N sahasrA pari yuktA vasAnaH sUryasya bhAnuM yaj~no dAdhAra | sahasradAH shatadA bhUridAvA dharttA divo bhuvanasya vishpatiH
verses.translation: Clothed in a thousand yoked things, the sacrifice has held the radiance of the sun; giver of thousands, of hundreds, bountiful, upholder of heaven, lord of the world.

verses.sanskrit: नाके सुपर्णमुप यत्पतन्तँ हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा । हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य योनौ शकुनं भुरण्युम्
verses.transliteration: nAke suparNamupa yatpatanta.N hR^idA venanto abhyachakShata tvA | hiraNyapakShaM varuNasya dUtaM yamasya yonau shakunaM bhuraNyum
verses.translation: When they saw you flying in the sky as a fair-winged bird, longing, with the heart; golden-winged, Varuna's messenger, a bird nourishing in Yama's seat.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वो गन्धर्वो अधि नाके अस्थात्प्रत्यङ्चित्रा बिभ्रदस्यायुधानि । वसानो अत्कँ सुरभिं दृशे कँ स्व३र्ण नाम जनत प्रियाणि
verses.transliteration: Urdhvo gandharvo adhi nAke asthAtpratya~NchitrA bibhradasyAyudhAni | vasAno atka.N surabhiM dR^ishe ka.N sva3rNa nAma janata priyANi
verses.translation: The Gandharva has stood high in the heaven, carrying wondrous weapons toward us; wearing a fragrant garment to be seen, he, like heaven, begot dear things.

verses.sanskrit: द्रप्सः समुद्रमभि यज्जिगाति पश्यन्गृध्रस्य चक्षसा विधर्मन् । भानुः शुक्रेण शोचिषा चकानस्तृतीये चक्रे रजसि प्रियाणि
verses.transliteration: drapsaH samudramabhi yajjigAti pashyangR^idhrasya chakShasA vidharman | bhAnuH shukreNa shochiShA chakAnastR^itIye chakre rajasi priyANi
verses.translation: When the drop goes to the sea, seeing with the vulture's eye in the rite; the radiant, desiring with bright flame, made dear things in the third sphere.

verses.sanskrit: आशुः शिशानो वृषभो न भीमो घनाघनः क्षोभणश्चर्षणीनाम् । सङ्क्रन्दनोऽनिमिष एकवीरः शतँ सेना अजयत्साकमिन्द्रः
verses.transliteration: AshuH shishAno vR^iShabho na bhImo ghanAghanaH kShobhaNashcharShaNInAm | sa~Nkrandano.animiSha ekavIraH shata.N senA ajayatsAkamindraH
verses.translation: Swift, sharpening, like a terrible bull, the repeated smiter, the shaker of peoples; roaring, unwinking, the one hero, Indra has conquered a hundred armies together.

verses.sanskrit: सङ्क्रन्दनेनानिमिषेण जिष्णुना युत्कारेण दुश्च्यवनेन धृष्णुना । तदिन्द्रेण जयत तत्सहध्वं युधो नर इषुहस्तेन वृष्णा
verses.transliteration: sa~NkrandanenAnimiSheNa jiShNunA yutkAreNa dushchyavanena dhR^iShNunA | tadindreNa jayata tatsahadhvaM yudho nara iShuhastena vR^iShNA
verses.translation: With roaring, unwinking, victorious, with the battle-cry, unshakable, bold — conquer with Indra, withstand it, O men, in battle with the bull with arrows in hand.

verses.sanskrit: स इषुहस्तैः स निषङ्गिभिर्वशी सँस्रष्टा स युध इन्द्रो गणेन । सँ सृष्टजित्सोमपा बाहुशर्ध्यू३ग्रधन्वा प्रतिहिताभिरस्ता
verses.transliteration: sa iShuhastaiH sa niSha~NgibhirvashI sa.NsraShTA sa yudha indro gaNena | sa.N sR^iShTajitsomapA bAhushardhyU3gradhanvA pratihitAbhirastA
verses.translation: He with arrow-handed ones, with quiver-bearing ones, the master, joined, Indra fights with his troop; the soma-drinker, with strong arms, fierce-bowed, the shooter of the arrows set on the string.

verses.sanskrit: बृहस्पते परि दीया रथेन रक्षोहामित्राँ अपबाधमानः । प्रभञ्जन्सेनाः प्रमृणो युधा जयन्नस्माकमेध्यविता रथानाम्
verses.transliteration: bR^ihaspate pari dIyA rathena rakShohAmitrA.N apabAdhamAnaH | prabha~njansenAH pramR^iNo yudhA jayannasmAkamedhyavitA rathAnAm
verses.translation: Brihaspati, go round with your chariot, slaying demons, driving away enemies; breaking armies, crushing in battle, conquering, protector of our chariots.

verses.sanskrit: बलविज्ञायः स्थविरः प्रवीरः सहस्वान्वाजी सहमान उग्रः । अभिवीरो अभिसत्वा सहोजा जैत्रमिन्द्र रथमा तिष्ठ गोवित्
verses.transliteration: balavij~nAyaH sthaviraH pravIraH sahasvAnvAjI sahamAna ugraH | abhivIro abhisatvA sahojA jaitramindra rathamA tiShTha govit
verses.translation: Strong-known, mighty, brave, victorious, a racer, overcoming, fierce; heroic and bold, born of strength, Indra, mount the victorious cattle-finding chariot.

verses.sanskrit: गोत्रभिदं गोविदं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा । इमँ सजाता अनु वीरयध्वमिन्द्रँ सखायो अनु सँ रभध्वम्
verses.transliteration: gotrabhidaM govidaM vajrabAhuM jayantamajma pramR^iNantamojasA | ima.N sajAtA anu vIrayadhvamindra.N sakhAyo anu sa.N rabhadhvam
verses.translation: Shake the cow-pen, the finder of cattle, thunderbolt-armed, victorious in battle, crushing with might; follow him, kinsmen, as heroes, and take hold with him, friends — Indra.

verses.sanskrit: अभि गोत्राणि सहसा गाहमानोऽदयो वीरः शतमन्युरिन्द्रः । दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाडयुध्यो३ऽस्माकँ सेना अवतु प्र युत्सु
verses.transliteration: abhi gotrANi sahasA gAhamAno.adayo vIraH shatamanyurindraH | dushchyavanaH pR^itanAShADayudhyo3.asmAka.N senA avatu pra yutsu
verses.translation: Plunging into the cattle-pens with strength, pitiless hero, hundred-furious Indra, hard to move, conquering armies, unconquerable; may he protect our army in the battles.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र आसां नेता बृहस्पतिर्दक्षिणा यज्ञः पुर एतु सोमः । देवसेनानामभिभञ्जतीनां जयन्तीनां मरुतो यन्त्वग्रम्
verses.transliteration: indra AsAM netA bR^ihaspatirdakShiNA yaj~naH pura etu somaH | devasenAnAmabhibha~njatInAM jayantInAM maruto yantvagram
verses.translation: May Indra be the leader of them, Brihaspati, sacrifice, soma, go before; of the divine armies breaking and conquering, may the Maruts go first.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य वृष्णो वरुणस्य राज्ञ आदित्यानां मरुताँ शर्ध उग्रम् । महामनसां भुवनच्यवानां घोषो देवानां जयतामुदस्थात्
verses.transliteration: indrasya vR^iShNo varuNasya rAj~na AdityAnAM marutA.N shardha ugram | mahAmanasAM bhuvanachyavAnAM ghoSho devAnAM jayatAmudasthAt
verses.translation: The strong wrath of Indra the bull, of king Varuna, of the Adityas and Maruts, great-minded, the shakers of the worlds, the cry of the conquering gods has risen.

verses.sanskrit: उद्धर्षय मघवन्नायुधान्युत्सत्वनां मामकानां मनाँसि । उद्वृत्रहन्वाजिनां वाजिनान्युद्रथानां जयतां यन्तु घोषाः
verses.transliteration: uddharShaya maghavannAyudhAnyutsatvanAM mAmakAnAM manA.Nsi | udvR^itrahanvAjinAM vAjinAnyudrathAnAM jayatAM yantu ghoShAH
verses.translation: Bounteous one, raise up our weapons and the spirits of our brave ones; Vritra-slayer, raise up the strengths of the strong, the cries of our conquering chariots.

verses.sanskrit: अस्माकमिन्द्रः समृतेषु ध्वजेष्वस्माकं या इषवस्ता जयन्तु । अस्माकं वीरा उत्तरे भवन्त्वस्माँ उ देवा अवता हवेषु
verses.transliteration: asmAkamindraH samR^iteShu dhvajeShvasmAkaM yA iShavastA jayantu | asmAkaM vIrA uttare bhavantvasmA.N u devA avatA haveShu
verses.translation: May Indra be with our banners in the meetings; may our arrows conquer; may our heroes be superior; may the gods protect us in the calls.

verses.sanskrit: असौ या सेना मरुतः परेषामभ्येति न ओजसा स्पर्धमाना । तां गूहत तमसापव्रतेन यथैतेषामन्यो अन्यं न जानात्
verses.transliteration: asau yA senA marutaH pareShAmabhyeti na ojasA spardhamAnA | tAM gUhata tamasApavratena yathaiteShAmanyo anyaM na jAnAt
verses.translation: That army of the enemies, O Maruts, which advances against us contending with might — hide it with darkness, no way, so that none of them knows another.

verses.sanskrit: अमीषां चित्तं प्रतिलोभयन्ती गृहाणाङ्गान्यप्वे परेहि । अभि प्रेहि निर्दह हृत्सु शोकैरन्धेनामित्रास्तमसा सचन्ताम्
verses.transliteration: amIShAM chittaM pratilobhayantI gR^ihANA~NgAnyapve parehi | abhi prehi nirdaha hR^itsu shokairandhenAmitrAstamasA sachantAm
verses.translation: Bewildering their minds, seize their limbs and go; go forth, burn; with griefs in their hearts may the enemies be joined to blinding darkness.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेता जयता नर इन्द्रो वः शर्म यच्छतु । उग्रा वः सन्तु बाहवोऽनाधृष्या यथासथ
verses.transliteration: pretA jayatA nara indro vaH sharma yachChatu | ugrA vaH santu bAhavo.anAdhR^iShyA yathAsatha
verses.translation: Go forth, conquer, men; may Indra give you shelter; let your arms be fierce, unassailable as you are.

verses.sanskrit: अवसृष्टा परा पत शरव्ये ब्रह्मसँशिते । गच्छामित्रान्प्र पद्यस्व मामीषां कं च नोच्छिषः
